**Create `apps/web/src/console/shell/console-navigation.ts`:**

```ts
// The console's destinations and who sees them: support everything but Staff, which super admins manage alone
// (spec 5). Hiding is for convenience only; the console's api refuses support's calls there anyway.
import {
  CirclePlusIcon,
  LayersIcon,
  LayoutDashboardIcon,
  ScrollTextIcon,
  ServerCogIcon,
  UserCogIcon,
  type LucideIcon,
} from "lucide-react";
import { consoleRoutes } from "../routes";
import { isSuperAdmin, type ConsoleStaff } from "../session/staff-context";

export interface ConsoleNavigationItem {
  /** Also the message key in the "console.navigation" namespace. */
  key: "home" | "onboard" | "plans" | "jobs" | "log" | "staff";
  href: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  /** Shown to super admins only. */
  superAdminOnly: boolean;
}

export const consoleNavigationItems: readonly ConsoleNavigationItem[] = [
  { key: "home", href: consoleRoutes.home, icon: LayoutDashboardIcon, superAdminOnly: false },
  { key: "onboard", href: consoleRoutes.onboard, icon: CirclePlusIcon, superAdminOnly: false },
  { key: "plans", href: consoleRoutes.plans, icon: LayersIcon, superAdminOnly: false },
  { key: "jobs", href: consoleRoutes.jobs, icon: ServerCogIcon, superAdminOnly: false },
  { key: "log", href: consoleRoutes.log, icon: ScrollTextIcon, superAdminOnly: false },
  { key: "staff", href: consoleRoutes.staff, icon: UserCogIcon, superAdminOnly: true },
];

/** The items this person may use, in order. */
export function visibleConsoleItems(staff: Pick<ConsoleStaff, "level">): ConsoleNavigationItem[] {
  return consoleNavigationItems.filter((item) => !item.superAdminOnly || isSuperAdmin(staff));
}

/** Whether the item is the current page: the dashboard only on its own page, the others on their path and below. */
export function isCurrentConsoleItem(item: ConsoleNavigationItem, pathname: string): boolean {
  return item.href === consoleRoutes.home
    ? pathname === consoleRoutes.home
    : pathname === item.href || pathname.startsWith(`${item.href}/`);
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/shell/console-sign-out.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// Signing out of the console: its query cache empties first, then the app's own sign-out runs (data/session.ts): the
// screen goes at once, other tabs are told, and the sign-in screen opens while the api is told on the way out.
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { LogOutIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { usePageData } from "@/data/providers";

export function ConsoleSignOutButton({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations("console.navigation");
  // The console's own cache: ConsoleProviders' QueryClientProvider is the nearest.
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const page = usePageData();
  const signOut = () => {
    void queryClient.cancelQueries();
    queryClient.clear();
    void page.signOut();
  };
  return (
    <Button variant="ghost" className={className} onClick={signOut}>
      <LogOutIcon aria-hidden="true" />
      {t("signOut")}
    </Button>
  );
}
```

```tsx
};

    <StatusBadge tone="neutral">{t("none")}</StatusBadge>
  ) : (
    <StatusBadge tone={toneOf[status]}>{t(status)}</StatusBadge>
  );
}
```

```ts
// Every message the app shows, by namespace (spec 9.6: next-intl from day one, English only in Phase 1). Each feature
```

```ts
/** The paths rewritten to the api (next.config.ts). */
const SERVER_PATHS = ["/api", "/p", "/webhooks"];

/** /api, /p and /webhooks and everything under them, in any case: Next.js's rewrites ignore case
 * (caseSensitiveRoutes is off by default), so /API/trpc/... reaches the api too. */
function isServerPath(pathname: string): boolean {
  const path = pathname.toLowerCase();
  return SERVER_PATHS.some((prefix) => path === prefix || path.startsWith(`${prefix}/`));
```

**Create `apps/web/src/shell/stop-impersonating.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// Support's way back from impersonating a member (spec 6.1): Better Auth gives support's own session back, the device
// forgets the member's data (data/session.ts), and the console opens with a full page load, so nothing of the
// member's stays in memory either. A stop that fails says why, and the page stays as it is.
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner";
import { authClient, type AuthClient } from "@/data/auth-client";
import { wipeLocalData } from "@/data/session";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { loadPage } from "@/lib/navigate";
import { routes } from "@/lib/routes";

export function StopImpersonatingButton({ auth = authClient }: { auth?: Pick<AuthClient, "stopImpersonating"> }) {
  const t = useTranslations("shell.banners");
  const { authError } = useErrorMessage();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const [stopping, setStopping] = useState(false);

  const stop = async () => {
    setStopping(true);
    const result = await auth.stopImpersonating();
    if (!result.ok) {
      toast.error(authError(result));
      setStopping(false);
      return;
    }
    await wipeLocalData(queryClient);
    loadPage(routes.console);
  };

  return (
    <Button variant="outline" disabled={stopping} onClick={() => void stop()}>
      {stopping && <Spinner />}
      {stopping ? t("stopping") : t("stop")}
    </Button>
  );
}
```

### Task G2: Platform staff need two-factor, and every 5B track finds its api, words and shared pieces ready

The console now refuses platform staff without two-factor sign-in (`SET_UP_TWO_FACTOR`, after `CHANGE_PASSWORD`), and
Task G1's frame sends them to set it up and back; the setup screen says it is the console that asks. The api's tRPC
context gains the database, the files service and the VAPID public key (the browser will ask for it, so one build of
the web app serves every environment), and the five routers the tracks fill (`notifications`, `attachments`,
`documents`, `shareLinks`, `audit`) and `organization.logo` are registered, empty, once. The web app gets a sentence
for every reason a refusal can carry, with a test that reads the api's sources and fails on a reason without one;
`useSubscription()` and `useWriteAccess()`, which answer as request check 2 does, row for row; `uploadFile()`, which
PUTs a file straight to storage with its signed headers, and `formatFileSize()`; a Content-Security-Policy that lets
the browser reach storage (`STORAGE_ORIGIN`); the settings screen's links to the sections the tracks build; every
message namespace the tracks fill, left `{}`; and the shadcn components they use, fitted to DESIGN.md.

**Create `apps/api/test/console-two-factor.test.ts`:**

```ts
// Two-factor sign-in is required of platform staff (spec 6.1: the platform's accounts reach every organization): the
// console refuses staff without it, SET_UP_TWO_FACTOR, until it is on, and a temporary password is replaced first.
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { consoleQuery, createTestConsole, signedInPlatformStaff, type TestConsole } from "./support/console.js";
import { createTestServer, postJson, type TestServer } from "./support/test-server.js";
import { refusalOf } from "./support/trpc.js";
import { enableTwoFactor } from "./support/two-factor.js";

describe("the console's two-factor requirement", () => {
  let server: TestServer;
  let testConsole: TestConsole;

  beforeAll(() => {
    server = createTestServer();
    testConsole = createTestConsole(server);
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await testConsole.close();
    await server.close();
  });

  it("refuses platform staff without two-factor, and lets them in once it is on", async () => {
    const support = await signedInPlatformStaff(server, "support", { twoFactor: false });
    expect(await refusalOf(await consoleQuery(testConsole, "whoAmI", support.jar))).toEqual({
      status: 403,
      reason: "SET_UP_TWO_FACTOR",
    });
    await enableTwoFactor(server, support.jar, support.password);
    expect((await consoleQuery(testConsole, "whoAmI", support.jar)).status).toBe(200);
  });

  it("refuses a super admin's procedures too", async () => {
    const superAdmin = await signedInPlatformStaff(server, "super-admin", { twoFactor: false });
    expect(await refusalOf(await consoleQuery(testConsole, "platformStaff.list", superAdmin.jar))).toEqual({
      status: 403,
      reason: "SET_UP_TWO_FACTOR",
    });
  });

  it("asks for the temporary password to be replaced first, then for two-factor", async () => {
    const newcomer = await signedInPlatformStaff(server, "support", { mustChangePassword: true, twoFactor: false });
    expect(await refusalOf(await consoleQuery(testConsole, "whoAmI", newcomer.jar))).toEqual({
      status: 403,
      reason: "CHANGE_PASSWORD",
    });
    const change = { currentPassword: newcomer.password, newPassword: "their-own-password-1" };
    expect(newcomer.jar.absorb(await postJson(server, "/api/auth/change-password", change, newcomer.jar)).status).toBe(
      200,
    );
    expect(await refusalOf(await consoleQuery(testConsole, "whoAmI", newcomer.jar))).toEqual({
      status: 403,
      reason: "SET_UP_TWO_FACTOR",
    });
  });
});
```

```ts
/**
 * Signs platform staff in again, as the sign-in screen does: the password (staff's own unless another is given), then
 * the authenticator's code when two-factor is on. Returns the new session's cookie jar.
 */
export async function signInPlatformStaffAgain(
  server: TestServer,
  staff: Pick<TestPlatformStaff, "email" | "password" | "secret">,
  password = staff.password,
): Promise<CookieJar> {
  const jar = new CookieJar();
  const response = await signInByEmail(server, jar, staff.email, password);
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`platform staff sign-in failed with ${String(response.status)}`);
  if (staff.secret === null) return jar;
  const code = await codeFor(server, staff.secret);
  const verified = jar.absorb(await postJson(server, "/api/auth/two-factor/verify-totp", { code }, jar));
  if (!verified.ok) throw new Error(`platform staff's code was refused with ${String(verified.status)}`);
  return jar;
}
```

```ts
describe("the storage origin", () => {
  const policyWith = async (env: Record<string, string | undefined>) => {
    const config = await configWith(env);
    const rules = config.headers ? await config.headers() : [];
    const all = rules.find((rule) => rule.source === "/:path*");
    return all?.headers.find((header) => header.key === "Content-Security-Policy")?.value ?? "";
  };

  it("joins the policy's connect-src and img-src, for uploads and images straight from storage", async () => {
    const policy = await policyWith({ NODE_ENV: "production", STORAGE_ORIGIN: "https://files.example.in/" });
    expect(policy).toContain("connect-src 'self' https://files.example.in;");
    expect(policy).toContain("img-src 'self' data: blob: https://files.example.in;");
  });

  it("is local MinIO in development, and nothing in a production build without STORAGE_ORIGIN", async () => {
    expect(await policyWith({ NODE_ENV: "development", STORAGE_ORIGIN: undefined })).toContain(
      "connect-src 'self' http://localhost:9000;",
    );
    expect(await policyWith({ NODE_ENV: "production", STORAGE_ORIGIN: undefined })).toContain("connect-src 'self';");
  });

  it("is refused when it isn't an http(s) origin, when the app is built", async () => {
    await expect(configWith({ NODE_ENV: "production", STORAGE_ORIGIN: "files.example.in" })).rejects.toThrow(
      /STORAGE_ORIGIN/,
    );
  });
});
```

```ts
// The console's steps (spec 6.1, 6.3): platform staff with a temporary password and no two-factor sign in on the one
// sign-in page, replace the password, set two-factor up, and land in the console, each step coming back to it.
import { setUpTwoFactor } from "./support/account-steps";
import { expect, test } from "./support/console";

test("new platform staff replace their temporary password and set up two-factor, then land in the console", async ({
  page,
  newcomer,
}) => {
  await page.goto("/console");
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/sign-in\?next=%2Fconsole$/);
  await page.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Email" }).fill(newcomer.email);
  await page.getByLabel("Password").fill(newcomer.password);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Sign in" }).click();

  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/change-password\?next=%2Fconsole$/);
  await expect(page.getByText("Your admin gave you a temporary password.")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole("link", { name: "Back to your account" })).toHaveCount(0);
  await page.getByLabel("Temporary password").fill(newcomer.password);
  await page.getByLabel("New password", { exact: true }).fill("newcomers-own-password");
  await page.getByLabel("New password again").fill("newcomers-own-password");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Save new password" }).click();

  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/two-factor-setup\?next=%2Fconsole$/);
  await expect(page.getByText("The platform console asks")).toBeVisible();
  await setUpTwoFactor(page, "newcomers-own-password");

  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: "Dashboard" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/console$/);
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/files/file-size.test.ts`:**

```ts
// File sizes as people read them, in Indian English: whole bytes and KB, one decimal from MB up, 1,024 to the step.
// @vitest-environment node
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { formatFileSize } from "@/files/file-size";

describe("formatFileSize", () => {
  it("names bytes, KB, MB and GB", () => {
    expect(formatFileSize(0)).toBe("0 bytes");
    expect(formatFileSize(1)).toBe("1 byte");
    expect(formatFileSize(512)).toBe("512 bytes");
    expect(formatFileSize(860 * 1024)).toBe("860 KB");
    expect(formatFileSize(1.2 * 1024 * 1024)).toBe("1.2 MB");
    expect(formatFileSize(1024 * 1024)).toBe("1 MB");
    expect(formatFileSize(2.5 * 1024 ** 3)).toBe("2.5 GB");
  });

  it("rounds KB to whole numbers, and groups them the Indian way", () => {
    expect(formatFileSize(1500)).toBe("1 KB");
    expect(formatFileSize(1023 * 1024)).toBe("1,023 KB");
    expect(formatFileSize(1024 ** 4 * 3)).toBe("3,072 GB");
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/files/upload.test.ts`:**

```ts
// The browser's upload goes straight to storage (spec 9.2): a PUT to the presigned URL with exactly the headers it
// came with (but Content-Length, which a page may not set: the browser sends the file's size), progress as a
// fraction, and an answer read the way the files module means it: a 2xx, or a 412 to a retry after the first PUT
// arrived, is done; anything else is an UploadError with the status, 0 when storage was never reached.
import type { PresignedUploadOutput } from "@travel-crm/contracts/files";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { UploadError, uploadFile } from "@/files/upload";

/** A stand-in for the browser's XMLHttpRequest: it records the request, and the test plays storage's part. */
class FakeRequest {
  static last: FakeRequest | undefined;
  method = "";
  url = "";
  headers: Record<string, string> = {};
  body: unknown;
  status = 0;
  aborted = false;
  upload: { onprogress: ((event: { lengthComputable: boolean; loaded: number; total: number }) => void) | null } = {
    onprogress: null,
  };
  onload: (() => void) | null = null;
  onerror: (() => void) | null = null;
  onabort: (() => void) | null = null;

  constructor() {
    FakeRequest.last = this;
  }
  open(method: string, url: string) {
    this.method = method;
    this.url = url;
  }
  setRequestHeader(name: string, value: string) {
    this.headers[name] = value;
  }
  send(body: unknown) {
    this.body = body;
  }
  abort() {
    this.aborted = true;
    this.onabort?.();
  }
  /** Storage answers. */
  answer(status: number) {
    this.status = status;
    this.onload?.();
  }
}

const upload: PresignedUploadOutput = {
  url: "https://storage.example.in/bucket/org/attachment?X-Amz-Signature=abc",
  method: "PUT",
  headers: { "content-type": "image/png", "content-length": "5", "if-none-match": "*" },
  expiresAt: "2026-10-15T18:15:00.000Z",
};

const file = new Blob(["hello"], { type: "image/png" });

function sent(): FakeRequest {
  const request = FakeRequest.last;
  if (!request) throw new Error("nothing was sent");
  return request;
}

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  FakeRequest.last = undefined;
});

describe("uploadFile", () => {
  it("PUTs the file to the presigned URL with its headers, the browser sending the length", async () => {
    vi.stubGlobal("XMLHttpRequest", FakeRequest);
    const done = uploadFile(upload, file);
    expect(sent()).toMatchObject({ method: "PUT", url: upload.url, body: file });
    expect(sent().headers).toEqual({ "content-type": "image/png", "if-none-match": "*" });
    sent().answer(200);
    await expect(done).resolves.toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("reports progress as a fraction, and 1 once storage has the file", async () => {
    vi.stubGlobal("XMLHttpRequest", FakeRequest);
    const progress: number[] = [];
    const done = uploadFile(upload, file, { onProgress: (fraction) => progress.push(fraction) });
    sent().upload.onprogress?.({ lengthComputable: true, loaded: 2, total: 5 });
    sent().upload.onprogress?.({ lengthComputable: false, loaded: 3, total: 0 });
    sent().answer(200);
    await done;
    expect(progress).toEqual([0.4, 1]);
  });

  it("counts a 412 as done: a retried PUT whose first try already arrived", async () => {
    vi.stubGlobal("XMLHttpRequest", FakeRequest);
    const done = uploadFile(upload, file);
    sent().answer(412);
    await expect(done).resolves.toBeUndefined();
  });

  it("fails with storage's status when it refuses, and with 0 when it can't be reached", async () => {
    vi.stubGlobal("XMLHttpRequest", FakeRequest);
    const refused = uploadFile(upload, file);
    sent().answer(403);
    await expect(refused).rejects.toEqual(expect.objectContaining({ name: "UploadError", status: 403 }));
    const unreachable = uploadFile(upload, file);
    sent().onerror?.();
    const error: unknown = await unreachable.catch((reason: unknown) => reason);
    expect(error).toBeInstanceOf(UploadError);
    expect((error as UploadError).status).toBe(0);
  });

  it("stops when its signal says so, before or during the upload", async () => {
    vi.stubGlobal("XMLHttpRequest", FakeRequest);
    const stopping = new AbortController();
    const done = uploadFile(upload, file, { signal: stopping.signal });
    stopping.abort();
    expect(sent().aborted).toBe(true);
    await expect(done).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: "AbortError" });
    FakeRequest.last = undefined;
    await expect(uploadFile(upload, file, { signal: stopping.signal })).rejects.toMatchObject({ name: "AbortError" });
    expect(FakeRequest.last).toBeUndefined();
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/lib/error-reasons.test.ts`:**

```ts
// @vitest-environment node
// Every reason a refusal can carry has its sentence (spec 9.7: the web app shows the reason's own message), and every
// sentence belongs to a reason something still throws. The reasons are read from the api's sources: the second
// argument of every `new DomainError(...)` in packages/domain, packages/api and apps/api, and, where that argument is
// a parameter of a helper (`notFound(reason, ...)`, `parseInput(..., reason)`), what every call of the helper passes.
import { readdirSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import errors from "@/i18n/messages/en-IN/errors.json";

const repository = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "../../../..");
const SOURCES = ["packages/domain/src", "packages/api/src", "apps/api/src"];

/** Reasons no screen can meet: the console commands' own (`console-command.ts`) and notify()'s, which only modules call. */
const NEVER_SHOWN = ["DEMO_CODE_TAKEN", "DEMO_PLAN_KEY_TAKEN", "SUPER_ADMIN_EXISTS", "INVALID_NOTIFICATION"];

const REASON = /"([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]*)"/g;

function sourceFiles(): string[] {
  return SOURCES.flatMap((folder) =>
    readdirSync(path.join(repository, folder), { recursive: true, encoding: "utf8" })
      .filter((file) => /\.tsx?$/.test(file))
      .map((file) => readFileSync(path.join(repository, folder, file), "utf8")),
  );
}

/** The top-level arguments of the call whose opening parenthesis is at `open`, as source text. */
function argumentsAt(text: string, open: number): string[] {
  const found: string[] = [];
  let depth = 0;
  let quote: string | null = null;
  let current = "";
  for (let index = open; index < text.length; index += 1) {
    const character = text.charAt(index);
    if (quote !== null) {
      if (character === "\\") index += 1;
      else if (character === quote) quote = null;
      current += character;
      continue;
    }
    if (character === '"' || character === "'" || character === "`") quote = character;
    if ("([{".includes(character)) depth += 1;
    if (")]}".includes(character)) depth -= 1;
    if (depth === 0) return [...found, current];
    if (character === "," && depth === 1) {
      found.push(current);
      current = "";
    } else if (index > open) {
      current += character;
    }
  }
  return found;
}

/** Every call of `callee` in the text: its arguments. */
function callsOf(text: string, callee: string): string[][] {
  const pattern = new RegExp(`(?<![\\w.])${callee.replace(/[.*+?^${}()|[\]\\]/g, "\\$&")}\\s*(?:<[^>()]*>)?\\(`, "g");
  return [...text.matchAll(pattern)].map((match) => argumentsAt(text, match.index + match[0].length - 1));
}

/** The helper a DomainError's reason parameter comes from: the nearest function before `at` that takes `parameter`. */
function helperTaking(text: string, at: number, parameter: string): { name: string; position: number } | null {
  const before = text.slice(0, at);
  const helpers = [...before.matchAll(/(?:function\s+(\w+)\s*(?:<[^>()]*>)?|const\s+(\w+)\s*=\s*)\(/g)];
  const nearest = helpers.at(-1);
  if (!nearest) return null;
  const name = nearest[1] ?? nearest[2] ?? "";
  const parameters = argumentsAt(text, nearest.index + nearest[0].length - 1).map((part) =>
    (part.split(":")[0] ?? "").trim(),
  );
  const position = parameters.indexOf(parameter);
  return position === -1 ? null : { name, position };
}

function thrownReasons(): Set<string> {
  const files = sourceFiles();
  const reasons = new Set<string>();
  const literalsIn = (text: string) => [...text.matchAll(REASON)].map(([, reason]) => reason ?? "");
  for (const text of files) {
    for (const match of text.matchAll(/new DomainError\(/g)) {
      const at = match.index + match[0].length - 1;
      const reason = (argumentsAt(text, at)[1] ?? "").trim();
      const literals = literalsIn(reason);
      const helper = literals.length === 0 ? helperTaking(text, match.index, reason) : null;
      if (helper) {
        const passed = files.flatMap((file) => callsOf(file, helper.name).map((call) => call[helper.position] ?? ""));
        for (const argument of passed) literals.push(...literalsIn(argument));
      } else if (literals.length === 0) {
        // A local such as `step`, compared on the same line: `if (step === "CHANGE_PASSWORD") throw ...`.
        const line = text.slice(text.lastIndexOf("\n", match.index) + 1, text.indexOf("\n", match.index));
        literals.push(...literalsIn(line).slice(0, 1));
      }
      expect(literals.length, `a DomainError with an unreadable reason: ${reason}`).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      for (const literal of literals) reasons.add(literal);
    }
  }
  return reasons;
}

describe("errors.json's reasons", () => {
  const thrown = thrownReasons();
  const sentences = Object.keys(errors.reasons);

  it("give every reason the api can refuse with a sentence", () => {
    const missing = [...thrown].filter((reason) => !sentences.includes(reason) && !NEVER_SHOWN.includes(reason));
    expect(missing.sort()).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("hold no sentence for a reason nothing throws, nor for one no screen can meet", () => {
    expect(sentences.filter((reason) => !thrown.has(reason) || NEVER_SHOWN.includes(reason)).sort()).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("find the reasons wherever they are written: literally, through a helper, or by a local", () => {
    for (const reason of ["LAST_OWNER", "LINK_REVOKED", "INVALID_PREFERENCE", "SET_UP_TWO_FACTOR", "NOT_SOLD_YEARLY"]) {
      expect(thrown, reason).toContain(reason);
    }
  });
});
```

```tsx
// The settings screen leads to the organization's other settings, each shown to the roles that may use it (spec 11:
// navigation follows the caller's permissions): the business profile, branding, business files and documents with

import { screen } from "@testing-library/react";

import { SettingsSections } from "@/organization/settings/settings-sections";
import { member } from "../support/members";

const { sections } = messages.settings;

const links = () => screen.queryAllByRole("link").map((link) => [link.textContent, link.getAttribute("href")]);

describe("SettingsSections", () => {
  it("leads an Owner to every section", () => {

  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/subscription/use-write-access.test.tsx`:**

```tsx
// A button learns whether it may act from the subscription (useWriteAccess): allowed while subscription.get loads
// (the api decides), and otherwise refused with the sentence for the reason the api would give.
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { NextIntlClientProvider } from "next-intl";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { createApiClient, TRPCProvider } from "@/data/trpc";
import { locale, messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { MeProvider } from "@/session/me-context";
import { useSubscription } from "@/subscription/use-subscription";
import { useWriteAccess, type WriteKind } from "@/subscription/write-access";
import { stubApi } from "../support/api-stub";
import { member } from "../support/members";

/** Says whether the subscription has loaded, and what the button would be. */
function Probe({ kind }: { kind?: WriteKind }) {
  const loaded = useSubscription().data !== undefined;
  const { allowed, hint } = useWriteAccess(kind);
  return <p>{`${loaded ? "loaded" : "loading"}, ${allowed ? "allowed" : `refused: ${hint ?? ""}`}`}</p>;
}

function renderProbe(probe: ReactNode, isOwner = false) {
  const queryClient = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } } });
  return render(
    <NextIntlClientProvider locale={locale} messages={messages}>
      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
        <TRPCProvider trpcClient={createApiClient()} queryClient={queryClient}>
          <MeProvider me={member({ isOwner })}>{probe}</MeProvider>
        </TRPCProvider>
      </QueryClientProvider>
    </NextIntlClientProvider>,
  );
}

const subscription = (access: string) => ({
  data: {
    status: "read_only",
    access,
    planName: "Growth",
    modules: [],
    trialEndsOn: null,
    paidThrough: null,
    nextChangeOn: null,
    limits: { seats: 10, whatsappNumbers: 1, storageBytes: 1000 },
  },
});

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("useWriteAccess", () => {
  it("allows while the subscription loads", () => {
    stubApi({ "subscription.get": "never" });
    renderProbe(<Probe />);
    expect(screen.getByText("loading, allowed")).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("refuses a change in a read-only organization, saying why, and allows an export", async () => {
    stubApi({ "subscription.get": subscription("read_only") });
    renderProbe(
      <>
        <Probe />
        <Probe kind="export" />
      </>,
    );
    expect(await screen.findByText(`loaded, refused: ${messages.errors.reasons.ORGANIZATION_READ_ONLY}`)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByText("loaded, allowed")).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("lets an Owner remove staff while suspended, and nobody else", async () => {
    stubApi({ "subscription.get": subscription("export_only") });
    renderProbe(<Probe kind="revoke" />, true);
    renderProbe(<Probe kind="revoke" />, false);
    expect(await screen.findByText("loaded, allowed")).toBeVisible();
    expect(await screen.findByText(`loaded, refused: ${messages.errors.reasons.ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED}`)).toBeVisible();
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/subscription/write-access.test.ts`:**

```ts
// @vitest-environment node
// What the app shows as allowed is what the api will allow (ADR 0021, request check 2): writeAccessOf answers every
// lifecycle state, kind of call and role as assertLifecycleAllows does, read from the domain itself. Tests may read
// the domain (only src is kept to the api's types).
import type { LifecycleAccess, SubscriptionOverview } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { DomainError } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { assertLifecycleAllows, type Entitlements } from "@travel-crm/domain/subscriptions";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { writeAccessOf, type WriteKind } from "@/subscription/write-access";

const states: LifecycleAccess[] = ["full", "read_only", "export_only", "locked"];
const kinds: WriteKind[] = ["change", "revoke", "export"];

function overview(access: LifecycleAccess): SubscriptionOverview {
  return {
    status: "active",
    access,
    planName: "Growth",
    modules: [],
    trialEndsOn: null,
    paidThrough: null,
    nextChangeOn: null,
    limits: { seats: 10, whatsappNumbers: 1, storageBytes: 1_000_000_000 },
  };
}

/** What the api's check 2 answers: allowed, or the refusal's reason. */
function apiAnswer(access: LifecycleAccess, call: { kind: WriteKind; isOwner: boolean }): string | null {
  try {
    assertLifecycleAllows({ access } as Entitlements, call);
    return null;
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof DomainError) return error.reason;
    throw error;
  }
}

describe("writeAccessOf", () => {
  const rows = states.flatMap((access) =>
    kinds.flatMap((kind) => [true, false].map((isOwner) => ({ access, kind, isOwner }))),
  );

  it.each(rows)("answers $access, $kind, Owner $isOwner as the api does", ({ access, kind, isOwner }) => {
    const reason = apiAnswer(access, { kind, isOwner });
    expect(writeAccessOf(overview(access), { kind, isOwner })).toEqual(
      reason === null ? { allowed: true, reason: null } : { allowed: false, reason },
    );
  });

  it("allows while the subscription isn't known: the api decides", () => {
    expect(writeAccessOf(undefined, { kind: "change", isOwner: false })).toEqual({ allowed: true, reason: null });
  });

  it("lets every Owner revoke access, read-only and suspended, but nobody once cancelled", () => {
    expect(writeAccessOf(overview("read_only"), { kind: "revoke", isOwner: false }).allowed).toBe(true);
    expect(writeAccessOf(overview("export_only"), { kind: "revoke", isOwner: true }).allowed).toBe(true);
    expect(writeAccessOf(overview("export_only"), { kind: "revoke", isOwner: false })).toEqual({
      allowed: false,
      reason: "ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED",
    });
    expect(writeAccessOf(overview("locked"), { kind: "export", isOwner: true })).toEqual({
      allowed: false,
      reason: "ORGANIZATION_CANCELLED",
    });
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/src/files/file-size.ts`:**

```ts
// A file's size as people read it, in Indian English: "512 bytes", "860 KB", "1.2 MB". 1,024 bytes to the step, as
// file managers count; whole bytes and KB, one decimal from MB up. Bytes are spelt out by Intl; KB, MB and GB are
// symbols, as ₹ is (Intl's own "kB" isn't what Indian file managers show).
import { formatIndianNumber } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";

const SYMBOLS = ["KB", "MB", "GB"] as const;
const STEP = 1024;

const bytesFormat = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", { style: "unit", unit: "byte", unitDisplay: "long" });
const oneDecimal = new Intl.NumberFormat("en-IN", { maximumFractionDigits: 1 });

export function formatFileSize(bytes: number): string {
  if (bytes < STEP) return bytesFormat.format(bytes);
  let size = bytes / STEP;
  let step = 0;
  while (size >= STEP && step < SYMBOLS.length - 1) {
    size /= STEP;
    step += 1;
  }
  const shown = step === 0 ? formatIndianNumber(Math.round(size)) : oneDecimal.format(size);
  return `${shown} ${SYMBOLS[step] ?? "GB"}`;
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/files/upload.ts`:**

```ts
// Sends a file straight to storage (spec 9.2: file bytes never pass through the api): a PUT to the presigned URL
// with the headers it was signed with, so storage refuses a file of another type or size, or one that would replace
// a file already there. The files module's confirmation follows; a retried PUT answered 412 means the first arrived.
import type { PresignedUploadOutput } from "@travel-crm/contracts/files";

/** Storage refused the upload (its HTTP status), or couldn't be reached (0). */
export class UploadError extends Error {
  readonly status: number;

  constructor(status: number) {
    super(status === 0 ? "Storage couldn't be reached" : `Storage refused the upload with ${String(status)}`);
    this.name = "UploadError";
    this.status = status;
  }
}

/**
 * Headers a page may not set (the Fetch standard's forbidden request headers): the browser sends Content-Length
 * itself, from the file's size, which is the size the URL was signed for.
 */
const SENT_BY_THE_BROWSER = new Set(["content-length"]);

/** 412: the URL refuses to replace a stored file (`if-none-match: *`), so a retry finds the first upload arrived. */
const ALREADY_THERE = 412;

/** PUTs file to the presigned URL with exactly its headers; 2xx or 412 (a retry after it arrived) resolves. */
export function uploadFile(
  upload: PresignedUploadOutput,
  file: Blob,
  options: { onProgress?: (fraction: number) => void; signal?: AbortSignal } = {},
): Promise<void> {
  const { onProgress, signal } = options;
  /** The signal's own reason when it gave one (AbortController.abort's is an AbortError), else an AbortError. */
  const stopped = (): Error =>
    signal?.reason instanceof Error ? signal.reason : new DOMException("The upload was stopped", "AbortError");
  if (signal?.aborted) return Promise.reject(stopped());
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    // XMLHttpRequest, not fetch: only it reports an upload's progress in every browser.
    const request = new XMLHttpRequest();
    request.open(upload.method, upload.url);
    for (const [name, value] of Object.entries(upload.headers)) {
      if (!SENT_BY_THE_BROWSER.has(name.toLowerCase())) request.setRequestHeader(name, value);
    }
    request.upload.onprogress = (event) => {
      if (event.lengthComputable && event.total > 0) onProgress?.(event.loaded / event.total);
    };
    request.onload = () => {
      if ((request.status >= 200 && request.status < 300) || request.status === ALREADY_THERE) {
        onProgress?.(1);
        resolve();
      } else {
        reject(new UploadError(request.status));
      }
    };
    request.onerror = () => {
      reject(new UploadError(0));
    };
    request.onabort = () => {
      reject(stopped());
    };
    signal?.addEventListener(
      "abort",
      () => {
        request.abort();
      },
      { once: true },
    );
    request.send(file);
  });
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/organization/settings/settings-sections.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// The settings screen's way to the organization's other settings: each section shown to the roles that may use it
// (spec 11: navigation follows the caller's permissions). Hiding is a convenience; the api refuses the rest.
import {
  BuildingIcon,
  ChevronRightIcon,
  FileTextIcon,
  FolderIcon,
  HistoryIcon,
  PaletteIcon,
  type LucideIcon,
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { routes } from "@/lib/routes";
import { holds, useMe } from "@/session/me-context";

interface Section {
  /** Also the message key in "settings.sections", with its hint at `${key}Hint`. */
  key: "profile" | "branding" | "files" | "documents" | "audit";
  href: string;
  icon: LucideIcon;
  requires: string;
}

const sections: readonly Section[] = [
  { key: "profile", href: routes.profile, icon: BuildingIcon, requires: "settings:manage" },
  { key: "branding", href: routes.branding, icon: PaletteIcon, requires: "settings:manage" },
  { key: "files", href: routes.files, icon: FolderIcon, requires: "settings:manage" },
  { key: "documents", href: routes.documents, icon: FileTextIcon, requires: "settings:manage" },
  { key: "audit", href: routes.audit, icon: HistoryIcon, requires: "audit:view" },
];

export function SettingsSections() {
  const t = useTranslations("settings.sections");
  const me = useMe();
  const shown = sections.filter((section) => holds(me, section.requires));
  if (shown.length === 0) return null;
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="sections-heading" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <h2 id="sections-heading" className="text-section font-semibold">
        {t("heading")}
      </h2>
      <ul className="divide-y rounded-lg border">
        {shown.map((section) => (
          <li key={section.key}>
            <Link href={section.href} className="flex min-h-14 items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 hover:bg-accent">
              <section.icon aria-hidden="true" className="size-5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" />
              <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
                <span className="font-medium">{t(section.key)}</span>
                <span className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{t(`${section.key}Hint`)}</span>
              </span>
              <ChevronRightIcon aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" />
            </Link>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```ts
"use client";

// What the member's organization's subscription allows today (subscription.get, spec 7.3): its status and access,
// plan, modules, dates and limits, with no price. Open in every state, so screens can say why something is refused.
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTRPC } from "@/data/trpc";

export function useSubscription() {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  return useQuery(trpc.subscription.get.queryOptions());
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/subscription/write-access.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// Whether a write may go ahead in the organization's lifecycle state today, for showing a button disabled with the
// reason (ADR 0021). It answers as request check 2 does (packages/domain/src/subscriptions/request-rules.ts, whose
// every row a test compares with this): read-only allows exports and revoking access, suspended only the Owner's,
// cancelled nothing. A convenience: the api checks every call itself.
import type { SubscriptionOverview } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useMe } from "@/session/me-context";
import { useSubscription } from "./use-subscription";

/** A change, taking someone's access away (removing staff, a new password), or an export of the organization's data. */
export type WriteKind = "change" | "revoke" | "export";

export type LifecycleRefusal = "ORGANIZATION_READ_ONLY" | "ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED" | "ORGANIZATION_CANCELLED";

/** What check 2 would answer (packages/domain/src/subscriptions/request-rules.ts), from subscription.get. */
export function writeAccessOf(
  overview: SubscriptionOverview | undefined,
  call: { kind: WriteKind; isOwner: boolean },
): { allowed: true; reason: null } | { allowed: false; reason: LifecycleRefusal } {
  const allowed = { allowed: true, reason: null } as const;
  switch (overview?.access) {
    case undefined:
    case "full":
      return allowed;
    case "read_only":
      return call.kind === "change" ? { allowed: false, reason: "ORGANIZATION_READ_ONLY" } : allowed;
    case "export_only":
      return call.kind !== "change" && call.isOwner ? allowed : { allowed: false, reason: "ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED" };
    case "locked":
      return { allowed: false, reason: "ORGANIZATION_CANCELLED" };
  }
}

/** For a button: allowed, or the sentence saying why not. Allowed while subscription.get loads: the api decides. */
export function useWriteAccess(kind: WriteKind = "change"): { allowed: boolean; hint: string | null } {
  const t = useTranslations("errors.reasons");
  const me = useMe();
  const { data } = useSubscription();
  const access = writeAccessOf(data, { kind, isOwner: me.member.role.isOwner });
  return access.allowed ? { allowed: true, hint: null } : { allowed: false, hint: t(access.reason) };
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/components/ui/popover.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "cn";
import { Popover as PopoverPrimitive } from "radix-ui";

function Popover({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof PopoverPrimitive.Root>) {
  return <PopoverPrimitive.Root data-slot="popover" {...props} />;
}

function PopoverTrigger({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof PopoverPrimitive.Trigger>) {
  return <PopoverPrimitive.Trigger data-slot="popover-trigger" {...props} />;
}

function PopoverContent({
  className,
  align = "center",
  sideOffset = 4,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof PopoverPrimitive.Content>) {
  return (
    <PopoverPrimitive.Portal>
      <PopoverPrimitive.Content
        data-slot="popover-content"
        align={align}
        sideOffset={sideOffset}
        className={cn(
          "z-(--z-dialog) flex w-72 origin-(--radix-popover-content-transform-origin) flex-col gap-2.5 rounded-lg bg-popover p-2.5 text-sm text-popover-foreground border shadow-md outline-hidden duration-100 data-[side=bottom]:slide-in-from-top-2 data-[side=left]:slide-in-from-right-2 data-[side=right]:slide-in-from-left-2 data-[side=top]:slide-in-from-bottom-2 data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-open:zoom-in-95 data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-closed:zoom-out-95",
          className,
        )}
        {...props}
      />
    </PopoverPrimitive.Portal>
  );
}

function PopoverAnchor({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof PopoverPrimitive.Anchor>) {
  return <PopoverPrimitive.Anchor data-slot="popover-anchor" {...props} />;
}

function PopoverHeader({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return <div data-slot="popover-header" className={cn("flex flex-col gap-0.5 text-sm", className)} {...props} />;
}

function PopoverTitle({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"h2">) {
  return <div data-slot="popover-title" className={cn("font-medium", className)} {...props} />;
}

function PopoverDescription({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"p">) {
  return <p data-slot="popover-description" className={cn("text-muted-foreground", className)} {...props} />;
}

export { Popover, PopoverAnchor, PopoverContent, PopoverDescription, PopoverHeader, PopoverTitle, PopoverTrigger };
```

```tsx
"use client";

import * as React from "react";
import { cn } from "cn";
import { Tooltip as TooltipPrimitive } from "radix-ui";

function TooltipProvider({ delayDuration = 0, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof TooltipPrimitive.Provider>) {
  return <TooltipPrimitive.Provider data-slot="tooltip-provider" delayDuration={delayDuration} {...props} />;
}

function Tooltip({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof TooltipPrimitive.Root>) {

    <TooltipProvider>
      <TooltipPrimitive.Root data-slot="tooltip" {...props} />
    </TooltipProvider>
  );
}

function TooltipTrigger({ ...props }: React.ComponentProps<typeof TooltipPrimitive.Trigger>) {
  return <TooltipPrimitive.Trigger data-slot="tooltip-trigger" {...props} />;
}

function TooltipContent({
  className,
  sideOffset = 0,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof TooltipPrimitive.Content>) {
  return (
    <TooltipPrimitive.Portal>
      <TooltipPrimitive.Content
        data-slot="tooltip-content"
```

### Task S1: Every screen says where the subscription stands, and a shut organization says why and whom to call

An organization's members now see its subscription's state above every screen, as subscription.get reports it today:
in the trial's last week "Trial ends 22 Oct", while payment is due "Payment due. Read-only from 22 Oct", and while
read-only "Read-only until paid: you can view and export", each in DESIGN.md's status style (a dot and the words on
the status tint) with the organization's calendar days. Suspended, cancelled, or without a subscription at all (the
api refuses `NO_SUBSCRIPTION`), every screen is replaced by one that says what happened, as a status, and how to
reach support (the brand's email and phone); each person's own account stays open (me.get and Better Auth answer in
every state), and while suspended the Owner is shown the way to Staff, which stays open to them, because removing
someone or giving them a new password still works then (ADR 0021). Until subscription.get answers, or when it can't,
the screen shows as before: hiding is a convenience, and the api refuses whatever the state doesn't allow. The
navigation also hides an item whose plan module isn't on the plan (`visibleNavigationItems(me, modules)`), though no
Foundation item belongs to one yet.

**Create `apps/web/test/e2e/support/subscription-states.ts`:**

```ts
// Moves a journey's agency along the subscription lifecycle (spec 7.3), straight in the database as the console's
// nightly job records it: the state begins today and the payment ran out before it. The api works out the state due
// today from these on every request, so the agency is in it at once.
import type { PlatformClient } from "@travel-crm/db/platform";

/** The lifecycle's states after a payment runs out (and cancelled, which a person decides). */
export type UnpaidState = "past_due" | "read_only" | "suspended" | "cancelled";

const DAY = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

export async function setSubscriptionState(
  platform: PlatformClient,
  organizationId: string,
  status: UnpaidState,
): Promise<void> {
  await platform.subscription.update({
    where: { organizationId },
    data: { status, statusChangedAt: new Date(), paidThrough: new Date(Date.now() - 30 * DAY) },
  });
}
```

**`apps/web/test/shell/banners.test.tsx`**, the whole file:

```tsx
// The banners above every screen: support impersonating the member always shows one (spec 6.1), with the way to stop,
// and so does being offline (DESIGN.md); the subscription shows one in the trial's last week, while payment is due
// (with the day read-only begins) and while read-only (spec 7.3). None shows otherwise.
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { NextIntlClientProvider } from "next-intl";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { createApiClient, TRPCProvider } from "@/data/trpc";
import { locale, messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { MeProvider, type SignedInMember } from "@/session/me-context";
import { Banners } from "@/shell/banners";
import { stubApi, type Answer, type ApiStub } from "../support/api-stub";
import { member } from "../support/members";

const { banners } = messages.shell;
const { banner } = messages.subscription;

const subscription = (
  status: string,
  access: string,
  dates: { trialEndsOn?: string; paidThrough?: string; nextChangeOn?: string } = {},
): Answer => ({
  data: {
    status,
    access,
    planName: "Growth",
    modules: [],
    trialEndsOn: null,
    paidThrough: null,
    nextChangeOn: null,
    limits: { seats: 10, whatsappNumbers: 1, storageBytes: 1000 },
    ...dates,
  },
});

const active = subscription("active", "full", { paidThrough: "2027-10-15", nextChangeOn: "2027-10-16" });

/** Renders the banners and waits until subscription.get has answered. */
async function renderBanners(me: SignedInMember, answer: Answer = active) {
  const api: ApiStub = stubApi({ "subscription.get": answer });
  const queryClient = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } } });
  const view = render(
    <NextIntlClientProvider locale={locale} messages={messages}>
      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
        <TRPCProvider trpcClient={createApiClient()} queryClient={queryClient}>
          <MeProvider me={me}>
            <Banners />
          </MeProvider>
        </TRPCProvider>
      </QueryClientProvider>
    </NextIntlClientProvider>,
  );
  await waitFor(() => {
    expect(api.calls).toContain("subscription.get");
    expect(queryClient.isFetching()).toBe(0);
  });
  return view;
}

beforeEach(() => {
  // Only the clock is fake, so the query cache's timers still run. 16 Oct 2026, 11:30 am in India.
  vi.useFakeTimers({ toFake: ["Date"] });
  vi.setSystemTime(new Date("2026-10-16T06:00:00Z"));
});

afterEach(() => {
  vi.useRealTimers();
  vi.restoreAllMocks();
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("Banners", () => {
  it("says so while support is signed in as the member", async () => {
    await renderBanners(member({ impersonatedBy: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000ad" }));
    expect(screen.getByText(banners.impersonated)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: banners.stop })).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("shows nothing for the member themselves, online, with the subscription paid", async () => {
    const { container } = await renderBanners(member());
    expect(container).toBeEmptyDOMElement();
  });

  it("says so while the device is offline", async () => {
    vi.spyOn(navigator, "onLine", "get").mockReturnValue(false);
    await renderBanners(member());
    expect(screen.getByRole("status")).toHaveTextContent(banners.offline);
  });

  it("says when the trial ends, in its last week only", async () => {
    await renderBanners(member(), subscription("trial", "full", { trialEndsOn: "2026-10-22" }));
    expect(screen.getByText("Trial ends 22 Oct")).toBeVisible();
    const { container } = await renderBanners(member(), subscription("trial", "full", { trialEndsOn: "2026-10-23" }));
    expect(container).toBeEmptyDOMElement();
  });

  it("says payment is due, and the day the organization becomes read-only", async () => {
    await renderBanners(member(), subscription("past_due", "full", { nextChangeOn: "2026-10-22" }));
    expect(screen.getByText("Payment due. Read-only from 22 Oct")).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("says a read-only organization can still view and export", async () => {
    await renderBanners(member({ isOwner: true }), subscription("read_only", "read_only"));
    expect(screen.getByText(banner.readOnly)).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("shows no subscription banner while the subscription can't be read", async () => {
    const { container } = await renderBanners(member(), "offline");
    expect(container).toBeEmptyDOMElement();
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/subscription/calendar-date.test.ts`:**

```ts
// @vitest-environment node
// A subscription's days as the organization's calendar shows them (DESIGN.md section 9): "22 Oct" this year,
// "5 Jan 2027" in another, the year counted by the organization's clocks, and never the day before in any zone.
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { formatCalendarDate } from "@/subscription/calendar-date";

describe("formatCalendarDate", () => {
  const now = new Date("2026-10-16T06:00:00Z");

  it("shows a day of this year without the year, and another year's with it", () => {
    expect(formatCalendarDate("2026-10-22", { timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata", now })).toBe("22 Oct");
    expect(formatCalendarDate("2027-01-05", { timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata", now })).toBe("5 Jan 2027");
  });

  it("counts this year by the organization's clocks", () => {
    // 20:00 UTC on 31 December is already New Year's Day in India, but not yet in New York.
    const newYearsEve = new Date("2026-12-31T20:00:00Z");
    expect(formatCalendarDate("2027-01-05", { timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata", now: newYearsEve })).toBe("5 Jan");
    expect(formatCalendarDate("2027-01-05", { timeZone: "America/New_York", now: newYearsEve })).toBe("5 Jan 2027");
  });

  it("shows the day itself, whichever side of UTC the zone is", () => {
    expect(formatCalendarDate("2026-10-22", { timeZone: "America/Los_Angeles", now })).toBe("22 Oct");
```

```tsx
// The subscription shuts an organization's screens (spec 7.3): suspended, cancelled or never set up, the screen is
// replaced by what happened and how to reach support, and while suspended the Owner is shown the way to Staff,
// which stays open to them. Until subscription.get answers, and in every other state, the screen shows.
import { brand } from "@travel-crm/brand";
import type { LifecycleAccess, SubscriptionStatus } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { NextIntlClientProvider } from "next-intl";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { createApiClient, TRPCProvider } from "@/data/trpc";
import { locale, messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { MeProvider } from "@/session/me-context";
import { SubscriptionGate } from "@/subscription/subscription-gate";
import { stubApi, type Answer } from "../support/api-stub";
import { member } from "../support/members";

const pathname = vi.hoisted(() => ({ current: "/" }));
vi.mock("next/navigation", () => ({ usePathname: () => pathname.current }));

const { locked } = messages.subscription;

const statusOf: Record<LifecycleAccess, SubscriptionStatus> = {
  full: "active",
  read_only: "read_only",
  export_only: "suspended",
  locked: "cancelled",
};

const subscription = (access: LifecycleAccess): Answer => ({
  data: {
    status: statusOf[access],
    access,
    planName: "Growth",
    modules: [],
    trialEndsOn: null,
    paidThrough: null,
    nextChangeOn: null,
    limits: { seats: 10, whatsappNumbers: 1, storageBytes: 1000 },
  },
});

/** Renders the gate around a stand-in screen at `path`, and waits until subscription.get has answered (or not). */
async function renderGate(answer: Answer, { path = "/", isOwner = false }: { path?: string; isOwner?: boolean } = {}) {
  pathname.current = path;
  const api = stubApi({ "subscription.get": answer });
  const queryClient = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false } } });
  render(
    <NextIntlClientProvider locale={locale} messages={messages}>
      <QueryClientProvider client={queryClient}>
        <TRPCProvider trpcClient={createApiClient()} queryClient={queryClient}>
          <MeProvider me={member({ isOwner })}>
            <SubscriptionGate>
              <p>The screen</p>
            </SubscriptionGate>
          </MeProvider>
        </TRPCProvider>
      </QueryClientProvider>
    </NextIntlClientProvider>,
  );
  if (answer === "never") return;
  await waitFor(() => {
    expect(api.calls).toContain("subscription.get");
    expect(queryClient.isFetching()).toBe(0);
  });
}

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("SubscriptionGate", () => {
  it("shows the screen while the subscription loads, when it can't be read, and while read-only", async () => {
    await renderGate("never");
    expect(screen.getByText("The screen")).toBeVisible();
    await renderGate("offline");
    await renderGate(subscription("read_only"));
    expect(screen.getAllByText("The screen")).toHaveLength(3);
  });

  it("replaces a suspended organization's screens with what happened and how to reach support", async () => {
    await renderGate(subscription("export_only"), { path: "/roles" });
    expect(screen.queryByText("The screen")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: locked.suspended.title })).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByText(locked.suspended.status)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: brand.supportEmail })).toHaveAttribute(
      "href",
      `mailto:${brand.supportEmail}`,
    );
    expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: "+91 00000 00000" })).toHaveAttribute("href", `tel:${brand.supportPhone}`);
    expect(screen.queryByRole("link", { name: locked.suspended.toStaff })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("points the Owner of a suspended organization to Staff, which stays open to them", async () => {
    await renderGate(subscription("export_only"), { path: "/settings", isOwner: true });
    expect(screen.getByText(locked.suspended.ownerCanRevoke)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: locked.suspended.toStaff })).toHaveAttribute("href", "/staff");
    await renderGate(subscription("export_only"), { path: "/staff", isOwner: true });
    expect(screen.getByText("The screen")).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("shuts a cancelled organization's every screen, the Owner's Staff too", async () => {
    await renderGate(subscription("locked"), { path: "/staff", isOwner: true });
    expect(screen.queryByText("The screen")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: locked.cancelled.title })).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("link", { name: locked.suspended.toStaff })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it("shuts an organization without a subscription", async () => {
    await renderGate({ status: 403, reason: "NO_SUBSCRIPTION" });
    expect(screen.getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: locked.noSubscription.title })).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByText(locked.noSubscription.status)).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("keeps the person's own account open", async () => {
    await renderGate(subscription("locked"), { path: "/account" });
    expect(screen.getByText("The screen")).toBeVisible();
  });
});
```

```ts
/** Whether the plan's modules (subscription.get's) include the item's; while they are unknown, every item shows. */
export function isOnPlan(item: Pick<NavigationItem, "module">, modules: readonly PlanModule[] | undefined): boolean {
  return item.module === null || modules === undefined || modules.some((module) => module === item.module);
}

/** The items this member may use, in order: their role holds the item's permission, their plan its module. */
export function visibleNavigationItems(me: SignedInMember, modules?: readonly PlanModule[]): NavigationItem[] {
  return navigationItems.filter(
    (item) => (item.requires === null || holds(me, item.requires)) && isOnPlan(item, modules),
  );
}
```

```ts
// A subscription's days as the organization's calendar shows them (DESIGN.md section 9): "22 Oct" this year, "22 Oct
// 2027" in another. subscription.get's dates are calendar days in the organization's time zone, with no time.
import { parseCalendarDate, startOfDayIn } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { formatDay } from "@/lib/format";

/** "22 Oct" in the organization's current year, else "22 Oct 2027". */
export function formatCalendarDate(date: string, { timeZone, now = new Date() }: { timeZone: string; now?: Date }) {
  // The day's first instant in the zone, shown in the same zone, is that day wherever the zone is.
  return formatDay(startOfDayIn(parseCalendarDate(date), timeZone), { timeZone, now });
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/subscription/locks.ts`:**

```ts
// Whether the subscription shuts the organization's screens (spec 7.3): suspended (only the Owner's exports and
// revocations work), cancelled (nothing works) or never set up (NO_SUBSCRIPTION); and the screens that stay open:
// the person's own account (me.get and Better Auth answer in every state), and Staff for the Owner while suspended,
// where removing someone or giving them a new password still works (ADR 0021).
import type { SubscriptionOverview } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { refusalOf } from "@/data/api-error";
import { routes } from "@/lib/routes";

export type Lock = "suspended" | "cancelled" | "noSubscription";

/** From subscription.get's answer, or its refusal. Loading, unreachable or open: no lock (the api decides). */
export function lockOf(overview: SubscriptionOverview | undefined, error: unknown): Lock | null {
  // A failed refresh keeps the last answer beside its error: the refusal is the newer news.
  if (refusalOf(error)?.reason === "NO_SUBSCRIPTION") return "noSubscription";
  switch (overview?.access) {
    case "export_only":
      return "suspended";
    case "locked":
      return "cancelled";
    case undefined:
    case "full":
    case "read_only":
      return null;
  }
}

/** Whether the screen at `pathname` shows despite the lock. */
export function staysOpen(lock: Lock, { pathname, isOwner }: { pathname: string; isOwner: boolean }): boolean {
  if (pathname === routes.account) return true;
  const atStaff = pathname === routes.staff || pathname.startsWith(`${routes.staff}/`);
  return lock === "suspended" && isOwner && atStaff;
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/subscription/subscription-banner.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// The subscription's banner above every screen (spec 7.3): the trial's last week, payment due with the day read-only
// begins, and read-only itself, each in DESIGN.md's status style (a dot and the words, on the status tint) with the
// organization's calendar days. Nothing while subscription.get loads or fails: its refusals speak for themselves.
import { calendarDateIn } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useMe } from "@/session/me-context";
import { formatCalendarDate } from "./calendar-date";
import { noticeOf, type SubscriptionNotice } from "./subscription-notice";
import { useSubscription } from "./use-subscription";

// Written out in full so Tailwind finds every class. Neutral for a trial ending, amber for payment due, red for
// read-only (DESIGN.md's status vocabulary).
const tones: Record<SubscriptionNotice["kind"], { strip: string; dot: string }> = {
  trialEnding: { strip: "bg-status-neutral-fill text-status-neutral-ink", dot: "bg-status-neutral-dot" },
  pastDue: { strip: "bg-status-attention-fill text-status-attention-ink", dot: "bg-status-attention-dot" },
  readOnly: { strip: "bg-status-bad-fill text-status-bad-ink", dot: "bg-status-bad-dot" },
};

export function SubscriptionBanner() {
  const t = useTranslations("subscription.banner");
  const me = useMe();
  const { data } = useSubscription();
  const { timeZone } = me.organization;
  const notice = data ? noticeOf(data, calendarDateIn(new Date(), timeZone)) : null;
  if (!notice) return null;

  const day = (date: string) => formatCalendarDate(date, { timeZone });
  const words = () => {
    switch (notice.kind) {
      case "trialEnding":
        return t("trialEnding", { date: day(notice.on) });
      case "pastDue":
        return notice.readOnlyFrom === null ? t("pastDueUndated") : t("pastDue", { date: day(notice.readOnlyFrom) });
      case "readOnly":
        return t("readOnly");
    }
  };
  return (
    <p className={cn("flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2 text-label", tones[notice.kind].strip)}>
      <span aria-hidden="true" className={cn("size-1.5 shrink-0 rounded-full", tones[notice.kind].dot)} />
      {words()}
    </p>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/subscription/subscription-gate.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// Shuts the organization's screens while its subscription does (spec 7.3): suspended, cancelled or never set up, the
// screen is replaced by one saying what happened and whom to contact, except those locks.ts keeps open. Until
// subscription.get answers, or when it can't, the screen shows: hiding is a convenience, the api refuses the rest.
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useMe } from "@/session/me-context";
import { LockedScreen } from "./locked-screen";
import { lockOf, staysOpen } from "./locks";
import { useSubscription } from "./use-subscription";

export function SubscriptionGate({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const me = useMe();
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const subscription = useSubscription();
  const lock = lockOf(subscription.data, subscription.error);
  if (lock === null || staysOpen(lock, { pathname, isOwner: me.member.role.isOwner })) return children;
  return <LockedScreen lock={lock} />;
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/subscription/subscription-notice.ts`:**

```ts
// What the shell's banner says about the subscription today (spec 7.3: past due is full access plus a warning): the
// trial's last week, payment due with the day read-only begins, and read-only itself. Suspended and cancelled shut
// the screens instead (locks.ts), so they have no banner.
import type { SubscriptionOverview } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { addDays, parseCalendarDate, type CalendarDate } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";

/** How many days before its end, its last day included, a trial says when it ends. */
export const TRIAL_ENDING_DAYS = 7;

export type SubscriptionNotice =
  { kind: "trialEnding"; on: string } | { kind: "pastDue"; readOnlyFrom: string | null } | { kind: "readOnly" };

/** The banner for the subscription on `today`, the organization's day, or null for none. */
export function noticeOf(overview: SubscriptionOverview, today: CalendarDate): SubscriptionNotice | null {
  switch (overview.status) {
    case "trial": {
      const endsOn = overview.trialEndsOn;
      const ending = endsOn !== null && addDays(parseCalendarDate(endsOn), 1 - TRIAL_ENDING_DAYS) <= today;
      return ending ? { kind: "trialEnding", on: endsOn } : null;
    }
    case "past_due":
      return { kind: "pastDue", readOnlyFrom: overview.nextChangeOn };
    case "read_only":
      return { kind: "readOnly" };
    case "active":
    case "suspended":
    case "cancelled":
      return null;
  }
}
```

```tsx
// How to reach the platform's support (spec 10: the brand's email and phone), for an organization whose subscription
// shuts its screens. The phone reads as Indians write it, "+91 98765 43210", in mono (DESIGN.md section 9).
import { brand } from "@travel-crm/brand";
import { MailIcon, PhoneIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";

/** An Indian number in E.164 ("+919876543210") as "+91 98765 43210"; any other as it is stored. */
function formatPhone(phone: string): string {
  return phone.replace(/^\+91(\d{5})(\d{5})$/, "+91 $1 $2");
}

const linkClasses =
  "flex min-h-11 items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2 text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline focus-visible:underline";

export function SupportContacts() {
  const t = useTranslations("subscription.locked");
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="support-heading" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <h2 id="support-heading" className="text-section font-semibold">
        {t("contactHeading")}
      </h2>
      <ul className="divide-y rounded-lg border">
        <li>
          <a href={`mailto:${brand.supportEmail}`} className={linkClasses}>
            <MailIcon aria-hidden="true" className="size-5 shrink-0" />
            <span className="break-all">{brand.supportEmail}</span>
          </a>
        </li>
        <li>
          <a href={`tel:${brand.supportPhone}`} className={linkClasses}>
            <PhoneIcon aria-hidden="true" className="size-5 shrink-0" />
            <span className="numbers">{formatPhone(brand.supportPhone)}</span>
          </a>
        </li>
      </ul>
    </section>
  );
}
```

### Task S2: A read-only organization's screens show what waits for payment, and an Owner can still cut someone off

Plan 5A's staff, roles and settings screens now answer as request check 2 does (`useWriteAccess()`, ADR 0021): while
the subscription refuses changes, adding staff, changing a role, a new role, editing, saving and deleting a role, and
no longer requiring two-factor are shown disabled, with the refusal's own sentence beside them (under the button, at
the top of the actions menu, above the role editor's buttons, as the switch's hint). Taking access away stays open
where the api allows it: removing someone and a new temporary password (the menu's other two actions), and requiring
two-factor, in read-only for anyone with the permission and while suspended for the Owner. The staff screen no longer
waits for the roles list when changes are refused (they are what it is for, and suspended the api refuses it), so the
Owner of a suspended organization sees whom to remove once the api lists staff for them (see the ruling). A refusal
that still happens (the state changed since the screen asked) shows its sentence, as 5A's screens already did. The
organization tests' query cache starts with a paid subscription, so their fake api sees only the calls they are about.

  (`PermissionsEditor` takes `disabled`), `apps/web/src/organization/settings/two-factor-requirement.tsx`
- Test: `apps/web/test/subscription/{staff,roles,settings}-write-access.test.tsx`,
  `apps/web/test/e2e/subscription-staff.spec.ts`; modified: `apps/web/test/organization/{api,render}.tsx`
  (`newQueryClient(subscription = paidSubscription)`; `renderAs` renders with the app's providers)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Task G2's `useWriteAccess(kind = "change"): { allowed: boolean; hint: string | null }` and its kinds
  `"change"`/`"revoke"`; Task S1's `setSubscriptionState` (journeys); plan 5A's staff, roles and settings screens,

  `@trpc/tanstack-react-query` `createTRPCOptionsProxy` (tests only, for `subscription.get`'s query key).
- Produces:

  - Element ids `add-staff-refused`, `new-role-refused`, `role-changes-refused` (each refused button's

```tsx
// A fake api for the organization hooks: every call the app makes waits until the test answers it, so a test can look
// at the screen "before the api answers", answer calls in any order, and refuse them with the api's own reasons. The
// query cache starts with a paid subscription, so the calls a test sees are only the ones it is about.
import type { AppRouter } from "@travel-crm/api";
import type { SubscriptionOverview } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { QueryClient, QueryClientProvider } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { createTRPCOptionsProxy } from "@trpc/tanstack-react-query";
import { render } from "@testing-library/react";
```

Replace:

```tsx

export function newQueryClient() {
  return new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false }, mutations: { retry: false } } });
}
```

with:

```tsx

/** subscription.get's answer for an organization that has paid: every change goes ahead. */
export const paidSubscription: SubscriptionOverview = {
  status: "active",
  access: "full",
  planName: "Growth",
  modules: [],
  trialEndsOn: null,
  paidThrough: "2027-10-15",
  nextChangeOn: "2027-10-16",
  limits: { seats: 10, whatsappNumbers: 1, storageBytes: 1_000_000_000 },
};

/**
 * A query cache for these tests. The screens ask for the subscription before offering a change (useWriteAccess): it
 * holds `subscription`, never stale, so it is never asked for; null leaves it to the api like any other call.
 */
export function newQueryClient(subscription: SubscriptionOverview | null = paidSubscription) {
  const queryClient = new QueryClient({ defaultOptions: { queries: { retry: false }, mutations: { retry: false } } });
  if (subscription) {
    const trpc = createTRPCOptionsProxy<AppRouter>({ client: createApiClient(), queryClient });
    queryClient.setQueryDefaults(trpc.subscription.get.queryKey(), { staleTime: Infinity });
    queryClient.setQueryData(trpc.subscription.get.queryKey(), subscription);
  }
  return queryClient;
}
```

```tsx
// Renders an organization screen's parts as a signed-in member sees them: with the app's messages, the member, a paid
// subscription, and a phone-sized or wide screen.
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { vi } from "vitest";
import type { SignedInMember } from "@/session/me-context";
import { member } from "../support/members";
import { newQueryClient, renderWithApi } from "./api";

/** jsdom has no matchMedia: answer every query as a screen of the given width would. */
export function screenIs(width: "phone" | "wide"): void {
  vi.stubGlobal(
    "matchMedia",
    vi.fn(() => ({ matches: width === "wide", addEventListener: vi.fn(), removeEventListener: vi.fn() })),
  );
}

export function renderAs(ui: ReactNode, me: SignedInMember = member({ isOwner: true })) {
  return renderWithApi(ui, newQueryClient(), me);
}
```

```tsx
// The roles screens as the subscription allows (ADR 0021): every change to a role is one, so in a read-only
// organization adding a role, editing one, saving and deleting are shown disabled with the reason; paid, they open.
import type { PermissionCatalogEntry, RoleSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/identity";
import type { LifecycleAccess } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import type { QueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { RoleEditorScreen } from "@/organization/roles/role-editor-screen";
import { RolesScreen } from "@/organization/roles/roles-screen";
import { newQueryClient, renderWithApi } from "../organization/api";
import { screenIs } from "../organization/render";
import { stubApi } from "../support/api-stub";

vi.mock("next/navigation", () => ({ useRouter: () => ({ push: vi.fn() }) }));

const { reasons } = messages.errors;

const roles: RoleSummary[] = [
  { key: "org-owner", name: "Owner", isOwner: true, permissions: [], memberCount: 1 },
  {
    key: "sales",
    name: "Sales",
    isOwner: false,
    permissions: [{ permission: "leads:view", scope: "own" }],
    memberCount: 0,
  },
];
const catalog: PermissionCatalogEntry[] = [
  { permission: "leads:view", module: "leads", scoped: true },
  { permission: "staff:manage", module: "staff", scoped: false },
];

function answerFor(access: LifecycleAccess) {
  stubApi({
    "subscription.get": {
      data: {
        status: access === "full" ? "active" : "read_only",
        access,
        planName: "Growth",
        modules: [],
        trialEndsOn: null,
        paidThrough: null,
        nextChangeOn: null,
        limits: { seats: 10, whatsappNumbers: 1, storageBytes: 1000 },
      },
    },
    "roles.list": { data: roles },
    "roles.permissionCatalog": { data: catalog },
  });
}

/** Waits until the screen's calls, the subscription's among them, have been answered. */
async function settled(queryClient: QueryClient) {
  await waitFor(() => {
    expect(queryClient.isFetching()).toBe(0);
  });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  screenIs("wide");
});

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("the roles screens in each state of the subscription", () => {
  it("offer a new role, and every edit, while the subscription is paid", async () => {
    answerFor("full");
    const list = newQueryClient(null);
    renderWithApi(<RolesScreen />, list);
    expect(await screen.findByText("Sales")).toBeVisible();
    await settled(list);
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "New role" })).toBeEnabled();
    answerFor("full");
    const editor = newQueryClient(null);
    renderWithApi(<RoleEditorScreen roleKey="sales" />, editor);
    expect(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Save" })).toBeVisible();
    await settled(editor);
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" })).toBeEnabled();
    expect(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Name" })).toBeEnabled();
  });

  it("read-only, show a new role disabled with the reason", async () => {
    answerFor("read_only");
    renderWithApi(<RolesScreen />, newQueryClient(null));
    const add = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "New role" });
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(add).toBeDisabled();
    });
    expect(add).toHaveAccessibleDescription(reasons.ORGANIZATION_READ_ONLY);
  });

  it("read-only, show the role's name, permissions, saving and deleting disabled, with the reason", async () => {
    answerFor("read_only");
    renderWithApi(<RoleEditorScreen roleKey="sales" />, newQueryClient(null));
    const save = await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Save" });
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(save).toBeDisabled();
    });
    expect(save).toHaveAccessibleDescription(reasons.ORGANIZATION_READ_ONLY);
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete role" })).toBeDisabled();
    expect(screen.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Name" })).toBeDisabled();
    for (const permission of screen.getAllByRole("checkbox")) expect(permission).toBeDisabled();
    expect(screen.getByRole("combobox")).toBeDisabled();
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/subscription/settings-write-access.test.tsx`:**

```tsx
// The two-factor requirement as the subscription allows (ADR 0021): requiring it takes access away from whoever can't
// pass it, so a read-only organization may still turn it on; turning it off loosens sign-in, a change, so read-only
// it is shown disabled with the reason.
import type { LifecycleAccess } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { TwoFactorRequirement } from "@/organization/settings/two-factor-requirement";
import { newQueryClient, renderWithApi } from "../organization/api";
import { stubApi } from "../support/api-stub";
import { member } from "../support/members";

const { reasons } = messages.errors;
const { security } = messages.settings;

/** Renders the switch, and waits until the subscription and the settings have answered. */
async function renderRequirement(access: LifecycleAccess, requireTwoFactor: boolean) {
  stubApi({
    "subscription.get": {
      data: {
        status: access === "full" ? "active" : "read_only",
        access,
        planName: "Growth",
        modules: [],
        trialEndsOn: null,
        paidThrough: null,
        nextChangeOn: null,
        limits: { seats: 10, whatsappNumbers: 1, storageBytes: 1000 },
      },
    },
    "settings.get": { data: { requireTwoFactor } },
  });
  const queryClient = newQueryClient(null);
  renderWithApi(<TwoFactorRequirement />, queryClient, member({ isOwner: true }));
  const requirement = await screen.findByRole("switch", { name: security.requireTwoFactor });
  await waitFor(() => {
    expect(queryClient.isFetching()).toBe(0);
  });
  return requirement;
}

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("the two-factor requirement in each state of the subscription", () => {
  it("can be turned on in a read-only organization", async () => {
    const requirement = await renderRequirement("read_only", false);
    expect(requirement).toBeEnabled();
    expect(screen.getByText(security.requireTwoFactorHint)).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("can't be turned off in a read-only organization, and says why", async () => {
    const requirement = await renderRequirement("read_only", true);
    expect(requirement).toBeDisabled();
    expect(screen.getByText(reasons.ORGANIZATION_READ_ONLY)).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("can be turned off by an Owner while the subscription is paid", async () => {
    const requirement = await renderRequirement("full", true);
    expect(requirement).toBeEnabled();
  });
});
```
