```tsx
// The staff screen as the subscription allows (ADR 0021): read-only, adding staff and changing a role are shown
// disabled with the reason, while removing someone and a new password stay open; suspended, the Owner still sees the
// list and can remove someone though the roles list is refused; and a refusal that still happens says why.
import type { RoleSummary, StaffMember } from "@travel-crm/contracts/identity";
import type { LifecycleAccess, SubscriptionStatus } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { screen, waitFor, within } from "@testing-library/react";

import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { StaffScreen } from "@/organization/staff/staff-screen";
import { newQueryClient, renderWithApi } from "../organization/api";
import { screenIs } from "../organization/render";
import { stubApi, type Answer } from "../support/api-stub";
import { member } from "../support/members";

const toast = vi.hoisted(() => ({ success: vi.fn(), error: vi.fn() }));
vi.mock("sonner", () => ({ toast }));

const { reasons } = messages.errors;
const owner = member({ isOwner: true });

const person = (memberId: string, name: string, role: StaffMember["role"]): StaffMember => ({
  memberId,
  userId: `${memberId}-user`,
  name,
  email: null,
  username: name.split(" ")[0]?.toLowerCase() ?? null,
  role,
  twoFactorEnabled: false,
  mustChangePassword: false,
  joinedAt: "2026-01-02T05:00:00.000Z",
});

const staff = [
  person(owner.member.memberId, "Asha Sharma", { key: "org-owner", name: "Owner" }),
  person("0199a000-0000-7000-8000-00000000000a", "Ravi Kumar", { key: "sales", name: "Sales" }),
];
const roles: RoleSummary[] = [
  { key: "org-owner", name: "Owner", isOwner: true, permissions: [], memberCount: 1 },
  { key: "sales", name: "Sales", isOwner: false, permissions: [], memberCount: 1 },
];

const statusOf: Record<LifecycleAccess, SubscriptionStatus> = {
  full: "active",
  read_only: "read_only",
  export_only: "suspended",
  locked: "cancelled",
};

function renderStaff(access: LifecycleAccess, answers: Record<string, Answer> = {}) {
  stubApi({
    "subscription.get": {
      data: {
        status: statusOf[access],
        access,
        planName: "Growth",
        modules: [],
        trialEndsOn: null,
        paidThrough: null,
        nextChangeOn: null,
        limits: { seats: 10, whatsappNumbers: 1, storageBytes: 1000 },
      },
    },
    "staff.list": { data: staff },
    "roles.list": { data: roles },
    ...answers,
  });
  const queryClient = newQueryClient(null);
  renderWithApi(<StaffScreen />, queryClient, owner);
  return queryClient;
}

async function openActionsForRavi() {
  await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Actions for Ravi Kumar" }));
  return screen.findByRole("menu");
}

beforeEach(() => {
  screenIs("wide");
  toast.error.mockClear();
});

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("the staff screen in each state of the subscription", () => {
  it("offers every change while the subscription is paid", async () => {
    const queryClient = renderStaff("full");
    const add = await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Add staff" });
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(queryClient.isFetching()).toBe(0);
    });
    expect(add).toBeEnabled();
    const menu = await openActionsForRavi();
    expect(within(menu).getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Change role" })).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-disabled");
  });

  it("read-only, shows adding staff and changing a role disabled with the reason, and leaves revoking open", async () => {
    renderStaff("read_only");
    const add = await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Add staff" });
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(add).toBeDisabled();
    });
    expect(add).toHaveAccessibleDescription(reasons.ORGANIZATION_READ_ONLY);
    const menu = await openActionsForRavi();
    expect(within(menu).getByText(reasons.ORGANIZATION_READ_ONLY)).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(menu).getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Change role" })).toHaveAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
    expect(within(menu).getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Reset password" })).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-disabled");
    expect(within(menu).getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Remove" })).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-disabled");
  });

  it("suspended, shows the Owner the list to remove someone, though the roles list is refused", async () => {
    renderStaff("export_only", { "roles.list": { status: 403, reason: "ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED" } });
    expect(await screen.findByText("Ravi Kumar")).toBeVisible();
    const add = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Add staff" });
    expect(add).toBeDisabled();
    expect(add).toHaveAccessibleDescription(reasons.ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED);
    const menu = await openActionsForRavi();
    expect(within(menu).getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Change role" })).toHaveAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
    expect(within(menu).getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Remove" })).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-disabled");
  });

  it("says why when the api refuses what the screen still offered", async () => {
    renderStaff("full", { "staff.remove": { status: 403, reason: "ORGANIZATION_CANCELLED" } });
    const menu = await openActionsForRavi();
    await userEvent.click(within(menu).getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Remove" }));
    const confirm = await screen.findByRole("alertdialog", { name: "Remove Ravi Kumar?" });
    await userEvent.click(within(confirm).getByRole("button", { name: "Remove" }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(toast.error).toHaveBeenCalledWith(reasons.ORGANIZATION_CANCELLED, { duration: Infinity });
    });
  });
});
```

## Track B: The business profile (the profile, the setup checklist, business files)

Spec 7.1 (the Owner completes what onboarding left out, on a setup checklist), 9.2 (files straight between the
browser and storage) and 5 (sensitive files), on plan 4's `organization.profile`, `organization.setup` and plan 3's
files module. The Owner fills in the business profile (the GSTIN and its state, address, contact, bank account,
invoice prefix) and watches the checklist tick on their home. The agency keeps its own papers (a GST certificate, a
PAN card, a cancelled cheque) in a files panel any record's screen can reuse: checked before sending, uploaded with
its progress, downloaded by a short-lived link, sensitive ones kept to the roles allowed to see them. The api change
is the `attachments` router alone, which Task G2 registered empty.

**Worktree.** Track B starts from Task G2's commit in its own worktree and branch:

```bash
cd /Users/ak/personal/travel-crm && git worktree add ../travel-crm-05b-business -b foundation/05b-business foundation/05b-screens
cd /Users/ak/personal/travel-crm-05b-business && source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use >/dev/null && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && pnpm --filter @travel-crm/db generate && pnpm --filter @travel-crm/brand build && pnpm --filter @travel-crm/web generate
```

**Owns (only this track edits them):** `apps/web/src/app/(app)/settings/{profile,files}/**`,
`apps/web/src/app/(app)/setup/**`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/page.tsx` (the home's checklist),
`apps/web/src/business/**`, `apps/web/src/files/**` but Task G2's `upload.ts` and `file-size.ts`,
`apps/web/src/i18n/messages/en-IN/business.json` (Task G2 left it `{}`), `packages/api/src/routers/attachments.ts`,
`apps/api/test/attachments*.test.ts`, `apps/web/test/{business,files}/**` but Task G2's
`test/files/{upload,file-size}.test.ts`, `apps/web/test/e2e/business-*.spec.ts`,
`apps/web/test/e2e/support/business.ts`. Nothing else: no dependency, shadcn component, error reason, route or
message namespace is added (Task G2 made them).

**Rulings made in this track:**

- The Owner's home shows the setup checklist until every step is done, in place of its links to staff, roles and
  settings, which come back afterwards; `/setup` itself is for anyone with `settings:manage`, the api's rule.
- The profile form checks the api's own schema in the browser. A GSTIN that is well formed but another state's names
  the state it belongs to. The phone sits after a fixed `+91`. The form starts again from what the api keeps after a
  save. In a read-only organization the whole form is locked and Save says why.
- `attachments.*` serves one record, the organization itself (record type `organization`, record id the member's
  organization), with `settings:manage`. Any other record is `NOT_FOUND`, as ADR 0011 has a file of another record
  be. Business modules add their records with their own permissions. Changes are `freshProcedure`, as the
  profile's are.
- A download link is a mutation of the `export` kind: no link is cached or saved on the device, and a read-only
  organization (or a suspended one's Owner) can still take its papers away.
- The files panel lives in `src/files/` for any record, with its words in `business.attachments.*`. A file is
  checked before sending (type, empty, 25 MB, name; a typeless `.heic` is a HEIC photo). An upload fails at once
  offline and can be stopped, and a download starts by `location.assign` of the link. A sensitive file the viewer
  may not open is the app's own "Sensitive file", with nothing to do to it.

**Gate for every task in this track** (all green before its commit; Docker must be running, never restart it):

```bash
cd /Users/ak/personal/travel-crm-05b-business && source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use >/dev/null && pnpm run format:check && pnpm exec turbo run typecheck lint test --concurrency=3 && pnpm run depcruise
cd /Users/ak/personal/travel-crm-05b-business/apps/web && source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use >/dev/null && pnpm exec playwright test --project=phone && pnpm exec playwright test --project=desktop
```

### Task B1: The Owner completes the business profile, and the setup checklist ticks on their home

The Owner lands on the setup checklist (spec 7.1) and finishes what onboarding left out. `/settings/profile` edits the
business profile over `organization.profile.get/update`: the legal name, the GSTIN and its state (a GSTIN that is
well formed but another state's is refused before sending, naming the state it belongs to), the address, a contact,
the bank account and the invoice prefix. GSTIN, IFSC, the account number and the phone are mono, and the phone sits
after its `+91`. The form checks the api's own schema (`updateOrganizationProfileInput`) and then shows the profile as
the api keeps it: capitals, E.164, the account's digits. `/setup` shows `organization.setup.get`: each step done or to
do, and each one leads to where it is done (business details, bank details and invoice prefix to the profile,
branding to branding, staff to staff). The Owner's home shows the checklist until every step is done. While the
organization can't make changes, the form is locked and the button says why (`useWriteAccess()`). No api change: plan
4's routers serve it.

**Files:**
- Create: `apps/web/src/app/(app)/settings/profile/page.tsx`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/setup/page.tsx`,
  `apps/web/src/business/profile/{profile-values.ts,use-profile.ts,profile-text-field.tsx,gst-state-select.tsx,profile-form.tsx,profile-screen.tsx}`,
  `apps/web/src/business/setup/{use-setup-checklist.ts,setup-steps.tsx,setup-screen.tsx,home-checklist.tsx}`
- Modify: `apps/web/src/app/(app)/page.tsx` (the Owner's home shows the checklist until it is done),
  `apps/web/src/i18n/messages/en-IN/business.json` (from `{}`)
- Test: `apps/web/test/business/{profile-values.test.ts,profile-screen.test.tsx,setup-checklist.test.tsx,page-titles.test.ts,sent.ts}`,
  `apps/web/test/e2e/business-profile.spec.ts`, `apps/web/test/e2e/support/business.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: plan 4's `organization.profile.get` (`BusinessProfileDetails | null`), `organization.profile.update`
  (`updateOrganizationProfileInput`), `organization.setup.get` (`SetupChecklist`, `SetupStep`); the kernel's
  `gstStates`, `isValidGstin`, `gstStateCodeFromGstin` (`@travel-crm/contracts/kernel`); Task G2's `routes.profile`,
  `routes.setup`, `routes.branding`, the `business` namespace, `useWriteAccess()`; 5A's `RequirePermission`,
  `StatusBadge`, `ErrorState`, `Delayed`, `PageTitle`, `useErrorMessage()`, `useMe()`, `visibleNavigationItems`;
  the tests' `stubApi`, `member`, `renderWithApi`/`newQueryClient` (`test/organization/api.tsx`); the journeys'
  `agency` and `database` fixtures.
- Produces:
  - `@/business/profile/profile-values`: `type ProfileField = keyof UpdateOrganizationProfileInput`,
    `type ProfileValues = Record<ProfileField, string>`, `type ProfileProblem = ProfileField | "gstinOfAnotherState"`,
    `profileValuesOf(profile: BusinessProfileDetails | null): ProfileValues`,

```tsx
// The business profile screen (spec 7.1): the Owner sees what onboarding saved and completes it; the api's own rules
// are checked before anything is sent, a GSTIN of another state named as such; the saved profile comes back as the api
// keeps it and the setup checklist is asked again; a refusal shows its sentence; a read-only organization's Owner may
// look but not save, and reads why.
import type { BusinessProfileDetails } from "@travel-crm/contracts/profile";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { ProfileScreen } from "@/business/profile/profile-screen";
import { useTRPC } from "@/data/trpc";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { stubApi } from "../support/api-stub";
import { member } from "../support/members";
import { newQueryClient, renderWithApi } from "../organization/api";
import { inputsSentTo } from "./sent";

const toast = vi.hoisted(() => ({ success: vi.fn(), error: vi.fn() }));
vi.mock("sonner", () => ({ toast }));

const words = messages.business.profile;

const saved: BusinessProfileDetails = {
  legalName: "Konkan Trails LLP",
  gstin: "27AAPFU0939F1ZV",
  gstStateCode: "27",
  address: null,
  contactName: "Lakshmi Nair",
  contactPhone: "+919820012345",
  bankAccountName: null,
  bankAccountNumber: null,
  bankIfsc: null,
  bankName: null,
  invoicePrefix: null,
  updatedAt: "2026-10-16T05:00:00.000Z",
};

const subscription = (access: "full" | "read_only") => ({
  data: {
    status: access === "full" ? "active" : "read_only",
    access,
    planName: "Growth",
    modules: [],
    trialEndsOn: null,
    paidThrough: null,
    nextChangeOn: null,
    limits: { seats: 10, whatsappNumbers: 1, storageBytes: 1000 },
  },
});

/** Stands in for the setup checklist on another screen: it asks the api again when the profile is saved. */
function ChecklistProbe() {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  useQuery(trpc.organization.setup.get.queryOptions());
  return null;
}

const owner = member({ isOwner: true });

describe("ProfileScreen", () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    toast.success.mockClear();
    toast.error.mockClear();
  });
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  });

  it("shows the saved profile, ids and numbers mono and the phone after its +91", async () => {
    stubApi({ "organization.profile.get": { data: saved }, "subscription.get": subscription("full") });
    renderWithApi(<ProfileScreen />, newQueryClient(), owner);
    expect(await screen.findByLabelText(words.legalName)).toHaveValue("Konkan Trails LLP");
    expect(screen.getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: words.title })).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(words.gstin)).toHaveClass("numbers");
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(words.contactPhone)).toHaveValue("98200 12345");
    expect(screen.getByText("+91")).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByRole("combobox", { name: words.gstState })).toHaveTextContent("Maharashtra");
  });

  it("starts empty, with a state to choose, before any profile was saved", async () => {
    stubApi({ "organization.profile.get": { data: null }, "subscription.get": subscription("full") });
    renderWithApi(<ProfileScreen />, newQueryClient(), owner);
    expect(await screen.findByLabelText(words.legalName)).toHaveValue("");
    expect(screen.getByRole("combobox", { name: words.gstState })).toHaveTextContent(words.chooseState);
  });

  it("names the state a GSTIN belongs to before sending it", async () => {
    const api = stubApi({ "organization.profile.get": { data: saved }, "subscription.get": subscription("full") });
    renderWithApi(<ProfileScreen />, newQueryClient(), owner);
    const gstin = await screen.findByLabelText(words.gstin);
    await userEvent.clear(gstin);
    await userEvent.type(gstin, "29AAPFU0939F1ZR");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: messages.common.save }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.problems.gstinOfAnotherState.replace("{state}", "Karnataka"))).toBeVisible();
    expect(gstin).toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
    expect(api.calls).not.toContain("organization.profile.update");
  });

  it("saves what the api keeps, says so, and asks for the setup checklist again", async () => {
    const api = stubApi({
      "organization.profile.get": { data: saved },
      "subscription.get": subscription("full"),
      "organization.setup.get": { data: { steps: [], done: false } },
    });
    renderWithApi(
      <>
        <ProfileScreen />
        <ChecklistProbe />
      </>,
      newQueryClient(),
      owner,
    );
    await userEvent.type(await screen.findByLabelText(words.address), "12 Hill Road, Mumbai 400050");
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(words.bankIfsc), "hdfc0001234");
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(words.bankAccountNumber), "0012 3456 7890");
    api.answer("organization.profile.update", {
      data: {
        ...saved,
        address: "12 Hill Road, Mumbai 400050",
        bankIfsc: "HDFC0001234",
        bankAccountNumber: "001234567890",
        updatedAt: "2026-10-16T06:00:00.000Z",
      },
    });
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: messages.common.save }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(toast.success).toHaveBeenCalledWith(words.saved);
    });
    expect(inputsSentTo("organization.profile.update")).toEqual([
      {
        ...saved,
        updatedAt: undefined,
        address: "12 Hill Road, Mumbai 400050",
        bankIfsc: "HDFC0001234",
        bankAccountNumber: "001234567890",
      },
    ]);
    // The form shows the profile as the api keeps it.
    expect(await screen.findByDisplayValue("001234567890")).toBeVisible();
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(api.calls.filter((path) => path === "organization.setup.get")).toHaveLength(2);
    });
  });

  it("shows a refusal's sentence and keeps what was typed", async () => {
    stubApi({
      "organization.profile.get": { data: saved },
      "subscription.get": subscription("full"),
      "organization.profile.update": { status: 403, reason: "MISSING_PERMISSION" },
    });
    renderWithApi(<ProfileScreen />, newQueryClient(), owner);
    await userEvent.type(await screen.findByLabelText(words.invoicePrefix), "kt");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: messages.common.save }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(messages.errors.reasons.MISSING_PERMISSION)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(words.invoicePrefix)).toHaveValue("kt");
  });

  it("lets a read-only organization's Owner look, but not save, and says why", async () => {
    stubApi({ "organization.profile.get": { data: saved }, "subscription.get": subscription("read_only") });
    renderWithApi(<ProfileScreen />, newQueryClient(), owner);
    expect(await screen.findByText(messages.errors.reasons.ORGANIZATION_READ_ONLY)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: messages.common.save })).toBeDisabled();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(words.legalName)).toBeDisabled();
  });

  it("says so when the profile didn't load, and tries again", async () => {
    const api = stubApi({ "organization.profile.get": { status: 500 }, "subscription.get": subscription("full") });
    renderWithApi(<ProfileScreen />, newQueryClient(), owner);
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.loadFailed)).toBeVisible();
    api.answer("organization.profile.get", { data: saved });
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: messages.common.tryAgain }));
    expect(await screen.findByLabelText(words.legalName)).toHaveValue("Konkan Trails LLP");
  });
});
```

```ts
// The business profile form speaks the api's own rules (updateOrganizationProfileInput): what it sends is what the api
// keeps, a blank box is no value, and each problem is named by the field it belongs to, a GSTIN of another state among
// them, so the form can say which state the GSTIN is registered in.
import type { BusinessProfileDetails } from "@travel-crm/contracts/profile";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {

const saved: BusinessProfileDetails = {

  bankAccountName: null,
  bankAccountNumber: null,
  bankIfsc: null,
  bankName: null,
  invoicePrefix: null,
  updatedAt: "2026-10-16T05:00:00.000Z",
};

const filled: ProfileValues = {
  legalName: "Konkan Trails LLP",
  gstin: "27aapfu0939f1zv",
  gstStateCode: "27",
  address: "12 Hill Road, Bandra, Mumbai 400050",
  contactName: "Lakshmi Nair",
  contactPhone: "98200 12345",
  bankAccountName: "Konkan Trails LLP",
  bankAccountNumber: "0012 3456 7890",
  bankIfsc: "hdfc0001234",
  bankName: "  ",
  invoicePrefix: "kt",
};

/** A Karnataka GSTIN: well formed, with its check character, but not Maharashtra's. */
const KARNATAKA_GSTIN = "29AAPFU0939F1ZR";

describe("profileValuesOf", () => {
  it("fills the form from the saved profile: a blank for what isn't there, an Indian phone without its +91", () => {
    expect(profileValuesOf(saved)).toEqual({
      legalName: "Konkan Trails LLP",
      gstin: "27AAPFU0939F1ZV",
      gstStateCode: "27",
      address: "12 Hill Road, Bandra, Mumbai 400050",
      contactName: "Lakshmi Nair",
      contactPhone: "98200 12345",
      bankAccountName: "",
      bankAccountNumber: "",
      bankIfsc: "",
      bankName: "",
      invoicePrefix: "",
    });
  });

  it("keeps another country's number whole", () => {
    expect(profileValuesOf({ ...saved, contactPhone: "+442079460958" }).contactPhone).toBe("+442079460958");
  });

  it("starts empty, the state still to choose, before any profile was saved", () => {
    expect(Object.values(profileValuesOf(null))).toEqual(Array<string>(11).fill(""));
  });
});

describe("toProfileInput", () => {
  it("sends what the api keeps: capitals, the phone in E.164, the account's digits, and null for a blank box", () => {
    expect(toProfileInput(filled)).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      input: {
        legalName: "Konkan Trails LLP",
        gstin: "27AAPFU0939F1ZV",
        gstStateCode: "27",
        address: "12 Hill Road, Bandra, Mumbai 400050",
        contactName: "Lakshmi Nair",
        contactPhone: "+919820012345",
        bankAccountName: "Konkan Trails LLP",
        bankAccountNumber: "001234567890",
        bankIfsc: "HDFC0001234",
        bankName: null,
        invoicePrefix: "KT",
      },
    });
  });

  it("names each problem by its field", () => {
    const result = toProfileInput({
      ...filled,
      legalName: " ",
      gstin: "27AAPFU0939F1ZX",
      contactPhone: "12345",
      bankAccountNumber: "12",
      bankIfsc: "HDFC1234567",
      invoicePrefix: "K",
    });
    expect(result).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problems: {
        legalName: "legalName",
        gstin: "gstin",
        contactPhone: "contactPhone",
        bankAccountNumber: "bankAccountNumber",
        bankIfsc: "bankIfsc",
        invoicePrefix: "invoicePrefix",
      },
    });
  });

  it("asks for the state when none was chosen", () => {
    expect(toProfileInput({ ...filled, gstStateCode: "" })).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problems: { gstStateCode: "gstStateCode" },
    });
  });

  it("tells a GSTIN of another state from a mistyped one", () => {
    expect(toProfileInput({ ...filled, gstin: KARNATAKA_GSTIN })).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problems: { gstin: "gstinOfAnotherState" },
    });
    expect(stateNameOfGstin(KARNATAKA_GSTIN.toLowerCase())).toBe("Karnataka");
    expect(stateNameOfGstin("29AAPFU0939F1ZX")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("lets a business without GST registration leave the GSTIN out", () => {
    expect(toProfileInput({ ...filled, gstin: "" })).toMatchObject({ ok: true, input: { gstin: null } });
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/business/sent.ts`:**

```ts
// What the app sent the api, read from the fetch the api stub stands in for (test/support/api-stub.ts): every input a
// procedure was called with, in the order sent, batched calls included.
import { vi } from "vitest";

export function inputsSentTo(path: string): unknown[] {
  return vi.mocked(fetch).mock.calls.flatMap(([input, init]) => {
    const url = new URL(input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input), "http://localhost");
    const paths = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname.replace(/^\/api\/trpc\//, "")).split(",");
    const position = paths.indexOf(path);
    if (position === -1 || typeof init?.body !== "string") return [];
    const body = JSON.parse(init.body) as Record<string, unknown>;
    return [body[String(position)]];
  });
}
```

```tsx
// The setup checklist (spec 7.1): each step says whether it is done and leads to the screen where it is done (the
// business profile for the details, bank account and invoice prefix; branding; staff); the Owner's home shows it until
// everything is done, and then the home it had before; other members' homes never ask for it.
import type { SetupChecklist } from "@travel-crm/contracts/profile";
import { screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import HomePage from "@/app/(app)/page";
import { SetupScreen } from "@/business/setup/setup-screen";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { routes } from "@/lib/routes";
import { stubApi } from "../support/api-stub";
import { member } from "../support/members";
import { newQueryClient, renderWithApi } from "../organization/api";

const words = messages.business.setup;

const halfway: SetupChecklist = {
  steps: [
    { step: "business-details", done: true },
    { step: "bank-details", done: true },
    { step: "invoice-prefix", done: false },
    { step: "branding", done: true },
    { step: "staff", done: false },
  ],
  done: false,
};

const finished: SetupChecklist = {
  steps: halfway.steps.map(({ step }) => ({ step, done: true })),
  done: true,
};

/** Each step's link: where it leads, and whether it says Done or To do. */
const steps = () =>
  screen
    .getAllByRole("link")
    .map((link) => [
      link.getAttribute("href"),
      within(link).queryByText(words.done) ? "done" : within(link).queryByText(words.toDo) ? "to do" : "",
    ]);

describe("SetupScreen", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  });

  it("leads to where each step is done, and says which are", async () => {
    stubApi({ "organization.setup.get": { data: halfway } });
    renderWithApi(<SetupScreen />, newQueryClient());
    expect(await screen.findByRole("link", { name: new RegExp(words.steps["invoice-prefix"].title) })).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: words.title })).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByText(/3 of 5 done/)).toBeVisible();
    expect(steps()).toEqual([
      [routes.profile, "done"],
      [routes.profile, "done"],
      [routes.profile, "to do"],
      [routes.branding, "done"],
      [routes.staff, "to do"],
    ]);
  });

  it("says when everything is set up", async () => {
    stubApi({ "organization.setup.get": { data: finished } });
    renderWithApi(<SetupScreen />, newQueryClient());
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.allDone)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByText(/5 of 5 done/)).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("says so when the checklist didn't load, and tries again", async () => {
    const api = stubApi({ "organization.setup.get": { status: 500 } });
    renderWithApi(<SetupScreen />, newQueryClient());
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.loadFailed)).toBeVisible();
    api.answer("organization.setup.get", { data: halfway });
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: messages.common.tryAgain }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/3 of 5 done/)).toBeVisible();
  });
});

describe("the home's checklist", () => {
  afterEach(() => {
    vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  });

  it("is on the Owner's home until everything is done", async () => {
    stubApi({ "organization.setup.get": { data: halfway } });
    renderWithApi(<HomePage />, newQueryClient(), member({ isOwner: true }));
    const checklist = await screen.findByRole("region", {
      name: words.homeHeading.replace("{organization}", "Sharma Travels"),
    });
    expect(within(checklist).getByText(/3 of 5 done/)).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(checklist).getAllByRole("link")).toHaveLength(5);
    expect(screen.queryByText(messages.shell.home.intro.replace("{organization}", "Sharma Travels"))).toBeNull();
  });

  it("gives way to the Owner's usual home once everything is done", async () => {
    stubApi({ "organization.setup.get": { data: finished } });
    renderWithApi(<HomePage />, newQueryClient(), member({ isOwner: true }));
    expect(
      await screen.findByText(messages.shell.home.intro.replace("{organization}", "Sharma Travels")),
    ).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("region")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("is never asked for on anyone else's home", () => {
    const api = stubApi({ "organization.setup.get": { data: halfway } });
    renderWithApi(<HomePage />, newQueryClient(), member({ permissions: ["settings:manage"] }));
    expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: messages.shell.home.settings })).toBeVisible();
    expect(api.calls).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```ts
// The business profile and the setup checklist (spec 7.1): a newly onboarded Owner lands on the checklist, completes
// the business profile (a GSTIN of another state is refused before it is sent) and watches the steps tick.
import { expectAccessible } from "./support/accessibility";
import { KARNATAKA_GSTIN, ONBOARDED_GSTIN, saveOnboardingProfile } from "./support/business";
import { expect, signInByEmail, test } from "./support/fixtures";

test("a newly onboarded Owner fills the profile and watches the checklist tick", async ({ page, agency, database }) => {
  await saveOnboardingProfile(database.platform, agency.organizationId, "Sharma Travels Private Limited");
  await signInByEmail(page, agency.owner);
  await page.goto("/");
  const checklist = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Finish setting up Sharma Travels" });
  await expect(checklist.getByText("0 of 5 done")).toBeVisible();
  await expectAccessible(page);

  await checklist.getByRole("link", { name: /^Business details/ }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: "Business profile" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByLabel("Legal name")).toHaveValue("Sharma Travels Private Limited");
  await expect(page.getByLabel("GSTIN")).toHaveValue(ONBOARDED_GSTIN);
  await expect(page.getByLabel("Contact phone")).toHaveValue("98200 12345");
  await expectAccessible(page);

  await page.getByLabel("GSTIN").fill(KARNATAKA_GSTIN);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }).click();
  await expect(
    page.getByText("This GSTIN is registered in Karnataka. Choose that state, or check the GSTIN."),
  ).toBeVisible();
  await page.getByLabel("GSTIN").fill(ONBOARDED_GSTIN.toLowerCase());
  await page.getByLabel("Address").fill("14 Linking Road, Bandra West, Mumbai 400050");
  await page.getByLabel("Account name").fill("Sharma Travels Private Limited");
  await page.getByLabel("Account number").fill("0012 3456 7890");
  await page.getByLabel("IFSC").fill("hdfc0001234");
  await page.getByLabel("Bank", { exact: true }).fill("HDFC Bank");
  await page.getByLabel("Invoice prefix").fill("st");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText("The business profile was saved")).toBeVisible();
  // The form shows what the api keeps.
  await expect(page.getByLabel("GSTIN")).toHaveValue(ONBOARDED_GSTIN);
  await expect(page.getByLabel("IFSC")).toHaveValue("HDFC0001234");
  await expect(page.getByLabel("Account number")).toHaveValue("001234567890");
  await expect(page.getByLabel("Invoice prefix")).toHaveValue("ST");

  await page.goto("/setup");
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: "Set up your organization" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText("3 of 5 done")).toBeVisible();
  // The checklist's own links: the navigation has a Staff item too.
  const steps = page.getByRole("main").getByRole("list");
  for (const [step, status] of [
    ["Business details", "Done"],
    ["Bank details", "Done"],
    ["Invoice prefix", "Done"],
    ["Branding", "To do"],
    ["Staff", "To do"],
  ] as const) {
    await expect(
      steps.getByRole("link", { name: new RegExp(`^${step}`) }).getByText(status, { exact: true }),
    ).toBeVisible();
  }
  await page.goto("/");
  await expect(checklist.getByText("3 of 5 done")).toBeVisible();
});
```

```ts
// The business profile a journey's agency starts with: what onboarding (plan 4) saves inside a new organization, its
// legal name, GSTIN, state and contact, written directly in the database as the fixtures write the rest.
import type { PlatformClient } from "@travel-crm/db/platform";

/** Maharashtra's: the agency's GSTIN and state agree. */
export const ONBOARDED_GSTIN = "27AAPFU0939F1ZV";

/** A well-formed GSTIN of Karnataka, with its check character: another state's. */
export const KARNATAKA_GSTIN = "29AAPFU0939F1ZR";

export async function saveOnboardingProfile(
  platform: PlatformClient,
  organizationId: string,
  legalName: string,
): Promise<void> {
  await platform.organizationProfile.create({
    data: {
      organizationId,
      legalName,
      gstin: ONBOARDED_GSTIN,
      gstStateCode: "27",
      contactName: "Asha Sharma",
      contactPhone: "+919820012345",
    },
  });
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The business's GST state, picked from the kernel's list of states and union territories (spec 9.6): it decides
// whether a sale carries CGST and SGST or IGST, and a GSTIN must start with its code.
import { gstStates } from "@travel-crm/contracts/kernel";
import { CircleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Controller, type UseFormReturn } from "react-hook-form";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";
import type { ProfileValues } from "./profile-values";

const ID = "profile-gstStateCode";

export function GstStateSelect({ form, disabled }: { form: UseFormReturn<ProfileValues>; disabled: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations("business.profile");
  return (
    <Controller
      control={form.control}
      name="gstStateCode"
      render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
        <Field data-invalid={fieldState.invalid}>
          <FieldLabel htmlFor={ID}>{t("gstState")}</FieldLabel>
          <Select value={field.value} onValueChange={field.onChange} disabled={disabled}>
            <SelectTrigger
              id={ID}
              ref={field.ref}
              className="h-11 w-full"
              aria-invalid={fieldState.invalid}
              aria-describedby={fieldState.error ? `${ID}-hint ${ID}-error` : `${ID}-hint`}
            >
              <SelectValue placeholder={t("chooseState")} />
            </SelectTrigger>
            <SelectContent>
              {gstStates.map((state) => (
                <SelectItem key={state.code} value={state.code}>
                  {state.name}
                </SelectItem>
              ))}
            </SelectContent>
          </Select>
          <FieldDescription id={`${ID}-hint`}>{t("gstStateHint")}</FieldDescription>
          {fieldState.error && (
            <FieldError id={`${ID}-error`} className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
              <CircleAlertIcon aria-hidden="true" className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" />
              {fieldState.error.message}
            </FieldError>
          )}
        </Field>
      )}
    />
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/business/profile/profile-form.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// The business profile form (spec 7.1): the business, its contact, its bank account and its invoice prefix, checked by
// the api's own schema before anything is sent. Problems show under their boxes and a refusal above the button. While
// the organization can't make changes (ADR 0021), the boxes are locked and the button says why.
import type { BusinessProfileDetails } from "@travel-crm/contracts/profile";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useForm, type FieldErrors, type Resolver } from "react-hook-form";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { FieldDescription, FieldGroup } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { useWriteAccess } from "@/subscription/write-access";
import { GstStateSelect } from "./gst-state-select";
import { ProfileTextField } from "./profile-text-field";
import { profileValuesOf, stateNameOfGstin, toProfileInput, type ProfileValues } from "./profile-values";
import { useSaveProfile } from "./use-profile";

function FormSection({ id, title, hint, children }: { id: string; title: string; hint?: string; children: ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={`${id}-heading`} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
        <h2 id={`${id}-heading`} className="text-section font-semibold">
          {title}
        </h2>
        {hint && <p className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{hint}</p>}
      </div>
      <FieldGroup>{children}</FieldGroup>
    </section>
  );
}

export function ProfileForm({ profile }: { profile: BusinessProfileDetails | null }) {
  const t = useTranslations("business.profile");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const write = useWriteAccess();
  const save = useSaveProfile();
  const resolver: Resolver<ProfileValues> = (values) => {
    const result = toProfileInput(values);
    if (result.ok) return { values, errors: {} };
    const errors: FieldErrors<ProfileValues> = {};
    for (const [field, problem] of Object.entries(result.problems)) {
      errors[field as keyof ProfileValues] = {
        type: "validate",
        message: t(`problems.${problem}`, { state: stateNameOfGstin(values.gstin) ?? "" }),
      };
    }
    return { values: {}, errors };
  };
  const form = useForm<ProfileValues>({ resolver, defaultValues: profileValuesOf(profile) });
  const submit = form.handleSubmit((values) => {
    const result = toProfileInput(values);
    if (result.ok) save.mutate(result.input);
  });

  return (
    <form noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)} className="flex flex-col gap-8">
      <fieldset disabled={!write.allowed} className="flex flex-col gap-8">
        <FormSection id="business" title={t("business")}>
          <ProfileTextField form={form} name="legalName" label={t("legalName")} hint={t("legalNameHint")} />
          <ProfileTextField form={form} name="gstin" label={t("gstin")} hint={t("gstinHint")} mono />
          <GstStateSelect form={form} disabled={!write.allowed} />
          <ProfileTextField form={form} name="address" label={t("address")} autoComplete="street-address" multiline />
        </FormSection>
        <FormSection id="contact" title={t("contact")}>
          <ProfileTextField form={form} name="contactName" label={t("contactName")} autoComplete="name" />
          <ProfileTextField
            form={form}
            name="contactPhone"
            label={t("contactPhone")}
            prefix="+91"
            inputMode="tel"
            autoComplete="tel-national"
            mono
          />
        </FormSection>
        <FormSection id="bank" title={t("bank")} hint={t("bankHint")}>
          <ProfileTextField form={form} name="bankAccountName" label={t("bankAccountName")} />
          <ProfileTextField
            form={form}
            name="bankAccountNumber"
            label={t("bankAccountNumber")}
            inputMode="numeric"
            mono
          />
          <ProfileTextField form={form} name="bankIfsc" label={t("bankIfsc")} mono />
          <ProfileTextField form={form} name="bankName" label={t("bankName")} />
        </FormSection>
        <FormSection id="invoices" title={t("invoices")}>
          <ProfileTextField
            form={form}
            name="invoicePrefix"
            label={t("invoicePrefix")}
            hint={t("invoicePrefixHint")}
            mono
          />
        </FormSection>
      </fieldset>
      {save.isError && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertDescription>{apiError(save.error)}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}
      <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-2">
        <Button
          type="submit"
          disabled={!write.allowed || save.isPending}
          aria-describedby={write.hint ? "profile-write-hint" : undefined}
        >
          {save.isPending ? tCommon("saving") : tCommon("save")}
        </Button>
        {write.hint && <FieldDescription id="profile-write-hint">{write.hint}</FieldDescription>}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/business/profile/profile-screen.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// The business profile screen (spec 7.1): what onboarding saved, for the Owner to complete, and what the setup
// checklist's business details, bank details and invoice prefix steps lead to.
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { PageTitle } from "@/components/page-title";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { ProfileForm } from "./profile-form";
import { useProfile } from "./use-profile";

export function ProfileScreen() {
  const t = useTranslations("business.profile");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  // Always asked again when the screen opens: the copy restored from IndexedDB can predate a change just made.
  const profile = useProfile();

  const body = () => {
    if (profile.isSuccess) {
      // A newer profile (saved here, or elsewhere and refreshed) starts the form again from what the api keeps.
      return <ProfileForm key={profile.data?.updatedAt ?? "new"} profile={profile.data} />;
    }
    if (profile.isError) {
      return (
        <ErrorState message={t("loadFailed")} retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")} onRetry={() => void profile.refetch()} />
      );
    }
    return (
      <Delayed>
        <div role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={tCommon("loading")} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((row) => (
            <Skeleton key={row} className="h-16 w-full" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </Delayed>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex max-w-[720px] flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="flex max-w-[65ch] flex-col gap-2">
        <PageTitle>{t("title")}</PageTitle>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("intro")}</p>
      </div>
      {body()}
    </div>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/business/profile/profile-text-field.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// One labelled box of the business profile form (DESIGN.md section 6: the label above, the hint and any problem below
// it, linked by aria-describedby, the problem with an icon; ids and numbers mono; a phone after its +91).
import { CircleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
import type { UseFormReturn } from "react-hook-form";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import type { ProfileField, ProfileValues } from "./profile-values";

export function ProfileTextField({
  form,
  name,
  label,
  hint,
  mono = false,
  prefix,
  multiline = false,
  autoComplete = "off",
  inputMode,
}: {
  form: UseFormReturn<ProfileValues>;
  name: Exclude<ProfileField, "gstStateCode">;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  /** GSTIN, IFSC, account numbers and phones: mono, tabular, and never respelt or capitalised by the keyboard. */
  mono?: boolean;
  /** Shown before the box, such as +91 before a phone number. */
  prefix?: string;
  multiline?: boolean;
  autoComplete?: string;
  inputMode?: "text" | "numeric" | "tel";
}) {
  const id = `profile-${name}`;
  const error = form.formState.errors[name];
  const describedBy = [hint ? `${id}-hint` : null, error ? `${id}-error` : null].filter((part) => part !== null);
  const box = {
    id,
    autoComplete,
    "aria-invalid": error !== undefined,
    // No attribute at all rather than an empty one, which points at nothing.
    "aria-describedby": describedBy.length > 0 ? describedBy.join(" ") : undefined,
    ...form.register(name),
  };
  return (
    <Field data-invalid={error !== undefined}>
      <FieldLabel htmlFor={id}>{label}</FieldLabel>
      {multiline ? (
        <Textarea rows={3} {...box} />
      ) : (
        <div className="flex">
          {prefix && (
            <span className="numbers flex h-11 items-center rounded-l-sm border border-r-0 border-input bg-muted px-3 text-muted-foreground">
              {prefix}
            </span>
          )}
          <Input
            {...box}
            inputMode={inputMode}
            spellCheck={mono ? false : undefined}
            autoCapitalize={mono ? "characters" : undefined}
            className={cn(mono && "numbers", prefix && "rounded-l-none")}
          />
        </div>
      )}
      {hint && <FieldDescription id={`${id}-hint`}>{hint}</FieldDescription>}
      {error && (
        <FieldError id={`${id}-error`} className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
          <CircleAlertIcon aria-hidden="true" className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" />
          {error.message}
        </FieldError>
      )}
    </Field>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/business/profile/profile-values.ts`:**

```ts
// The business profile form's values, as text, and the api's input made from them. The api's own schema
// (updateOrganizationProfileInput) decides what is valid; each problem is named by the field it belongs to, so the
// form shows its message there, and a GSTIN that is well formed but another state's is told apart from a mistyped one.
import { gstStates, gstStateCodeFromGstin, isValidGstin } from "@travel-crm/contracts/kernel";
import {
  updateOrganizationProfileInput,
  type BusinessProfileDetails,
  type UpdateOrganizationProfileInput,
} from "@travel-crm/contracts/profile";

export type ProfileField = keyof UpdateOrganizationProfileInput;

/** Every box of the form, as typed. A blank box is no value: the api's schema turns "" into null. */
export type ProfileValues = Record<ProfileField, string>;

/** Message keys in "business.profile.problems": the field's own, or a GSTIN of another state than the one chosen. */
export type ProfileProblem = ProfileField | "gstinOfAnotherState";

const FIELDS: readonly ProfileField[] = [
  "legalName",
  "gstin",
  "gstStateCode",
  "address",
  "contactName",
  "contactPhone",
  "bankAccountName",
  "bankAccountNumber",
  "bankIfsc",
  "bankName",
  "invoicePrefix",
];

const isField = (value: unknown): value is ProfileField =>
  typeof value === "string" && (FIELDS as readonly string[]).includes(value);

/** India's numbers are shown after the form's own +91, grouped as people write them: "98765 43210". */
function phoneAsTyped(e164: string): string {
  const national = /^\+91(\d{5})(\d{5})$/.exec(e164);
  return national ? `${national[1] ?? ""} ${national[2] ?? ""}` : e164;
}

/** The form's boxes for the saved profile, or empty ones before any was saved. */
export function profileValuesOf(profile: BusinessProfileDetails | null): ProfileValues {
  const values = Object.fromEntries(FIELDS.map((field) => [field, profile?.[field] ?? ""])) as ProfileValues;
  return { ...values, contactPhone: phoneAsTyped(values.contactPhone) };
}

/** The state a well-formed GSTIN is registered in, by name ("Karnataka"), or null for one that isn't well formed. */
export function stateNameOfGstin(text: string): string | null {
  const gstin = text.trim().toUpperCase();
  if (!isValidGstin(gstin)) return null;
  const code = gstStateCodeFromGstin(gstin);
  return gstStates.find((state) => state.code === code)?.name ?? null;
}

export function toProfileInput(
  values: ProfileValues,
):
  | { ok: true; input: UpdateOrganizationProfileInput }
  | { ok: false; problems: Partial<Record<ProfileField, ProfileProblem>> } {
  const parsed = updateOrganizationProfileInput.safeParse(values);
  if (parsed.success) return { ok: true, input: parsed.data };
  const problems: Partial<Record<ProfileField, ProfileProblem>> = {};
  for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) {
    const field = issue.path[0];
    if (!isField(field) || problems[field] !== undefined) continue;
    // The schema's one rule across fields (a GSTIN starts with its state's code) is a problem of a well-formed GSTIN.
    problems[field] = field === "gstin" && stateNameOfGstin(values.gstin) !== null ? "gstinOfAnotherState" : field;
  }
  return { ok: false, problems };
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/business/profile/use-profile.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// The business profile's calls. Saving puts the profile the api kept (GSTIN and IFSC in capitals, the phone in E.164)
// in the cache at once, so the form shows it, and asks for the setup checklist again, whose steps follow the profile.
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useTRPC } from "@/data/trpc";

export function useProfile() {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  return useQuery(trpc.organization.profile.get.queryOptions());
}

export function useSaveProfile() {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const t = useTranslations("business.profile");
  return useMutation(
    trpc.organization.profile.update.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: async (saved) => {
        queryClient.setQueryData(trpc.organization.profile.get.queryKey(), saved);
        toast.success(t("saved"));
        await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.organization.setup.get.queryKey() });
      },
    }),
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The Owner's home, until the organization is set up (spec 7.1: the Owner lands on the setup checklist): the
// checklist's steps and how far along they are, and once every step is done, the home it shows otherwise.
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { useMe } from "@/session/me-context";
import { SetupSteps, useSetupProgress } from "./setup-steps";
import { useSetupChecklist } from "./use-setup-checklist";

export function HomeChecklist({ afterwards }: { afterwards: ReactNode }) {
  const t = useTranslations("business.setup");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const me = useMe();
  const checklist = useSetupChecklist();
  const progress = useSetupProgress();

  if (checklist.data?.done) return afterwards;
  if (checklist.data) {
    return (
      <section aria-labelledby="setup-heading" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <h2 id="setup-heading" className="text-section font-semibold">
            {t("homeHeading", { organization: me.organization.name })}
          </h2>
          <p className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{progress(checklist.data)}</p>
        </div>
        <SetupSteps checklist={checklist.data} />
      </section>
    );
  }
  if (checklist.isError) {
    return (
      <>
        <ErrorState
          message={t("loadFailed")}
          retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")}
          onRetry={() => void checklist.refetch()}
        />
        {afterwards}
      </>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Delayed>
      <Skeleton role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={tCommon("loading")} className="h-72 w-full" />
    </Delayed>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The setup checklist screen (spec 7.1, spec 11): what an organization does first, each step marked done or to do and
// leading to where it is done, and how far along it is.
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { PageTitle } from "@/components/page-title";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { SetupSteps, useSetupProgress } from "./setup-steps";
import { useSetupChecklist } from "./use-setup-checklist";

export function SetupScreen() {
  const t = useTranslations("business.setup");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const checklist = useSetupChecklist();
  const progress = useSetupProgress();

  const body = () => {
    if (checklist.data) {
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
          <p className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{progress(checklist.data)}</p>
          <SetupSteps checklist={checklist.data} />
          {checklist.data.done && <p>{t("allDone")}</p>}
        </div>
      );
    }
    if (checklist.isError) {
      return (
        <ErrorState
          message={t("loadFailed")}
          retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")}
          onRetry={() => void checklist.refetch()}
        />
      );
    }
    return (
      <Delayed>
        <div role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={tCommon("loading")} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {[0, 1, 2, 3, 4].map((row) => (
            <Skeleton key={row} className="h-14 w-full" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </Delayed>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex max-w-[720px] flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="flex max-w-[65ch] flex-col gap-2">
        <PageTitle>{t("title")}</PageTitle>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("intro")}</p>
      </div>
      {body()}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The setup checklist's steps (spec 7.1), each leading to the screen where it is done: the business profile for the
// details, the bank account and the invoice prefix, then branding and staff. Status is a dot and a word (DESIGN.md).
import type { SetupChecklist, SetupStep } from "@travel-crm/contracts/profile";
import { ChevronRightIcon } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/status-badge";
import { routes } from "@/lib/routes";

const whereDone: Record<SetupStep, string> = {
  "business-details": routes.profile,
  "bank-details": routes.profile,
  "invoice-prefix": routes.profile,
  branding: routes.branding,
  staff: routes.staff,
};

/** "3 of 5 done". */
export function useSetupProgress() {
  const t = useTranslations("business.setup");
  return (checklist: SetupChecklist) =>
    t("progress", { done: checklist.steps.filter((step) => step.done).length, total: checklist.steps.length });
}

export function SetupSteps({ checklist }: { checklist: SetupChecklist }) {
  const t = useTranslations("business.setup");
  return (
    <ol className="divide-y rounded-lg border">
      {checklist.steps.map(({ step, done }) => (
        <li key={step}>
          <Link href={whereDone[step]} className="flex min-h-14 items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3 hover:bg-accent">
            <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
              <span className="font-medium">{t(`steps.${step}.title`)}</span>
              <span className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{t(`steps.${step}.hint`)}</span>
            </span>
            <StatusBadge tone={done ? "good" : "neutral"}>{done ? t("done") : t("toDo")}</StatusBadge>
            <ChevronRightIcon aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" />
          </Link>
        </li>
      ))}
    </ol>
  );
}
```

### Task B2: The agency keeps its own papers, uploaded from the browser straight to storage

The agency keeps its own papers in the app: a GST certificate, a PAN card, licences, a cancelled cheque. The
`attachments` router (empty since Task G2) gets `list`, `requestUpload`, `confirmUpload`, `downloadLink` and `remove`
over plan 3's files module, for the one record the Foundation lets staff attach files to: the organization itself,
with `settings:manage`. Any other record type, or another organization's id, is "not found", as a file of another
record is (ADR 0011). Changes read the session afresh, as the profile's do. A download link is a mutation marked
`export`: it is asked for on the click, so no link is cached or saved on the device, and a read-only organization
can still take its papers away. `/settings/files` shows a reusable `AttachmentsPanel` (`src/files/`). A chosen file
is checked first by the api's own rules (`attachmentContentTypes`, `MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES`, `attachmentFileName`), then
goes straight to storage with its progress (Task G2's `uploadFile`) and is confirmed. A sensitive file shows its name,
download and Remove only to `documents:view_sensitive`; to others it is a "Sensitive file". The storage limit's
refusal reads as its sentence. While the organization can't make changes, uploading and removing are off and say why.
The journey uploads a PDF to MinIO through the browser, which the CSP's `STORAGE_ORIGIN` allows, and downloads it.

  `apps/web/src/business/files/business-files-screen.tsx`, `apps/web/src/app/(app)/settings/files/page.tsx`

  `apps/web/test/business/{page-titles.test.ts,sent.ts}` (a query's input, read from its address),
  `apps/web/test/e2e/support/business.ts` (`addRole`)

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: plan 3's `Files` (`ctx.files`: `list`, `requestUpload`, `confirmUpload`, `downloadLink`, `remove`) and
  `@travel-crm/contracts/files` (`requestUploadInput`, `attachmentRefInput`, `attachmentSummary`, `presignedUpload`,

**Create `apps/api/test/attachments.test.ts`:**

```ts
// The agency's own papers over HTTP (spec 9.2): files on its organization record, uploaded straight to storage and
// confirmed, listed, downloaded by a short-lived link and removed, with settings:manage. Any other record is "not
// found"; a sensitive file's name, download and removal are for documents:view_sensitive; the storage limit refuses
// with its reason; a read-only organization may list and download but not upload or remove.
import type { AttachmentSummary, DownloadLinkOutput, PresignedUploadOutput } from "@travel-crm/contracts/files";
import { createMemoryStorage, type MemoryStorage } from "@travel-crm/integrations/storage";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { CookieJar } from "./support/cookie-jar.js";
import { addStaff, ownerAccess, signedInOwner, signedInStaff } from "./support/people.js";
import { createTestAgency, createTestServer, type TestAgency, type TestServer } from "./support/test-server.js";
import { dataOf, mutate, query, refusalOf } from "./support/trpc.js";

const PDF = new TextEncoder().encode("%PDF-1.4 a GST registration certificate");

interface Uploaded {
  attachment: AttachmentSummary;
  upload: PresignedUploadOutput;
}

describe("attachments", () => {
  let server: TestServer;
  let storage: MemoryStorage;

  beforeAll(() => {
    storage = createMemoryStorage();
    server = createTestServer({}, { storage });
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await server.close();
  });

  const papers = (agency: TestAgency) => ({ recordType: "organization", recordId: agency.organizationId });

  /** Asks for an upload, sends the file as the browser would, and confirms it. */
  async function uploaded(
    agency: TestAgency,
    jar: CookieJar,
    file: { fileName: string; sensitive?: boolean },
  ): Promise<AttachmentSummary> {
    const asked = await dataOf<Uploaded>(
      await mutate(
        server,
        "attachments.requestUpload",
        { ...papers(agency), contentType: "application/pdf", sizeBytes: PDF.byteLength, ...file },
        jar,
      ),
    );
    await storage.upload({ ...asked.upload, expiresAt: new Date(asked.upload.expiresAt) }, PDF, "application/pdf");
    return dataOf<AttachmentSummary>(
      await mutate(server, "attachments.confirmUpload", { ...papers(agency), attachmentId: asked.attachment.id }, jar),
    );
  }

  it("lets the Owner upload the agency's papers, list them, download one by a short-lived link and remove it", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const jar = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    const asked = await dataOf<Uploaded>(
      await mutate(
        server,
        "attachments.requestUpload",
        {
          ...papers(agency),
          fileName: "GST certificate.pdf",
          contentType: "application/pdf",
          sizeBytes: PDF.byteLength,
        },
        jar,
      ),
    );
    expect(asked.attachment).toMatchObject({ status: "pending", sensitive: false, fileName: "GST certificate.pdf" });
    expect(asked.upload).toMatchObject({ method: "PUT", headers: { "content-type": "application/pdf" } });
    expect(new Date(asked.upload.expiresAt).getTime()).toBeGreaterThan(Date.now());
    // Nothing is listed until storage holds the file and the upload is confirmed.
    expect(await dataOf(await query(server, "attachments.list", jar, papers(agency)))).toEqual([]);

    await storage.upload({ ...asked.upload, expiresAt: new Date(asked.upload.expiresAt) }, PDF, "application/pdf");
    const file = { ...papers(agency), attachmentId: asked.attachment.id };
    const ready = await dataOf<AttachmentSummary>(await mutate(server, "attachments.confirmUpload", file, jar));
    expect(ready).toMatchObject({ status: "ready", sizeBytes: PDF.byteLength });
    expect(await dataOf(await query(server, "attachments.list", jar, papers(agency)))).toEqual([ready]);

    const link = await dataOf<DownloadLinkOutput>(await mutate(server, "attachments.downloadLink", file, jar));
    expect(link.url).toContain(encodeURIComponent("GST certificate.pdf"));
    expect(new Date(link.expiresAt).getTime()).toBeGreaterThan(Date.now());

    expect((await mutate(server, "attachments.remove", file, jar)).status).toBe(200);
    expect(await dataOf(await query(server, "attachments.list", jar, papers(agency)))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("refuses any record but the member's own organization, as not found", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const other = await createTestAgency(server);
    const jar = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    const theirs = await uploaded(other, await signedInOwner(server, other), { fileName: "PAN card.pdf" });
    const records = [
      papers(other),
      { recordType: "lead", recordId: crypto.randomUUID() },
      { recordType: "organization_logo", recordId: agency.organizationId },
      { recordType: "issued_document", recordId: crypto.randomUUID() },
    ];
    for (const record of records) {
      const upload = { ...record, fileName: "x.pdf", contentType: "application/pdf", sizeBytes: 10 };
      const file = { ...record, attachmentId: theirs.id };
      for (const response of [
        await query(server, "attachments.list", jar, record),
        await mutate(server, "attachments.requestUpload", upload, jar),
        await mutate(server, "attachments.confirmUpload", file, jar),
        await mutate(server, "attachments.downloadLink", file, jar),
        await mutate(server, "attachments.remove", file, jar),
      ]) {
        expect(await refusalOf(response), record.recordType).toEqual({ status: 404, reason: "NOT_FOUND" });
      }
    }
  });

  it("refuses staff without settings:manage", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const sales = await addStaff(server, agency, { username: "ravi", roleKey: "sales" });
    const jar = await signedInStaff(server, agency, sales);
    expect(await refusalOf(await query(server, "attachments.list", jar, papers(agency)))).toEqual({
      status: 403,
      reason: "MISSING_PERMISSION",
    });
    const upload = { ...papers(agency), fileName: "x.pdf", contentType: "application/pdf", sizeBytes: 10 };
    expect(await refusalOf(await mutate(server, "attachments.requestUpload", upload, jar))).toEqual({
      status: 403,
      reason: "MISSING_PERMISSION",
    });
  });

  it("keeps a sensitive file's name, download and removal to documents:view_sensitive", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const ownerJar = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    const role = await server.identity.roles.create(await ownerAccess(server, agency), {
      name: "Office manager",
      permissions: [{ permission: "settings:manage" }],
    });
    const manager = await addStaff(server, agency, { username: "meera", roleKey: role.key });
    const managerJar = await signedInStaff(server, agency, manager);
    const cheque = await uploaded(agency, ownerJar, { fileName: "Cancelled cheque.pdf", sensitive: true });
    const file = { ...papers(agency), attachmentId: cheque.id };

    expect(await dataOf(await query(server, "attachments.list", managerJar, papers(agency)))).toEqual([
      { ...cheque, fileName: "Sensitive file" },
    ]);
    for (const path of ["attachments.downloadLink", "attachments.remove"]) {
      expect(await refusalOf(await mutate(server, path, file, managerJar)), path).toEqual({
        status: 403,
        reason: "MISSING_PERMISSION",
      });
    }
    expect(await dataOf(await query(server, "attachments.list", ownerJar, papers(agency)))).toEqual([cheque]);
    expect((await mutate(server, "attachments.remove", file, ownerJar)).status).toBe(200);
  });

  it("refuses an upload past the plan's storage limit, with its reason", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const jar = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    const plan = await server.platform.plan.create({
      data: {
        key: `tiny-storage-${agency.organizationId.slice(-12)}`,
        name: "Tiny storage",
        monthlyPricePaise: 0,
        seatLimit: 10,
        whatsappNumberLimit: 0,
        storageLimitBytes: 1000n,
        modules: [],
      },
    });
    await server.platform.subscription.update({
      where: { organizationId: agency.organizationId },
      data: { planId: plan.id },
    });
    const upload = { ...papers(agency), fileName: "Licence.pdf", contentType: "application/pdf", sizeBytes: 1001 };
    expect(await refusalOf(await mutate(server, "attachments.requestUpload", upload, jar))).toEqual({
      status: 403,
      reason: "STORAGE_LIMIT_REACHED",
    });
  });

  it("lets a read-only organization list and download its papers, but not upload or remove them", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const jar = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    const licence = await uploaded(agency, jar, { fileName: "Tour operator licence.pdf" });
    const file = { ...papers(agency), attachmentId: licence.id };
    await server.platform.subscription.update({
      where: { organizationId: agency.organizationId },
      data: { status: "read_only", statusChangedAt: new Date() },
    });
    expect(await dataOf(await query(server, "attachments.list", jar, papers(agency)))).toEqual([licence]);
    expect((await mutate(server, "attachments.downloadLink", file, jar)).status).toBe(200);
    const upload = { ...papers(agency), fileName: "x.pdf", contentType: "application/pdf", sizeBytes: 10 };
    for (const [path, input] of [
      ["attachments.requestUpload", upload],
      ["attachments.remove", file],
    ] as const) {
      expect(await refusalOf(await mutate(server, path, input, jar)), path).toEqual({
        status: 403,
        reason: "ORGANIZATION_READ_ONLY",
      });
    }
  });
});
```

**`apps/web/test/business/sent.ts`**, the whole file:

```ts
// What the app sent the api, read from the fetch the api stub stands in for (test/support/api-stub.ts): every input a
// procedure was called with, in the order sent, batched calls included. A mutation's inputs are in its body, a
// query's in its address.
import { vi } from "vitest";

export function inputsSentTo(path: string): unknown[] {
  return vi.mocked(fetch).mock.calls.flatMap(([input, init]) => {
    const url = new URL(input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input), "http://localhost");
    const paths = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname.replace(/^\/api\/trpc\//, "")).split(",");
    const position = paths.indexOf(path);
    const sent = typeof init?.body === "string" ? init.body : url.searchParams.get("input");
    if (position === -1 || sent === null) return [];
    const inputs = JSON.parse(sent) as Record<string, unknown>;
    return [inputs[String(position)]];
  });
}
```

```ts
// Business files (spec 9.2): an Owner uploads a PDF from the browser straight to storage (MinIO, which the
// Content-Security-Policy allows as STORAGE_ORIGIN), sees it listed and downloads it; a sensitive file is only a
// "Sensitive file" to a role without documents:view_sensitive, with nothing it can do to it.
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import type { Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { expectAccessible } from "./support/accessibility";
import { addRole } from "./support/business";
import { expect, signInByEmail, test } from "./support/fixtures";
import { signInWithCode } from "./support/sign-in-with-code";

const PDF = Buffer.from("%PDF-1.4\n% A GST registration certificate, as far as storage can tell.\n");

/** Uploads a PDF through the screen, as a person picks it from their files. */
async function uploadPdf(page: Page, name: string, { sensitive = false } = {}): Promise<void> {
  if (sensitive) await page.getByRole("checkbox", { name: "Sensitive" }).check();
  const chooser = page.waitForEvent("filechooser");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Upload a file" }).click();
  await (await chooser).setFiles({ name, mimeType: "application/pdf", buffer: PDF });
  await expect(page.getByText(`${name} was uploaded`)).toBeVisible();
}

test("an Owner uploads a PDF to storage through the browser, sees it listed and downloads it", async ({
  page,
  agency,
}) => {
  await signInByEmail(page, agency.owner);
  await page.goto("/settings/files");
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: "Business files" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText("No files yet.", { exact: false })).toBeVisible();
  await expectAccessible(page);

  await uploadPdf(page, "GST certificate.pdf");
  // The screen's own list: a toast is a list item too.
  const row = page.getByRole("main").getByRole("listitem").filter({ hasText: "GST certificate.pdf" });
  await expect(row).toContainText(`PDF · ${String(PDF.byteLength)} bytes · Added`);
  await expectAccessible(page);

  const download = page.waitForEvent("download");
  await row.getByRole("button", { name: "Download GST certificate.pdf" }).click();
  const file = await download;
  expect(file.suggestedFilename()).toBe("GST certificate.pdf");
  expect(await readFile(await file.path())).toEqual(PDF);
});

test("a sensitive file is only a Sensitive file to a role without documents:view_sensitive", async ({
  page,
  browser,
  agency,
  addStaff,
  database,
}) => {
  const roleKey = await addRole(database, agency, { name: "Office manager", permissions: ["settings:manage"] });
  const manager = await addStaff({ name: "Meera Iyer", username: "meera", roleKey });
  await signInByEmail(page, agency.owner);
  await page.goto("/settings/files");
  await uploadPdf(page, "Aadhaar card.pdf", { sensitive: true });
  await expect(page.getByRole("main").getByRole("listitem").filter({ hasText: "Aadhaar card.pdf" })).toContainText(
    "Sensitive",
  );

  // Meera, on her own device, may manage settings but not open sensitive files.
  const meerasPhone = await browser.newContext({ baseURL: process.env.E2E_BASE_URL ?? "" });
  const meera = await meerasPhone.newPage();
  await signInWithCode(meera.request, {
    orgCode: agency.code,
    username: manager.username,
    password: manager.password,
  });
  await meera.goto("/settings/files");
  const row = meera.getByRole("main").getByRole("listitem").filter({ hasText: "Sensitive file" });
  await expect(row).toContainText("Your role can't open sensitive files.");
  await expect(row.getByRole("button")).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(meera.getByText("Aadhaar card.pdf")).toHaveCount(0);
  await expectAccessible(meera);
  await meerasPhone.close();
});
```

```ts
/** A role with just these permissions, made by the agency's Owner. Returns its key, for addStaff. */
export async function addRole(
  database: { identity: Identity; platform: PlatformClient },
  agency: Agency,
  role: { name: string; permissions: string[] },
): Promise<string> {
  const user = await database.platform.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { email: agency.owner.email } });
  const owner = await database.identity.resolveAccess(user.id, agency.organizationId);
  if (!owner) throw new Error("the agency's owner has no access");
  const created = await database.identity.roles.create(owner, {
    name: role.name,
    permissions: role.permissions.map((permission) => ({ permission })),
  });
  return created.key;
}
```

**Create `apps/web/test/files/attachment-file.test.ts`:**

```ts
// A chosen file is checked with the api's own rules before anything is sent (ADR 0011): one of the allowed types
// (a HEIC photo known by its name where the browser can't tell its type), not empty, at most 25 MB, and a name
// without folders or direction characters.
import { MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES } from "@travel-crm/contracts/files";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { checkAttachmentFile, kindOf } from "@/files/attachment-file";

const file = (name: string, type: string, size = 2048) => ({ name, type, size });

describe("checkAttachmentFile", () => {
  it("takes PDFs and photos of papers", () => {
    for (const type of ["application/pdf", "image/jpeg", "image/png", "image/webp", "image/heic"]) {
      expect(checkAttachmentFile(file("paper", type))).toEqual({ ok: true, contentType: type });
    }
  });

  it("knows a HEIC photo by its name when the browser gives it no type", () => {
    expect(checkAttachmentFile(file("IMG_0042.HEIC", ""))).toEqual({ ok: true, contentType: "image/heic" });
  });

  it("refuses other types, which can carry scripts or aren't papers", () => {
    for (const [name, type] of [
      ["logo.svg", "image/svg+xml"],
      ["page.html", "text/html"],
      ["papers.zip", "application/zip"],
      ["notes", ""],
    ] as const) {
      expect(checkAttachmentFile(file(name, type)), name).toEqual({ ok: false, problem: "type" });
    }
  });

  it("refuses an empty file and one over 25 MB", () => {
    expect(checkAttachmentFile(file("blank.pdf", "application/pdf", 0))).toEqual({ ok: false, problem: "empty" });
    expect(checkAttachmentFile(file("scan.pdf", "application/pdf", MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES))).toMatchObject({ ok: true });
    expect(checkAttachmentFile(file("scan.pdf", "application/pdf", MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES + 1))).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problem: "size",
    });
  });

  it("refuses a name that would show as something else", () => {
    // "invoice<RLO>fdp.exe" shows as "invoiceexe.pdf".
    expect(checkAttachmentFile(file("invoice\u202Efdp.pdf", "application/pdf"))).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problem: "name",
    });
  });
});

describe("kindOf", () => {
  it("names a file's kind as people know it", () => {
    expect(kindOf("application/pdf")).toBe("pdf");
    expect(kindOf("image/heic")).toBe("heic");
    expect(kindOf("application/octet-stream")).toBe("other");
  });
});
```
