**`packages/api/src/routers/attachments.ts`**, the whole file:

```ts
// attachments.*: files on any record (spec 9.2): presigned uploads the browser PUTs straight to storage, their
// confirmation, the list of a record's files and their downloads. File bytes never pass through the api. The
// Foundation's one record is the organization itself, for the agency's own papers (a GST certificate, a PAN card, a
// cancelled cheque), with settings:manage; business modules add their records with their own permissions. Changes
// read the session afresh, as the profile's do: the papers can hold bank details.
import {
  attachmentRefInput,
  attachmentSummary,
  downloadLink,
  presignedUpload,
  requestUploadInput,
} from "@travel-crm/contracts/files";
import type { MemberAccess } from "@travel-crm/domain/identity";
import { DomainError } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { z } from "zod";
import { freshProcedure, orgProcedure } from "../procedures.js";
import { router } from "../trpc.js";

/**
 * The member's own organization record, and no other: another record type, or another organization's id, is "not
 * found", as a file of another record is (ADR 0011). The files module then checks the file belongs to it.
 */
function assertOwnOrganization(member: MemberAccess, record: { recordType: string; recordId: string }): void {
  if (record.recordType !== "organization" || record.recordId !== member.organizationId) {
    throw new DomainError("NOT_FOUND", "NOT_FOUND", "No such record");
  }
}

/** A record named without one of its files. */
const recordInput = attachmentRefInput.omit({ attachmentId: true });

const papersViewer = orgProcedure.requires("settings:manage");
const papersEditor = freshProcedure.requires("settings:manage");

export const attachmentsRouter = router({
  /** The record's ready files, oldest first; a sensitive file's name only for documents:view_sensitive. */
  list: papersViewer
    .input(recordInput)
    .output(z.array(attachmentSummary))
    .query(({ ctx, input }) => {
      assertOwnOrganization(ctx.member, input);
      return ctx.files.list(ctx.member, input);
    }),

  /** Records a pending file and says where the browser PUTs it, for 10 minutes. Refused past the storage limit. */
  requestUpload: papersEditor
    .input(requestUploadInput)
    .output(z.object({ attachment: attachmentSummary, upload: presignedUpload }))
    .mutation(async ({ ctx, input }) => {
      assertOwnOrganization(ctx.member, input);
      const { attachment, upload } = await ctx.files.requestUpload(ctx.member, input);
      return { attachment, upload: { ...upload, expiresAt: upload.expiresAt.toISOString() } };
    }),

  /** Marks the upload ready once storage holds it; harmless to repeat, as after a retried PUT answered 412. */
  confirmUpload: papersEditor
    .input(attachmentRefInput)
    .output(attachmentSummary)
    .mutation(({ ctx, input }) => {
      assertOwnOrganization(ctx.member, input);
      return ctx.files.confirmUpload(ctx.member, input);
    }),

  /**
   * A 5-minute link that downloads the file. A mutation, so no link is cached or saved on the device; an export, so a
   * read-only organization (and a suspended one's Owner) can still take its papers away (ADR 0021).
   */
  downloadLink: papersEditor
    .meta({ lifecycle: "export" })
    .input(attachmentRefInput)
    .output(downloadLink)
    .mutation(async ({ ctx, input }) => {
      assertOwnOrganization(ctx.member, input);
      const link = await ctx.files.downloadLink(ctx.member, input);
      return { url: link.url, expiresAt: link.expiresAt.toISOString() };
    }),

  /** Hides the file (a soft delete); its bytes stay in storage, and count, until the platform's purge. */
  remove: papersEditor.input(attachmentRefInput).mutation(async ({ ctx, input }) => {
    assertOwnOrganization(ctx.member, input);
    await ctx.files.remove(ctx.member, input);
  }),
});
```

**Create `apps/web/src/files/attachment-file.ts`:**

```ts
// What a chosen file must be before it is sent (spec 9.2, ADR 0011), by the api's own rules: one of the types staff
// may upload, not empty, at most 25 MB, and a name without folders, control or direction characters. Storage then
// holds the upload to the type and size it was signed for.
import {
  attachmentContentTypes,
  attachmentFileName,
  MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES,
  type AttachmentContentType,
} from "@travel-crm/contracts/files";

/** Message keys in "business.attachments.problems". */
export type AttachmentFileProblem = "type" | "size" | "empty" | "name";

/** Message keys in "business.attachments.kinds". */
export type AttachmentKind = "pdf" | "jpeg" | "png" | "webp" | "heic" | "other";

const isAllowedType = (type: string): type is AttachmentContentType =>
  (attachmentContentTypes as readonly string[]).includes(type);

/** The type to sign the upload for. Browsers that can't open HEIC photos give them no type: the name says it. */
function contentTypeOf(file: { name: string; type: string }): AttachmentContentType | null {
  const type = file.type.toLowerCase();
  if (isAllowedType(type)) return type;
  return type === "" && /\.heic$/i.test(file.name) ? "image/heic" : null;
}

export function checkAttachmentFile(file: {
  name: string;
  type: string;
  size: number;
}): { ok: true; contentType: AttachmentContentType } | { ok: false; problem: AttachmentFileProblem } {
  const contentType = contentTypeOf(file);
  if (contentType === null) return { ok: false, problem: "type" };
  if (file.size === 0) return { ok: false, problem: "empty" };
  if (file.size > MAX_ATTACHMENT_BYTES) return { ok: false, problem: "size" };
  if (!attachmentFileName.safeParse(file.name).success) return { ok: false, problem: "name" };
  return { ok: true, contentType };
}

const kinds: Record<AttachmentContentType, AttachmentKind> = {
  "application/pdf": "pdf",
  "image/jpeg": "jpeg",
  "image/png": "png",
  "image/webp": "webp",
  "image/heic": "heic",
};

/** A file's kind as people know it ("PDF", "JPEG image"), from the type it was stored with. */
export function kindOf(contentType: string): AttachmentKind {
  return isAllowedType(contentType) ? kinds[contentType] : "other";
}

/** What the file picker offers: the allowed types, and HEIC photos by name for browsers that give them no type. */
export const ACCEPTED_FILES = [...attachmentContentTypes, ".heic"].join(",");
```

```tsx
"use client";

// A record's files as a divided list (DESIGN.md section 6): the name (wrapping, any script), then its kind, size and
// the day it was added in the organization's zone, and Download and Remove. A sensitive file is marked; to a role
// without documents:view_sensitive it is only a "Sensitive file", with nothing to do to it (spec 5).
import type { AttachmentSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/files";
import { DownloadIcon, FileIcon, LockIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { formatDay } from "@/lib/format";
import { holds, useMe } from "@/session/me-context";
import { useWriteAccess } from "@/subscription/write-access";
import { kindOf } from "./attachment-file";
import { formatFileSize } from "./file-size";
import { RemoveAttachmentDialog } from "./remove-attachment-dialog";
import { useDownloadAttachment, type AttachmentRecord } from "./use-attachments";

function AttachmentActions({
  record,
  attachment,
  name,
}: {
  record: AttachmentRecord;
  attachment: AttachmentSummary;
  name: string;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("business.attachments");
  const change = useWriteAccess("change");
  const take = useWriteAccess("export");
  const download = useDownloadAttachment();
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
      <Button
        variant="outline"
        aria-label={t("downloadName", { name })}
        disabled={!take.allowed || download.isPending}
        onClick={() => {
          download.mutate({ ...record, attachmentId: attachment.id });
        }}
      >
        <DownloadIcon aria-hidden="true" />
        {t("download")}
      </Button>
      <Button
        variant="destructive"
        aria-label={t("removeName", { name })}
        disabled={!change.allowed}
        onClick={() => {
          setRemoving(true);
        }}
      >
        {t("remove")}
      </Button>
      <RemoveAttachmentDialog
        record={record}
        attachmentId={attachment.id}
        name={name}
        open={removing}
        onOpenChange={setRemoving}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

function AttachmentRow({ record, attachment }: { record: AttachmentRecord; attachment: AttachmentSummary }) {
  const t = useTranslations("business.attachments");
  const me = useMe();
  // The api already hides the name; the screen says it in its own words, and offers nothing it would refuse.
  const hidden = attachment.sensitive && !holds(me, "documents:view_sensitive");
  const name = hidden ? t("sensitiveFile") : attachment.fileName;
  const added = formatDay(new Date(attachment.createdAt), { timeZone: me.organization.timeZone });
  return (
    <li className="flex flex-col gap-3 px-4 py-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 items-start gap-3">
        <FileIcon aria-hidden="true" className="mt-0.5 size-5 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" />
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
          <span className="font-medium break-words script-leading">{name}</span>
          <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-1 text-label text-muted-foreground">
            {t(`kinds.${kindOf(attachment.contentType)}`)} ·{" "}
            <span className="numbers">{formatFileSize(attachment.sizeBytes)}</span> · {t("added", { date: added })}
            {attachment.sensitive && (
              <>
                {" · "}
                <LockIcon aria-hidden="true" className="size-3.5" />
                {t("sensitive")}
              </>
            )}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
      {hidden ? (
        <p className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{t("sensitiveHidden")}</p>
      ) : (
        <AttachmentActions record={record} attachment={attachment} name={name} />
      )}
    </li>
  );
}

export function AttachmentList({
  record,
  attachments,
}: {
  record: AttachmentRecord;
  attachments: AttachmentSummary[];
}) {
  return (
    <ul className="divide-y rounded-lg border">
      {attachments.map((attachment) => (
        <AttachmentRow key={attachment.id} record={record} attachment={attachment} />
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/files/attachments-panel.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// A record's files, for any screen that keeps files on its record (spec 9.2): a way to add one, then the list, with
// honest loading, empty and error states. The api decides who may use the record's files; this shows what it says.
import { FolderIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/empty-state";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { AttachmentList } from "./attachment-list";
import { UploadControl } from "./upload-control";
import { useAttachments, type AttachmentRecord } from "./use-attachments";

export function AttachmentsPanel({ record, emptyMessage }: { record: AttachmentRecord; emptyMessage: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations("business.attachments");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  // Always asked again when the screen opens: the copy restored from IndexedDB can predate a file just added.
  const files = useAttachments(record);

  const body = () => {
    if (files.data) {
      return files.data.length > 0 ? (
        <AttachmentList record={record} attachments={files.data} />
      ) : (
        <EmptyState icon={FolderIcon} message={emptyMessage} />
      );
    }
    if (files.isError) {
      return (
        <ErrorState message={t("loadFailed")} retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")} onRetry={() => void files.refetch()} />
      );
    }
    return (
      <Delayed>
        <div role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={tCommon("loading")} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {[0, 1, 2].map((row) => (
            <Skeleton key={row} className="h-16 w-full" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </Delayed>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <UploadControl record={record} />
      {body()}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// Removing a file: asked once more, because it goes for everyone. Its bytes stay in storage until the platform's
// purge, so it still counts toward the plan's storage (ADR 0011), and the dialog says so.
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { useRemoveAttachment, type AttachmentRecord } from "./use-attachments";

export function RemoveAttachmentDialog({
  record,
  attachmentId,
  name,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
}: {
  record: AttachmentRecord;
  attachmentId: string;
  name: string;
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("business.attachments");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const remove = useRemoveAttachment(record, name);
  return (
    <AlertDialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogTitle>{t("removeTitle", { name })}</AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>{t("removeDescription")}</AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel>{tCommon("cancel")}</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction
            // The final step of a destructive action is the one place red fills a button (DESIGN.md section 6).
            className="bg-status-bad-ink text-on-action hover:bg-status-bad-ink/90"
            disabled={remove.isPending}
            onClick={(event) => {
              // Stay open until the api answers, so the button can't be pressed twice.
              event.preventDefault();
              remove.mutate(
                { ...record, attachmentId },
                {
                  onSuccess: () => {
                    onOpenChange(false);
                  },
                },
              );
            }}
          >
            {t("remove")}
          </AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}
```

```ts
// Starts a download from a short-lived storage link. The link saves the file under its own name (Content-Disposition:
// attachment, ADR 0011), so the browser downloads it and this page stays open. In its own file so tests can stand in
```

**Create `apps/web/src/files/upload-control.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// Adding a file to a record: whether it is sensitive, then the file picker. The file is checked before anything is
// sent; while it goes to storage its progress shows, with a way to stop; a problem, a refusal (the storage limit's
// among them) or a storage that can't be reached says so. While the organization can't make changes (ADR 0021) the
// control is off and says why.
import { UploadIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useId, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import { Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/progress";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { useWriteAccess } from "@/subscription/write-access";
import { ACCEPTED_FILES, checkAttachmentFile } from "./attachment-file";
import { UploadError } from "./upload";
import type { AttachmentRecord } from "./use-attachments";
import { useUploadAttachment, wasStopped } from "./use-upload-attachment";

export function UploadControl({ record }: { record: AttachmentRecord }) {
  const t = useTranslations("business.attachments");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const write = useWriteAccess();
  const { upload, progress, stop } = useUploadAttachment(record);
  const picker = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const id = useId();
  const [sensitive, setSensitive] = useState(false);
  const [problem, setProblem] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const choose = (file: File) => {
    const check = checkAttachmentFile(file);
    if (!check.ok) {
      upload.reset();
      setProblem(t(`problems.${check.problem}`, { name: file.name }));
      return;
    }
    setProblem(null);
    upload.mutate(
      { file, contentType: check.contentType, sensitive },
      {
        onSuccess: () => {
          setSensitive(false);
        },
      },
    );
  };
  const failure = (error: unknown): string => {
    if (error instanceof UploadError) return error.status === 0 ? t("storageUnreachable") : t("storageRefused");
    return apiError(error);
  };
  const percent = Math.round(progress * 100);
  const busy = upload.isPending;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-lg border p-4">
      <Field orientation="horizontal" data-disabled={!write.allowed || busy}>
        <Checkbox
          id={`${id}-sensitive`}
          checked={sensitive}
          disabled={!write.allowed || busy}
          onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
            setSensitive(checked === true);
          }}
        />
        <FieldContent>
          <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-sensitive`}>{t("sensitive")}</FieldLabel>
          <FieldDescription>{t("sensitiveHint")}</FieldDescription>
        </FieldContent>
      </Field>
      <input
        ref={picker}
        type="file"
        accept={ACCEPTED_FILES}
        className="hidden"
        onChange={(event) => {
          const file = event.target.files?.[0];
          // Cleared, so choosing the same file again (after a refusal) is a change too.
          event.target.value = "";
          if (file) choose(file);
        }}
      />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2">
        <Button
          type="button"
          disabled={!write.allowed || busy}
          aria-describedby={write.hint ? `${id}-hint` : undefined}
          onClick={() => picker.current?.click()}
        >
          <UploadIcon aria-hidden="true" />
          {t("upload")}
        </Button>
        <p className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{t("allowed")}</p>
      </div>
      {write.hint && (
        <p id={`${id}-hint`} className="text-label text-muted-foreground">
          {write.hint}
        </p>
      )}
      {busy && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <p className="min-w-0 break-words script-leading">{t("uploading", { name: upload.variables.file.name })}</p>
            <span className="numbers">{t("progress", { percent })}</span>
          </div>
          <Progress value={percent} aria-label={t("uploading", { name: upload.variables.file.name })} />
          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" className="self-start" onClick={stop}>
            {t("stop")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
      {problem && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertDescription>{problem}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}
      {upload.isError && !wasStopped(upload.error) && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertDescription>{failure(upload.error)}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/files/use-attachments.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// A record's files and what can be done to one: list them, download one by a short-lived link, remove one. A link is
// asked for when it is needed (a mutation, so none is kept on the device) and fails at once when offline rather than
// opening the download whenever the connection comes back. Toasts live in the hooks, not in callers' mutate() options,
// so they don't depend on the calling component staying mounted.
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useTRPC } from "@/data/trpc";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { startDownload } from "./start-download";

/** The record a file belongs to: every call names it, so the api can check who may use that record's files. */
export interface AttachmentRecord {
  recordType: string;
  recordId: string;
}

export function useAttachments(record: AttachmentRecord) {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  return useQuery(trpc.attachments.list.queryOptions(record));
}

export function useRefreshAttachments(record: AttachmentRecord) {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.attachments.list.queryKey(record) });
}

export function useDownloadAttachment() {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  return useMutation(
    trpc.attachments.downloadLink.mutationOptions({
      networkMode: "always",
      onSuccess: (link) => {
        startDownload(link.url);
      },
      onError: (error) => {
        toast.error(apiError(error), { duration: Infinity });
      },
    }),
  );
}

export function useRemoveAttachment(record: AttachmentRecord, name: string) {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  const refresh = useRefreshAttachments(record);
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const t = useTranslations("business.attachments");
  return useMutation(
    trpc.attachments.remove.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: () => {
        toast.success(t("removed", { name }));
      },
      onError: (error) => {
        toast.error(apiError(error), { duration: Infinity });
      },
      onSettled: refresh,
    }),
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/files/use-upload-attachment.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// Uploading one file to a record (spec 9.2: file bytes never pass through the api): the api records it and signs an
// upload, the browser PUTs the file straight to storage with its progress (uploadFile), then the api confirms it
// arrived. It fails at once when offline rather than waiting at 0%, and can be stopped; the record's list is asked
// for again however it ends. A stopped upload leaves only a pending record, which nobody sees.
import type { AttachmentContentType } from "@travel-crm/contracts/files";
import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useTRPCClient } from "@/data/trpc";
import { uploadFile } from "./upload";
import { useRefreshAttachments, type AttachmentRecord } from "./use-attachments";

export interface UploadRequest {
  file: File;
  /** The type checkAttachmentFile found, which the upload is signed for. */
  contentType: AttachmentContentType;
  sensitive: boolean;
}

/** An upload the person stopped: not a failure to report. */
export function wasStopped(error: unknown): boolean {
  return error instanceof DOMException && error.name === "AbortError";
}

export function useUploadAttachment(record: AttachmentRecord) {
  const client = useTRPCClient();
  const refresh = useRefreshAttachments(record);
  const t = useTranslations("business.attachments");
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);
  const stopper = useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const upload = useMutation({
    networkMode: "always",
    mutationFn: async ({ file, contentType, sensitive }: UploadRequest) => {
      const controller = new AbortController();
      stopper.current = controller;
      setProgress(0);
      const { attachment, upload: signed } = await client.attachments.requestUpload.mutate({
        ...record,
        fileName: file.name,
        contentType,
        sizeBytes: file.size,
        sensitive,
      });
      await uploadFile(signed, file, { onProgress: setProgress, signal: controller.signal });
      return client.attachments.confirmUpload.mutate({ ...record, attachmentId: attachment.id });
    },
    onSuccess: (_attachment, { file }) => {
      toast.success(t("uploaded", { name: file.name }));
    },
    onSettled: refresh,
  });
  return {
    upload,
    /** How much of the file storage has, from 0 to 1. */
    progress,
    stop: () => {
      stopper.current?.abort();
    },
  };
}
```

## Track D: Branding, documents and share links

Spec 9.3 (React-PDF templates with the organization's own logo, colours and terms; share links that expire, are
revoked and record every open), 10 (an organization's branding is its own, in the database) and 11 (settings:
branding), on plan 3's documents, files and share-links modules and plan 4's profile. An Owner gives the documents
their logo (uploaded straight to storage), colour and terms on `/settings/branding`, previews them on a sample
quotation the worker renders, finds every issued document with its PDF on `/settings/documents`, and shares one by a
link whose opens they can see and which they can turn off. Issued documents freeze the logo's attachment id, and the
worker draws its bytes, never another file's.

**Rulings in this track:**
- Ruling: the files module gains `systemFile(organizationId, { recordType, recordId, attachmentId })`, a ready,
  ordinary file's bytes named by its record — the worker must read the logo to draw it and only the files module knows
  a file's storage key; naming the record (`organization_logo`, the organization) makes a frozen id of any other file,
  a passport scan, "not found" — cost if wrong: the worker fetches `systemDownloadLink`'s URL instead.
- Ruling: a logo whose bytes aren't a PNG or JPEG, or that was removed before the render, is left off and the document
  still renders; `renderPdf` refuses a logo whose bytes aren't its type, and the listener draws a logo as the image its
  bytes are (`imageTypeOf`) — storage checks only the declared type and React-PDF silently drops an image it can't read
  — cost if wrong: such documents lack the logo; the branding screen says the logo can't be shown.
- Ruling: replacing the logo keeps the old file (the newest ready one is the logo); removing one removes it and every
  older one — a document issued a moment before still finds its logo, and an older logo never comes back — cost if
  wrong: replaced logos stay stored and counted, as removed files do until a purge.
- Ruling: samples are numbered `SMPL-<year>-<n>`, not `SAMPLE` — document prefixes are 2-5 capital letters (the
  counter and the database's CHECK) — cost if wrong: a migration widening both.
- Ruling: every procedure here needs `settings:manage` — every issued document today is a branding sample; quotes and
  invoices bring their own permissions — cost if wrong: one `requires()` each.
- Ruling: `documents.get` joins the brief's procedures — the preview asks for its one document while the worker renders —
  cost if wrong: none.
- Ruling: PDF links are fetched when the button is pressed and opened with `loadPage` — a five-minute link is never
  cached or saved; storage's Content-Disposition makes it a download, so the page stays — cost if wrong: a browser that
  shows PDFs inline from a navigation leaves the page.
- Ruling: the documents list pages with `useInfiniteQuery` by hand — tRPC 11.19's `infiniteQueryOptions` adds a
  `direction` the strict input refuses — cost if wrong: none.
- Ruling: turning a share link off is `.meta({ lifecycle: "revoke" })` — it takes a customer's access away, which
  read-only allows (ADR 0021); making one is a change — cost if wrong: one meta line.
- Ruling: making and revoking a share link are recorded in the audit log by ids (`share-link.created` with record type,
  id and expiry; `share-link.revoked` with when), never the label — CLAUDE.md's every change staff make, and a label
  can name a customer — cost if wrong: the audit viewer (Track A) shows its readable fallback until it has sentences
  for the two actions.
- Ruling: logo uploads are not audited — the files module records no upload or removal — cost if wrong: a
  `recordAudit` after `confirmUpload` and `remove`.

**Found in a file this track doesn't own:** `saveOrganizationBranding` (`packages/domain/src/profile/profile.ts`)
writes the profile's old `updated_at` back: it spreads `before`, whose `updatedAt` is a string, into the upsert, and
Prisma's `@updatedAt` yields to an explicit value. The branding form keys itself by its saved content, so it is right
either way; the fix is to leave `updatedAt` out of what `write()` is given.

### Task D1: An Owner gives the organization's documents its logo, colour and terms

`/settings/branding` shows how the documents an organization issues will look, in three parts saved on their own: its
logo, its brand colour and its terms. The logo is an attachment of record type `organization_logo` whose record is
the organization (a new contract: PNG or JPEG, at most 1 MB, the only images React-PDF draws): the browser checks the
type and size, asks `organization.logo.requestUpload` where to send it, PUTs it straight to storage with its progress
(Task G2's `uploadFile`), confirms it, and shows it through `organization.logo.get`'s five-minute link; the newest
ready logo is the logo, and removing one takes the ones it replaced with it, so an older logo never comes back. The
colour (typed as `#rrggbb` or picked, the picker being its swatch) and the terms go through plan 4's
`organization.branding.update`; before the business details exist, the screen sends the Owner to them first. Issued
documents freeze the logo's attachment id in their branding (`logoAttachmentId`), and the worker's render reads its
bytes through a new files-module call, `systemFile`, named by its record, so a frozen id that names any other file (a
passport scan) is never printed; a logo removed before the render, or whose bytes aren't really a PNG or JPEG
(storage checks only the declared type, and React-PDF silently drops an image it can't read), is left out and the
document still renders. In a read-only organization the changes are disabled with the reason.

**Create `apps/api/test/logo.test.ts`:**

```ts
// The organization's logo over HTTP (spec 9.3): a PNG or JPEG of at most 1 MB, uploaded straight to storage and shown
// through a short-lived link; the newest is the logo, and removing it takes the ones it replaced with it. Only roles
// with settings:manage reach it, and a read-only organization's Owner may look but not change it.
import type { LogoUpload, OrganizationLogo } from "@travel-crm/contracts/profile";
import { systemActor } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { createMemoryStorage, type MemoryStorage } from "@travel-crm/integrations/storage";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { CookieJar } from "./support/cookie-jar.js";
import { addStaff, signedInOwner, signedInStaff } from "./support/people.js";
import { createTestAgency, createTestServer, type TestServer } from "./support/test-server.js";
import { dataOf, mutate, query, refusalOf } from "./support/trpc.js";

/** What the browser would send: storage checks only its size and declared type. */
const pngBytes = new TextEncoder().encode("the bytes of a logo");

describe("the organization's logo", () => {
  let server: TestServer;
  let storage: MemoryStorage;

  beforeAll(() => {
    storage = createMemoryStorage();
    server = createTestServer({}, { storage });
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await server.close();
  });

  /** Uploads a logo as the branding screen does: ask for a link, PUT the file to storage, confirm it. */
  async function uploadedLogo(jar: CookieJar, fileName = "Logo.png"): Promise<OrganizationLogo> {
    const { attachmentId, upload } = await dataOf<LogoUpload>(
      await mutate(
        server,
        "organization.logo.requestUpload",
        { fileName, contentType: "image/png", sizeBytes: pngBytes.byteLength },
        jar,
      ),
    );
    await storage.upload({ ...upload, expiresAt: new Date(upload.expiresAt) }, pngBytes, "image/png");
    return dataOf<OrganizationLogo>(await mutate(server, "organization.logo.confirmUpload", { attachmentId }, jar));
  }

  it("lets the Owner upload a logo straight to storage, and shows it through a short-lived link", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const jar = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    expect(await dataOf(await query(server, "organization.logo.get", jar))).toBeNull();

    const logo = await uploadedLogo(jar);
    const key = `organizations/${agency.organizationId}/attachments/${logo.attachmentId}`;
    expect(storage.objects.get(key)?.contentType).toBe("image/png");
    expect(logo).toMatchObject({ fileName: "Logo.png" });
    expect(logo.url).toContain(encodeURIComponent(key));
    expect(new Date(logo.expiresAt).getTime() - Date.now()).toBeLessThanOrEqual(5 * 60 * 1000);
    expect(await dataOf<OrganizationLogo>(await query(server, "organization.logo.get", jar))).toMatchObject({
      attachmentId: logo.attachmentId,
      fileName: "Logo.png",
    });
  });

  it("makes the newest logo the logo, and removing it takes the ones it replaced with it", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const jar = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    const first = await uploadedLogo(jar, "First.png");
    const second = await uploadedLogo(jar, "Second.png");
    const current = async () =>
      (await dataOf<OrganizationLogo | null>(await query(server, "organization.logo.get", jar)))?.attachmentId ?? null;
    expect(await current()).toBe(second.attachmentId);

    // A screen still showing the first logo removes only that one and older: the newer one stays.
    expect((await mutate(server, "organization.logo.remove", { attachmentId: first.attachmentId }, jar)).status).toBe(
      200,
    );
    expect(await current()).toBe(second.attachmentId);
    const third = await uploadedLogo(jar, "Third.png");
    await dataOf(await mutate(server, "organization.logo.remove", { attachmentId: third.attachmentId }, jar));
    // Not the second logo coming back: it went with the one that replaced it.
    expect(await current()).toBeNull();
  });

  it("refuses other images and larger files before handing out an upload link", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const jar = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    for (const input of [
      { fileName: "Logo.svg", contentType: "image/svg+xml", sizeBytes: 900 },
      { fileName: "Logo.webp", contentType: "image/webp", sizeBytes: 900 },
      { fileName: "Logo.png", contentType: "image/png", sizeBytes: 1024 * 1024 + 1 },
    ]) {
      const response = await mutate(server, "organization.logo.requestUpload", input, jar);
      expect(response.status, input.contentType).toBe(400);
    }
  });

  it("confirms and removes only the organization's logos, never another of its files", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const jar = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    const licence = await server.files.storeGeneratedFile(systemActor(agency.organizationId), {
      recordType: "organization",
      recordId: agency.organizationId,
      fileName: "Licence.png",
      contentType: "image/png",
      body: pngBytes,
    });
    for (const path of ["organization.logo.confirmUpload", "organization.logo.remove"]) {
      expect(await refusalOf(await mutate(server, path, { attachmentId: licence.id }, jar)), path).toEqual({
        status: 404,
        reason: "ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND",
      });
    }
    expect(await dataOf(await query(server, "organization.logo.get", jar))).toBeNull();
  });

  it("refuses staff without settings:manage", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const sales = await addStaff(server, agency, { username: "ravi", roleKey: "sales" });
    const jar = await signedInStaff(server, agency, sales);
    const refused = { status: 403, reason: "MISSING_PERMISSION" };
    expect(await refusalOf(await query(server, "organization.logo.get", jar))).toEqual(refused);
    const attachmentId = "0199e7a0-0000-7000-8000-00000000a001";
    for (const [path, input] of [
      ["organization.logo.requestUpload", { fileName: "Logo.png", contentType: "image/png", sizeBytes: 9 }],
      ["organization.logo.confirmUpload", { attachmentId }],
      ["organization.logo.remove", { attachmentId }],
    ] as const) {
      expect(await refusalOf(await mutate(server, path, input, jar)), path).toEqual(refused);
    }
  });

  it("lets a read-only organization's Owner see the logo, but not change it", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const jar = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    const logo = await uploadedLogo(jar);
    await server.platform.subscription.update({
      where: { organizationId: agency.organizationId },
      data: { status: "read_only", statusChangedAt: new Date() },
    });
    expect(await dataOf<OrganizationLogo>(await query(server, "organization.logo.get", jar))).toMatchObject({
      attachmentId: logo.attachmentId,
    });
    const readOnly = { status: 403, reason: "ORGANIZATION_READ_ONLY" };
    expect(
      await refusalOf(
        await mutate(
          server,
          "organization.logo.requestUpload",
          { fileName: "Logo.png", contentType: "image/png", sizeBytes: 9 },
          jar,
        ),
      ),
    ).toEqual(readOnly);
    expect(
      await refusalOf(await mutate(server, "organization.logo.remove", { attachmentId: logo.attachmentId }, jar)),
    ).toEqual(readOnly);
  });
});
```

**Create `packages/contracts/test/profile/logo.test.ts`:**

```ts
// The logo's contract: a PNG or JPEG of at most 1 MB, the only images React-PDF draws, named like any file.
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { MAX_LOGO_BYTES, logoRefInput, requestLogoUploadInput } from "../../src/profile/index.js";

const logo = { fileName: "Sharma Holidays.png", contentType: "image/png", sizeBytes: 48_213 };

describe("logo contracts", () => {
  it("takes a PNG or a JPEG of at most 1 MB", () => {
    expect(requestLogoUploadInput.parse(logo)).toEqual(logo);
    expect(requestLogoUploadInput.safeParse({ ...logo, contentType: "image/jpeg" }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(requestLogoUploadInput.safeParse({ ...logo, sizeBytes: MAX_LOGO_BYTES }).success).toBe(true);
    expect(MAX_LOGO_BYTES).toBe(1024 * 1024);
  });

  it("refuses other images, a larger file, an empty one, and unknown keys", () => {
    for (const contentType of ["image/svg+xml", "image/webp", "image/heic", "application/pdf"]) {
      expect(requestLogoUploadInput.safeParse({ ...logo, contentType }).success, contentType).toBe(false);
    }
    expect(requestLogoUploadInput.safeParse({ ...logo, sizeBytes: MAX_LOGO_BYTES + 1 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(requestLogoUploadInput.safeParse({ ...logo, sizeBytes: 0 }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(requestLogoUploadInput.safeParse({ ...logo, sensitive: true }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(requestLogoUploadInput.safeParse({ ...logo, recordType: "lead" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it("names the file as any upload must: no folders, no direction marks", () => {
    expect(requestLogoUploadInput.safeParse({ ...logo, fileName: "../logo.png" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(requestLogoUploadInput.safeParse({ ...logo, fileName: "logo\u202Egnp.exe" }).success).toBe(false);
  });

  it("names an uploaded logo by its attachment id alone", () => {
    const attachmentId = "0199e7a0-0000-7000-8000-000000000001";
    expect(logoRefInput.parse({ attachmentId })).toEqual({ attachmentId });
    expect(logoRefInput.safeParse({ attachmentId: "logo" }).success).toBe(false);
    expect(logoRefInput.safeParse({ attachmentId, recordId: attachmentId }).success).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```ts
// The smallest valid logos, for rendering tests: a 1x1 transparent PNG and a 1x1 grey JPEG.

const bytesOf = (base64: string) => Uint8Array.from(atob(base64), (character) => character.charCodeAt(0));

export const tinyPng = bytesOf(
  "iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNkYPhfDwAChwGA60e6kgAAAABJRU5ErkJggg==",
);

export const tinyJpeg = bytesOf(
  "/9j/4AAQSkZJRgABAQEASABIAAD/2wBDAP//////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////" +
    "////////////wgALCAABAAEBAREA/8QAFBABAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAP/aAAgBAQABPxA=",
);
```

```ts
// A logo's real type comes from its bytes, not from what the browser declared: storage checks only the declared one.
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { imageTypeOf } from "../../src/pdf/index.js";
import { tinyJpeg, tinyPng } from "./logos.js";

describe("imageTypeOf", () => {
  it("knows a PNG and a JPEG by their signatures", () => {
    expect(imageTypeOf(tinyPng)).toBe("image/png");
    expect(imageTypeOf(tinyJpeg)).toBe("image/jpeg");
  });

  it("knows nothing else, nor a signature cut short", () => {
    expect(imageTypeOf(new TextEncoder().encode("<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'/>"))).toBeNull();
    expect(imageTypeOf(new TextEncoder().encode("%PDF-1.7"))).toBeNull();
    expect(imageTypeOf(new Uint8Array())).toBeNull();
    expect(imageTypeOf(tinyPng.subarray(0, 7))).toBeNull();
    expect(imageTypeOf(tinyJpeg.subarray(0, 2))).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/documents/sent.ts`:**

```ts
// What the app sent the stubbed api (support/api-stub.ts): each call's input to one procedure, in order, read from the
// fetch the stub stands in for. Mutations are batched POSTs whose body is { "0": input }.
import { vi } from "vitest";

type FetchCall = [input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit];

export function inputsSentTo(path: string): unknown[] {
  const calls = vi.mocked(fetch).mock.calls as FetchCall[];
  return calls
    .filter(([input]) => {
      const url = new URL(input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input), "http://localhost");
      return decodeURIComponent(url.pathname) === `/api/trpc/${path}`;
    })
    .map(([, init]) => (JSON.parse(typeof init?.body === "string" ? init.body : "{}") as Record<string, unknown>)["0"]);
}
```

```ts
// subscription.get's answer for the screens' write actions (useWriteAccess): an active organization, or one in a
// lifecycle state that refuses changes.
import type { Answer } from "../support/api-stub";

export function subscriptionAnswer(access: "full" | "read_only" = "full"): Answer {
  return {
    data: {
      status: access === "full" ? "active" : "read_only",
      access,
      planName: "Growth",
      modules: [],
      trialEndsOn: null,
      paidThrough: null,
      nextChangeOn: null,
      limits: { seats: 10, whatsappNumbers: 1, storageBytes: 1000 },
    },
  };
}
```

**Create `apps/web/test/branding/branding-form.test.tsx`:**

```tsx
// The branding form (spec 9.3): the brand colour, typed or picked, with its swatch, and the terms every document
// prints, saved through organization.branding.update. A colour that isn't #rrggbb is caught before sending; before the
// business details exist the screen sends the Owner to them first; in a read-only organization saving is disabled
// with the reason.
import { fireEvent, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { BrandingForm } from "@/branding/branding-form";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { routes } from "@/lib/routes";
import { newQueryClient, renderWithApi } from "../organization/api";
import { stubApi, type Answer } from "../support/api-stub";
import { inputsSentTo } from "../documents/sent";
import { subscriptionAnswer } from "../documents/subscription";

const words = messages.documents.branding.details;

const saved = { brandColour: "#1f6f5c", documentTerms: "50% to book.", updatedAt: "2026-10-15T05:30:00.000Z" };

function renderForm(answers: Record<string, Answer> = {}) {
  const api = stubApi({
    "organization.branding.get": { data: saved },
    "subscription.get": subscriptionAnswer(),
    ...answers,
  });
  renderWithApi(<BrandingForm />, newQueryClient());
  return api;
}

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("BrandingForm", () => {
  it("shows the colour, with its swatch, and the terms as saved", async () => {
    renderForm();
    expect(await screen.findByLabelText(words.colour)).toHaveValue("#1f6f5c");
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(words.colourPicker)).toHaveValue("#1f6f5c");
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(words.terms)).toHaveValue("50% to book.");
  });

  it("saves a picked colour and new terms, and shows what the api saved", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    const api = renderForm({
      "organization.branding.update": {
        data: { brandColour: "#6a4bbd", documentTerms: "Pay within 7 days.", updatedAt: saved.updatedAt },
      },
    });
    const colour = await screen.findByLabelText(words.colour);
    await user.clear(colour);
    await user.type(colour, "#6A4BBD");
    const terms = screen.getByLabelText(words.terms);
    await user.clear(terms);
    await user.type(terms, "Pay within 7 days.");
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.save }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(api.calls).toContain("organization.branding.update");
    });
    expect(inputsSentTo("organization.branding.update")).toEqual([
      { brandColour: "#6A4BBD", documentTerms: "Pay within 7 days." },
    ]);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByLabelText(words.colour)).toHaveValue("#6a4bbd");
    });
  });

  it("follows the colour picker in the typed colour", async () => {
    renderForm();
    const picker = await screen.findByLabelText(words.colourPicker);
    // A colour input can't be typed into; the picker hands its value over as an input event.
    fireEvent.input(picker, { target: { value: "#034f46" } });
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(words.colour)).toHaveValue("#034f46");
  });

  it("sends an empty colour as none, for the standard one", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderForm({ "organization.branding.update": { data: { ...saved, brandColour: null } } });
    await user.clear(await screen.findByLabelText(words.colour));
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.save }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(inputsSentTo("organization.branding.update")).toEqual([
        { brandColour: "", documentTerms: "50% to book." },
      ]);
    });
  });

  it("refuses a colour that isn't #rrggbb before sending it", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    const api = renderForm();
    const colour = await screen.findByLabelText(words.colour);
    await user.clear(colour);
    await user.type(colour, "green");
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.save }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.colourInvalid)).toBeVisible();
    expect(colour).toHaveAttribute("aria-invalid", "true");
    expect(api.calls).not.toContain("organization.branding.update");
  });

  it("shows a refusal as its sentence", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderForm({ "organization.branding.update": { status: 409, reason: "PROFILE_NOT_SAVED" } });
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: words.save }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(messages.errors.reasons.PROFILE_NOT_SAVED)).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("sends the Owner to the business details first, when there are none", async () => {
    renderForm({ "organization.branding.get": { data: null } });
    expect(await screen.findByText(messages.documents.branding.profileFirst)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: messages.documents.branding.profileLink })).toHaveAttribute(
      "href",
      routes.profile,
    );
    expect(screen.queryByLabelText(words.colour)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("says when the branding didn't load, and tries again", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    const api = renderForm({ "organization.branding.get": { status: 500 } });
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: messages.common.tryAgain }));
    expect(api.calls.filter((path) => path === "organization.branding.get").length).toBeGreaterThan(1);
  });

  it("disables saving in a read-only organization, saying why", async () => {
    renderForm({
      "subscription.get": subscriptionAnswer("read_only"),
    });
    expect(await screen.findByText(messages.errors.reasons.ORGANIZATION_READ_ONLY)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.save })).toBeDisabled();
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/branding/logo-panel.test.tsx`:**

```tsx
// The logo on the branding screen (spec 9.2, 9.3): shown through its short-lived link, uploaded straight to storage
// with progress once its type and size have been checked here, confirmed, and removed after asking. A failed upload
// or a refusal shows its sentence; in a read-only organization uploading is disabled with the reason.
import { fireEvent, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { LogoPanel } from "@/branding/logo-panel";
import type * as UploadModule from "@/files/upload";
import { UploadError, uploadFile } from "@/files/upload";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { newQueryClient, renderWithApi } from "../organization/api";
import { screenIs } from "../organization/render";
import { stubApi, type Answer } from "../support/api-stub";
import { inputsSentTo } from "../documents/sent";
import { subscriptionAnswer } from "../documents/subscription";

vi.mock("@/files/upload", async (importOriginal) => ({
  ...(await importOriginal<typeof UploadModule>()),
  uploadFile: vi.fn(),
}));

const words = messages.documents.branding.logo;

const attachmentId = "0199e7a0-0000-7000-8000-00000000a001";
const logo = {
  attachmentId,
  fileName: "Sharma.png",
  url: "https://files.example.test/organizations/o/attachments/a001?signature=1",
  expiresAt: "2026-10-15T05:35:00.000Z",
};
const upload = {
  url: "https://files.example.test/organizations/o/attachments/a002?signature=2",
  method: "PUT" as const,
  headers: { "content-type": "image/png", "content-length": "9", "if-none-match": "*" },
  expiresAt: "2026-10-15T05:40:00.000Z",
};

function renderPanel(answers: Record<string, Answer> = {}) {
  const api = stubApi({
    "organization.logo.get": { data: logo },
    "subscription.get": subscriptionAnswer(),
    ...answers,
  });
  renderWithApi(<LogoPanel />, newQueryClient());
  return api;
}

const png = (name = "Sharma.png", size = 9) => new File([new Uint8Array(size)], name, { type: "image/png" });

/** Chooses a file as the browser's file picker would. */
function choose(file: File) {
  fireEvent.change(screen.getByLabelText(words.fileLabel), { target: { files: [file] } });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  screenIs("wide");
  vi.mocked(uploadFile).mockReset();
});

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("LogoPanel", () => {
  it("shows the logo through its short-lived link", async () => {
    renderPanel();
    expect(await screen.findByRole("img", { name: words.alt })).toHaveAttribute("src", logo.url);
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.replace })).toBeEnabled();
  });

  it("says there is no logo yet", async () => {
    renderPanel({ "organization.logo.get": { data: null } });
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.none)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.upload })).toBeEnabled();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: words.remove })).toBeNull();
  });

  it("checks the type and size before sending anything", async () => {
    const api = renderPanel({ "organization.logo.get": { data: null } });
    await screen.findByText(words.none);
    choose(new File(["<svg/>"], "Logo.svg", { type: "image/svg+xml" }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.wrongType)).toBeVisible();
    choose(png("Big.png", 1024 * 1024 + 1));
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.tooLarge.replace("{size}", "1 MB"))).toBeVisible();
    expect(api.calls).not.toContain("organization.logo.requestUpload");
    expect(uploadFile).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("uploads straight to storage with progress, confirms, and shows the new logo", async () => {
    let finish: () => void = () => undefined;
    vi.mocked(uploadFile).mockImplementation((_upload, _file, options) => {
      options?.onProgress?.(0.5);
      return new Promise((resolve) => {
        finish = () => {
          resolve();
        };
      });
    });
    const replaced = { ...logo, attachmentId: "0199e7a0-0000-7000-8000-00000000a002", url: `${logo.url}&new` };
    const api = renderPanel({
      "organization.logo.get": { data: null },
      "organization.logo.requestUpload": { data: { attachmentId: replaced.attachmentId, upload } },
      "organization.logo.confirmUpload": { data: replaced },
    });
    await screen.findByText(words.none);
    const file = png();
    choose(file);

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(vi.mocked(uploadFile).mock.calls.map(([sentTo, sent]) => [sentTo, sent])).toEqual([[upload, file]]);
    });
    expect(inputsSentTo("organization.logo.requestUpload")).toEqual([
      { fileName: "Sharma.png", contentType: "image/png", sizeBytes: 9 },
    ]);
    expect(screen.getByRole("progressbar", { name: words.uploading })).toBeVisible();
    expect(api.calls).not.toContain("organization.logo.confirmUpload");
    finish();

    expect(await screen.findByRole("img", { name: words.alt })).toHaveAttribute("src", replaced.url);
    expect(inputsSentTo("organization.logo.confirmUpload")).toEqual([{ attachmentId: replaced.attachmentId }]);
  });

  it("gives a file whose name can't be stored a plain one", async () => {
    vi.mocked(uploadFile).mockResolvedValue();
    renderPanel({
      "organization.logo.get": { data: null },
      "organization.logo.requestUpload": { data: { attachmentId, upload } },
      "organization.logo.confirmUpload": { data: logo },
    });
    await screen.findByText(words.none);

        { fileName: "Logo.jpg", contentType: "image/jpeg", sizeBytes: 9 },
      ]);
    });

    vi.mocked(uploadFile).mockRejectedValue(new UploadError(0));
    const api = renderPanel({
      "organization.logo.get": { data: null },
      "organization.logo.requestUpload": { data: { attachmentId, upload } },

    await screen.findByText(words.none);
    choose(png());
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.uploadFailed)).toBeVisible();
    expect(api.calls).not.toContain("organization.logo.confirmUpload");
  });

  it("shows a refusal as its sentence", async () => {
    renderPanel({
      "organization.logo.get": { data: null },
      "organization.logo.requestUpload": { status: 413, reason: "STORAGE_LIMIT_REACHED" },
    });
    await screen.findByText(words.none);
    choose(png());
    expect(await screen.findByText(messages.errors.reasons.STORAGE_LIMIT_REACHED)).toBeVisible();
    expect(uploadFile).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("removes the logo once asked again", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    const api = renderPanel({ "organization.logo.remove": { data: null } });
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: words.remove }));
    expect(screen.getByText(words.removeDescription)).toBeVisible();
    api.answer("organization.logo.get", { data: null });
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.removeConfirm }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(inputsSentTo("organization.logo.remove")).toEqual([{ attachmentId }]);
    });
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.none)).toBeVisible();

    expect(await screen.findByText(words.broken)).toBeVisible();

    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.remove })).toBeDisabled();
```

```ts
// The organization's logo on its documents (spec 9.3): a PNG or JPEG of at most 1 MB, sent straight to storage as an
// attachment of record type organization_logo whose record is the organization. The newest ready one is the logo.
import { z } from "zod";
import { attachmentFileName, presignedUpload } from "../files/index.js";

/** The images React-PDF draws: PNG and JPEG. Not SVG, which can carry scripts, nor WebP or HEIC, which it can't draw. */
export const logoContentTypes = ["image/png", "image/jpeg"] as const;
export type LogoContentType = (typeof logoContentTypes)[number];

/** The largest logo: 1 MB, plenty for a header 40 points high, and quick for the worker to read for every PDF. */
export const MAX_LOGO_BYTES = 1024 * 1024;

/** The record type logos are attached to; the record is the organization itself. */
export const LOGO_RECORD_TYPE = "organization_logo";

export const requestLogoUploadInput = z.strictObject({
  fileName: attachmentFileName,
  contentType: z.enum(logoContentTypes),
  sizeBytes: z.number().int().min(1).max(MAX_LOGO_BYTES),
});
export type RequestLogoUploadInput = z.infer<typeof requestLogoUploadInput>;

/** An uploaded logo, by its attachment: to confirm it arrived, or to remove it. */
export const logoRefInput = z.strictObject({ attachmentId: z.uuid() });
export type LogoRefInput = z.infer<typeof logoRefInput>;

/** Where the browser PUTs the logo, and the attachment to confirm afterwards. */
export const logoUpload = z.object({ attachmentId: z.uuid(), upload: presignedUpload });
export type LogoUpload = z.infer<typeof logoUpload>;

/** The logo as the branding screen shows it: through a short-lived link. */
export const organizationLogo = z.object({
  attachmentId: z.uuid(),
  fileName: z.string(),
  url: z.url(),
  expiresAt: z.iso.datetime(),
});
export type OrganizationLogo = z.infer<typeof organizationLogo>;
```

**Create `packages/integrations/src/pdf/image-type.ts`:**

```ts
// What kind of image a logo's bytes really are. Storage checks only the type the browser declared, so a renamed file
// can arrive, and React-PDF silently leaves out an image it can't read.

const PNG_SIGNATURE = [0x89, 0x50, 0x4e, 0x47, 0x0d, 0x0a, 0x1a, 0x0a] as const;
const JPEG_SIGNATURE = [0xff, 0xd8, 0xff] as const;

function startsWith(bytes: Uint8Array, signature: readonly number[]): boolean {
  return bytes.byteLength >= signature.length && signature.every((byte, index) => bytes[index] === byte);
}

/** "image/png" or "image/jpeg", from the file's own signature; null for anything else. */
export function imageTypeOf(bytes: Uint8Array): "image/png" | "image/jpeg" | null {
  if (startsWith(bytes, PNG_SIGNATURE)) return "image/png";
  if (startsWith(bytes, JPEG_SIGNATURE)) return "image/jpeg";
  return null;
}
```

```ts
/**
```

```ts
 * when some text holds characters the fonts can't show. Text is printed in its composed (NFC) form with \n line
```

```ts
/**
 * A file's bytes, for server code that has already decided the file may be shown and draws it into what it makes:
 * the organization's logo on a PDF. Named by its record, so an id that belongs to another record is "not found";
 * sensitive files are refused, as for systemDownloadLink.
 */
export async function systemFile(
  { db, storage }: FilesDependencies,
  organizationId: string,
  input: AttachmentRefInput,
): Promise<StoredFile> {
  const row = await db.forOrg(organizationId, (tx) => findAttachment(tx, input));
  assertReady(row);
  if (row.sensitive) {
    throw new DomainError("FORBIDDEN", "SENSITIVE_FILE", "Sensitive files are shown only to staff allowed to see them");
  }
  const body = await storage.get(storageKeyOf(row));
  // A ready file that storage has lost is a fault, not a missing file: fail, so a job that wanted it is retried.
  if (!body) throw new Error(`Attachment ${row.id} is ready but storage holds nothing for it`);
  return { body, contentType: row.contentType };
}

/** A pending upload hasn't arrived: as far as anyone downloading is concerned, it doesn't exist yet. */
```

**Create `packages/domain/src/documents/document-logo.ts`:**

```ts
// The organization's logo for a document's PDF: the bytes of the logo frozen in its branding, read from storage
// when the worker renders it, and drawn as the image they really are.
import { LOGO_RECORD_TYPE } from "@travel-crm/contracts/profile";
import { imageTypeOf, type DocumentBranding } from "@travel-crm/integrations/pdf";
import type { Files } from "../files/index.js";
import { DomainError } from "../kernel/index.js";

/**
 * The logo to draw, or undefined to leave it out. Only the organization's own logo is read (its record is the
 * organization), so a frozen id that names any other file, a passport scan, is never printed. A logo removed since
 * the document was issued, or whose bytes aren't a PNG or JPEG (storage checks only the declared type), is left out
 * and the document still renders. Anything else, storage failing, is thrown, so the job is retried.
 */
export async function documentLogo(
  files: Pick<Files, "systemFile">,
  organizationId: string,
  logoAttachmentId: string | undefined,
): Promise<DocumentBranding["logo"]> {
  if (logoAttachmentId === undefined) return undefined;
  let body: Uint8Array;
  try {
    ({ body } = await files.systemFile(organizationId, {
      recordType: LOGO_RECORD_TYPE,
      recordId: organizationId,
      attachmentId: logoAttachmentId,
    }));
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof DomainError && (error.code === "NOT_FOUND" || error.code === "FORBIDDEN")) return undefined;
    throw error;
  }
  const contentType = imageTypeOf(body);
  return contentType === null ? undefined : { data: body, contentType };
}
```

```markdown
  stores the PDF as an attachment of the document (record type `issued_document`, file name `<number>.pdf`) and
  records it on the document.

```

Replace:

```markdown
  fix, the platform must clear `render_failure` and publish a new `document.issued`, and no code does that. Any other renderer error is rethrown, so the job is retried.
- The organization's logo isn't in the frozen branding yet: it joins with plan 4's branding settings.
```

with:

```markdown
  fix, the platform must clear `render_failure` and publish a new `document.issued`, and no code does that. Any other renderer error is rethrown, so the job is retried.
- The frozen branding names the organization's logo by its attachment id (`logoAttachmentId`, an `organization_logo`
  attachment whose record is the organization); the worker reads its bytes when it renders, through the files
  module's `systemFile`, and draws them as the image they are (PNG or JPEG by their signature). An id that names any
  other file is never read, so a passport scan can't be printed; a logo removed before the render, or whose bytes
  aren't a PNG or JPEG, is left out and the document still renders.
```

**`packages/api/src/routers/logo.ts`**, the whole file:

```ts
// organization.logo.*: the organization's logo, an attachment of record type organization_logo whose newest ready
// file is the logo (PNG or JPEG, at most 1 MB), for the branding screen and the issued documents' branding. The file
// goes straight to storage; the api hands out the links and checks what arrived.
import type { AttachmentSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/files";
import {
  LOGO_RECORD_TYPE,
  logoRefInput,
  logoUpload,
  organizationLogo,
  requestLogoUploadInput,
  type OrganizationLogo,
} from "@travel-crm/contracts/profile";
import type { Files } from "@travel-crm/domain/files";
import type { MemberAccess } from "@travel-crm/domain/identity";
import { DomainError } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { freshProcedure, orgProcedure } from "../procedures.js";
import { router } from "../trpc.js";

/** The organization's logos are attached to the organization itself. */
const logosOf = (member: MemberAccess) => ({ recordType: LOGO_RECORD_TYPE, recordId: member.organizationId });

/**
 * The organization's logo: the newest of its ready logo files, or undefined. A replaced logo is kept, so a document
 * issued with it a moment before still finds it when the worker renders.
 */
export async function currentLogo(
  files: Pick<Files, "list">,
  member: MemberAccess,
): Promise<AttachmentSummary | undefined> {
  // Oldest first.
  return (await files.list(member, logosOf(member))).at(-1);
}

/** The logo with a short-lived link to show it (5 minutes: the screen asks again when it opens). */
async function shown(files: Files, member: MemberAccess, logo: AttachmentSummary): Promise<OrganizationLogo> {
  const link = await files.downloadLink(member, { ...logosOf(member), attachmentId: logo.id });
  return { attachmentId: logo.id, fileName: logo.fileName, url: link.url, expiresAt: link.expiresAt.toISOString() };
}

export const logoRouter = router({
  get: orgProcedure
    .requires("settings:manage")
    .output(organizationLogo.nullable())
    .query(async ({ ctx }) => {
      const logo = await currentLogo(ctx.files, ctx.member);
      return logo ? shown(ctx.files, ctx.member, logo) : null;
    }),

  /** Where the browser PUTs the logo; it counts toward the organization's storage like any file. */
  requestUpload: freshProcedure
    .requires("settings:manage")
    .input(requestLogoUploadInput)
    .output(logoUpload)
    .mutation(async ({ ctx, input }) => {
      const { attachment, upload } = await ctx.files.requestUpload(ctx.member, {
        ...logosOf(ctx.member),
        ...input,
        sensitive: false,
      });
      return { attachmentId: attachment.id, upload: { ...upload, expiresAt: upload.expiresAt.toISOString() } };
    }),

  /** Once storage holds the promised file, it is the logo. Harmless to repeat, as after a retried PUT. */
  confirmUpload: freshProcedure
    .requires("settings:manage")
    .input(logoRefInput)
    .output(organizationLogo)
    .mutation(async ({ ctx, input }) => {
      const logo = await ctx.files.confirmUpload(ctx.member, { ...logosOf(ctx.member), ...input });
      return shown(ctx.files, ctx.member, logo);
    }),

  /**
   * Removes the logo and the ones it replaced, so an older logo never comes back in its place. A screen still showing
   * an older logo removes only that one and older: a newer logo, uploaded meanwhile, stays.
   */
  remove: freshProcedure
    .requires("settings:manage")
    .input(logoRefInput)
    .mutation(async ({ ctx, input }) => {
      const logos = await ctx.files.list(ctx.member, logosOf(ctx.member));
      const position = logos.findIndex((logo) => logo.id === input.attachmentId);
      if (position === -1) throw new DomainError("NOT_FOUND", "ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND", "No such logo");
      for (const logo of logos.slice(0, position + 1)) {
        await ctx.files.remove(ctx.member, { ...logosOf(ctx.member), attachmentId: logo.id });
      }
    }),
});
```


The worker's wiring (`apps/api/src/worker-jobs.ts`) already passes the whole files module to the listener: it needs
no change.

**Create `apps/web/src/branding/logo-file.ts`:**

```ts
// What may be sent as the logo, checked before anything is: the type and size the api accepts, and a name storage can
// keep. A file's own name may hold direction marks, which the api refuses; the logo's name matters to nobody.
import { attachmentFileName } from "@travel-crm/contracts/files";
import {
  logoContentTypes,
  MAX_LOGO_BYTES,
  type LogoContentType,
  type RequestLogoUploadInput,
} from "@travel-crm/contracts/profile";

/** Why a file can't be the logo; also its message key in "documents.branding.logo". */
export type LogoProblem = "wrongType" | "tooLarge";

const isLogoType = (type: string): type is LogoContentType => (logoContentTypes as readonly string[]).includes(type);

export function logoUploadOf(
  file: File,
): { ok: true; input: RequestLogoUploadInput } | { ok: false; problem: LogoProblem } {
  const contentType = file.type;
  // An empty file isn't an image of any type.
  if (!isLogoType(contentType) || file.size === 0) return { ok: false, problem: "wrongType" };
  if (file.size > MAX_LOGO_BYTES) return { ok: false, problem: "tooLarge" };
  const name = attachmentFileName.safeParse(file.name);
  const fileName = name.success ? name.data : `Logo.${contentType === "image/png" ? "png" : "jpg"}`;
  return { ok: true, input: { fileName, contentType, sizeBytes: file.size } };
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/branding/use-logo.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// Changing the logo (spec 9.2): the api says where to upload, the browser PUTs the file straight to storage with its
// progress, and the confirmed logo, with its link, replaces the one shown; or it is removed.
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { MAX_LOGO_BYTES } from "@travel-crm/contracts/profile";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useTRPC } from "@/data/trpc";
import { formatFileSize } from "@/files/file-size";
import { UploadError, uploadFile } from "@/files/upload";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { logoUploadOf } from "./logo-file";

export type LogoUploadState =
  { phase: "idle" } | { phase: "uploading"; progress: number } | { phase: "failed"; message: string };

export function useLogoUpload() {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const t = useTranslations("documents.branding.logo");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const requestUpload = useMutation(trpc.organization.logo.requestUpload.mutationOptions());
  const confirmUpload = useMutation(trpc.organization.logo.confirmUpload.mutationOptions());
  const [state, setState] = useState<LogoUploadState>({ phase: "idle" });

  const start = async (file: File): Promise<void> => {
    const checked = logoUploadOf(file);
    if (!checked.ok) {
      setState({ phase: "failed", message: t(checked.problem, { size: formatFileSize(MAX_LOGO_BYTES) }) });
      return;
    }
    setState({ phase: "uploading", progress: 0 });
    try {
      const { attachmentId, upload } = await requestUpload.mutateAsync(checked.input);
      await uploadFile(upload, file, {
        onProgress: (progress) => {
          setState({ phase: "uploading", progress });
        },
      });
      const logo = await confirmUpload.mutateAsync({ attachmentId });
      queryClient.setQueryData(trpc.organization.logo.get.queryKey(), logo);
      setState({ phase: "idle" });
      toast.success(t("saved"));
    } catch (error) {
      setState({ phase: "failed", message: error instanceof UploadError ? t("uploadFailed") : apiError(error) });
    }
  };

  return { state, start };
}

export function useRemoveLogo() {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const t = useTranslations("documents.branding.logo");
  return useMutation(
    trpc.organization.logo.remove.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: () => {
        toast.success(t("removed"));
      },
      onSettled: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.organization.logo.get.queryKey() }),
    }),
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// Removing the logo, asked once more: documents issued from now on have none, while those already issued keep theirs.
import type { OrganizationLogo } from "@travel-crm/contracts/profile";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { useRemoveLogo } from "./use-logo";

export function RemoveLogoDialog({
  logo,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
}: {
  logo: OrganizationLogo;
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("documents.branding.logo");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const remove = useRemoveLogo();
  return (
    <AlertDialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(next) => {
        if (!next) remove.reset();
        onOpenChange(next);
      }}
    >
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogTitle>{t("removeTitle")}</AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>{t("removeDescription")}</AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        {remove.isError && (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertDescription>{apiError(remove.error)}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel>{tCommon("cancel")}</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction
            // The final step of a destructive action is the one place red fills a button (DESIGN.md section 6).
            className="bg-status-bad-ink text-on-action hover:bg-status-bad-ink/90"
            disabled={remove.isPending}
            onClick={(event) => {
              // Stay open until the api answers, so a refusal is shown here and the button can't be pressed twice.
              event.preventDefault();
              remove.mutate(
                { attachmentId: logo.attachmentId },
                {
                  onSuccess: () => {
                    onOpenChange(false);
                  },
                },
              );
            }}
          >
            {t("removeConfirm")}
          </AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The logo on the branding screen: the current one, shown through its short-lived link, and uploading a PNG or JPEG
// straight to storage with its progress, or removing it. Type and size are checked here before anything is sent.
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { MAX_LOGO_BYTES, type OrganizationLogo } from "@travel-crm/contracts/profile";
import Image from "next/image";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Progress } from "@/components/ui/progress";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { useTRPC } from "@/data/trpc";
import { formatFileSize } from "@/files/file-size";
import { useWriteAccess } from "@/subscription/write-access";
import { RemoveLogoDialog } from "./remove-logo-dialog";
import { useLogoUpload } from "./use-logo";

/** The logo as it was uploaded, contained in the space a document's header gives it. */
function LogoImage({ logo }: { logo: OrganizationLogo }) {
  const t = useTranslations("documents.branding.logo");
  const [broken, setBroken] = useState(false);
  if (broken) return <p className="text-label text-status-bad-ink">{t("broken")}</p>;
  return (
    <div className="relative h-20 w-48">
      {/* Unoptimized: the link is storage's own, signed and short-lived, never fetched by the web server. */}
      <Image
        src={logo.url}
        alt={t("alt")}
        fill
        unoptimized
        sizes="192px"
        className="object-contain object-left"
        onError={() => {
          setBroken(true);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

export function LogoPanel() {
  const t = useTranslations("documents.branding.logo");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  // The link lasts five minutes: never kept in the saved copy, and asked for again once it is a minute old.
  const logo = useQuery(
    trpc.organization.logo.get.queryOptions(undefined, { staleTime: 60_000, meta: { persist: false } }),
  );
  const { state, start } = useLogoUpload();
  const write = useWriteAccess();
  const fileInput = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState(false);
  const uploading = state.phase === "uploading";

  const preview = () => {
    if (logo.data) return <LogoImage key={logo.data.url} logo={logo.data} />;
    if (logo.data === null) return <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("none")}</p>;
    if (logo.isError) {
      return (
        <ErrorState message={t("loadFailed")} retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")} onRetry={() => void logo.refetch()} />
      );
    }
    return (
      <Delayed>
        <Skeleton role="status" aria-label={tCommon("loading")} className="h-20 w-48" />
      </Delayed>
    );
  };

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="logo-heading" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <h2 id="logo-heading" className="text-section font-semibold">
        {t("heading")}
      </h2>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 rounded-lg border p-4">
        {preview()}
        <p className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{t("hint", { size: formatFileSize(MAX_LOGO_BYTES) })}</p>
        {uploading && <Progress value={state.progress * 100} aria-label={t("uploading")} />}
        {state.phase === "failed" && (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertDescription>{state.message}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}
        <input
          ref={fileInput}
          type="file"
          accept="image/png,image/jpeg"
          aria-label={t("fileLabel")}
          tabIndex={-1}
          className="sr-only"
          onChange={(event) => {
            const file = event.target.files?.[0];
            // Cleared, so choosing the same file again (after a failed upload) is a change too.
            event.target.value = "";
            if (file) void start(file);
          }}
        />
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            disabled={!write.allowed || uploading || logo.isPending}
            onClick={() => fileInput.current?.click()}
          >
            {logo.data ? t("replace") : t("upload")}
          </Button>
          {logo.data && (
            <Button
              variant="destructive"
              disabled={!write.allowed || uploading}
              onClick={() => {
                setRemoving(true);
              }}
            >
              {t("remove")}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
        {write.hint !== null && <p className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{write.hint}</p>}
      </div>
      {logo.data && <RemoveLogoDialog logo={logo.data} open={removing} onOpenChange={setRemoving} />}
    </section>
  );
}
```
