```tsx
"use client";

// The colour and terms section (organization.branding): the saved branding in its form, or, before the business
// details exist, the way to them first (the api refuses branding until then).
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { useTRPC } from "@/data/trpc";
import { routes } from "@/lib/routes";
import { BrandingDetailsForm } from "./branding-details-form";

export function BrandingForm() {
  const t = useTranslations("documents.branding");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  // Always asked again when the screen opens: a form starts from the api's latest answer, not a restored copy.
  const branding = useQuery(trpc.organization.branding.get.queryOptions());

  const body = () => {
    if (branding.data) {
      const { brandColour, documentTerms } = branding.data;
      // Keyed by what is saved, so the api's answer replacing an older copy (restored after a reload, or saved in
      // another tab) starts the form again from it. Not by updatedAt: a branding save leaves it as it was.
      return <BrandingDetailsForm key={JSON.stringify([brandColour, documentTerms])} saved={branding.data} />;
    }
    if (branding.data === null) {
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-2">
          <p>{t("profileFirst")}</p>
          <Link href={routes.profile} className="flex min-h-11 items-center text-primary underline underline-offset-4">
            {t("profileLink")}
          </Link>
        </div>
      );
    }
    if (branding.isError) {
      return (
        <ErrorState
          message={t("details.loadFailed")}
          retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")}
          onRetry={() => void branding.refetch()}
        />
      );
    }
    return (
      <Delayed>
        <div role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={tCommon("loading")} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <Skeleton className="h-11 w-48" />
          <Skeleton className="h-28 w-full" />
        </div>
      </Delayed>
    );
  };

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="branding-details-heading" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <h2 id="branding-details-heading" className="text-section font-semibold">
        {t("details.heading")}
      </h2>
      <div className="rounded-lg border p-4">{body()}</div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldGroup, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { useWriteAccess } from "@/subscription/write-access";
import { useSaveBranding } from "./use-branding";

interface BrandingValues {
  brandColour: string;
  documentTerms: string;
}

const HEX_COLOUR = /^#[0-9a-f]{6}$/i;

const valuesOf = (branding: BrandingDetails): BrandingValues => ({
  brandColour: branding.brandColour ?? "",
  documentTerms: branding.documentTerms ?? "",
});

export function BrandingDetailsForm({ saved }: { saved: BrandingDetails }) {
  const t = useTranslations("documents.branding.details");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const write = useWriteAccess();
  const save = useSaveBranding();
  const resolver: Resolver<BrandingValues> = (values) => {
    const checked = saveBrandingInput.safeParse(values);
    if (checked.success) return { values, errors: {} };
    const errors: FieldErrors<BrandingValues> = {};
    for (const issue of checked.error.issues) {
      if (issue.path[0] === "brandColour") errors.brandColour = { type: "validate", message: t("colourInvalid") };
      if (issue.path[0] === "documentTerms") errors.documentTerms = { type: "validate", message: t("termsTooLong") };
    }
    return { values: {}, errors };
  };
  const form = useForm<BrandingValues>({ resolver, defaultValues: valuesOf(saved) });
  const { errors } = form.formState;
  const colour = useWatch({ control: form.control, name: "brandColour" }).trim();
  // A colour input holds a colour at all times: the typed one when it is one, else the standard colour documents use.
  const swatch = HEX_COLOUR.test(colour) ? colour.toLowerCase() : brand.colours.action;

  const submit = form.handleSubmit((values) => {
    save.mutate(values, {
      onSuccess: (branding) => {
        form.reset(valuesOf(branding));
      },
    });
  });

  return (
    <form noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)} className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <FieldGroup>
        <Field data-invalid={errors.brandColour !== undefined}>
          <FieldLabel htmlFor="brand-colour">{t("colour")}</FieldLabel>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <input
              type="color"
              aria-label={t("colourPicker")}
              value={swatch}
              className="size-11 shrink-0 cursor-pointer rounded-sm border border-input bg-background p-1"
              onChange={(event) => {
                form.setValue("brandColour", event.target.value, { shouldDirty: true, shouldValidate: true });
              }}
            />
            <Input
              id="brand-colour"
              className="numbers w-36"
              maxLength={7}
              autoComplete="off"
              autoCapitalize="none"
              spellCheck={false}
              aria-invalid={errors.brandColour !== undefined}
              {...form.register("brandColour")}
            />
          </div>
          <FieldDescription>{t("colourHint")}</FieldDescription>
          <FieldError errors={[errors.brandColour]} />
        </Field>
        <Field data-invalid={errors.documentTerms !== undefined}>
          <FieldLabel htmlFor="document-terms">{t("terms")}</FieldLabel>
          <Textarea
            id="document-terms"
            maxLength={2000}
            rows={4}
            className="script-leading"
            aria-invalid={errors.documentTerms !== undefined}
            {...form.register("documentTerms")}
          />
          <FieldDescription>{t("termsHint")}</FieldDescription>
          <FieldError errors={[errors.documentTerms]} />
        </Field>
      </FieldGroup>
      {save.isError && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertDescription>{apiError(save.error)}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}
      <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-2">
        <Button type="submit" disabled={!write.allowed || save.isPending}>
          {save.isPending ? t("saving") : t("save")}
        </Button>
        {write.hint !== null && <p className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{write.hint}</p>}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

### Task D2: An Owner previews the branding on a sample quotation, and finds every issued document with its PDF

The branding screen gains "Preview on a sample quotation": `documents.issueSample` issues the Foundation's sample
template as a quotation with the branding as saved (the organization's name, colour, terms and current logo, frozen),
its made-up lines taxed within the organization's own GST state, numbered `SMPL-<year>-<n>` and kept like every issued
document. The screen says while the worker prepares the PDF, asking `documents.get` again every two seconds, then
offers it to download through `documents.downloadLink`'s five-minute link (storage sends it as a download under its
number, so the page stays). `/settings/documents` lists the organization's issued documents newest first, a page at a
time (`documents.list`): number, document, when it was issued in the organization's zone, and whether its PDF is ready,
being prepared or can never be made, refreshing while one is being prepared; a ready PDF is a click away. The api
refuses a sample before the business details (they hold the GST state), and the read-only organization may look and
download but issue nothing.

**Create `packages/domain/test/documents/list-issued-documents.test.ts`:**

```ts
// The organization's issued documents for its documents screen: newest first, a page at a time, each saying whether
// its PDF is ready, being prepared or can never be made, and never another organization's.
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { issueDocument, listIssuedDocuments } from "../../src/documents/index.js";
import { systemActor } from "../../src/kernel/index.js";
import { createOrganization, createTestDocuments, quotation, type TestDocuments } from "./test-documents.js";

describe("listIssuedDocuments", () => {
  let test: TestDocuments;

  beforeAll(() => {
    test = createTestDocuments();
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await test.close();
  });

  /** Issues a document a minute after the one before, as people do. */
  const issuedAt = (minute: number) => new Date(Date.UTC(2026, 9, 15, 6, minute));

  async function issued(organizationId: string, minute: number) {
    return test.db.forOrg(organizationId, (tx) =>
      issueDocument(tx, systemActor(organizationId), { ...quotation }, issuedAt(minute)),
    );
  }

  it("lists the newest first, a page at a time", async () => {
    const organizationId = await createOrganization(test);
    const documents = [
      await issued(organizationId, 1),
      await issued(organizationId, 2),
      await issued(organizationId, 3),
    ];
    const list = (input: { cursor?: string; limit?: number }) =>
      test.db.forOrg(organizationId, (tx) => listIssuedDocuments(tx, input));

    const first = await list({ limit: 2 });
    expect(first.documents.map((document) => document.number)).toEqual(["DOC-2026-0003", "DOC-2026-0002"]);
    expect(first.nextCursor).toBe(documents[1]?.id);
    if (first.nextCursor === null) throw new Error("a second page was expected");
    const second = await list({ limit: 2, cursor: first.nextCursor });
    expect(second).toEqual({ documents: [documents[0]], nextCursor: null });
    expect((await list({})).documents).toHaveLength(3);
  });

  it("says which PDFs can never be made", async () => {
    const organizationId = await createOrganization(test);
    const document = await issued(organizationId, 1);
    await test.db.forOrg(organizationId, (tx) =>
      tx.issuedDocument.update({ where: { id: document.id }, data: { renderFailure: "UNPRINTABLE_TEXT: U+0939" } }),
    );
    const { documents } = await test.db.forOrg(organizationId, (tx) => listIssuedDocuments(tx, {}));
    expect(documents).toMatchObject([{ id: document.id, pdfAttachmentId: null, renderFailed: true }]);
  });

  it("shows nothing of another organization's, not even through its cursor", async () => {
    const organizationId = await createOrganization(test);
    const other = await createOrganization(test);
    const theirs = await issued(other, 1);
    await issued(organizationId, 2);
    const list = (cursor?: string) =>
      test.db.forOrg(organizationId, (tx) => listIssuedDocuments(tx, cursor === undefined ? {} : { cursor }));
    expect((await list()).documents.map((document) => document.id)).not.toContain(theirs.id);
    expect(await list(theirs.id)).toEqual({ documents: [], nextCursor: null });
  });

  it("refuses a page it can't read", async () => {
    const organizationId = await createOrganization(test);
    for (const input of [{ limit: 0 }, { limit: 51 }, { cursor: "page-2" }]) {
      await expect(
        test.db.forOrg(organizationId, (tx) => listIssuedDocuments(tx, input)),
        JSON.stringify(input),
      ).rejects.toMatchObject({ code: "VALIDATION", reason: "INVALID_PAGE" });
    }
  });
});
```

```ts
// The sample quotation an organization previews its branding on: its name, colour, terms and logo, made-up lines
// taxed in its own state, and nothing the organization didn't set.
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { brandedSampleQuotation, SAMPLE_PREFIX } from "../../src/documents/index.js";

const profile = { gstStateCode: "29", brandColour: "#1f6f5c", documentTerms: "50% to book." };

describe("brandedSampleQuotation", () => {
  it("carries the organization's branding, its logo among it", () => {
    const sample = brandedSampleQuotation({
      organizationName: "Konkan Trails",
      profile,
      logoAttachmentId: "0199e7a0-0000-7000-8000-00000000a001",
    });
    expect(sample.branding).toEqual({
      organizationName: "Konkan Trails",
      accentColour: "#1f6f5c",
      terms: "50% to book.",
      logoAttachmentId: "0199e7a0-0000-7000-8000-00000000a001",
    });
    expect(sample.template).toBe("sample");
    expect(sample.content.title).toBe("Quotation");
    expect(sample.content.notes).toMatch(/sample/i);
  });

  it("taxes its lines within the organization's own state: CGST and SGST", () => {
    const labels = brandedSampleQuotation({ organizationName: "Konkan Trails", profile }).content.totals.map(
      (total) => total.label,
    );
    expect(labels).toContain("CGST 2.5 %");
    expect(labels).toContain("SGST 2.5 %");
    expect(labels).not.toContain("IGST 5 %");
  });

  it("leaves out what the organization didn't set", () => {
    const sample = brandedSampleQuotation({
      organizationName: "Konkan Trails",
      profile: { gstStateCode: "27", brandColour: null, documentTerms: null },
    });
    expect(sample.branding).toEqual({ organizationName: "Konkan Trails" });
  });

  it("is numbered with its own prefix, apart from real documents", () => {
    expect(SAMPLE_PREFIX).toMatch(/^[A-Z]{2,5}$/);
    expect(SAMPLE_PREFIX).toBe("SMPL");
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/api/test/documents.test.ts`:**

```ts
// The documents screen's api (spec 9.3): a sample quotation issued from the profile and branding, logo included,
// numbered SMPL and kept like every issued document; the organization's documents newest first, a page at a time;
// and a short-lived link to a rendered PDF. Only roles with settings:manage reach them; read-only organizations may
// look and download, but issue nothing.
import type { IssuedDocumentPage, IssuedDocumentSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/documents";
import type { DownloadLinkOutput } from "@travel-crm/contracts/files";
import type { LogoUpload, OrganizationLogo } from "@travel-crm/contracts/profile";
import { issuedDocumentRenderInput } from "@travel-crm/contracts/documents";
import { renderIssuedDocumentListener } from "@travel-crm/domain/documents";
import { runListenerJob } from "@travel-crm/domain/jobs";
import { renderPdf } from "@travel-crm/integrations/pdf";
import { createMemoryStorage, type MemoryStorage } from "@travel-crm/integrations/storage";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { CookieJar } from "./support/cookie-jar.js";
import { addStaff, signedInOwner, signedInStaff } from "./support/people.js";
import { createTestAgency, createTestServer, type TestAgency, type TestServer } from "./support/test-server.js";
import { dataOf, mutate, query, refusalOf } from "./support/trpc.js";

const profile = {
  legalName: "Konkan Trails LLP",
  gstin: "27AAPFU0939F1ZV",
  gstStateCode: "27",
  address: "12 Hill Road, Bandra, Mumbai 400050",
  contactName: "Lakshmi Nair",
  contactPhone: "+91 98200 12345",
  bankAccountName: "Konkan Trails LLP",
  bankAccountNumber: "001234567890",
  bankIfsc: "HDFC0001234",
  bankName: "HDFC Bank",
  invoicePrefix: "KT",
};

/** A 1x1 PNG: a logo the PDF can draw. */
const logoPng = Uint8Array.from(
  atob("iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNkYPhfDwAChwGA60e6kgAAAABJRU5ErkJggg=="),
  (character) => character.charCodeAt(0),
);

describe("issued documents", () => {
  let server: TestServer;
  let storage: MemoryStorage;

  beforeAll(() => {
    storage = createMemoryStorage();
    server = createTestServer({}, { storage });
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await server.close();
  });

  /** An agency whose Owner has saved the business details and the branding, signed in. */
  async function brandedAgency(): Promise<{ agency: TestAgency; jar: CookieJar }> {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const jar = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    await dataOf(await mutate(server, "organization.profile.update", profile, jar));
    await dataOf(
      await mutate(
        server,
        "organization.branding.update",
        { brandColour: "#1F6F5C", documentTerms: "50% to book." },
        jar,
      ),
    );
    return { agency, jar };
  }

  async function uploadedLogo(jar: CookieJar): Promise<OrganizationLogo> {
    const { attachmentId, upload } = await dataOf<LogoUpload>(
      await mutate(
        server,
        "organization.logo.requestUpload",
        { fileName: "Logo.png", contentType: "image/png", sizeBytes: logoPng.byteLength },
        jar,
      ),
    );
    await storage.upload({ ...upload, expiresAt: new Date(upload.expiresAt) }, logoPng, "image/png");
    return dataOf<OrganizationLogo>(await mutate(server, "organization.logo.confirmUpload", { attachmentId }, jar));
  }

  const issueSample = async (jar: CookieJar) =>
    dataOf<IssuedDocumentSummary>(await mutate(server, "documents.issueSample", undefined, jar));

  /** What the worker does after issuing: run the render listener for the document.issued event. */
  async function rendered(agency: TestAgency, documentId: string): Promise<void> {
    const event = await server.db.forOrg(agency.organizationId, (tx) =>
      tx.outboxEvent.findFirstOrThrow({ where: { type: "document.issued", payload: { equals: { documentId } } } }),
    );
    const listener = renderIssuedDocumentListener({ files: server.files, render: renderPdf });
    expect(
      await runListenerJob({
        db: server.db,
        listener,
        data: { organizationId: agency.organizationId, eventId: event.id, eventType: event.type },
      }),
    ).toBe("handled");
  }

  it("issues a sample quotation from the profile and branding, with the logo frozen in it", async () => {
    const { agency, jar } = await brandedAgency();
    const logo = await uploadedLogo(jar);
    const sample = await issueSample(jar);
    expect(sample).toMatchObject({
      template: "sample",
      title: "Quotation",
      pdfAttachmentId: null,
      renderFailed: false,
    });
    expect(sample.number).toMatch(/^SMPL-\d{4}-0001$/);

    const stored = await server.db.forOrg(agency.organizationId, (tx) =>
      tx.issuedDocument.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: sample.id } }),
    );
    expect(issuedDocumentRenderInput.parse(stored.renderInput).branding).toEqual({
      organizationName: "Test agency",
      accentColour: "#1f6f5c",
      terms: "50% to book.",
      logoAttachmentId: logo.attachmentId,
    });
    // Kept, as every issued document is: the next sample has the next number.
    expect((await issueSample(jar)).number).toMatch(/^SMPL-\d{4}-0002$/);
  });

  it("gives a short-lived link to the PDF once the worker has rendered it, logo and all", async () => {
    const { agency, jar } = await brandedAgency();
    await uploadedLogo(jar);
    const sample = await issueSample(jar);
    expect(await refusalOf(await query(server, "documents.downloadLink", jar, { documentId: sample.id }))).toEqual({
      status: 404,
      reason: "DOCUMENT_NOT_READY",
    });

    await rendered(agency, sample.id);
    const ready = await dataOf<IssuedDocumentSummary>(
      await query(server, "documents.get", jar, { documentId: sample.id }),
    );
    expect(ready.pdfAttachmentId).not.toBeNull();
    const link = await dataOf<DownloadLinkOutput>(
      await query(server, "documents.downloadLink", jar, { documentId: sample.id }),
    );
    const key = `organizations/${agency.organizationId}/attachments/${ready.pdfAttachmentId ?? ""}`;
    expect(link.url).toContain(encodeURIComponent(key));
    expect(link.url).toContain(encodeURIComponent(`${sample.number}.pdf`));
    expect(new Date(link.expiresAt).getTime() - Date.now()).toBeLessThanOrEqual(5 * 60 * 1000);
    const pdf = new TextDecoder("latin1").decode(storage.objects.get(key)?.body);
    expect(pdf.startsWith("%PDF-")).toBe(true);
    expect(pdf).toContain("/Subtype /Image");
  });

  it("lists the organization's documents newest first, a page at a time", async () => {
    const { jar } = await brandedAgency();
    const issued = [await issueSample(jar), await issueSample(jar), await issueSample(jar)];
    const first = await dataOf<IssuedDocumentPage>(await query(server, "documents.list", jar, { limit: 2 }));
    expect(first.documents.map((document) => document.id)).toEqual([issued[2]?.id, issued[1]?.id]);
    const rest = await dataOf<IssuedDocumentPage>(
      await query(server, "documents.list", jar, { limit: 2, cursor: first.nextCursor }),
    );
    expect(rest).toEqual({ documents: [issued[0]], nextCursor: null });
  });

  it("says a PDF that can never be made can't be downloaded", async () => {
    const { agency, jar } = await brandedAgency();
    const sample = await issueSample(jar);
    await server.db.forOrg(agency.organizationId, (tx) =>
      tx.issuedDocument.update({ where: { id: sample.id }, data: { renderFailure: "UNPRINTABLE_TEXT: U+0939" } }),
    );
    expect(await refusalOf(await query(server, "documents.downloadLink", jar, { documentId: sample.id }))).toEqual({
      status: 404,
      reason: "DOCUMENT_UNAVAILABLE",
    });
    const { documents } = await dataOf<IssuedDocumentPage>(await query(server, "documents.list", jar, {}));
    expect(documents).toMatchObject([{ id: sample.id, renderFailed: true }]);
  });

  it("refuses a sample before the business details, and another organization's document", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const jar = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    expect(await refusalOf(await mutate(server, "documents.issueSample", undefined, jar))).toEqual({
      status: 409,
      reason: "PROFILE_NOT_SAVED",
    });
    const { jar: otherJar } = await brandedAgency();
    const theirs = await issueSample(otherJar);

      });

    for (const [path, input] of [

      expect(await refusalOf(await query(server, path, salesJar, input)), path).toEqual(refused);

  it("lets a read-only organization's Owner look and download, but issue nothing", async () => {
    const { agency, jar } = await brandedAgency();

    await rendered(agency, sample.id);

    expect((await query(server, "documents.list", jar, {})).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await query(server, "documents.downloadLink", jar, { documentId: sample.id })).status).toBe(200);
    expect(await refusalOf(await mutate(server, "documents.issueSample", undefined, jar))).toEqual({
      status: 403,
      reason: "ORGANIZATION_READ_ONLY",
    });
  });
});
```

**`apps/web/test/documents/sent.ts`**, the whole file:

```ts
// What the app sent the stubbed api (support/api-stub.ts): each call's input to one procedure, in order, read from the
// fetch the stub stands in for. tRPC batches calls: "/api/trpc/a,b" with the inputs by position, { "0": …, "1": … },
// in the body of a POST (mutations) or the `input` parameter of a GET (queries).
import { vi } from "vitest";

type FetchCall = [input: RequestInfo | URL, init?: RequestInit];

const API_TRPC = "/api/trpc/";

export function inputsSentTo(path: string): unknown[] {
  const calls = vi.mocked(fetch).mock.calls as FetchCall[];
  return calls.flatMap(([input, init]) => {
    const url = new URL(input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input), "http://localhost");
    if (!url.pathname.startsWith(API_TRPC)) return [];
    const paths = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname.slice(API_TRPC.length)).split(",");
    const sent = init?.method === "POST" ? init.body : url.searchParams.get("input");
    const inputs = JSON.parse(typeof sent === "string" ? sent : "{}") as Record<string, unknown>;
    return paths.flatMap((called, position) => (called === path ? [inputs[String(position)]] : []));
  });
}
```

```tsx
// prepares its PDF, then downloads it through a short-lived link. A refusal shows its sentence; a sample whose PDF can
// never be made says so; in a read-only organization the preview is disabled with the reason.

import { SamplePreview } from "@/branding/sample-preview";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { loadPage } from "@/lib/navigate";

vi.mock("@/lib/navigate", () => ({ loadPage: vi.fn(), replacePage: vi.fn() }));

const preparing = {

  template: "sample",
  number: "SMPL-2026-0001",

  renderedAt: null,

}

});

});
```

```ts
// A sample quotation (spec 9.3): an Owner previews their branding on one, the worker renders its PDF, and the PDF
// downloads from storage, from the branding screen and from the documents screen, which lists it as ready.
import { readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import type { Download } from "@playwright/test";
import { saveBusinessProfile } from "./support/documents";
import { expect, signInByEmail, test } from "./support/fixtures";

/** The downloaded file's name and its first bytes. */
async function downloaded(download: Download): Promise<{ name: string; start: string }> {
  const file = await download.path();
  return { name: download.suggestedFilename(), start: (await readFile(file)).subarray(0, 5).toString("latin1") };
}

test("an Owner previews a sample quotation, and downloads its PDF once the worker has made it", async ({
  page,
  agency,
}) => {
  await signInByEmail(page, agency.owner);
  await saveBusinessProfile(page);
  await page.goto("/settings/branding");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Preview on a sample quotation" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText(/^SMPL-\d{4}-0001 is being prepared/)).toBeVisible();
  // The worker renders it in the background; the screen asks again until it has.
  await expect(page.getByText(/^SMPL-\d{4}-0001 is ready/)).toBeVisible({ timeout: 20_000 });

  const fromBranding = page.waitForEvent("download");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Download the PDF" }).click();
  const sample = await downloaded(await fromBranding);
  expect(sample.name).toMatch(/^SMPL-\d{4}-0001\.pdf$/);
  expect(sample.start).toBe("%PDF-");

  await page.getByRole("link", { name: "All documents" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: "Documents" })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText("Ready", { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  const fromList = page.waitForEvent("download");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Download SMPL-\d{4}-0001 as a PDF$/ }).click();
  expect((await downloaded(await fromList)).start).toBe("%PDF-");
});
```

**Create `packages/domain/src/documents/list-issued-documents.ts`:**

```ts
// The organization's issued documents for its documents screen: newest first, a page at a time.
import {
  listIssuedDocumentsInput,
  type IssuedDocumentPage,
  type ListIssuedDocumentsInput,
} from "@travel-crm/contracts/documents";
import type { OrgTx } from "@travel-crm/db";
import { DomainError } from "../kernel/index.js";
import { summaryFields, toSummary } from "./issued-document-row.js";

/**
 * One page of the transaction's organization's documents, the newest issued first (the id breaks a tie). The next page
 * starts after `cursor`, the last document of the page before; a cursor this organization can't see starts nothing.
 */
export async function listIssuedDocuments(tx: OrgTx, input: ListIssuedDocumentsInput): Promise<IssuedDocumentPage> {
  const checked = listIssuedDocumentsInput.safeParse(input);
  if (!checked.success) throw new DomainError("VALIDATION", "INVALID_PAGE", "That page of documents can't be read");
  const { cursor, limit } = checked.data;
  // One more than a page, to know whether another follows.
  const rows = await tx.issuedDocument.findMany({
    select: summaryFields,
    orderBy: [{ issuedAt: "desc" }, { id: "desc" }],
    take: limit + 1,
    ...(cursor === undefined ? {} : { cursor: { id: cursor }, skip: 1 }),
  });
  const page = rows.slice(0, limit);
  const last = page.at(-1);
  return { documents: page.map(toSummary), nextCursor: rows.length > limit && last ? last.id : null };
}
```

```ts
// The sample quotation an organization previews its branding on (spec 9.3): made-up lines taxed in its own state,
// with its name, colour, terms and logo, ready for issueDocument with the samples' own prefix. A sample is issued and
// kept like any document; its number says what it is.
import type { IssueDocumentInput } from "@travel-crm/contracts/documents";
import type { OrganizationProfileDetails } from "@travel-crm/contracts/profile";
import { isGstStateCode, money } from "../kernel/index.js";
import { sampleQuotation } from "./sample-quotation.js";

/** Samples are numbered apart from real documents: SMPL-2026-0001. Prefixes are 2-5 capital letters. */
export const SAMPLE_PREFIX = "SMPL";

export interface SampleBranding {
  /** The organization's name, as its documents' header shows it. */
  organizationName: string;
  profile: Pick<OrganizationProfileDetails, "gstStateCode" | "brandColour" | "documentTerms">;
  /** The organization's current logo, frozen into the sample. */
  logoAttachmentId?: string | undefined;
}

export function brandedSampleQuotation({
  organizationName,
  profile,
  logoAttachmentId,
}: SampleBranding): IssueDocumentInput {
  const state = profile.gstStateCode;
  // The database holds only the kernel's state codes; anything else is a fault, not a person's mistake.
  if (!isGstStateCode(state)) throw new RangeError(`Not a GST state code: ${JSON.stringify(state)}`);
  return sampleQuotation({
    recipient: { name: "Meera Iyer", lines: ["A customer of yours"] },
    // Within the organization's own state: CGST and SGST, as most of its quotations will be.
    supplierStateCode: state,
    placeOfSupplyStateCode: state,
    lines: [
      {
        description: "Andaman islands, 6 nights",
        detail: "2 adults, sea-view room",
        // Tour operator services.
        sacCode: "998555",
        taxableValue: money(1_25_000_00),
        rateBasisPoints: 500,
      },
      {
        description: "Airport transfers",
        detail: "Port Blair, both ways",
        sacCode: "996601",
        taxableValue: money(4_500_00),
        rateBasisPoints: 1800,
      },
    ],
    branding: {
      organizationName,
      ...(profile.brandColour === null ? {} : { accentColour: profile.brandColour }),
      ...(profile.documentTerms === null ? {} : { terms: profile.documentTerms }),
      ...(logoAttachmentId === undefined ? {} : { logoAttachmentId }),
    },
    notes: "A sample, to show how your quotations look. It is not an offer.",
  });
}
```

```ts
  getIssuedDocument,
  issueDocument,
  listIssuedDocuments,
  SAMPLE_PREFIX,
} from "@travel-crm/domain/documents";
import { DomainError } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { freshProcedure, orgProcedure } from "../procedures.js";
import { router } from "../trpc.js";
import { currentLogo } from "./logo.js";

export const documentsRouter = router({
  /**
   * Issues a sample quotation with the branding as saved now, logo included, numbered SMPL-<year>-<n>. It is kept like
   * every issued document: what was issued is never removed.
   */
  issueSample: freshProcedure
    .requires("settings:manage")
    .output(issuedDocumentSummary)
    .mutation(async ({ ctx }) => {
      const { organizationId } = ctx.member;
      const [profile, organization, logo] = await Promise.all([
        ctx.profiles.get(organizationId),
        ctx.identity.organizationProfile(organizationId),
        currentLogo(ctx.files, ctx.member),
      ]);
      // The sample is taxed in the organization's GST state, which the business details hold.
      if (!profile) {
        throw new DomainError("CONFLICT", "PROFILE_NOT_SAVED", "Save the business details before a sample");
      }
      const sample = brandedSampleQuotation({
        organizationName: organization?.name ?? profile.legalName,
        profile,
        logoAttachmentId: logo?.id,
      });
      return ctx.db.forOrg(organizationId, (tx) => issueDocument(tx, ctx.member, { ...sample, prefix: SAMPLE_PREFIX }));
    }),

  list: orgProcedure
    .requires("settings:manage")
    .input(listIssuedDocumentsInput)
    .output(issuedDocumentPage)
    .query(({ ctx, input }) => ctx.db.forOrg(ctx.member.organizationId, (tx) => listIssuedDocuments(tx, input))),

  /** One document, which the screen asks for again while the worker prepares its PDF. */
  get: orgProcedure
    .requires("settings:manage")
    .input(documentRefInput)
    .output(issuedDocumentSummary)
    .query(({ ctx, input }) => ctx.db.forOrg(ctx.member.organizationId, (tx) => getIssuedDocument(tx, input))),

  /** A five-minute link that downloads the rendered PDF under the document's number. */
  downloadLink: orgProcedure
    .requires("settings:manage")
    .input(documentRefInput)
    .output(downloadLink)
    .query(async ({ ctx, input }) => {
      const document = await ctx.db.forOrg(ctx.member.organizationId, (tx) => getIssuedDocument(tx, input));
      if (document.renderFailed) {
        throw new DomainError("NOT_FOUND", "DOCUMENT_UNAVAILABLE", "The document's PDF can't be made");
      }
      if (document.pdfAttachmentId === null) {
        throw new DomainError("NOT_FOUND", "DOCUMENT_NOT_READY", "The document is still being prepared");
      }
      const link = await ctx.files.downloadLink(ctx.member, {
        recordType: "issued_document",
        recordId: document.id,
        attachmentId: document.pdfAttachmentId,
      });
      return { url: link.url, expiresAt: link.expiresAt.toISOString() };
    }),
});
```

**Create `apps/web/src/documents/document-state.ts`:**

```ts
// Where an issued document's PDF is: ready to download, being prepared by the worker, or never to be made (text its
// fonts can't show). Screens ask again while one is being prepared.
import type { IssuedDocumentSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/documents";
import type { StatusTone } from "@/components/status-badge";

export type DocumentState = "ready" | "preparing" | "failed";

/** How often a screen asks again while the worker prepares a PDF: it takes a few seconds. */
export const PREPARING_POLL_MS = 2000;

export function documentState(
  document: Pick<IssuedDocumentSummary, "pdfAttachmentId" | "renderFailed">,
): DocumentState {
  if (document.renderFailed) return "failed";
  return document.pdfAttachmentId === null ? "preparing" : "ready";
}

/** DESIGN.md's status vocabulary: ready is good, being prepared needs a moment, can't be made is bad. */
export const stateTones: Record<DocumentState, StatusTone> = { ready: "good", preparing: "attention", failed: "bad" };
```

```ts
"use client";

// Downloading an issued document's PDF: a five-minute link from the api, opened at once, so it never sits in the cache
// or the saved copy. Storage sends the file as a download under the document's number; the page stays as it is.
import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useTRPCClient } from "@/data/trpc";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { loadPage } from "@/lib/navigate";

export function useDownloadPdf() {
  const client = useTRPCClient();
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  return useMutation({
    mutationFn: (documentId: string) => client.documents.downloadLink.query({ documentId }),
    onSuccess: (link) => {
      loadPage(link.url);
    },
    onError: (error) => {
      toast.error(apiError(error));
    },
  });
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/documents/use-issued-documents.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// The organization's issued documents a page at a time (documents.list), newest first: each page asks for those after
// the last document of the page before. While the worker prepares a PDF, the list asks again until it is ready.
import { useInfiniteQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTRPC, useTRPCClient } from "@/data/trpc";
import { documentState, PREPARING_POLL_MS } from "./document-state";

export const DOCUMENTS_PER_PAGE = 20;

export function useIssuedDocuments() {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  const client = useTRPCClient();
  // By hand rather than tRPC's infiniteQueryOptions, which adds a `direction` the strict input refuses.
  const query = useInfiniteQuery({
    queryKey: [...trpc.documents.list.pathKey(), { limit: DOCUMENTS_PER_PAGE }],
    queryFn: ({ pageParam }) =>
      client.documents.list.query({
        limit: DOCUMENTS_PER_PAGE,
        ...(pageParam === null ? {} : { cursor: pageParam }),
      }),
    initialPageParam: null as string | null,
    getNextPageParam: (page) => page.nextCursor,
    refetchInterval: (current) =>
      current.state.data?.pages.some((page) =>
        page.documents.some((document) => documentState(document) === "preparing"),
      )
        ? PREPARING_POLL_MS
        : false,
  });
  return { ...query, documents: query.data?.pages.flatMap((page) => page.documents) };
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The documents screen (spec 9.3): every document the organization has issued, newest first, a page at a time, with
// its PDF once the worker has made it. Today they are the samples the branding screen previews; quotes and invoices
// join them.
import { FileTextIcon } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { BackToSettings } from "@/branding/back-to-settings";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/empty-state";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { PageTitle } from "@/components/page-title";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { routes } from "@/lib/routes";
import { DocumentsList } from "./documents-list";
import { useIssuedDocuments } from "./use-issued-documents";

export function DocumentsScreen() {
  const t = useTranslations("documents.list");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const issued = useIssuedDocuments();

  const body = () => {
    if (issued.documents) {
      if (issued.documents.length === 0) {
        return (
          <EmptyState
            icon={FileTextIcon}
            message={t("empty")}
            action={
              <Button asChild>
                <Link href={routes.branding}>{t("emptyAction")}</Link>
              </Button>
            }
          />
        );
      }
      return (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <DocumentsList documents={issued.documents} />
          {issued.hasNextPage && (
            <Button
              variant="outline"
              className="self-center"
              disabled={issued.isFetchingNextPage}
              onClick={() => void issued.fetchNextPage()}
            >
              {issued.isFetchingNextPage ? t("loadingMore") : t("more")}
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      );
    }
    if (issued.isError) {
      return (
        <ErrorState message={t("loadFailed")} retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")} onRetry={() => void issued.refetch()} />
      );
    }
    return (
      <Delayed>
        <div role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={tCommon("loading")} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {[0, 1, 2].map((row) => (
            <Skeleton key={row} className="h-14 w-full" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </Delayed>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <BackToSettings />
        <PageTitle>{t("title")}</PageTitle>
        <p className="max-w-[65ch] text-muted-foreground">{t("intro")}</p>
      </div>
      {body()}
    </div>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/branding/use-sample.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// Previewing the branding on a sample quotation: issue one (documents.issueSample), then ask for it again while the
// worker prepares its PDF, until it is ready or can never be made.
import { skipToken, useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTRPC } from "@/data/trpc";
import { documentState, PREPARING_POLL_MS } from "@/documents/document-state";

export function useSample() {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const issue = useMutation(
    trpc.documents.issueSample.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.documents.list.pathKey() }),
    }),
  );
  const issued = issue.data;
  const sample = useQuery(
    trpc.documents.get.queryOptions(issued ? { documentId: issued.id } : skipToken, {
      refetchInterval: (query) =>
        query.state.data && documentState(query.state.data) !== "preparing" ? false : PREPARING_POLL_MS,
      // A sample being prepared is this page's business only: never kept in the saved copy.
      meta: { persist: false },
    }),
  );
  // The issued document is the answer until the first get comes back.
  return { issue, sample: sample.data ?? issued };
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// "Preview on a sample quotation" (spec 9.3): issues a sample with the branding as it is saved, waits while the worker
// prepares its PDF, then offers it to download. The sample is kept with the organization's documents, as every
// issued document is; its number, SMPL-…, says what it is.
import Link from "next/link";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner";
import { documentState } from "@/documents/document-state";
import { useDownloadPdf } from "@/documents/use-download-pdf";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { routes } from "@/lib/routes";
import { useWriteAccess } from "@/subscription/write-access";
import { useSample } from "./use-sample";

export function SamplePreview() {
  const t = useTranslations("documents.sample");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const write = useWriteAccess();
  const { issue, sample } = useSample();
  const download = useDownloadPdf();
  const state = sample ? documentState(sample) : null;

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="sample-heading" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <h2 id="sample-heading" className="text-section font-semibold">
        {t("heading")}
      </h2>
      <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-4 rounded-lg border p-4">
        <p className="max-w-[65ch] text-muted-foreground">{t("intro")}</p>
        {sample && (
          // Polite: the preparing and ready lines follow each other as the worker gets on.
          <div role="status" className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            {state === "preparing" && <Spinner aria-hidden="true" />}
            <p>{t(state ?? "preparing", { number: sample.number })}</p>
          </div>
        )}
        {issue.isError && (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertDescription>{apiError(issue.error)}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          {sample && state === "ready" && (
            <Button
              disabled={download.isPending}
              onClick={() => {
                download.mutate(sample.id);
              }}
            >
              {t("download")}
            </Button>
          )}
          {/* Again after a change to the branding: each preview is a new sample. */}
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            disabled={!write.allowed || issue.isPending || state === "preparing"}
            onClick={() => {
              issue.mutate();
            }}
          >
            {issue.isPending ? t("issuing") : t("issue")}
          </Button>
          {sample && (
            <Link
              href={routes.documents}
              className="flex min-h-11 items-center text-primary underline underline-offset-4"
            >
              {t("allDocuments")}
            </Link>
          )}
        </div>
        {write.hint !== null && <p className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{write.hint}</p>}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

### Task D3: An Owner shares an issued document by link, sees it opened, and turns the link off

The documents screen's rows gain "Share": a dialog with the document's links, newest first (each one's label, whether
it still opens the document, how often customers opened it and when last, in the organization's zone, and when it
expires) and a new link with a label for staff and the default 30 days or never. A new link's whole address is shown
once, on the app's own address (`new URL(path, location.origin)`: the web app hands `/p` to the api), with a copy
button; only a hash of its secret is kept, so no list shows it again. A working link is turned off after asking, for
good. `shareLinks.create`, `.list` and `.revoke` share only the organization's own issued documents
(`INVALID_RECORD_TYPE` for anything else, `DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND` for another organization's); turning a link off takes a
customer's access away, so it works in a read-only organization (and for the Owner while suspended), which makes no
new links. Making a link and turning one off are now recorded in the audit log, by ids: a label can name a customer.

**Files:**

**Create `apps/api/test/share-links.test.ts`:**

```ts
// Share links over HTTP (spec 9.3): a link to an issued document, its token shown once, that opens the PDF at /p and
// counts the open; links that never expire; revoking for good; nothing but the organization's own issued documents
// shared. Only roles with settings:manage reach them, and a read-only organization may still turn a link off.
import type { IssuedDocumentSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/documents";
import type { CreatedShareLink, ShareLinkSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/share-links";
import { renderIssuedDocumentListener } from "@travel-crm/domain/documents";
import { runListenerJob } from "@travel-crm/domain/jobs";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import type { CookieJar } from "./support/cookie-jar.js";
import { addStaff, signedInOwner, signedInStaff } from "./support/people.js";
import { createTestAgency, createTestServer, type TestAgency, type TestServer } from "./support/test-server.js";
import { dataOf, mutate, query, refusalOf } from "./support/trpc.js";

const profile = {
  legalName: "Konkan Trails LLP",
  gstin: null,
  gstStateCode: "27",
  address: null,
  contactName: null,
  contactPhone: null,
  bankAccountName: null,
  bankAccountNumber: null,
  bankIfsc: null,
  bankName: null,
  invoicePrefix: null,
};

const DAY = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

/** A browser at its own address, so tests don't share the share links' rate-limit bucket. */
const visitor = (address: string) => ({ headers: { "x-forwarded-for": address } });

describe("share links", () => {
  let server: TestServer;

  beforeAll(() => {
    server = createTestServer();
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await server.close();
  });

  /** An agency's Owner with a sample quotation the worker has rendered. */
  async function sharedSample(): Promise<{ agency: TestAgency; jar: CookieJar; sample: IssuedDocumentSummary }> {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const jar = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    await dataOf(await mutate(server, "organization.profile.update", profile, jar));
    const sample = await dataOf<IssuedDocumentSummary>(await mutate(server, "documents.issueSample", undefined, jar));
    const event = await server.db.forOrg(agency.organizationId, (tx) =>
      tx.outboxEvent.findFirstOrThrow({
        where: { type: "document.issued", payload: { equals: { documentId: sample.id } } },
      }),
    );
    const listener = renderIssuedDocumentListener({
      files: server.files,
      render: () => Promise.resolve(new TextEncoder().encode("%PDF-1.7 sample")),
    });
    await runListenerJob({
      db: server.db,
      listener,
      data: { organizationId: agency.organizationId, eventId: event.id, eventType: event.type },
    });
    return { agency, jar, sample };
  }

  const linksOf = async (jar: CookieJar, sample: IssuedDocumentSummary) =>
    dataOf<ShareLinkSummary[]>(
      await query(server, "shareLinks.list", jar, { recordType: "issued_document", recordId: sample.id }),
    );

  const linkTo = async (jar: CookieJar, sample: IssuedDocumentSummary, extra: { expiresAt?: string | null } = {}) =>
    dataOf<CreatedShareLink>(
      await mutate(
        server,
        "shareLinks.create",
        { recordType: "issued_document", recordId: sample.id, label: `Quotation ${sample.number}`, ...extra },
        jar,
      ),
    );

  it("makes a link to an issued document, shown once, that opens its PDF and counts the open", async () => {
    const { jar, sample } = await sharedSample();
    const link = await linkTo(jar, sample);
    expect(link.path).toBe(`/p/${link.token}`);

    const [listed] = await linksOf(jar, sample);
    expect(listed).toMatchObject({ id: link.shareLinkId, label: `Quotation ${sample.number}`, openCount: 0 });
    expect(new Date(listed?.expiresAt ?? 0).getTime() - Date.now()).toBeGreaterThan(29 * DAY);
    // Only a hash of the token is kept: no list shows it again.
    expect(JSON.stringify(await linksOf(jar, sample))).not.toContain(link.token.slice(22));

    const opened = await server.app.request(link.path, visitor("203.0.113.31"));
    expect(opened.status).toBe(302);
    expect(opened.headers.get("location")).toContain(encodeURIComponent(`${sample.number}.pdf`));
    const [counted] = await linksOf(jar, sample);
    expect(counted).toMatchObject({ openCount: 1, revokedAt: null });
    expect(counted?.lastOpenedAt).not.toBeNull();
  });

  it("makes a link that never expires when asked", async () => {
    const { jar, sample } = await sharedSample();
    await linkTo(jar, sample, { expiresAt: null });
    expect(await linksOf(jar, sample)).toMatchObject([{ expiresAt: null }]);
  });

  it("turns a link off for good: it is refused at once, and turning it off again changes nothing", async () => {
    const { jar, sample } = await sharedSample();
    const link = await linkTo(jar, sample);
    expect((await mutate(server, "shareLinks.revoke", { shareLinkId: link.shareLinkId }, jar)).status).toBe(200);
    const refused = await server.app.request(link.path, visitor("203.0.113.32"));
    expect(refused.status).toBe(410);
    expect(await refused.text()).toContain("This link has been turned off");
    expect((await mutate(server, "shareLinks.revoke", { shareLinkId: link.shareLinkId }, jar)).status).toBe(200);
    const [listed] = await linksOf(jar, sample);
    expect(listed?.revokedAt).not.toBeNull();
    expect(listed?.openCount).toBe(0);
  });

  it("shares nothing but the organization's own issued documents", async () => {
    const { jar, sample } = await sharedSample();
    const { sample: theirs } = await sharedSample();
    const create = (recordType: string, recordId: string) =>
      mutate(server, "shareLinks.create", { recordType, recordId, label: "A link" }, jar);
    expect(await refusalOf(await create("lead", sample.id))).toEqual({ status: 400, reason: "INVALID_RECORD_TYPE" });
    expect(await refusalOf(await create("issued_document", theirs.id))).toEqual({
      status: 404,
      reason: "DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND",
    });
    expect(
      await refusalOf(await query(server, "shareLinks.list", jar, { recordType: "lead", recordId: sample.id })),
    ).toEqual({ status: 400, reason: "INVALID_RECORD_TYPE" });
  });

  it("can't turn off another organization's link", async () => {
    const { jar } = await sharedSample();
    const other = await sharedSample();
    const theirs = await linkTo(other.jar, other.sample);
    expect(
      await refusalOf(await mutate(server, "shareLinks.revoke", { shareLinkId: theirs.shareLinkId }, jar)),
    ).toEqual({ status: 404, reason: "LINK_NOT_FOUND" });
    expect(await linksOf(other.jar, other.sample)).toMatchObject([{ revokedAt: null }]);
  });

  it("refuses staff without settings:manage", async () => {
    const { agency, jar, sample } = await sharedSample();
    const link = await linkTo(jar, sample);
    const sales = await addStaff(server, agency, { username: "ravi", roleKey: "sales" });
    const salesJar = await signedInStaff(server, agency, sales);
    const refused = { status: 403, reason: "MISSING_PERMISSION" };
    const record = { recordType: "issued_document", recordId: sample.id };
    expect(await refusalOf(await query(server, "shareLinks.list", salesJar, record))).toEqual(refused);
    expect(await refusalOf(await mutate(server, "shareLinks.create", { ...record, label: "x" }, salesJar))).toEqual(
      refused,
    );
    expect(
      await refusalOf(await mutate(server, "shareLinks.revoke", { shareLinkId: link.shareLinkId }, salesJar)),
    ).toEqual(refused);
  });

  it("lets a read-only organization's Owner see and turn off links, but make none", async () => {
    const { agency, jar, sample } = await sharedSample();
    const link = await linkTo(jar, sample);
    await server.platform.subscription.update({
      where: { organizationId: agency.organizationId },
      data: { status: "read_only", statusChangedAt: new Date() },
    });
    expect(await linksOf(jar, sample)).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(
      await refusalOf(
        await mutate(
          server,
          "shareLinks.create",
          { recordType: "issued_document", recordId: sample.id, label: "x" },
          jar,
        ),
      ),
    ).toEqual({ status: 403, reason: "ORGANIZATION_READ_ONLY" });
    // Turning a link off takes a customer's access away, which read-only allows (ADR 0021).
    expect((await mutate(server, "shareLinks.revoke", { shareLinkId: link.shareLinkId }, jar)).status).toBe(200);
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/documents/share-links-dialog.test.tsx`:**

```tsx
// A document's share links (spec 9.3): each link's label, whether it works, how often it was opened and when last,
// and when it expires; a new link with a label and the default 30 days or never, its whole address shown once to copy;
// and turning one off after asking. A read-only organization makes no new links but may still turn one off.
import { screen, waitFor, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { ShareLinksDialog } from "@/documents/share-links-dialog";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { newQueryClient, renderWithApi } from "../organization/api";
import { screenIs } from "../organization/render";
import { stubApi, type Answer } from "../support/api-stub";
import { inputsSentTo } from "./sent";
import { subscriptionAnswer } from "./subscription";

const words = messages.documents.share;

const document = {
  id: "0199e7a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000d1",
  template: "sample" as const,
  number: "SMPL-2026-0001",
  title: "Quotation",
  issuedAt: "2026-10-15T05:30:00.000Z",
  issuedBy: null,
  pdfAttachmentId: "0199e7a0-0000-7000-8000-0000000000f1",
  renderedAt: "2026-10-15T05:30:05.000Z",
  renderFailed: false,
};

const link = (label: string, extra: Record<string, unknown>) => ({
  id: `0199e7a0-0000-7000-8000-00000000${String(label.length).padStart(4, "0")}`,
  recordType: "issued_document",
  recordId: document.id,
  label,
  createdBy: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-000000000001",
  createdAt: "2026-10-15T06:00:00.000Z",
  expiresAt: "2099-11-14T06:00:00.000Z",
  revokedAt: null,
  openCount: 0,
  lastOpenedAt: null,
  ...extra,
});

// 18:45 UTC on 15 October is 16 October, 12:15 am, in India.
const forMeera = link("For Meera Iyer", { openCount: 2, lastOpenedAt: "2026-10-15T18:45:00.000Z", expiresAt: null });
const turnedOff = link("Old link", { revokedAt: "2026-10-15T07:00:00.000Z" });
const expired = link("Last year's", { expiresAt: "2025-10-15T06:00:00.000Z" });
const token = `${"A".repeat(22)}${"b".repeat(43)}`;

function renderDialog(answers: Record<string, Answer> = {}) {
  const api = stubApi({
    "subscription.get": subscriptionAnswer(),
    "shareLinks.list": { data: [forMeera, turnedOff, expired] },
    "shareLinks.create": { data: { shareLinkId: forMeera.id, token, path: `/p/${token}` } },
    "shareLinks.revoke": { data: null },
    ...answers,
  });
  renderWithApi(<ShareLinksDialog document={document} open onOpenChange={vi.fn()} />, newQueryClient());
  return api;
}

const rowOf = (label: string) => {
  const row = screen.getByText(label).closest("li");
  if (!row) throw new Error(`no row for ${label}`);
  return row;
};

beforeEach(() => {
  screenIs("wide");
});

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("ShareLinksDialog", () => {
  it("lists the links with whether each works, its opens, the last one and its expiry", async () => {
    renderDialog();
    expect(await screen.findByRole("dialog", { name: words.title.replace("{number}", document.number) })).toBeVisible();
    await screen.findByText("For Meera Iyer");
    const meera = rowOf("For Meera Iyer");
    expect(within(meera).getByText(words.status.active)).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(meera).getByText(/^Opened 2 times, last 16 Oct, 12:15\sam$/)).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(meera).getByText(words.neverExpires)).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(rowOf("Old link")).getByText(words.status.revoked)).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(rowOf("Last year's")).getByText(words.status.expired)).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(rowOf("Last year's")).getByText("Not opened yet")).toBeVisible();
    // Only a working link can be turned off.
    expect(within(rowOf("Old link")).queryByRole("button")).toBeNull();
    expect(within(rowOf("Last year's")).queryByRole("button")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("makes a link with a label and the default 30 days, and shows its whole address once, to copy", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    const api = renderDialog({ "shareLinks.list": { data: [] } });
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.none)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(words.label)).toHaveValue("Quotation SMPL-2026-0001");
    expect(screen.getByRole("radio", { name: words.expiryDefault })).toBeChecked();
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.create }));

    const address = new URL(`/p/${token}`, window.location.origin).href;
    expect(await screen.findByLabelText(words.linkLabel)).toHaveValue(address);
    expect(screen.getByText(words.onlyOnce)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.copyLink })).toBeVisible();
    expect(inputsSentTo("shareLinks.create")).toEqual([
      { recordType: "issued_document", recordId: document.id, label: "Quotation SMPL-2026-0001" },
    ]);

    const listed = api.calls.filter((path) => path === "shareLinks.list").length;
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.done }));
    expect(screen.queryByLabelText(words.linkLabel)).toBeNull();
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(api.calls.filter((path) => path === "shareLinks.list").length).toBeGreaterThan(listed);
    });
  });

  it("makes a link that never expires", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderDialog({ "shareLinks.list": { data: [] } });
    await screen.findByText(words.none);
    const label = screen.getByLabelText(words.label);
    await user.clear(label);
    await user.type(label, "For Meera Iyer");
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("radio", { name: words.expiryNever }));
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.create }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(inputsSentTo("shareLinks.create")).toEqual([
        { recordType: "issued_document", recordId: document.id, label: "For Meera Iyer", expiresAt: null },
      ]);
    });
  });

  it("asks for a label before sending anything", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    const api = renderDialog({ "shareLinks.list": { data: [] } });
    await screen.findByText(words.none);
    await user.clear(screen.getByLabelText(words.label));
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.create }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.labelInvalid)).toBeVisible();
    expect(api.calls).not.toContain("shareLinks.create");
  });

  it("shows a refusal as its sentence", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    renderDialog({ "shareLinks.create": { status: 404, reason: "DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND" } });
    await user.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: words.create }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(messages.errors.reasons.DOCUMENT_NOT_FOUND)).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("turns a link off after asking", async () => {
    const user = userEvent.setup();
    const api = renderDialog();
    await user.click(
      await screen.findByRole("button", { name: words.revokeNamed.replace("{label}", "For Meera Iyer") }),
    );
    expect(screen.getByText(words.revokeDescription)).toBeVisible();
    api.answer("shareLinks.list", { data: [{ ...forMeera, revokedAt: "2026-10-16T05:00:00.000Z" }] });
    await user.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.revokeConfirm }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(inputsSentTo("shareLinks.revoke")).toEqual([{ shareLinkId: forMeera.id }]);
    });
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(within(rowOf("For Meera Iyer")).getByText(words.status.revoked)).toBeVisible();
    });
  });

  it("makes no new link in a read-only organization, saying why, but still turns one off", async () => {
    renderDialog({ "subscription.get": subscriptionAnswer("read_only") });
    expect(await screen.findByText(messages.errors.reasons.ORGANIZATION_READ_ONLY)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.create })).toBeDisabled();
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.revokeNamed.replace("{label}", "For Meera Iyer") })).toBeEnabled();
  });
});
```

```ts
interface Answered<T> {
  result: { data: T };
}

/** Issues a sample quotation through the api as the signed-in Owner, and waits until the worker has rendered it. */
export async function renderedSample(page: Page): Promise<{ id: string; number: string }> {
  const issued = await page.request.post("/api/trpc/documents.issueSample", {
    data: {},
    headers: { origin: appOrigin() },
  });
  expect(issued.ok()).toBe(true);
  const { id, number } = ((await issued.json()) as Answered<{ id: string; number: string }>).result.data;
  const input = encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({ documentId: id }));
  const pdfOf = async () => {
    const answer = await page.request.get(`/api/trpc/documents.get?input=${input}`);
    return ((await answer.json()) as Answered<{ pdfAttachmentId: string | null }>).result.data.pdfAttachmentId;
  };
  // The worker renders it in the background, within seconds.
  await expect.poll(pdfOf, { timeout: 20_000 }).not.toBeNull();
  return { id, number };
}
```

**Create `apps/web/test/e2e/documents-share-links.spec.ts`:**

```ts
// Share links (spec 9.3): an Owner makes a link to an issued document and copies it, a customer opens it at /p on the
// app's address and lands on the PDF, the open is counted, and once the Owner turns the link off it is refused.
import { renderedSample, saveBusinessProfile } from "./support/documents";
import { expect, signInByEmail, test } from "./support/fixtures";

test("an Owner shares a document by link, sees it opened, and turns the link off", async ({ page, agency }) => {
  await signInByEmail(page, agency.owner);
  await saveBusinessProfile(page);
  const sample = await renderedSample(page);
  await page.goto("/settings/documents");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: `Share ${sample.number}` }).click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: `Share ${sample.number}` });
  await expect(dialog.getByText("No links yet.")).toBeVisible();
  await dialog.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Label" }).fill("For Meera Iyer");
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Create link" }).click();

  const shown = dialog.getByRole("textbox", { name: "The link" });
  await expect(shown).toHaveValue(/\/p\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{65}$/);
  const link = await shown.inputValue();
  expect(new URL(link).origin).toBe(new URL(page.url()).origin);

  // The customer opens it: the app's address hands it to the api, which sends them to the PDF.
  const opened = await page.request.get(link, { maxRedirects: 0 });
  expect(opened.status()).toBe(302);
  const pdf = await page.request.get(opened.headers().location ?? "");
  expect((await pdf.body()).subarray(0, 5).toString("latin1")).toBe("%PDF-");

  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Done" }).click();
  await expect(dialog.getByText(/^Opened 1 time, last /)).toBeVisible();
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Turn off For Meera Iyer" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("alertdialog").getByRole("button", { name: "Turn off the link" }).click();
  await expect(dialog.getByText("Turned off")).toBeVisible();

  const refused = await page.request.get(link, { maxRedirects: 0 });
  expect(refused.status()).toBe(410);
  expect(await refused.text()).toContain("This link has been turned off");
});
```

**`packages/api/src/routers/share-links.ts`**, the whole file:

```ts
// shareLinks.*: links to a shared record, opened at /p/<token> (spec 9.3): made, listed and turned off. The
// Foundation's one shared record is an issued document, and every one today is a branding sample, so settings:manage
// covers them; quotes and invoices bring their own permissions.
import {
  createdShareLink,
  createShareLinkInput,
  listShareLinksInput,
  revokeShareLinkInput,
  shareLinkSummary,
} from "@travel-crm/contracts/share-links";
import type { OrgTx } from "@travel-crm/db";
import { getIssuedDocument } from "@travel-crm/domain/documents";
import { DomainError } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { createShareLink, listShareLinks, revokeShareLink } from "@travel-crm/domain/share-links";
import { z } from "zod";
import { orgProcedure } from "../procedures.js";
import { router } from "../trpc.js";

/** What /p/<token> can open (apps/api/src/share-link-resolvers.ts): an issued document. */
const SHAREABLE_RECORD_TYPE = "issued_document";

/** The record must be one of the organization's own issued documents: another's is "not found". */
async function assertShareable(tx: OrgTx, record: { recordType: string; recordId: string }): Promise<void> {
  if (record.recordType !== SHAREABLE_RECORD_TYPE) {
    throw new DomainError("VALIDATION", "INVALID_RECORD_TYPE", "Only issued documents can be shared by link");
  }
  await getIssuedDocument(tx, { documentId: record.recordId });
}

const shareManager = orgProcedure.requires("settings:manage");

export const shareLinksRouter = router({
  /** A new link, whose whole token is in this answer only: the database keeps a hash of its secret. */
  create: shareManager
    .input(createShareLinkInput)
    .output(createdShareLink)
    .mutation(({ ctx, input }) =>
      ctx.db.forOrg(ctx.member.organizationId, async (tx) => {
        await assertShareable(tx, input);
        const { expiresAt, ...link } = input;
        return createShareLink(tx, ctx.member, {
          ...link,
          ...(expiresAt === undefined ? {} : { expiresAt: expiresAt === null ? null : new Date(expiresAt) }),
        });
      }),
    ),

  /** A record's links, newest first, with how often and when each was last opened. */
  list: shareManager
    .input(listShareLinksInput)
    .output(z.array(shareLinkSummary))
    .query(({ ctx, input }) =>
      ctx.db.forOrg(ctx.member.organizationId, async (tx) => {
        await assertShareable(tx, input);
        return listShareLinks(tx, input);
      }),
    ),

  /**
   * Turns a link off for good. It takes a customer's access away, so like removing staff it works while read-only,
   * and for the Owner while suspended (ADR 0021).
   */
  revoke: shareManager
    .meta({ lifecycle: "revoke" })
    .input(revokeShareLinkInput)
    .mutation(({ ctx, input }) =>
      ctx.db.forOrg(ctx.member.organizationId, (tx) => revokeShareLink(tx, ctx.member, input)),
    ),
});
```

**Create `apps/web/src/documents/share-link-state.ts`:**

```ts
// Whether a share link still opens its document: active, expired, or turned off (revoked, which is for good).
import type { ShareLinkSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/share-links";
import type { StatusTone } from "@/components/status-badge";

export type ShareLinkState = "active" | "expired" | "revoked";

export function shareLinkState(
  link: Pick<ShareLinkSummary, "expiresAt" | "revokedAt">,
  now: Date = new Date(),
): ShareLinkState {
  if (link.revokedAt !== null) return "revoked";
  return link.expiresAt !== null && new Date(link.expiresAt) <= now ? "expired" : "active";
}

/** A working link is good news; one that no longer opens is neither good nor bad, just over. */
export const linkTones: Record<ShareLinkState, StatusTone> = { active: "good", expired: "neutral", revoked: "neutral" };
```

**Create `apps/web/src/documents/use-share-links.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// A document's share links (shareLinks.*): the list, asked for afresh whenever it is shown (customers' opens arrive at
// any time), making a link and turning one off, each followed by the list again.
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useTRPC } from "@/data/trpc";

/** What the documents screen shares: an issued document (apps/api/src/share-link-resolvers.ts opens it). */
export const sharedDocument = (documentId: string) => ({ recordType: "issued_document", recordId: documentId });

export function useShareLinks(documentId: string) {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  return useQuery(trpc.shareLinks.list.queryOptions(sharedDocument(documentId), { staleTime: 0 }));
}

export function useCreateShareLink() {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return useMutation(
    trpc.shareLinks.create.mutationOptions({
      onSettled: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.shareLinks.list.pathKey() }),
    }),
  );
}

export function useRevokeShareLink() {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const t = useTranslations("documents.share");
  return useMutation(
    trpc.shareLinks.revoke.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: () => {
        toast.success(t("revoked"));
      },
      onSettled: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.shareLinks.list.pathKey() }),
    }),
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/documents/revoke-share-link-dialog.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// Turning a link off, asked once more: whoever has it can no longer open the document, and it can't be undone.
import type { ShareLinkSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/share-links";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { useRevokeShareLink } from "./use-share-links";

export function RevokeShareLinkDialog({
  link,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
}: {
  link: ShareLinkSummary;
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("documents.share");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const revoke = useRevokeShareLink();
  return (
    <AlertDialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={(next) => {
        if (!next) revoke.reset();
        onOpenChange(next);
      }}
    >
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogTitle>{t("revokeTitle")}</AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>{t("revokeDescription")}</AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        {revoke.isError && (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertDescription>{apiError(revoke.error)}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel>{tCommon("cancel")}</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction
            // The final step of a destructive action is the one place red fills a button (DESIGN.md section 6).
            className="bg-status-bad-ink text-on-action hover:bg-status-bad-ink/90"
            disabled={revoke.isPending}
            onClick={(event) => {
              // Stay open until the api answers, so a refusal is shown here and the button can't be pressed twice.
              event.preventDefault();
              revoke.mutate(
                { shareLinkId: link.id },
                {
                  onSuccess: () => {
                    onOpenChange(false);
                  },
                },
              );
            }}
          >
            {t("revokeConfirm")}
          </AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/documents/share-link-list.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// A document's links, newest first: each one's label, whether it still opens the document, how often customers opened
// it and when last (in the organization's zone), when it expires, and the way to turn a working one off.
import type { ShareLinkSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/share-links";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/status-badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { formatDay, formatTime } from "@/lib/format";
import { useMe } from "@/session/me-context";
import { useWriteAccess } from "@/subscription/write-access";
import { RevokeShareLinkDialog } from "./revoke-share-link-dialog";
import { linkTones, shareLinkState } from "./share-link-state";
import { useShareLinks } from "./use-share-links";

function ShareLinkRow({ link }: { link: ShareLinkSummary }) {
  const t = useTranslations("documents.share");
  const { timeZone } = useMe().organization;
  // Turning a link off takes a customer's access away, which read-only allows.
  const revokeAccess = useWriteAccess("revoke");
  const [revoking, setRevoking] = useState(false);
  const state = shareLinkState(link);
  const when = (instant: string) => {
    const at = new Date(instant);
    return t("when", { day: formatDay(at, { timeZone }), time: formatTime(at, { timeZone }) });
  };
  return (
    <li className="flex items-start gap-3 px-4 py-3">
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          <span className="font-medium break-words script-leading">{link.label}</span>
          <StatusBadge tone={linkTones[state]}>{t(`status.${state}`)}</StatusBadge>
        </div>
        <p className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 gap-y-1 text-label text-muted-foreground">
          <span>
            {link.lastOpenedAt === null
              ? t("notOpened")
              : t("opened", { count: link.openCount, when: when(link.lastOpenedAt) })}
          </span>
          <span>
            {link.expiresAt === null
              ? t("neverExpires")
              : t("expires", { day: formatDay(new Date(link.expiresAt), { timeZone }) })}
          </span>
        </p>
      </div>
      {state === "active" && (
        <>
          <Button
            variant="destructive"
            aria-label={t("revokeNamed", { label: link.label })}
            disabled={!revokeAccess.allowed}
            onClick={() => {
              setRevoking(true);
            }}
          >
            {t("revoke")}
          </Button>
          <RevokeShareLinkDialog link={link} open={revoking} onOpenChange={setRevoking} />
        </>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}

export function ShareLinkList({ documentId }: { documentId: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations("documents.share");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const links = useShareLinks(documentId);
  if (links.data) {
    if (links.data.length === 0) return <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("none")}</p>;
    return (
      <ul className="divide-y rounded-lg border">
        {links.data.map((link) => (
          <ShareLinkRow key={link.id} link={link} />
        ))}
      </ul>
    );
  }
  if (links.isError) {
    return (
      <ErrorState message={t("loadFailed")} retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")} onRetry={() => void links.refetch()} />
    );
  }
  return (
    <Delayed>
      <Skeleton role="status" aria-label={tCommon("loading")} className="h-16 w-full" />
    </Delayed>
  );
}
```
