**Create `apps/web/src/documents/create-share-link-form.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// A new link to the document: a label for staff (who it is for) and its expiry, the default 30 days or never. The
// label is checked by the api's own rule before it is sent; a refusal shows above the button.
import type { IssuedDocumentSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/documents";
import { shareLinkLabel } from "@travel-crm/contracts/share-links";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Controller, useForm, type Resolver } from "react-hook-form";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldGroup, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/components/ui/radio-group";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { useWriteAccess } from "@/subscription/write-access";
import { sharedDocument, type useCreateShareLink } from "./use-share-links";

interface ShareLinkValues {
  label: string;
  /** "default": the api's 30 days. */
  expiry: "default" | "never";
}

export function CreateShareLinkForm({
  document,
  create,
}: {
  document: IssuedDocumentSummary;
  /** The create call, owned by the dialog so that it can let go of the token when it closes. */
  create: ReturnType<typeof useCreateShareLink>;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("documents.share");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const write = useWriteAccess();
  const resolver: Resolver<ShareLinkValues> = (values) =>
    shareLinkLabel.safeParse(values.label).success
      ? { values, errors: {} }
      : { values: {}, errors: { label: { type: "validate", message: t("labelInvalid") } } };
  const form = useForm<ShareLinkValues>({
    resolver,
    defaultValues: { label: `${document.title} ${document.number}`, expiry: "default" },
  });
  const { errors } = form.formState;

  const submit = form.handleSubmit((values) => {
    create.mutate({
      ...sharedDocument(document.id),
      label: values.label,
      ...(values.expiry === "never" ? { expiresAt: null } : {}),
    });
  });

  return (
    <form noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <h3 className="font-semibold">{t("newLink")}</h3>
      <FieldGroup>
        <Field data-invalid={errors.label !== undefined}>
          <FieldLabel htmlFor={`share-label-${document.id}`}>{t("label")}</FieldLabel>
          <Input
            id={`share-label-${document.id}`}
            maxLength={200}
            autoComplete="off"
            className="script-leading"
            aria-invalid={errors.label !== undefined}
            {...form.register("label")}
          />
          <FieldDescription>{t("labelHint")}</FieldDescription>
          <FieldError errors={[errors.label]} />
        </Field>
        <Field>
          <FieldLabel id={`share-expiry-${document.id}`}>{t("expiry")}</FieldLabel>
          <Controller
            control={form.control}
            name="expiry"
            render={({ field }) => (
              <RadioGroup
                aria-labelledby={`share-expiry-${document.id}`}
                value={field.value}
                onValueChange={field.onChange}
                className="flex flex-wrap gap-6"
              >
                {(["default", "never"] as const).map((expiry) => (
                  <div key={expiry} className="flex min-h-11 items-center gap-3">
                    <RadioGroupItem value={expiry} id={`share-expiry-${document.id}-${expiry}`} />
                    <FieldLabel htmlFor={`share-expiry-${document.id}-${expiry}`} className="font-normal">
                      {expiry === "default" ? t("expiryDefault") : t("expiryNever")}
                    </FieldLabel>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </RadioGroup>
            )}
          />
        </Field>
      </FieldGroup>
      {create.isError && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertDescription>{apiError(create.error)}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}
      <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-2">
        <Button type="submit" disabled={!write.allowed || create.isPending}>
          {create.isPending ? t("creating") : t("create")}
        </Button>
        {write.hint !== null && <p className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{write.hint}</p>}
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// A new link's whole address, shown this once (only a hash of its secret is kept), with a way to copy it.
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";

export function CreatedLink({ path, onDone }: { path: string; onDone: () => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations("documents.share");

  const address = new URL(path, window.location.origin).href;
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel htmlFor="created-share-link">{t("linkLabel")}</FieldLabel>

          <Input
            id="created-share-link"
            readOnly
            value={address}
            className="numbers"
            onFocus={(event) => {
              event.currentTarget.select();
            }}
          />
          <CopyButton value={address} label={t("copyLink")} />
        </div>
        <FieldDescription>{t("onlyOnce")}</FieldDescription>
      </Field>
      <Button className="self-end" onClick={onDone}>
        {t("done")}
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/documents/share-links-dialog.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// A document's share links (spec 9.3): the links made so far, a new one, and a new link's whole address once.
import type { IssuedDocumentSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/documents";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { ResponsiveDialog } from "@/organization/responsive-dialog";
import { CreateShareLinkForm } from "./create-share-link-form";
import { CreatedLink } from "./created-link";
import { ShareLinkList } from "./share-link-list";
import { useCreateShareLink } from "./use-share-links";

export function ShareLinksDialog({
  document,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
}: {
  document: IssuedDocumentSummary;
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("documents.share");
  const create = useCreateShareLink();
  const changeOpen = (next: boolean) => {
    // The token is in the call's answer: let go of it when the dialog closes.
    if (!next) create.reset();
    onOpenChange(next);
  };
  return (
    <ResponsiveDialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={changeOpen}
      title={t("title", { number: document.number })}
      description={t("description")}
    >
      {create.data ? (
        <CreatedLink
          path={create.data.path}
          onDone={() => {
            create.reset();
          }}
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
          <ShareLinkList documentId={document.id} />
          <CreateShareLinkForm document={document} create={create} />
        </div>
      )}
    </ResponsiveDialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// What can be done with one issued document from the list: download its PDF once the worker has made it, and share it
// by link, unless its PDF can never be made.
import type { IssuedDocumentSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/documents";
import { Share2Icon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { documentState } from "./document-state";
import { DownloadPdfButton } from "./download-pdf-button";
import { ShareLinksDialog } from "./share-links-dialog";

export function DocumentActions({ document }: { document: IssuedDocumentSummary }) {
  const t = useTranslations("documents.share");
  const [sharing, setSharing] = useState(false);
  const state = documentState(document);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2">
      {state === "ready" && <DownloadPdfButton document={document} />}
      {state !== "failed" && (
        <>
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            aria-label={t("openNamed", { number: document.number })}
            onClick={() => {
              setSharing(true);
            }}
          >
            <Share2Icon aria-hidden="true" />
            {t("open")}
          </Button>
          <ShareLinksDialog document={document} open={sharing} onOpenChange={setSharing} />
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## Track N: Notifications (the bell, the choices, and web push)

Spec 9.4 on the screen, over plan 3's notifications module: every member's bell in the app's frame, with the unread
count in the People violet and their notifications newest first; `/account/notifications`, where each person chooses
what also reaches them by email and by push, for everything and for each kind; and web push from end to end on the
app's side: turned on per device, shown by the service worker, opened on a tap, and taken off a device when its person
signs out, so a shared phone never gets the last person's pushes. The api fills Task G2's `notifications` router; the
domain needs no change. Built in its own worktree from Task G2's commit; it edits only the files in its Owns list.

**Depends on:** Task G2 (the empty `notificationsRouter`, `ctx.db` and `ctx.pushPublicKey`, `TEST_PUSH_PUBLIC_KEY`,
`routes.notificationPreferences`, the `notifications` namespace), Task G1 (the journeys run the worker, which renders
the shared document and tells its sharer), and plans 3 and 5A as each task's Interfaces say.

**Rulings in this track:**
- Ruling: marking read, the choices and push are `lifecycle: "always"`; the bell's list and count are views — they
  touch only the person's own rows, never the organization's records: withdrawing consent (DPDP) and taking a device
  off on signing out must work whatever the organization has paid, and a read-only organization's staff must be able
  to clear their bell — cost if wrong: a suspended or cancelled organization's members can still change their own
  notification rows; one meta line each to tighten.
- Ruling: on phones the bell sits in a new bar above the page (the organization's name and the bell), not in the
  bottom bar — the bottom bar holds four destinations and More (DESIGN.md: 4-5), and Track A's audit item already
  brings an Owner to five — cost if wrong: 56px of a phone's height; in More the count would be hidden.
- Ruling: support impersonating a member reads the bell and the choices but can't mark read, change a choice or
  subscribe a browser (the domain refuses the first two; the router the third, or the member's pushes would reach
  support's browser) — cost if wrong: none.
- Ruling: signing out removes this browser's push subscription first (the api, then the push service), waits for it
  at most three seconds before ending the session, never holds up the wipe and never fails the sign-out; only signing
  out does it — cost if wrong: a slow sign-out by up to three seconds; a session that merely expired leaves the
  subscription until the next person turns push on there.
- Ruling: the scalar outputs (`unreadCount`, `markRead`'s count, `push.publicKey`) are written in the router —
  `@travel-crm/contracts/notifications` isn't this track's — cost if wrong: Task I1 moves them into the contracts.
- Ruling: the push journey stands in for the page's notification permission and push manager — Playwright's
  Chromium has no push service (the headless shell reports notifications denied even after a grant; the new headless
  mode can't register) — cost if wrong: a real push service's subscription and delivery stay unverified in the
  journeys; the worker's push and tap handlers are tested in its sandbox.

### Task N1: Every member sees what happened in the bell, and chooses what also reaches them by email and push

The bell (spec 9.4) joins the app's frame: beside the organization's name at the top of the sidebar on wide screens,
and in a new bar above the page on phones, so the bottom bar keeps its destinations (DESIGN.md: 4-5, More included).
Its unread count is white on the People violet, its label says the count to screen readers, and it opens the person's
notifications, newest first and a page at a time, in a popover on wide screens or a sheet on phones; following an
unread one's link (only a path in the app) marks it read, and so do "Mark read" and "Mark all read", at once and put
back with the reason if the api refuses. `/account/notifications`, linked from the account screen, is where a person
chooses, for everything and for each kind, whether it also reaches them by email and by push; a kind's own choice wins,
as delivery reads them. The api fills Task G2's empty `notifications` router for any member (`planModule: "core"`):
the list and the count are views, while marking read and the choices are the person's own rows, so they work in every
state of the subscription (an unsubscribe link must work whatever the organization has paid). Support impersonating a
member reads both but changes neither, as the domain already refuses.

**Create `apps/api/test/notifications-bell.test.ts`:**

```ts
// The bell over HTTP (spec 9.4): every member, whatever their role, sees their own notifications, newest first and a
// page at a time, with the unread count, and marks one or all read; nobody sees or marks another person's. Support
// impersonating a member sees the bell but can't mark it read, and a read-only organization's members still clear it.
import type { NotificationPage } from "@travel-crm/contracts/notifications";
import { systemActor } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { notify } from "@travel-crm/domain/notifications";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { signedInPlatformStaff, signInPlatformStaffAgain } from "./support/console.js";
import type { CookieJar } from "./support/cookie-jar.js";
import { addStaff, signedInOwner, signedInStaff } from "./support/people.js";
import {
  createTestAgency,
  createTestServer,
  postJson,
  type TestAgency,
  type TestServer,
} from "./support/test-server.js";
import { dataOf, mutate, query, refusalOf } from "./support/trpc.js";

describe("the bell", () => {
  let server: TestServer;

  beforeAll(() => {
    server = createTestServer();
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await server.close();
  });

  /** Tells one person something, as a listener would: the ids of what it created. */
  function tell(agency: TestAgency, userId: string, title: string, link?: string): Promise<string[]> {
    return server.db.forOrg(agency.organizationId, (tx) =>
      notify(tx, systemActor(agency.organizationId), {
        recipientUserIds: [userId],
        kind: "share-link.opened",
        title,
        body: "The link you shared has just been opened.",
        ...(link === undefined ? {} : { link }),
      }),
    );
  }

  const page = async (jar: CookieJar, input: { cursor?: string; limit?: number } = {}) =>
    dataOf<NotificationPage>(await query(server, "notifications.list", jar, input));
  const unread = async (jar: CookieJar) => dataOf<number>(await query(server, "notifications.unreadCount", jar));

  it("shows each member their own notifications, newest first, a page at a time, with the unread count", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const sales = await addStaff(server, agency, { username: "ravi", roleKey: "sales" });
    for (const title of ["Opened: Quotation 1", "Opened: Quotation 2", "Opened: Quotation 3"]) {
      await tell(agency, agency.owner.userId, title, "/settings/documents");
    }
    await tell(agency, sales.userId, "Opened: Ravi's quotation");
    const owner = await signedInOwner(server, agency);

    const first = await page(owner, { limit: 2 });
    expect(first.notifications.map(({ title }) => title)).toEqual(["Opened: Quotation 3", "Opened: Quotation 2"]);
    expect(first.notifications[0]).toMatchObject({
      kind: "share-link.opened",
      link: "/settings/documents",
      readAt: null,
    });
    expect(first.nextCursor).toBe(first.notifications[1]?.id);
    const second = await page(owner, { limit: 2, ...(first.nextCursor ? { cursor: first.nextCursor } : {}) });
    expect(second).toMatchObject({ notifications: [{ title: "Opened: Quotation 1" }], nextCursor: null });
    expect(await unread(owner)).toBe(3);

    // A salesperson holds no permission for it: the bell is every member's.
    const ravi = await signedInStaff(server, agency, sales);
    expect((await page(ravi)).notifications).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({ title: "Opened: Ravi's quotation" })]);
    expect(await unread(ravi)).toBe(1);
  });

  it("marks one or all read, and never another person's", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const sales = await addStaff(server, agency, { username: "meera", roleKey: "sales" });
    const [mine = "", alsoMine = ""] = [
      ...(await tell(agency, agency.owner.userId, "Opened: one")),
      ...(await tell(agency, agency.owner.userId, "Opened: two")),
    ];
    const [theirs = ""] = await tell(agency, sales.userId, "Opened: Meera's");
    const owner = await signedInOwner(server, agency);

    expect(
      await dataOf(await mutate(server, "notifications.markRead", { notificationIds: [mine, theirs] }, owner)),
    ).toBe(1);
    expect(await unread(owner)).toBe(1);
    const listed = (await page(owner)).notifications;
    expect(listed.find(({ id }) => id === mine)?.readAt).toEqual(expect.any(String));
    expect(listed.find(({ id }) => id === alsoMine)?.readAt).toBeNull();

    expect(await dataOf(await mutate(server, "notifications.markRead", { all: true }, owner))).toBe(1);
    expect(await unread(owner)).toBe(0);
    // Meera's is still unread: the Owner's "all" is all of the Owner's.
    expect(await unread(await signedInStaff(server, agency, sales))).toBe(1);
  });

  it("lets support impersonating a member see the bell, but not mark it read", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    await tell(agency, agency.owner.userId, "Opened: for the Owner");
    const staff = await signedInPlatformStaff(server);
    const jar = await signInPlatformStaffAgain(server, staff);
    const started = jar.absorb(
      await postJson(server, "/api/auth/admin/impersonate-user", { userId: agency.owner.userId }, jar),
    );
    expect(started.status).toBe(200);

    expect(await unread(jar)).toBe(1);
    expect(await refusalOf(await mutate(server, "notifications.markRead", { all: true }, jar))).toEqual({
      status: 403,
      reason: "IMPERSONATING",
    });
    expect(await unread(await signedInOwner(server, agency))).toBe(1);
  });

  it("lets a read-only organization's members read and clear their bell", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    await tell(agency, agency.owner.userId, "Opened: while read-only");
    const owner = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    await server.platform.subscription.update({
      where: { organizationId: agency.organizationId },
      data: { status: "read_only", statusChangedAt: new Date() },
    });
    expect((await page(owner)).notifications).toHaveLength(1);
    expect(await dataOf(await mutate(server, "notifications.markRead", { all: true }, owner))).toBe(1);
  });

  it("refuses a page bigger than the bell shows, and an empty mark", async () => {
    const owner = await signedInOwner(server, await createTestAgency(server));
    expect((await query(server, "notifications.list", owner, { limit: 51 })).status).toBe(400);
    expect((await mutate(server, "notifications.markRead", { notificationIds: [] }, owner)).status).toBe(400);
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/api/test/notifications-preferences.test.ts`:**

```ts
// Choosing what reaches you over HTTP (spec 9.4, DPDP): every member turns email or push off and on again, for one
// kind or for everything, and sees their choices; they are their own, so support impersonating them can't change
// them, and opting out works whatever the organization's subscription allows, cancelled included.
import type { NotificationPreference } from "@travel-crm/contracts/notifications";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { signedInPlatformStaff, signInPlatformStaffAgain } from "./support/console.js";
import type { CookieJar } from "./support/cookie-jar.js";
import { addStaff, signedInOwner, signedInStaff } from "./support/people.js";
import { createTestAgency, createTestServer, postJson, type TestServer } from "./support/test-server.js";
import { dataOf, mutate, query, refusalOf } from "./support/trpc.js";

describe("notification preferences", () => {
  let server: TestServer;

  beforeAll(() => {
    server = createTestServer();
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await server.close();
  });

  const listed = async (jar: CookieJar) =>
    dataOf<NotificationPreference[]>(await query(server, "notifications.preferences.list", jar));
  const choose = (jar: CookieJar, choice: NotificationPreference) =>
    mutate(server, "notifications.preferences.set", choice, jar);

  it("turns email or push off and on again, for one kind or for everything, for any member", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const sales = await addStaff(server, agency, { username: "ravi", roleKey: "sales" });
    const ravi = await signedInStaff(server, agency, sales);
    expect(await listed(ravi)).toEqual([]);

    const pushOff = { channel: "push", kind: "*", optedOut: true } as const;
    expect(await dataOf(await choose(ravi, pushOff))).toEqual(pushOff);
    await dataOf(await choose(ravi, { channel: "email", kind: "share-link.opened", optedOut: true }));
    await dataOf(await choose(ravi, { channel: "email", kind: "share-link.opened", optedOut: false }));
    expect(await listed(ravi)).toEqual([
      { channel: "email", kind: "share-link.opened", optedOut: false },
      { channel: "push", kind: "*", optedOut: true },
    ]);
    // The Owner's choices are the Owner's.
    expect(await listed(await signedInOwner(server, agency))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("refuses a kind that isn't one, and the bell, which can't be turned off", async () => {
    const owner = await signedInOwner(server, await createTestAgency(server));
    expect((await choose(owner, { channel: "email", kind: "everything", optedOut: true })).status).toBe(400);
    const bell = await mutate(
      server,
      "notifications.preferences.set",
      { channel: "bell", kind: "*", optedOut: true },
      owner,
    );
    expect(bell.status).toBe(400);
  });

  it("lets support impersonating a member read their choices, but not change them", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const staff = await signedInPlatformStaff(server);
    const jar = await signInPlatformStaffAgain(server, staff);
    const started = jar.absorb(
      await postJson(server, "/api/auth/admin/impersonate-user", { userId: agency.owner.userId }, jar),
    );
    expect(started.status).toBe(200);
    expect(await listed(jar)).toEqual([]);
    expect(await refusalOf(await choose(jar, { channel: "email", kind: "*", optedOut: true }))).toEqual({
      status: 403,
      reason: "IMPERSONATING",
    });
  });

  it("lets a member opt out whatever the subscription allows, cancelled included", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const owner = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    await server.platform.subscription.update({
      where: { organizationId: agency.organizationId },
      data: { status: "cancelled", statusChangedAt: new Date() },
    });
    // Everything else is refused now...
    expect(await refusalOf(await query(server, "notifications.unreadCount", owner))).toEqual({
      status: 403,
      reason: "ORGANIZATION_CANCELLED",
    });
    // ...but consent is the person's: the emails' unsubscribe link leads here.
    await dataOf(await choose(owner, { channel: "email", kind: "*", optedOut: true }));
    expect(await listed(owner)).toEqual([{ channel: "email", kind: "*", optedOut: true }]);
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/e2e/notifications-bell.spec.ts`:**

```ts
// The bell (spec 9.4): a customer opens a quotation the Owner shared, the worker tells the Owner, and the Owner's bell
// shows it with the unread count until it is marked read. The Owner chooses from their account that link opens no
// longer reach them by email, and the choice stays.
import { signInByEmail } from "./support/fixtures";
import { expect, test } from "./support/notifications";

test("a customer opens a shared link, and the sharer's bell says so until it is read", async ({
  page,
  request,
  agency,
  shareAsOwner,
  ownerUnread,
}) => {
  // Issuing, rendering the PDF and the worker's notice each take a moment.
  test.slow();
  const shared = await shareAsOwner();
  await signInByEmail(page, agency.owner);
  await page.goto("/");
  const bell = page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Notifications/ }).filter({ visible: true });
  await expect(bell).toHaveAccessibleName("Notifications");

  // The customer is signed in nowhere: the link redirects to the PDF, and the open is recorded.
  const opened = await request.get(shared.path, { maxRedirects: 0 });
  expect(opened.status()).toBe(302);
  // The open goes out as an event; the worker's listener tells the sharer.
  await expect.poll(ownerUnread, { timeout: 30_000 }).toBe(1);

  await page.reload();
  await expect(bell).toHaveAccessibleName("Notifications, 1 unread");
  await bell.click();
  const panel = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Notifications" });
  await expect(panel.getByText(`Opened: ${shared.label}`)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(panel.getByText("The link you shared has just been opened.")).toBeVisible();
  await panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Mark all read" }).click();
  await expect(panel.getByRole("button", { name: "Mark all read" })).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect.poll(ownerUnread).toBe(0);
  // The phone's sheet hides the page from assistive technology while it is open, the bell with it.
  await page.keyboard.press("Escape");
  await expect(bell).toHaveAccessibleName("Notifications");
  // The journey ends with the list open again, so the accessibility check judges it.
  await bell.click();
  await expect(panel.getByText(`Opened: ${shared.label}`)).toBeVisible();
});

test("an Owner turns off email for opened links, and the choice stays", async ({ page, agency }) => {
  await signInByEmail(page, agency.owner);
  await page.goto("/account");
  await page.getByRole("link", { name: "Choose what reaches you" }).click();
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/account\/notifications$/);
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: "Notifications" })).toBeVisible();

  const opens = page.getByRole("group", { name: "A customer opens a link you shared" });
  const email = opens.getByRole("switch", { name: "Email" });
  await expect(email).toBeChecked();
  const saved = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.url().includes("notifications.preferences.set"));
  await email.click();
  expect((await saved).ok()).toBe(true);
  await expect(email).not.toBeChecked();

  await page.reload();
  await expect(opens.getByRole("switch", { name: "Email" })).not.toBeChecked();
  await expect(opens.getByRole("switch", { name: "Push" })).toBeChecked();
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/e2e/support/notifications.ts`:**

```ts
// What the notification journeys need beyond every journey's agency: a quotation the Owner issued and shared, made
// through the domain as the documents screen will make it, rendered by the journeys' own worker, so a customer can
// open its link; and a look at the Owner's bell in the database, in the agency's own scope.
import type { IssueDocumentInput } from "@travel-crm/contracts/documents";
import { createDatabase, type Database } from "@travel-crm/db";
import { getIssuedDocument, issueDocument } from "@travel-crm/domain/documents";
import type { MemberAccess } from "@travel-crm/domain/identity";
import { createShareLink } from "@travel-crm/domain/share-links";
import { expect, test as base } from "./fixtures";

export { expect };

export interface SharedDocument {
  /** "/p/<token>": anyone may open it, signed in or not. */
  path: string;
  label: string;
}

interface NotificationFixtures {
  owner: MemberAccess;
  /** The Owner shares a quotation once the worker has rendered its PDF. */
  shareAsOwner: () => Promise<SharedDocument>;
  /** How many of the Owner's notifications are unread. */
  ownerUnread: () => Promise<number>;
}

const quotation = (organizationName: string): IssueDocumentInput => ({
  template: "sample",
  content: {
    title: "Quotation",
    recipient: { name: "Meera Iyer", lines: ["Mumbai 400002"] },
    rows: [{ description: "Andaman islands, 6 nights", amount: "₹1,46,500.00" }],
    totals: [{ label: "Total", amount: "₹1,46,500.00", emphasis: true }],
  },
  branding: { organizationName },
});

/** Waits for the worker to render the document's PDF: until then its link asks the customer to wait. */
async function rendered(organizationData: Database, organizationId: string, documentId: string): Promise<void> {
  await expect
    .poll(
      async () =>
        (await organizationData.forOrg(organizationId, (tx) => getIssuedDocument(tx, { documentId }))).pdfAttachmentId,
      { timeout: 30_000 },
    )
    .not.toBeNull();
}

export const test = base.extend<NotificationFixtures, { organizationData: Database }>({
  organizationData: [
    async ({}, use) => {
      const url = process.env.E2E_DATABASE_URL;
      if (!url)
        throw new Error("E2E_DATABASE_URL is not set: run the journeys with `pnpm --filter @travel-crm/web e2e`");
      const organizationData = createDatabase(url, { maxConnections: 2 });
      await use(organizationData);
      await organizationData.disconnect();
    },
    { scope: "worker" },
  ],
  owner: async ({ database, agency }, use) => {
    const user = await database.platform.user.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { email: agency.owner.email } });
    const access = await database.identity.resolveAccess(user.id, agency.organizationId);
    if (!access) throw new Error("the agency's owner has no access");
    await use(access);
  },
  shareAsOwner: async ({ organizationData, agency, owner }, use) => {
    await use(async () => {
      const document = await organizationData.forOrg(agency.organizationId, (tx) =>
        issueDocument(tx, owner, quotation(agency.name)),
      );
      await rendered(organizationData, agency.organizationId, document.id);
      const label = `Quotation ${document.number}`;
      const link = await organizationData.forOrg(agency.organizationId, (tx) =>
        createShareLink(tx, owner, { recordType: "issued_document", recordId: document.id, label }),
      );
      return { path: link.path, label };
    });
  },
  ownerUnread: async ({ organizationData, agency, owner }, use) => {
    await use(() =>
      organizationData.forOrg(agency.organizationId, (tx) =>
        tx.notification.count({ where: { recipientUserId: owner.userId, readAt: null } }),
      ),
    );
  },
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/notifications/kinds.test.ts`:**

```ts
// @vitest-environment node
// The preferences screen shows what delivery will do: for every channel, kind and set of choices, whether a
// notification reaches the person is the opposite of the domain's own isOptedOut (tests may import the domain; only
// src is kept to the api's types). It lists every kind a module sends, each with its words.
import { readdir, readFile } from "node:fs/promises";
import type { NotificationChannel, NotificationPreference } from "@travel-crm/contracts/notifications";
import { isOptedOut } from "@travel-crm/domain/notifications";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { EVERY_KIND, notificationKinds, reaches } from "@/notifications/preferences/kinds";

const KIND = "share-link.opened";
const channels: NotificationChannel[] = ["email", "push"];

/** Every combination of no choice, in, or out, for everything and for the kind, on each channel. */
function everyChoiceSet(): NotificationPreference[][] {
  const options = [undefined, false, true];
  const sets: NotificationPreference[][] = [];
  for (const channel of channels) {
    for (const forEverything of options) {
      for (const forKind of options) {
        sets.push([
          ...(forEverything === undefined ? [] : [{ channel, kind: EVERY_KIND, optedOut: forEverything }]),
          ...(forKind === undefined ? [] : [{ channel, kind: KIND, optedOut: forKind }]),
        ]);
      }
    }
  }
  return sets;
}

describe("reaches", () => {
  it("agrees with delivery for every channel, kind and set of choices", () => {
    for (const choices of everyChoiceSet()) {
      for (const channel of channels) {
        for (const kind of [KIND, EVERY_KIND, "document.issued"]) {
          expect(reaches(choices, channel, kind), JSON.stringify({ choices, channel, kind })).toBe(
            !isOptedOut(choices, channel, kind),
          );
        }
      }
    }
  });
});

/** The kinds the domain's modules notify with, read from their sources (`kind: "share-link.opened"`). */
async function kindsSent(): Promise<string[]> {
  const domain = new URL("../../../../packages/domain/src/", import.meta.url);
  const files = (await readdir(domain, { recursive: true })).filter((file) => file.endsWith(".ts"));
  const sources = await Promise.all(files.map((file) => readFile(new URL(file, domain), "utf8")));
  return [...new Set(sources.flatMap((source) => [...source.matchAll(SENT_KIND)].map(([, kind]) => kind ?? "")))];
}

const SENT_KIND = /\bkind: "([a-z][a-z0-9-]*(?:\.[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)+)"/g;

describe("notificationKinds", () => {
  it("lists every kind a module notifies with, so each can be chosen", async () => {
    const sent = await kindsSent();
    expect(sent).toContain(KIND);
    expect(notificationKinds.map(({ kind }) => kind)).toEqual(expect.arrayContaining(sent));
  });

  it("gives each kind a label and a hint", () => {
    for (const { kind, messageKey } of notificationKinds) {
      const words = messages.notifications.preferences.kinds[messageKey];
      expect(words.label, kind).not.toBe("");
      expect(words.hint, kind).not.toBe("");
    }
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/notifications/notification-bell.test.tsx`:**

```tsx
// The bell (spec 9.4) as a member sees it: the unread count in the People violet, the list newest first and a page at
// a time, an item's link followed only when it is a path in the app, and marking one or all read, which clears the
// count at once and puts it back if the api refuses. Support impersonating the member reads it but can't mark it read.
import type { NotificationPage, NotificationSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/notifications";
import { screen, waitFor, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { createTranslator } from "next-intl";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { locale, messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { formatDay } from "@/lib/format";
import { NotificationBell } from "@/notifications/bell/notification-bell";
import { newQueryClient, renderWithApi } from "../organization/api";
import { stubApi, type Answer } from "../support/api-stub";
import { member } from "../support/members";
import { sentInputs } from "./sent-inputs";

const toast = vi.hoisted(() => ({ success: vi.fn(), error: vi.fn() }));
vi.mock("sonner", () => ({ toast }));
const push = vi.hoisted(() => vi.fn());
vi.mock("next/navigation", () => ({ useRouter: () => ({ push, prefetch: vi.fn() }) }));

const { bell } = messages.notifications;
const t = createTranslator({ locale, messages, namespace: "notifications.bell" });

function notification(number: number, changes: Partial<NotificationSummary> = {}): NotificationSummary {
  return {
    id: `0199a000-0000-7000-8000-${String(number).padStart(12, "0")}`,
    kind: "share-link.opened",
    title: `Opened: Quotation ${String(number)}`,
    body: "The link you shared has just been opened.",
    link: null,
    createdAt: "2026-10-16T05:30:00.000Z",
    readAt: null,
    ...changes,
  };
}

const page = (notifications: NotificationSummary[], nextCursor: string | null = null): Answer => ({
  data: { notifications, nextCursor } satisfies NotificationPage,
});

function renderBell(answers: Record<string, Answer>, me = member({ name: "Asha" })) {
  const api = stubApi(answers);
  renderWithApi(<NotificationBell opensAs="popover" />, newQueryClient(), me);
  return api;
}

async function openBell(count: number) {
  await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: t("label", { count }) }));
  return screen.findByRole("dialog", { name: bell.title });
}

/** jsdom can't load another page: a followed link stops at the document, after the app has handled the click. */
const stayOnPage = (event: MouseEvent) => {
  event.preventDefault();
};

beforeEach(() => {
  toast.error.mockClear();
  document.addEventListener("click", stayOnPage);
});

afterEach(() => {
  document.removeEventListener("click", stayOnPage);
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("NotificationBell", () => {
  it("shows the unread count in violet, and says it to screen readers", async () => {
    renderBell({ "notifications.unreadCount": { data: 3 } });
    const button = await screen.findByRole("button", { name: t("label", { count: 3 }) });
    expect(within(button).getByText("3")).toHaveClass("bg-people", "text-on-action", "numbers");
  });

  it("shows no count when everything is read", async () => {
    renderBell({ "notifications.unreadCount": { data: 0 } });
    expect(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: bell.title })).toHaveTextContent("");
  });

  it("caps a long count, and says the whole of it to screen readers", async () => {
    renderBell({ "notifications.unreadCount": { data: 1234 } });
    const busy = await screen.findByRole("button", { name: t("label", { count: 1234 }) });
    expect(within(busy).getByText(bell.manyUnread)).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("lists the newest first, and links an item only to a path in the app", async () => {
    renderBell({
      "notifications.unreadCount": { data: 2 },
      "notifications.list": page([
        notification(3, { link: "/settings/documents" }),
        notification(2, { link: "//evil.example/settings" }),
        notification(1, { readAt: "2026-10-16T06:00:00.000Z" }),
      ]),
    });
    const list = within(await openBell(2));
    const items = await list.findAllByRole("listitem");
    expect(items).toHaveLength(3);
    const [linked, offSite, read] = items;
    if (!linked || !offSite || !read) throw new Error("three items expected");
    expect(linked).toHaveTextContent("Opened: Quotation 3");
    expect(offSite).toHaveTextContent("Opened: Quotation 2");
    expect(read).toHaveTextContent("Opened: Quotation 1");
    expect(within(linked).getByRole("link")).toHaveAttribute("href", "/settings/documents");
    expect(within(offSite).queryByRole("link")).toBeNull();
    expect(within(linked).getByText(bell.unread)).toHaveClass("sr-only");
    expect(within(read).queryByText(bell.unread)).toBeNull();
    // In the organization's zone: 05:30 UTC is 11:00 am in India ("16 Oct", with the year once it isn't this one).
    const day = formatDay(new Date("2026-10-16T05:30:00.000Z"), { timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata" });
    expect(within(linked).getByText(t("when", { day, time: "11:00 am" }))).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("marks an item read as its link is followed, and the count drops at once", async () => {
    renderBell({
      "notifications.unreadCount": { data: 2 },
      "notifications.list": page([notification(2, { link: "/settings/documents" }), notification(1)]),
      "notifications.markRead": "never",
    });
    const list = within(await openBell(2));
    await userEvent.click(await list.findByRole("link", { name: /Opened: Quotation 2/ }));
    expect(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: t("label", { count: 1 }) })).toBeVisible();
    expect(sentInputs("notifications.markRead")).toEqual([{ notificationIds: [notification(2).id] }]);
  });

  it("marks one item without a link read, or everything at once", async () => {
    const readAt = "2026-10-16T06:00:00.000Z";
    const api = renderBell({
      "notifications.unreadCount": { data: 2 },
      "notifications.list": page([notification(2), notification(1)]),
      "notifications.markRead": { data: 1 },
    });
    const list = within(await openBell(2));
    const [first] = await list.findAllByRole("listitem");
    if (!first) throw new Error("an item expected");
    // What the api answers once each mark has landed, when the bell asks again.
    api.answer("notifications.unreadCount", { data: 1 });
    api.answer("notifications.list", page([notification(2, { readAt }), notification(1)]));
    await userEvent.click(within(first).getByRole("button", { name: bell.markRead }));
    await screen.findByRole("button", { name: t("label", { count: 1 }) });
    api.answer("notifications.unreadCount", { data: 0 });
    api.answer("notifications.list", page([notification(2, { readAt }), notification(1, { readAt })]));
    await userEvent.click(list.getByRole("button", { name: bell.markAllRead }));
    await screen.findByRole("button", { name: bell.title });
    expect(sentInputs("notifications.markRead")).toEqual([{ notificationIds: [notification(2).id] }, { all: true }]);
    expect(list.queryByText(bell.unread)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("puts the count back and says why when the api refuses", async () => {
    renderBell({
      "notifications.unreadCount": { data: 1 },
      "notifications.list": page([notification(1)]),
      "notifications.markRead": { status: 403, reason: "ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED" },
    });
    const list = within(await openBell(1));
    await userEvent.click(await list.findByRole("button", { name: bell.markAllRead }));
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(toast.error).toHaveBeenCalledWith(messages.errors.reasons.ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED, expect.anything());
    });
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: t("label", { count: 1 }) })).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("shows older notifications a page at a time", async () => {
    const api = renderBell({
      "notifications.unreadCount": { data: 0 },
      "notifications.list": page([notification(3), notification(2)], notification(2).id),
    });
    const list = within(await openBell(0));
    await list.findByText("Opened: Quotation 2");
    api.answer("notifications.list", page([notification(1)]));
    await userEvent.click(list.getByRole("button", { name: bell.showMore }));
    expect(await list.findByText("Opened: Quotation 1")).toBeVisible();
    expect(list.queryByRole("button", { name: bell.showMore })).toBeNull();
    expect(sentInputs("notifications.list")).toEqual([{ limit: 20 }, { limit: 20, cursor: notification(2).id }]);
  });

  it("says when there is nothing yet", async () => {
    renderBell({ "notifications.unreadCount": { data: 0 }, "notifications.list": page([]) });
    const list = within(await openBell(0));
    expect(await list.findByText(bell.empty)).toBeVisible();
    expect(list.queryByRole("button", { name: bell.markAllRead })).toBeNull();
  });

  it("says when the list didn't load, with a way to try again", async () => {
    const api = renderBell({ "notifications.unreadCount": { data: 0 }, "notifications.list": { status: 500 } });
    const list = within(await openBell(0));
    expect(await list.findByText(bell.loadFailed)).toBeVisible();
    api.answer("notifications.list", page([notification(1)]));
    await userEvent.click(list.getByRole("button", { name: messages.common.tryAgain }));
    expect(await list.findByText("Opened: Quotation 1")).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("lets support impersonating the member read the list, with no way to mark it read", async () => {
    renderBell(
      {
        "notifications.unreadCount": { data: 1 },
        "notifications.list": page([notification(1, { link: "/settings/documents" })]),
      },
      member({ name: "Asha", impersonatedBy: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000ad" }),
    );
    const list = within(await openBell(1));
    expect(await list.findByText(t("impersonating", { name: "Asha" }))).toBeVisible();
    expect(list.queryByRole("button", { name: bell.markAllRead })).toBeNull();
    await userEvent.click(list.getByRole("link", { name: /Opened: Quotation 1/ }));
    expect(sentInputs("notifications.markRead")).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```tsx
// /account/notifications (spec 9.4): each person chooses, for everything and for each kind, whether it also reaches
// them by email and by push; a kind's own choice wins over everything, as delivery reads them. A change shows at once
// and goes back, with the reason, if the api refuses. Support impersonating the person sees the choices but can't
// change them, and staff without email are told why no email reaches them.
import type { NotificationPreference } from "@travel-crm/contracts/notifications";
import { screen, waitFor, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { createTranslator } from "next-intl";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { locale, messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { NotificationPreferencesScreen } from "@/notifications/preferences/preferences-screen";
import type { SignedInMember } from "@/session/me-context";

import { stubApi, type Answer } from "../support/api-stub";
import { member } from "../support/members";
import { sentInputs } from "./sent-inputs";

vi.mock("sonner", () => ({ toast }));

const t = createTranslator({ locale, messages, namespace: "notifications.preferences" });

/** A member who signs in by email, so email can reach them. */
function withEmail(me: SignedInMember = member({ name: "Asha" })): SignedInMember {
  return { ...me, user: { ...me.user, email: "asha@sharma.example" } };
}

function renderScreen(answers: Record<string, Answer>, me: SignedInMember = withEmail()) {

  renderWithApi(<NotificationPreferencesScreen />, newQueryClient(), me);
  return api;
}

const choices = (list: NotificationPreference[]): Answer => ({ data: list });

/** The switch for one channel in one row ("Everything", or a kind's label). */
async function switchFor(row: string, channel: "email" | "push") {
  const group = await screen.findByRole("group", { name: row });
  return within(group).getByRole("switch", { name: preferences[channel] });
}

beforeEach(() => {
  toast.error.mockClear();
});

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("NotificationPreferencesScreen", () => {
  it("shows email and push for everything and for each kind, a kind's own choice winning", async () => {
    renderScreen({
      "notifications.preferences.list": choices([
        { channel: "push", kind: "*", optedOut: true },
        { channel: "push", kind: "share-link.opened", optedOut: false },
      ]),
    });
    expect(await screen.findByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: preferences.title })).toBeVisible();
    const kind = preferences.kinds.shareLinkOpened.label;
    expect(await switchFor(preferences.everything.label, "email")).toBeChecked();
    expect(await switchFor(preferences.everything.label, "push")).not.toBeChecked();
    expect(await switchFor(kind, "email")).toBeChecked();
    expect(await switchFor(kind, "push")).toBeChecked();
    expect(screen.getByText(preferences.kindWins)).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("saves a change at once", async () => {
    renderScreen({
      "notifications.preferences.list": choices([]),
      "notifications.preferences.set": { data: { channel: "email", kind: "*", optedOut: true } },
    });
    const email = await switchFor(preferences.everything.label, "email");
    await userEvent.click(email);
    expect(email).not.toBeChecked();
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(sentInputs("notifications.preferences.set")).toEqual([{ channel: "email", kind: "*", optedOut: true }]);
    });
  });

  it("moves a switch back, and says why, when the change fails", async () => {
    renderScreen({
      "notifications.preferences.list": choices([]),
      "notifications.preferences.set": { status: 500 },
    });
    const push = await switchFor(preferences.kinds.shareLinkOpened.label, "push");
    await userEvent.click(push);
    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(toast.error).toHaveBeenCalledWith(messages.errors.generic, expect.anything());
    });
    expect(push).toBeChecked();
  });

  it("lets support impersonating the person see the choices, but not change them", async () => {
    renderScreen(
      { "notifications.preferences.list": choices([]) },
      withEmail(member({ name: "Asha", impersonatedBy: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000ad" })),
    );
    expect(await screen.findByText(t("impersonating", { name: "Asha" }))).toBeVisible();
    expect(await switchFor(preferences.everything.label, "email")).toBeDisabled();
    expect(await switchFor(preferences.kinds.shareLinkOpened.label, "push")).toBeDisabled();
  });

  it("tells staff without email why no email reaches them, and leaves push theirs to choose", async () => {
    renderScreen({ "notifications.preferences.list": choices([]) }, member());
    expect(await screen.findByText(preferences.noEmail)).toBeVisible();
    expect(await switchFor(preferences.everything.label, "email")).toBeDisabled();
    expect(await switchFor(preferences.everything.label, "push")).toBeEnabled();
  });

  it("says when the choices didn't load, with a way to try again", async () => {
    const api = renderScreen({ "notifications.preferences.list": { status: 500 } });
    expect(await screen.findByText(preferences.loadFailed)).toBeVisible();
    api.answer("notifications.preferences.list", choices([]));
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: messages.common.tryAgain }));
    expect(await switchFor(preferences.everything.label, "email")).toBeChecked();
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/notifications/sent-inputs.ts`:**

```ts
// What the app sent with each call to one procedure, in call order, for tests whose api is support/api-stub.ts: read
// from the fetch stub's calls, a query's input from ?input= and a mutation's from its body, both batched by index as
// tRPC's httpBatchLink sends them.
import { vi } from "vitest";

const API_TRPC = "/api/trpc/";

export function sentInputs(path: string): unknown[] {
  const inputs: unknown[] = [];
  for (const [input, init] of vi.mocked(fetch).mock.calls) {
    const url = new URL(input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input), "http://localhost");
    if (!url.pathname.startsWith(API_TRPC)) continue;
    const paths = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname.slice(API_TRPC.length)).split(",");
    const body = typeof init?.body === "string" ? init.body : (url.searchParams.get("input") ?? "{}");
    const batch = JSON.parse(body) as Record<string, unknown>;
    paths.forEach((each, index) => {
      if (each === path) inputs.push(batch[String(index)]);
    });
  }
  return inputs;
}
```

**`packages/api/src/routers/notifications.ts`**, the whole file:

```ts
// notifications.*: the bell and each person's choice of what reaches them by email and push (spec 9.4), for every
// member: they are the person's own, so they need no permission. The bell's list and count are views like any other;
// marking read and the choices touch only the person's own rows, never the organization's records, so they work in
// every state of the subscription: an unsubscribe link must work whatever the organization has paid (DPDP).
import {
  listNotificationsInput,
  markReadInput,
  notificationPage,
  notificationPreference,
  notificationPreferenceInput,
} from "@travel-crm/contracts/notifications";
import {
  listNotifications,
  listPreferences,
  markRead,
  setPreference,
  unreadCount,
} from "@travel-crm/domain/notifications";
import { z } from "zod";
import { orgProcedure } from "../procedures.js";
import { router } from "../trpc.js";

const person = orgProcedure.meta({ planModule: "core" });
/** The person's own rows, in every state of the subscription. */
const ownRows = person.meta({ lifecycle: "always" });

const preferencesRouter = router({
  list: ownRows
    .output(z.array(notificationPreference))
    .query(({ ctx }) => ctx.db.forOrg(ctx.member.organizationId, (tx) => listPreferences(tx, ctx.member))),

  /** Refused to support impersonating the person (IMPERSONATING): consent is the person's own. */
  set: ownRows
    .input(notificationPreferenceInput)
    .output(notificationPreference)
    .mutation(({ ctx, input }) =>
      ctx.db.forOrg(ctx.member.organizationId, (tx) => setPreference(tx, ctx.member, input)),
    ),
});

export const notificationsRouter = router({
  /** Newest first, a page at a time. */
  list: person
    .input(listNotificationsInput)
    .output(notificationPage)
    .query(({ ctx, input }) =>
      ctx.db.forOrg(ctx.member.organizationId, (tx) => listNotifications(tx, ctx.member, input)),
    ),

  unreadCount: person
    .output(z.number().int().nonnegative())
    .query(({ ctx }) => ctx.db.forOrg(ctx.member.organizationId, (tx) => unreadCount(tx, ctx.member))),

  /** Returns how many were unread. Refused to support impersonating the person (IMPERSONATING). */
  markRead: ownRows
    .input(markReadInput)
    .output(z.number().int().nonnegative())
    .mutation(({ ctx, input }) => ctx.db.forOrg(ctx.member.organizationId, (tx) => markRead(tx, ctx.member, input))),

  preferences: preferencesRouter,
});
```

**Create `apps/web/src/notifications/bell/notification-bell.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// The bell (spec 9.4): a button with the unread count, opening the person's notifications in a popover from the
// sidebar on wide screens, or in a sheet from the bottom on phones (DESIGN.md: sheets on mobile). Its label says the
// count, so a screen reader hears it without the badge.
import { BellIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Popover, PopoverContent, PopoverTrigger } from "@/components/ui/popover";
import { Sheet, SheetContent, SheetDescription, SheetHeader, SheetTitle, SheetTrigger } from "@/components/ui/sheet";
import { NotificationList } from "./notification-list";
import { UnreadCount } from "./unread-count";
import { useUnreadCount } from "./use-bell";

export function NotificationBell({ opensAs }: { opensAs: "popover" | "sheet" }) {
  const t = useTranslations("notifications.bell");
  const titleId = useId();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const unread = useUnreadCount().data ?? 0;
  const close = () => {
    setOpen(false);
  };
  const trigger = (
    <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label={t("label", { count: unread })} className="relative shrink-0">
      <BellIcon aria-hidden="true" />
      {unread > 0 && <UnreadCount count={unread} />}
    </Button>
  );

  if (opensAs === "popover") {
    return (
      <Popover open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
        <PopoverTrigger asChild>{trigger}</PopoverTrigger>
        <PopoverContent
          align="start"
          aria-labelledby={titleId}
          className="max-h-[80dvh] w-96 max-w-[calc(100vw-2rem)] gap-0 overflow-y-auto p-0"
        >
          <h2 id={titleId} className="px-4 pt-3 text-section font-semibold">
            {t("title")}
          </h2>
          <NotificationList open={open} onFollow={close} />
        </PopoverContent>
      </Popover>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Sheet open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen}>
      <SheetTrigger asChild>{trigger}</SheetTrigger>
      <SheetContent
        side="bottom"
        className="max-h-[90dvh] gap-0 overflow-y-auto rounded-t-xl pb-[env(safe-area-inset-bottom)]"
      >
        <SheetHeader>
          <SheetTitle>{t("title")}</SheetTitle>
          <SheetDescription>{t("description")}</SheetDescription>
        </SheetHeader>
        <NotificationList open={open} onFollow={close} />
      </SheetContent>
    </Sheet>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/notifications/bell/notification-item.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// One notification in the bell. An unread one carries the People violet dot and, for screen readers, the word (never
// colour alone); then its title, its text and when, in the organization's zone. Its link is followed only when it is
// a path in this app: the api checks links, and the bell checks them again, so nothing in it leads off the app.
import type { NotificationSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/notifications";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { formatDay, formatTime } from "@/lib/format";
import { isAppPath } from "@/lib/routes";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useMe } from "@/session/me-context";

export function NotificationItem({
  notification,
  canMark,
  onMark,
  onFollow,
}: {
  notification: NotificationSummary;
  /** False while support is impersonating the person: only they mark their notifications read. */
  canMark: boolean;
  onMark: () => void;
  /** The link is being followed. */
  onFollow: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("notifications.bell");
  const { timeZone } = useMe().organization;
  const createdAt = new Date(notification.createdAt);
  const unread = notification.readAt === null;
  const link = notification.link !== null && isAppPath(notification.link) ? notification.link : null;

  const content = (
    <>
      <span
        aria-hidden="true"
        className={cn("mt-2 size-2 shrink-0 rounded-full", unread ? "bg-people" : "bg-transparent")}
      />
      <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-0.5">
        {unread && <span className="sr-only">{t("unread")}</span>}
        <span className={cn("script-leading break-words", unread ? "font-semibold" : "font-medium")}>
          {notification.title}
        </span>
        <span className="script-leading text-label break-words text-muted-foreground">{notification.body}</span>
        <span className="text-caption text-muted-foreground">
          {t("when", { day: formatDay(createdAt, { timeZone }), time: formatTime(createdAt, { timeZone }) })}
        </span>
      </span>
    </>
  );

  return (
    <li className="flex items-start gap-1 px-2 py-1">
      {link === null ? (
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 gap-3 px-2 py-2">{content}</div>
      ) : (
        <Link
          href={link}
          onClick={onFollow}
          className="flex min-h-11 min-w-0 flex-1 gap-3 rounded-lg px-2 py-2 text-foreground hover:bg-accent"
        >
          {content}
        </Link>
      )}
      {link === null && unread && canMark && (
        <Button variant="ghost" className="shrink-0" onClick={onMark}>
          {t("markRead")}
        </Button>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The person's notifications inside the bell, newest first, a page at a time (spec 9.4), with honest loading, empty
// and failed states (DESIGN.md), "Mark all read" and older ones on request. Following an unread one's link marks it
// read. Support impersonating the person reads them but can't mark them read: the api refuses, as reading is the
// person's own.
import { BellIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/empty-state";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner";
import { useMe } from "@/session/me-context";
import { NotificationItem } from "./notification-item";
import { useMarkRead, useNotificationPages, useUnreadCount } from "./use-bell";

export function NotificationList({ open, onFollow }: { open: boolean; onFollow: () => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations("notifications.bell");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const me = useMe();
  const pages = useNotificationPages({ enabled: open });
  const unread = useUnreadCount().data ?? 0;
  const markRead = useMarkRead();
  const canMark = me.impersonatedBy === null;
  const { notifications } = pages;

  if (notifications === undefined) {
    return pages.isError ? (
      <ErrorState message={t("loadFailed")} retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")} onRetry={() => void pages.refetch()} />
    ) : (
      <Delayed>
        <div role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={t("loading")} className="flex flex-col gap-2 p-4">
          {[0, 1, 2].map((row) => (
            <Skeleton key={row} className="h-14 w-full" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </Delayed>
    );
  }
  if (notifications.length === 0) return <EmptyState icon={BellIcon} message={t("empty")} />;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-1 pb-3">
      {canMark ? (
        unread > 0 && (
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            className="mr-2 self-end"
            onClick={() => {
              markRead.mutate({ all: true });
            }}
          >
            {t("markAllRead")}
          </Button>
        )
      ) : (
        <p className="px-4 py-2 text-label text-muted-foreground">{t("impersonating", { name: me.user.name })}</p>
      )}
      <ul className="flex flex-col divide-y">
        {notifications.map((notification) => {
          const mark = () => {
            markRead.mutate({ notificationIds: [notification.id] });
          };
          return (
            <NotificationItem
              key={notification.id}
              notification={notification}
              canMark={canMark}
              onMark={mark}
              onFollow={() => {
                if (canMark && notification.readAt === null) mark();
                onFollow();
              }}
            />
          );
        })}
      </ul>
      {pages.hasNextPage && (
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          className="self-center"
          disabled={pages.isFetchingNextPage}
          onClick={() => void pages.fetchNextPage()}
        >
          {pages.isFetchingNextPage && <Spinner />}
          {pages.isFetchingNextPage ? t("loadingMore") : t("showMore")}
        </Button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/notifications/bell/use-bell.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// The bell's data (spec 9.4): the unread count, asked again every minute while the app is in view, and the person's
// notifications a page at a time, newest first. Marking read is a quick action (spec 11): the list and the count
// change at once, and go back with the reason if the api refuses.
import type { MarkReadInput, NotificationPage } from "@travel-crm/contracts/notifications";
import { useInfiniteQuery, useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient, type InfiniteData } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useTRPC, useTRPCClient } from "@/data/trpc";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";

export const NOTIFICATIONS_PER_PAGE = 20;

/** The bell is how people hear of things, so its count doesn't wait for the window to regain focus. */
const COUNT_REFRESH_MS = 60_000;

export function useUnreadCount() {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  return useQuery({ ...trpc.notifications.unreadCount.queryOptions(), refetchInterval: COUNT_REFRESH_MS });
}

/** The list's key: under notifications.list, so invalidating that path refreshes it. */
function useListKey() {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  return [...trpc.notifications.list.pathKey(), { limit: NOTIFICATIONS_PER_PAGE }];
}

/** Asked only once the bell opens; each page asks for those older than the last of the page before. */
export function useNotificationPages({ enabled }: { enabled: boolean }) {
  const client = useTRPCClient();
  const query = useInfiniteQuery({
    queryKey: useListKey(),
    queryFn: ({ pageParam }) =>
      client.notifications.list.query({
        limit: NOTIFICATIONS_PER_PAGE,
        ...(pageParam === null ? {} : { cursor: pageParam }),
      }),
    initialPageParam: null as string | null,
    getNextPageParam: (page: NotificationPage) => page.nextCursor,
    enabled,
  });
  return { ...query, notifications: query.data?.pages.flatMap((page) => page.notifications) };
}

/** Marks some (only unread ones are passed) or all of the person's notifications read. */
export function useMarkRead() {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const listKey = useListKey();
  const countKey = trpc.notifications.unreadCount.queryKey();
  return useMutation(
    trpc.notifications.markRead.mutationOptions({
      onMutate: async (which: MarkReadInput) => {
        await Promise.all([
          queryClient.cancelQueries({ queryKey: listKey }),
          queryClient.cancelQueries({ queryKey: countKey }),
        ]);
        const before = {
          list: queryClient.getQueryData<InfiniteData<NotificationPage>>(listKey),
          count: queryClient.getQueryData(countKey),
        };
        const marked = (id: string) => "all" in which || which.notificationIds.includes(id);
        const readAt = new Date().toISOString();
        queryClient.setQueryData<InfiniteData<NotificationPage>>(listKey, (data) =>
          data === undefined
            ? data
            : {
                ...data,
                pages: data.pages.map((page) => ({
                  ...page,
                  notifications: page.notifications.map((notification) =>
                    notification.readAt === null && marked(notification.id)
                      ? { ...notification, readAt }
                      : notification,
                  ),
                })),
              },
        );
        queryClient.setQueryData(countKey, (count) =>
          count === undefined ? count : "all" in which ? 0 : Math.max(0, count - which.notificationIds.length),
        );
        return { before };
      },
      onError: (error, _which, onMutateResult) => {
        if (onMutateResult) {
          queryClient.setQueryData(listKey, onMutateResult.before.list);
          queryClient.setQueryData(countKey, onMutateResult.before.count);
        }
        toast.error(apiError(error), { duration: Infinity });
      },
      onSettled: async () => {
        await Promise.all([
          queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.notifications.list.pathKey() }),
          queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: countKey }),
        ]);
      },
    }),
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/notifications/preferences/kinds.ts`:**

```ts
// The kinds of notification the modules send, for choosing what reaches you, and what a person's choices mean for
// one: a kind's own choice wins over the one for every kind ("*"), as delivery reads them. A module that starts
// sending a kind adds its line here and its words to notifications.json (test/notifications/kinds.test.ts checks).
import type { NotificationChannel, NotificationPreference } from "@travel-crm/contracts/notifications";

/** The choice that covers every kind. */
export const EVERY_KIND = "*";

/** Each kind, and the key of its words under notifications.preferences.kinds. */
export const notificationKinds = [{ kind: "share-link.opened", messageKey: "shareLinkOpened" }] as const;

/** Whether notifications of this kind reach the person on this channel, given their choices. */
export function reaches(
  preferences: readonly NotificationPreference[],
  channel: NotificationChannel,
  kind: string,
): boolean {
  const choiceFor = (forKind: string) =>
    preferences.find((preference) => preference.channel === channel && preference.kind === forKind);
  return !(choiceFor(kind) ?? choiceFor(EVERY_KIND))?.optedOut;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// One row of the choices: a kind, or every kind, with its email and push switches. The row is a group named by the
// kind, so each switch reads "Email" or "Push" within it.
import type { NotificationChannel } from "@travel-crm/contracts/notifications";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useId } from "react";
import { Field, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Switch } from "@/components/ui/switch";

const channels: readonly NotificationChannel[] = ["email", "push"];

export function PreferenceRow({
  label,
  hint,
  receives,
  disabled,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string;
  hint: string;
  /** Whether this kind reaches the person on each channel. */
  receives: Record<NotificationChannel, boolean>;
  disabled: Record<NotificationChannel, boolean>;
  onChange: (channel: NotificationChannel, receives: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("notifications.preferences");
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <div
      role="group"
      aria-labelledby={`${id}-label`}
      aria-describedby={`${id}-hint`}
      className="flex flex-col gap-3 px-4 py-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:gap-6"
    >
      <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-0.5">
        <p id={`${id}-label`} className="font-medium">
          {label}
        </p>
        <p id={`${id}-hint`} className="text-label text-muted-foreground">
          {hint}
        </p>
      </div>
      <div className="flex shrink-0 gap-6">
        {channels.map((channel) => (
          <Field key={channel} orientation="horizontal" data-disabled={disabled[channel]} className="w-auto gap-3">
            <Switch
              id={`${id}-${channel}`}
              checked={receives[channel]}
              disabled={disabled[channel]}
              onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
                onChange(channel, checked);
              }}
            />
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-${channel}`}>{t(channel)}</FieldLabel>
          </Field>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// /account/notifications (spec 9.4): the person's own choice of what reaches them by email and push, for every kind
// and for each one; the bell always shows everything, so it isn't offered. A change saves at once. Support
// impersonating the person sees the choices but can't change them (consent is the person's own), and staff who sign
// in without email are told why none reaches them.
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useId } from "react";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { PageTitle } from "@/components/page-title";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { shownEmail } from "@/lib/shown-email";
import { useMe } from "@/session/me-context";
import { EVERY_KIND, notificationKinds, reaches } from "./kinds";
import { PreferenceRow } from "./preference-row";
import { usePreferences, useSetPreference } from "./use-preferences";

export function NotificationPreferencesScreen() {
  const t = useTranslations("notifications.preferences");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const headingId = useId();
  const me = useMe();
  const preferences = usePreferences();
  const change = useSetPreference();
  const impersonated = me.impersonatedBy !== null;
  const hasEmail = shownEmail(me.user.email) !== null;

  let content;
  if (!preferences.data) {
    content = preferences.isError ? (
      <ErrorState
        message={t("loadFailed")}
        retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")}
        onRetry={() => void preferences.refetch()}
      />
    ) : (
      <Delayed>
        <div role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={t("loading")} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {[0, 1].map((row) => (
            <Skeleton key={row} className="h-16 w-full" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </Delayed>
    );
  } else {
    const choices = preferences.data;
    const rows = [
      { kind: EVERY_KIND, label: t("everything.label"), hint: t("everything.hint") },
      ...notificationKinds.map(({ kind, messageKey }) => ({
        kind,
        label: t(`kinds.${messageKey}.label`),
        hint: t(`kinds.${messageKey}.hint`),
      })),
    ];
    content = (
      <>
        {impersonated && (
          <p className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{t("impersonating", { name: me.user.name })}</p>
        )}
        {!hasEmail && <p className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{t("noEmail")}</p>}
        <div className="divide-y rounded-lg border">
          {rows.map(({ kind, label, hint }) => (
            <PreferenceRow
              key={kind}
              label={label}
              hint={hint}
              receives={{ email: hasEmail && reaches(choices, "email", kind), push: reaches(choices, "push", kind) }}
              disabled={{ email: impersonated || !hasEmail, push: impersonated }}
              onChange={(channel, receives) => {
                change.mutate({ channel, kind, optedOut: !receives });
              }}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
        <p className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{t("kindWins")}</p>
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex max-w-[720px] flex-col gap-6">
      <PageTitle>{t("title")}</PageTitle>
      <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("intro")}</p>
      <section aria-labelledby={headingId} className="flex flex-col gap-3">
        <h2 id={headingId} className="text-section font-semibold">
          {t("kindsHeading")}
        </h2>
        {content}
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/notifications/preferences/use-preferences.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// The person's choice of what reaches them (spec 9.4), and changing one as a quick action (spec 11): the switch moves
// at once, and moves back with the reason if the change fails.
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useTRPC } from "@/data/trpc";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";

export function usePreferences() {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  return useQuery(trpc.notifications.preferences.list.queryOptions());
}

export function useSetPreference() {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const listKey = trpc.notifications.preferences.list.queryKey();
  return useMutation(
    trpc.notifications.preferences.set.mutationOptions({
      onMutate: async (choice) => {
        await queryClient.cancelQueries({ queryKey: listKey });
        const before = queryClient.getQueryData(listKey);
        queryClient.setQueryData(listKey, (choices = []) => [
          ...choices.filter(({ channel, kind }) => channel !== choice.channel || kind !== choice.kind),
          choice,
        ]);
        return { before };
      },
      onError: (error, _choice, onMutateResult) => {
        if (onMutateResult) queryClient.setQueryData(listKey, onMutateResult.before);
        toast.error(apiError(error), { duration: Infinity });
      },
      onSettled: async () => {
        await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: listKey });
      },
    }),
  );
}
```

### Task N2: A member turns push on for a device, the service worker shows it, and signing out takes it away

Web push (spec 9.4) from end to end on the app's side. The api serves `notifications.push.publicKey` (the VAPID public
key from its settings, so one build of the web app serves every environment), `subscribe` and `unsubscribe`, in every
state of the subscription; support impersonating a member can't subscribe, or the member's pushes would reach
support's browser. The notification choices' page gains "On this device": whether this browser gets pushes, turning
them on (the browser's permission, `pushManager.subscribe` with the key, saved to the api, taken back if the api
refuses) and off, and in plain words why not where it can't (no push in this browser, no service worker yet,
notifications blocked). The service worker shows a push from the delivery's payload, tells the app's open pages so the
bell asks again at once, and on a tap opens the push's page in the app (only a path in the app, else home), bringing
forward a window already there. Signing out removes this browser's subscription first, from the api while the session
can still say whose it is and from its push service, so a shared phone gets no more of the last person's pushes: best
effort, never holding up the wipe, and given at most three seconds before the session ends.

  `test/e2e/support/notifications.ts`; Task G2's `ctx.pushPublicKey` and `TEST_PUSH_PUBLIC_KEY`; plan 3's
  `savePushSubscription(tx, actor, subscription)`, `removePushSubscription(tx, actor, { endpoint })`,
  `pushSubscriptionInput`, `removePushSubscriptionInput`, `DomainError` and the delivery's push payload
  (`{ title, body, url? }`, `url` a path in the app); plan 5A's `signOut(queryClient, auth)` and `reportProblem`, the
  worker's `self`/`APP_ROUTES` and its tests' `bundledWorker()`, `at()`, `MemoryCacheStorage`, `WorkerEvent`, `ORIGIN`
  (`test/pwa/{fake-app,worker-sandbox}.ts`), `stubApi`, `StatusBadge`, `isAppPath`, `routes.home`.
- Produces:
  - `notifications.push.publicKey` (output `string`), `notifications.push.subscribe` (input
    `PushSubscriptionInput`; refuses `FORBIDDEN`/`IMPERSONATING` while support impersonates),
    `notifications.push.unsubscribe` (input `{ endpoint }`; another person's browser stays): `lifecycle: "always"`.
  - `interface PushApi { publicKey(): Promise<string>; subscribe(subscription: PushSubscriptionInput): Promise<void>;
    unsubscribe(endpoint: string): Promise<void> }`, `pushApi(client = createApiClient()): PushApi`
    (`@/notifications/push/push-api`); `type PushState = "unsupported" | "no-worker" | "blocked" | "off" | "on"`,
    `pushState()`, `turnPushOn(api)`, `turnPushOff(api)`, each `Promise<PushState>`
    (`@/notifications/push/push-device`); `FORGET_PUSH_TIME_LIMIT_MS = 3_000`,
    `forgetThisDevicesPush(api = pushApi()): Promise<void>` (`@/notifications/push/forget-push`).
  - `signOut(queryClient, auth, forgetPush = forgetThisDevicesPush)` (`@/data/session`): the subscription goes before
    the session ends.
  - `PUSH_ARRIVED` (`{ type: "notification-arrived" }`), `isPushArrived(data)` (`@/notifications/push/push-message`);
    `useRefreshOnPush()` (`@/notifications/bell/use-refresh-on-push`), called by `AppShell`;
    `usePushOnThisDevice()`, `PushOnThisDevice`.
  - The worker: `notificationFor(payload: string | null): PushNotification` (`{ title, options: { body, icon, data:
    { path } } }`), `tapTarget(data, origin): string`, `openFromNotification(clients: AppWindows, url): Promise<void>`
    (`src/service-worker/push.ts`); `push` and `notificationclick` listeners in `sw.ts`.
  - Words: `notifications.push.*` (the worker reads `fallbackTitle` and `fallbackBody` too). Journeys: the
    `ownerPushEndpoints(): Promise<string[]>` fixture. Tests: `fakePushBrowser({ permission?, prompt?, registered?,
    subscribed?, unsubscribe? })` and `THIS_PHONE` (`test/notifications/fake-push-browser.ts`).
