**Create `apps/api/test/notifications-push.test.ts`:**

```ts
// Web push over HTTP (spec 9.4): the browser learns the VAPID public key from the api, so one build of the web app
// serves every environment; a member saves their browser's subscription and removes it again, never another's; only
// the browsers' own push services are accepted; support impersonating a member can't subscribe, or the member's pushes
// would reach support's browser; and removing one works whatever the subscription allows, as signing out does.
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { signedInPlatformStaff, signInPlatformStaffAgain } from "./support/console.js";
import type { CookieJar } from "./support/cookie-jar.js";
import { addStaff, signedInOwner, signedInStaff } from "./support/people.js";
import {
  createTestAgency,
  createTestServer,
  postJson,
  TEST_PUSH_PUBLIC_KEY,
  type TestAgency,
  type TestServer,
} from "./support/test-server.js";
import { dataOf, mutate, query, refusalOf } from "./support/trpc.js";

/** A browser's subscription as PushSubscription.toJSON() gives it. */
const browser = (name: string) => ({
  endpoint: `https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send/${name}-${crypto.randomUUID()}`,
  expirationTime: null,
  keys: { p256dh: "B".repeat(87), auth: "A".repeat(22) },
});

describe("web push", () => {
  let server: TestServer;

  beforeAll(() => {
    server = createTestServer();
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await server.close();
  });

  /** Whose browser the endpoint is, as the worker will read it; null when it is nobody's. */
  const ownerOf = async (agency: TestAgency, endpoint: string) =>
    (
      await server.db.forOrg(agency.organizationId, (tx) =>
        tx.pushSubscription.findFirst({ where: { endpoint }, select: { userId: true } }),
      )
    )?.userId ?? null;
  const subscribe = (jar: CookieJar, subscription: ReturnType<typeof browser>) =>
    mutate(server, "notifications.push.subscribe", subscription, jar);
  const unsubscribe = (jar: CookieJar, endpoint: string) =>
    mutate(server, "notifications.push.unsubscribe", { endpoint }, jar);

  it("gives the browser the VAPID public key it subscribes with", async () => {
    const owner = await signedInOwner(server, await createTestAgency(server));
    expect(await dataOf(await query(server, "notifications.push.publicKey", owner))).toBe(TEST_PUSH_PUBLIC_KEY);
  });

  it("saves a member's browser, and removes it again, never another person's", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const sales = await addStaff(server, agency, { username: "ravi", roleKey: "sales" });
    const owner = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    const ravi = await signedInStaff(server, agency, sales);
    const ownersPhone = browser("owner");
    const ravisPhone = browser("ravi");
    expect((await subscribe(owner, ownersPhone)).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await subscribe(ravi, ravisPhone)).status).toBe(200);
    expect(await ownerOf(agency, ownersPhone.endpoint)).toBe(agency.owner.userId);
    expect(await ownerOf(agency, ravisPhone.endpoint)).toBe(sales.userId);

    // Ravi's phone isn't the Owner's to remove.
    expect((await unsubscribe(owner, ravisPhone.endpoint)).status).toBe(200);
    expect((await unsubscribe(owner, ownersPhone.endpoint)).status).toBe(200);
    expect(await ownerOf(agency, ownersPhone.endpoint)).toBeNull();
    expect(await ownerOf(agency, ravisPhone.endpoint)).toBe(sales.userId);
  });

  it("accepts only the browsers' own push services, over https", async () => {
    const owner = await signedInOwner(server, await createTestAgency(server));
    const plain = { ...browser("plain"), endpoint: "http://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send/x" };
    expect((await subscribe(owner, plain)).status).toBe(400);
    const elsewhere = { ...browser("elsewhere"), endpoint: "https://push.example/send/x" };
    expect(await refusalOf(await subscribe(owner, elsewhere))).toEqual({
      status: 400,
      reason: "INVALID_PUSH_SUBSCRIPTION",
    });
  });

  it("refuses support impersonating a member a subscription, so the member's pushes never reach support", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const staff = await signedInPlatformStaff(server);
    const jar = await signInPlatformStaffAgain(server, staff);
    const started = jar.absorb(
      await postJson(server, "/api/auth/admin/impersonate-user", { userId: agency.owner.userId }, jar),
    );
    expect(started.status).toBe(200);
    const supportsLaptop = browser("support");
    expect(await refusalOf(await subscribe(jar, supportsLaptop))).toEqual({ status: 403, reason: "IMPERSONATING" });
    expect(await ownerOf(agency, supportsLaptop.endpoint)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("removes a browser whatever the subscription allows, as signing out of a cancelled organization does", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const owner = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    const phone = browser("cancelled");
    expect((await subscribe(owner, phone)).status).toBe(200);
    await server.platform.subscription.update({
      where: { organizationId: agency.organizationId },
      data: { status: "cancelled", statusChangedAt: new Date() },
    });
    expect(await dataOf(await query(server, "notifications.push.publicKey", owner))).toBe(TEST_PUSH_PUBLIC_KEY);
    expect((await unsubscribe(owner, phone.endpoint)).status).toBe(200);
    expect(await ownerOf(agency, phone.endpoint)).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/e2e/notifications-push.spec.ts`:**

```ts
// Push (spec 9.4), as far as Chromium goes without a push service: turning push on asks the browser and saves its
// subscription to the api; signing out removes it from the api and from the browser before the session ends, so a
// shared phone gets no more of this person's pushes. The journeys' Chromium has no push service (a headless browser
// reports notifications denied, and its push manager can't register), so the page's permission and push manager are
// stand-ins (standInPush). Unverified here: a real push service's subscription and delivery, the browser's own
// prompt, and showing a push and its tap (the worker's tests cover those two: test/pwa/push-worker.test.ts).
import type { Page, TestInfo } from "@playwright/test";
import { signInByEmail } from "./support/fixtures";
import { expect, test } from "./support/notifications";

/**
 * Runs in the page before the app: notifications allowed, and a push manager that hands out one subscription on a
 * known push service and records in sessionStorage (which outlives the sign-out's page load) that it was removed.
 */
function standInPush(): void {
  const endpoint = `https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send/e2e-${crypto.randomUUID()}`;
  const keys = { p256dh: `B${"A".repeat(86)}`, auth: "A".repeat(22) };
  let current: object | null = null;
  const subscription = {
    endpoint,
    expirationTime: null,
    toJSON: () => ({ endpoint, expirationTime: null, keys }),
    unsubscribe: () => {
      current = null;
      sessionStorage.setItem("e2e-push-removed", endpoint);
      return Promise.resolve(true);
    },
  };
  Object.defineProperty(Notification, "permission", { configurable: true, get: () => "granted" });
  Notification.requestPermission = () => Promise.resolve("granted");
  PushManager.prototype.subscribe = function subscribe() {
    current = subscription;
    sessionStorage.setItem("e2e-push-subscribed", endpoint);
    return Promise.resolve(subscription as unknown as PushSubscription);
  };
  PushManager.prototype.getSubscription = function getSubscription() {
    return Promise.resolve(current as PushSubscription | null);
  };
}

const isPhone = (testInfo: TestInfo) => testInfo.project.name === "phone";

async function signOutFrom(page: Page, testInfo: TestInfo): Promise<void> {
  if (isPhone(testInfo)) await page.getByRole("button", { name: "More" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Sign out" }).filter({ visible: true }).click();
}

test("turning push on saves this browser, and signing out removes it first", async ({
  page,
  agency,
  ownerPushEndpoints,
}, testInfo) => {
  await page.addInitScript(standInPush);
  await signInByEmail(page, agency.owner);
  await page.goto("/account/notifications");
  // A browser subscribes through the service worker, which the app registers on its first page.
  await page.evaluate(() => navigator.serviceWorker.ready.then(() => undefined));

  const device = page.getByRole("region", { name: "On this device" });
  await expect(device.getByText("Off", { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await device.getByRole("button", { name: "Turn on push" }).click();
  await expect(device.getByText("On", { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(device.getByRole("button", { name: "Turn off push" })).toBeVisible();
  const endpoint = await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.getItem("e2e-push-subscribed"));
  expect(await ownerPushEndpoints()).toEqual([endpoint]);

  await signOutFrom(page, testInfo);
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\/sign-in$/);
  expect(await ownerPushEndpoints()).toEqual([]);
  expect(await page.evaluate(() => sessionStorage.getItem("e2e-push-removed"))).toBe(endpoint);
});

test("turning push off removes this browser from the api", async ({ page, agency, ownerPushEndpoints }) => {
  await page.addInitScript(standInPush);
  await signInByEmail(page, agency.owner);
  await page.goto("/account/notifications");
  await page.evaluate(() => navigator.serviceWorker.ready.then(() => undefined));
  const device = page.getByRole("region", { name: "On this device" });
  await device.getByRole("button", { name: "Turn on push" }).click();
  await expect.poll(ownerPushEndpoints).toHaveLength(1);
  await device.getByRole("button", { name: "Turn off push" }).click();
  await expect(device.getByRole("button", { name: "Turn on push" })).toBeVisible();
  expect(await ownerPushEndpoints()).toEqual([]);
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/notifications/fake-push-browser.ts`:**

```ts
// A browser's push machinery for tests, which jsdom lacks: Notification's permission and its prompt, the service
// worker's registration (or none, as in a development build) with a push manager that hands out one subscription, and
// a record of what was subscribed and unsubscribed. restore() takes it all away again.
import { vi } from "vitest";

export const THIS_PHONE = "https://fcm.googleapis.com/fcm/send/this-phone";

export interface FakePushBrowser {
  /** The subscription the push manager holds now, if any. */
  subscription(): { endpoint: string; unsubscribe: () => Promise<boolean> } | null;
  /** The options each subscribe() was given. */
  subscribedWith: PushSubscriptionOptionsInit[];
  /** How many times the browser was unsubscribed. */
  unsubscribed: number;
  restore(): void;
}

export function fakePushBrowser({
  permission = "default",
  prompt = "granted",
  registered = true,
  subscribed = false,
  unsubscribe = () => Promise.resolve(true),
}: {
  permission?: NotificationPermission;
  /** What the permission prompt answers. */
  prompt?: NotificationPermission;
  /** False for a page no service worker controls (a development build). */
  registered?: boolean;
  subscribed?: boolean;
  /** What the push service does when asked to forget this browser. */
  unsubscribe?: () => Promise<boolean>;
} = {}): FakePushBrowser {
  let current: ReturnType<FakePushBrowser["subscription"]> = null;
  const browser: FakePushBrowser = {
    subscription: () => current,
    subscribedWith: [],
    unsubscribed: 0,
    restore: () => {
      Reflect.deleteProperty(navigator, "serviceWorker");
    },
  };
  const subscription = () => ({
    endpoint: THIS_PHONE,
    expirationTime: null,
    toJSON: () => ({
      endpoint: THIS_PHONE,
      expirationTime: null,
      keys: { p256dh: "B".repeat(87), auth: "A".repeat(22) },
    }),
    unsubscribe: async () => {
      browser.unsubscribed += 1;
      const answer = await unsubscribe();
      current = null;
      return answer;
    },
  });
  if (subscribed) current = subscription();
  const registration = {
    pushManager: {
      getSubscription: () => Promise.resolve(current),
      subscribe: (options: PushSubscriptionOptionsInit) => {
        browser.subscribedWith.push(options);
        current = subscription();
        return Promise.resolve(current);
      },
    },
  };
  const notification = {
    permission,
    requestPermission: vi.fn(() => {
      notification.permission = prompt;
      return Promise.resolve(prompt);
    }),
  };
  vi.stubGlobal("Notification", notification);
  // Only its presence matters: the app reaches the push manager through the registration.
  vi.stubGlobal("PushManager", { prototype: {} });
  Object.defineProperty(navigator, "serviceWorker", {
    configurable: true,
    value: {
      getRegistration: () => Promise.resolve(registered ? registration : undefined),
      ready: Promise.resolve(registration),
      addEventListener: vi.fn(),
      removeEventListener: vi.fn(),
    },
  });
  return browser;
}
```

**Create `apps/web/test/notifications/push-device.test.ts`:**

```ts
// This browser's push (spec 9.4), with a stand-in for the browser's push machinery (fake-push-browser.ts): what the
// preferences page can say about it; turning it on (the browser's permission, a subscription with the api's VAPID key,
// saved to the api, and taken back if the api refuses); turning it off (from the api and from the push service); and
// signing out's removal, which never throws and never waits long.
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { FORGET_PUSH_TIME_LIMIT_MS, forgetThisDevicesPush } from "@/notifications/push/forget-push";
import type { PushApi } from "@/notifications/push/push-api";
import { pushState, turnPushOff, turnPushOn } from "@/notifications/push/push-device";
import { fakePushBrowser, THIS_PHONE, type FakePushBrowser } from "./fake-push-browser";

/** A VAPID public key as the api gives it: a P-256 point (65 bytes, the first 4) in base64url. */
const PUBLIC_KEY = `B${"A".repeat(86)}`;

function fakeApi(changes: Partial<PushApi> = {}): PushApi & { calls: unknown[][] } {
  const calls: unknown[][] = [];
  return {
    calls,
    publicKey: () => Promise.resolve(PUBLIC_KEY),
    subscribe: (subscription) => {
      calls.push(["subscribe", subscription]);
      return Promise.resolve();
    },
    unsubscribe: (endpoint) => {
      calls.push(["unsubscribe", endpoint]);
      return Promise.resolve();
    },
    ...changes,
  };
}

let browser: FakePushBrowser | undefined;

afterEach(() => {
  browser?.restore();
  browser = undefined;
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  vi.useRealTimers();
});

describe("pushState", () => {
  it("says what this browser can do", async () => {
    expect(await pushState()).toBe("unsupported");
    browser = fakePushBrowser({ registered: false });
    expect(await pushState()).toBe("no-worker");
    browser.restore();
    browser = fakePushBrowser({ permission: "denied" });
    expect(await pushState()).toBe("blocked");
    browser.restore();
    browser = fakePushBrowser({ permission: "granted" });
    expect(await pushState()).toBe("off");
    browser.restore();
    browser = fakePushBrowser({ permission: "granted", subscribed: true });
    expect(await pushState()).toBe("on");
  });
});

describe("turnPushOn", () => {
  it("asks the browser, subscribes with the api's key and saves the subscription", async () => {
    browser = fakePushBrowser();
    const api = fakeApi();
    expect(await turnPushOn(api)).toBe("on");
    const [options] = browser.subscribedWith;
    expect(options?.userVisibleOnly).toBe(true);
    const key = new Uint8Array(options?.applicationServerKey as Uint8Array);
    expect([key.length, key[0]]).toEqual([65, 4]);
    expect(api.calls).toEqual([
      [
        "subscribe",
        { endpoint: THIS_PHONE, expirationTime: null, keys: { p256dh: "B".repeat(87), auth: "A".repeat(22) } },
      ],
    ]);
  });

  it("does nothing more when the person dismisses or refuses the browser's question", async () => {
    browser = fakePushBrowser({ prompt: "default" });
    expect(await turnPushOn(fakeApi())).toBe("off");
    browser.restore();
    browser = fakePushBrowser({ prompt: "denied" });
    expect(await turnPushOn(fakeApi())).toBe("blocked");
    expect(browser.subscribedWith).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("takes the subscription back when the api refuses it, and says so", async () => {
    browser = fakePushBrowser();
    const refusal = new Error("refused");
    await expect(turnPushOn(fakeApi({ subscribe: () => Promise.reject(refusal) }))).rejects.toBe(refusal);
    expect(browser.subscription()).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("turnPushOff", () => {
  it("removes the subscription from the api and the push service", async () => {
    browser = fakePushBrowser({ permission: "granted", subscribed: true });
    const api = fakeApi();
    expect(await turnPushOff(api)).toBe("off");
    expect(api.calls).toEqual([["unsubscribe", THIS_PHONE]]);
    expect(browser.unsubscribed).toBe(1);
  });

  it("still turns this browser off when the api can't be told", async () => {
    browser = fakePushBrowser({ permission: "granted", subscribed: true });
    expect(await turnPushOff(fakeApi({ unsubscribe: () => Promise.reject(new TypeError("offline")) }))).toBe("off");
    expect(browser.subscription()).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe("forgetThisDevicesPush", () => {
  it("asks nothing of a browser without a subscription, or without push at all", async () => {
    const api = fakeApi();
    await forgetThisDevicesPush(api);
    browser = fakePushBrowser({ permission: "granted" });
    await forgetThisDevicesPush(api);
    expect(api.calls).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("removes this browser's subscription, and never throws", async () => {
    browser = fakePushBrowser({ permission: "granted", subscribed: true });
    const api = fakeApi({ unsubscribe: () => Promise.reject(new TypeError("offline")) });
    await expect(forgetThisDevicesPush(api)).resolves.toBeUndefined();
    expect(browser.unsubscribed).toBe(1);
  });

  it("stops waiting for an api or a push service that doesn't answer", async () => {
    vi.useFakeTimers();
    browser = fakePushBrowser({
      permission: "granted",
      subscribed: true,
      unsubscribe: () => new Promise(() => undefined),
    });
    const forgotten = vi.fn();
    void forgetThisDevicesPush(fakeApi({ unsubscribe: () => new Promise(() => undefined) })).then(forgotten);
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(FORGET_PUSH_TIME_LIMIT_MS - 1);
    expect(forgotten).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1);
    expect(forgotten).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/notifications/push-on-this-device.test.tsx`:**

```tsx
// Push on this device, on the notification choices' page (spec 9.4): it says whether this browser gets pushes, turns
// them on and off, says plainly why it can't where it can't (no push in this browser, no service worker, notifications
// blocked) and when turning on failed, and offers support impersonating the person no way to turn it on.
import { screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { createTranslator } from "next-intl";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { locale, messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { PushOnThisDevice } from "@/notifications/push/push-on-this-device";
import { newQueryClient, renderWithApi } from "../organization/api";
import { member } from "../support/members";

const device = vi.hoisted(() => ({ pushState: vi.fn(), turnPushOn: vi.fn(), turnPushOff: vi.fn() }));
vi.mock("@/notifications/push/push-device", () => device);
const toast = vi.hoisted(() => ({ success: vi.fn(), error: vi.fn() }));
vi.mock("sonner", () => ({ toast }));

const { push } = messages.notifications;
const t = createTranslator({ locale, messages, namespace: "notifications.push" });

function renderPush(me = member({ name: "Asha" })) {
  renderWithApi(<PushOnThisDevice />, newQueryClient(), me);
}

beforeEach(() => {
  for (const call of Object.values(device)) call.mockReset();
  toast.error.mockClear();
});

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("PushOnThisDevice", () => {
  it("turns push on, and says it is on", async () => {
    device.pushState.mockResolvedValue("off");
    device.turnPushOn.mockResolvedValue("on");
    renderPush();
    expect(await screen.findByText(push.off)).toBeVisible();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: push.turnOn }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(push.on)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: push.turnOff })).toBeVisible();
    expect(device.turnPushOn).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });

  it("turns push off again", async () => {
    device.pushState.mockResolvedValue("on");
    device.turnPushOff.mockResolvedValue("off");
    renderPush();
    await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: push.turnOff }));
    expect(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: push.turnOn })).toBeVisible();
  });

  it.each([
    ["unsupported", push.unsupported],
    ["no-worker", push.noWorker],
    ["blocked", push.blocked],
  ] as const)("says why push can't be turned on: %s", async (state, sentence) => {
    device.pushState.mockResolvedValue(state);
    renderPush();
    expect(await screen.findByText(sentence)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: push.turnOn })).toBeNull();
  });

  it("says so when the browser couldn't turn push on, and stays off", async () => {
    device.pushState.mockResolvedValue("off");
    device.turnPushOn.mockRejectedValue(new DOMException("Registration failed", "AbortError"));
    renderPush();
```

**Create `apps/web/test/notifications/refresh-on-push.test.tsx`:**

```tsx
// When a push arrives the service worker tells the app's open pages (push-message.ts), and the bell asks again at
// once rather than at its next minute; any other message from the worker changes nothing.
import { renderHook } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { useRefreshOnPush } from "@/notifications/bell/use-refresh-on-push";
import { PUSH_ARRIVED } from "@/notifications/push/push-message";
import { newQueryClient, withApp } from "../organization/api";

afterEach(() => {
  Reflect.deleteProperty(navigator, "serviceWorker");
});

/** The service worker container, as a target the test can send the worker's messages from. */
function workerContainer(): EventTarget {
  const container = new EventTarget();
  Object.defineProperty(navigator, "serviceWorker", { configurable: true, value: container });
  return container;
}

describe("useRefreshOnPush", () => {
  it("refreshes the bell when the service worker says a push arrived", () => {
    const container = workerContainer();
    const queryClient = newQueryClient();
    const invalidate = vi.spyOn(queryClient, "invalidateQueries");
    const { unmount } = renderHook(
      () => {
        useRefreshOnPush();
      },
      { wrapper: withApp(queryClient) },
    );

    container.dispatchEvent(new MessageEvent("message", { data: { type: "something-else" } }));
    expect(invalidate).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    container.dispatchEvent(new MessageEvent("message", { data: PUSH_ARRIVED }));
    expect(invalidate).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ queryKey: [["notifications"]] });

    unmount();
    container.dispatchEvent(new MessageEvent("message", { data: PUSH_ARRIVED }));
    expect(invalidate).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });

  it("does nothing in a browser without service workers", () => {
    expect(() =>
      renderHook(
        () => {
          useRefreshOnPush();
        },
        { wrapper: withApp(newQueryClient()) },
      ),
    ).not.toThrow();
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/notifications/sign-out-push.test.ts`:**

```ts
// Signing out removes this browser's push subscription first (spec 9.4), so a shared phone never gets the last
// person's pushes: from the api while the session can still say whose it is, then from the push service; best effort,
// and nothing about it holds up the wipe or stops the sign-out.
import "fake-indexeddb/auto";
import { QueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import type { AuthClient } from "@/data/auth-client";
import { isSignOutOwed } from "@/data/owed-sign-out";
import { signOut } from "@/data/session";
import { stubApi } from "../support/api-stub";
import { fakePushBrowser, THIS_PHONE, type FakePushBrowser } from "./fake-push-browser";
import { sentInputs } from "./sent-inputs";

type SignOutResult = Awaited<ReturnType<AuthClient["signOut"]>>;
const answered: SignOutResult = { ok: true, data: null };

let browser: FakePushBrowser | undefined;

afterEach(() => {
  browser?.restore();
  browser = undefined;
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  window.localStorage.clear();
});

describe("signing out", () => {
  it("removes this browser's push subscription from the api and the push service before the session ends", async () => {
    browser = fakePushBrowser({ permission: "granted", subscribed: true });
    const api = stubApi({ "notifications.push.unsubscribe": { data: null } });
    const queryClient = new QueryClient();
    queryClient.setQueryData(["notifications", "unreadCount"], 3);
    const atSignOut: unknown[] = [];
    const auth = {
      signOut: vi.fn(() => {
        atSignOut.push([...api.calls], browser?.subscription() ?? null, queryClient.getQueryCache().getAll().length);
        return Promise.resolve(answered);
      }),
    };
    await signOut(queryClient, auth);
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(auth.signOut).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    });
    expect(atSignOut).toEqual([["notifications.push.unsubscribe"], null, 0]);
    expect(sentInputs("notifications.push.unsubscribe")).toEqual([{ endpoint: THIS_PHONE }]);
  });

  it("asks the api nothing about push for a browser without a subscription", async () => {
    browser = fakePushBrowser({ permission: "granted" });
    const api = stubApi({});
    await signOut(new QueryClient(), { signOut: () => Promise.resolve(answered) });
    expect(api.calls).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("still signs out when removing the subscription fails, and reports it", async () => {
    const reported = vi.fn();
    vi.stubGlobal("reportError", reported);
    const failing = () => Promise.reject(new Error("the push service is down"));
    const auth = { signOut: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve(answered)) };
    await signOut(new QueryClient(), auth, failing);
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(isSignOutOwed()).toBe(false);
    });
    expect(auth.signOut).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(reported).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/pwa/push-worker.test.ts`:**

```ts
// @vitest-environment node
// The service worker as it ships (fake-app.ts bundles it) receiving a push and the tap on its notification: it shows
// the notification, tells the app's open pages so their bell asks again, and a tap opens the push's page in the app
// or brings forward a window already on it, never another site. Run like worker-sandbox.ts runs the worker, with the
// stand-ins a push needs besides: the registration's notifications and the app's windows.
import vm from "node:vm";
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { PUSH_ARRIVED } from "@/notifications/push/push-message";
import { at, bundledWorker } from "./fake-app";
import { MemoryCacheStorage, ORIGIN, WorkerEvent } from "./worker-sandbox";

interface AppWindow {
  url: string;
  told: unknown[];
  focus: () => Promise<AppWindow>;
  navigate: (url: string) => Promise<AppWindow>;
  postMessage: (message: unknown) => void;
}

function appWindow(url: string): AppWindow {
  const window: AppWindow = {
    url,
    told: [],
    focus: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve(window)),
    navigate: vi.fn((to: string) => Promise.resolve({ ...window, url: to })),
    postMessage: (message) => window.told.push(message),
  };
  return window;
}

/** The worker, started with these windows of the app open: what it shows and opens, and ways to push and tap. */
async function pushWorker(windows: AppWindow[] = []) {
  const listeners = new Map<string, (event: WorkerEvent) => void>();
  const shown: [string, unknown][] = [];
  const opened: string[] = [];
  const scope = {
    location: new URL("/sw.js", ORIGIN),
    addEventListener: (type: string, listener: (event: WorkerEvent) => void) => listeners.set(type, listener),
    skipWaiting: () => Promise.resolve(),
    registration: {
      showNotification: (title: string, options: unknown) => {
        shown.push([title, options]);
        return Promise.resolve();
      },
    },
    clients: {
      claim: () => Promise.resolve(),
      matchAll: () => Promise.resolve(windows),
      openWindow: (url: string) => {
        opened.push(url);
        return Promise.resolve(null);
      },
    },
  };
  vm.runInNewContext(await bundledWorker(), {
    self: scope,
    caches: new MemoryCacheStorage(),
    fetch: () => Promise.reject(new TypeError("Failed to fetch")),
    Response,
    Request,
    Headers,
    URL,
    console,
    setTimeout: (callback: () => void, delay: number) => setTimeout(callback, delay),
  });
  async function dispatch(type: string, properties: object): Promise<void> {
    const event = Object.assign(new WorkerEvent(), properties);
    listeners.get(type)?.(event);
    await event.settled();
  }
  const close = vi.fn();
  return {
    shown,
    opened,
    close,
    push: (payload: string | null) => dispatch("push", { data: payload === null ? null : { text: () => payload } }),
    tap: (data: unknown) => dispatch("notificationclick", { notification: { data, close } }),
  };
}

const payload = JSON.stringify({
  title: "Opened: Quotation SAMPLE-2026-0001",
  body: "The link you shared has just been opened.",
  url: "/settings/documents",
});

describe("a push", () => {
  it("shows its notification, and tells the app's open pages", async () => {
    const open = [appWindow(at("/")), appWindow(at("/staff"))];
    const worker = await pushWorker(open);
    await worker.push(payload);
    expect(worker.shown).toEqual([
      [
        "Opened: Quotation SAMPLE-2026-0001",
        expect.objectContaining({
          body: "The link you shared has just been opened.",
          data: { path: "/settings/documents" },
        }),
      ],
    ]);
    expect(open.map(({ told }) => told)).toEqual([[PUSH_ARRIVED], [PUSH_ARRIVED]]);
  });

  it("still shows a notification when its payload can't be read", async () => {
    const worker = await pushWorker();
    await worker.push(null);
    expect(worker.shown).toHaveLength(1);
  });
});

describe("a tap on the notification", () => {
  it("closes it and opens its page in the app", async () => {
    const worker = await pushWorker();
    await worker.tap({ path: "/settings/documents" });
    expect(worker.close).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(worker.opened).toEqual([at("/settings/documents")]);
  });

  it("brings forward a window already on that page", async () => {
    const there = appWindow(at("/settings/documents"));
    const worker = await pushWorker([there]);
    await worker.tap({ path: "/settings/documents" });
    expect(there.focus).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(worker.opened).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("opens home for anything but a path in the app", async () => {
    const worker = await pushWorker();
    await worker.tap({ path: "https://evil.example/settings" });
    expect(worker.opened).toEqual([at("/")]);
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/pwa/push.test.ts`:**

```ts
// @vitest-environment node
// What the service worker does with a push, decided from facts alone (src/service-worker/push.ts): the notification
// it shows from the delivery's payload ({ title, body, url }); something honest for a payload it can't read, since a
// browser must show one for every push; and where a tap leads: the push's path in the app, else home, never another
// site, bringing forward a window already there rather than opening another.
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import words from "@/i18n/messages/en-IN/notifications.json";
import { notificationFor, openFromNotification, tapTarget } from "@/service-worker/push";

const ORIGIN = "https://app.example.in";
const opened = {
  title: "Opened: Quotation SAMPLE-2026-0001",
  body: "The link you shared has just been opened.",
  url: "/settings/documents",
};

describe("notificationFor", () => {
  it("shows the push's title and text, and keeps its path for the tap", () => {
    expect(notificationFor(JSON.stringify(opened))).toEqual({
      title: opened.title,
      options: { body: opened.body, icon: "/icons/icon-192.png", data: { path: "/settings/documents" } },
    });
  });

  it("leads home from a push without a path in the app", () => {
    for (const url of [
      undefined,
      "https://evil.example/x",
      "//evil.example/x",
      "/\\evil.example",
      "/api/auth/sign-out",
    ]) {
      expect(notificationFor(JSON.stringify({ ...opened, url })).options.data, String(url)).toEqual({ path: "/" });
    }
  });

  it("still shows something for a push it can't read", () => {
    for (const payload of [null, "not json", "42", JSON.stringify({ title: 7, body: ["x"] })]) {
      expect(notificationFor(payload), String(payload)).toEqual({
        title: words.push.fallbackTitle,
        options: { body: words.push.fallbackBody, icon: "/icons/icon-192.png", data: { path: "/" } },
      });
    }
  });
});

describe("tapTarget", () => {
  it("is the notification's path on the app's own address, or home", () => {
    expect(tapTarget({ path: "/staff" }, ORIGIN)).toBe(`${ORIGIN}/staff`);
    for (const data of [undefined, null, {}, { path: "//evil.example" }, { path: 42 }]) {
      expect(tapTarget(data, ORIGIN), JSON.stringify(data)).toBe(`${ORIGIN}/`);
    }
  });
});

describe("openFromNotification", () => {
  function appWindow(url: string, { movable = true }: { movable?: boolean } = {}) {
    const window = {
      url,
      focus: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve(window)),
      navigate: vi.fn((to: string) =>
        movable ? Promise.resolve({ ...window, url: to }) : Promise.reject(new TypeError("not controlled")),
      ),
    };
    return window;
  }
  function clientsWith(...windows: ReturnType<typeof appWindow>[]) {
    return { matchAll: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve(windows)), openWindow: vi.fn(() => Promise.resolve(null)) };
  }
  const target = `${ORIGIN}/settings/documents`;

  it("brings forward a window of the app already on that page", async () => {
    const there = appWindow(target);
    const clients = clientsWith(appWindow(`${ORIGIN}/`), there);
    await openFromNotification(clients, target);
    expect(there.focus).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(clients.openWindow).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("takes another window of the app there, and brings it forward", async () => {
    const elsewhere = appWindow(`${ORIGIN}/staff`);
    const clients = clientsWith(elsewhere);
    await openFromNotification(clients, target);
    expect(elsewhere.navigate).toHaveBeenCalledWith(target);
    expect(elsewhere.focus).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(clients.openWindow).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("opens a window when the app has none, or none it can move", async () => {
    const none = clientsWith();
    await openFromNotification(none, target);
    expect(none.openWindow).toHaveBeenCalledWith(target);
    const stuck = clientsWith(appWindow(`${ORIGIN}/staff`, { movable: false }));
    await openFromNotification(stuck, target);
    expect(stuck.openWindow).toHaveBeenCalledWith(target);
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/src/notifications/bell/use-refresh-on-push.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// The bell asks again the moment a push arrives, which the service worker tells the app's open pages
// (push/push-message.ts), rather than at its next minute.
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useEffect } from "react";
import { useTRPC } from "@/data/trpc";
import { isPushArrived } from "../push/push-message";

export function useRefreshOnPush(): void {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!("serviceWorker" in navigator)) return;
    const workers = navigator.serviceWorker;
    const onMessage = (event: MessageEvent<unknown>) => {
      if (isPushArrived(event.data)) void queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.notifications.pathKey() });
    };
    workers.addEventListener("message", onMessage);
    return () => {
      workers.removeEventListener("message", onMessage);
    };
  }, [trpc, queryClient]);
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/notifications/push/forget-push.ts`:**

```ts
// Signing out's part in push (data/session.ts): this browser's subscription goes, from the api while the session can
// still say whose it is and from its push service, so a shared phone gets no more of this person's pushes. Best
// effort and time-limited, so the sign-in page never waits long for it; it rejects only when the browser itself
// fails, which signing out reports.
import { pushApi, type PushApi } from "./push-api";
import { turnPushOff } from "./push-device";

/** How long signing out waits for the api and the push service. */
export const FORGET_PUSH_TIME_LIMIT_MS = 3_000;

export async function forgetThisDevicesPush(api: PushApi = pushApi()): Promise<void> {
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  const timeUp = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
    timer = setTimeout(resolve, FORGET_PUSH_TIME_LIMIT_MS);
  });
  try {
    await Promise.race([turnPushOff(api), timeUp]);
  } finally {
    clearTimeout(timer);
  }
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/notifications/push/push-api.ts`:**

```ts
// What turning push on and off needs of the api (notifications.push.*), apart from React so signing out can use it
// too: the VAPID public key, and saving or removing this browser's subscription.
import type { PushSubscriptionInput } from "@travel-crm/contracts/notifications";
import { createApiClient, type ApiClient } from "@/data/trpc";

export interface PushApi {
  publicKey(): Promise<string>;
  subscribe(subscription: PushSubscriptionInput): Promise<void>;
  unsubscribe(endpoint: string): Promise<void>;
}

export function pushApi(client: ApiClient = createApiClient()): PushApi {
  return {
    publicKey: () => client.notifications.push.publicKey.query(),
    subscribe: async (subscription) => {
      await client.notifications.push.subscribe.mutate(subscription);
    },
    unsubscribe: async (endpoint) => {
      await client.notifications.push.unsubscribe.mutate({ endpoint });
    },
  };
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/notifications/push/push-device.ts`:**

```ts
// This browser's web push (spec 9.4): what it can do, and turning push on or off for the person signed in. A
// subscription lives in two places, the browser's push service and the api (whose worker sends to it), and both change
// together. Only a production build registers the service worker (pwa/register-service-worker.ts), so only there can
// push be turned on; on an iPhone, only the app added to the Home Screen has push at all.
import type { PushSubscriptionInput } from "@travel-crm/contracts/notifications";
import type { PushApi } from "./push-api";

/** "no-worker": no service worker for this page (yet). "blocked": the person told the browser no. */
export type PushState = "unsupported" | "no-worker" | "blocked" | "off" | "on";

function hasPush(): boolean {
  return "serviceWorker" in navigator && typeof PushManager !== "undefined" && typeof Notification !== "undefined";
}

export async function pushState(): Promise<PushState> {
  if (!hasPush()) return "unsupported";
  const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration();
  if (!registration) return "no-worker";
  if (Notification.permission === "denied") return "blocked";
  return (await registration.pushManager.getSubscription()) === null ? "off" : "on";
}

/** The VAPID public key's bytes, as subscribe() takes them: the api gives it in base64url. */
function keyBytes(base64url: string): Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer> {
  const base64 = base64url.replaceAll("-", "+").replaceAll("_", "/");
  const padded = base64.padEnd(Math.ceil(base64.length / 4) * 4, "=");
  return Uint8Array.from(atob(padded), (character) => character.charCodeAt(0));
}

/** What the api keeps of a subscription: PushSubscription.toJSON(), its keys base64url. */
function inputOf(subscription: PushSubscription): PushSubscriptionInput {
  const { expirationTime, keys } = subscription.toJSON();
  return {
    endpoint: subscription.endpoint,
    expirationTime: expirationTime ?? null,
    keys: { p256dh: keys?.p256dh ?? "", auth: keys?.auth ?? "" },
  };
}

/**
 * Asks the browser's permission, subscribes with the api's key and saves the subscription for the person. When the
 * api refuses it, the browser is unsubscribed again, so the two never disagree, and the refusal is thrown.
 */
export async function turnPushOn(api: PushApi): Promise<PushState> {
  const state = await pushState();
  if (state !== "off" && state !== "on") return state;
  const permission = await Notification.requestPermission();
  if (permission !== "granted") return permission === "denied" ? "blocked" : "off";
  const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.ready;
  const subscription =
    (await registration.pushManager.getSubscription()) ??
    (await registration.pushManager.subscribe({
      // Every push shows a notification: browsers allow nothing else.
      userVisibleOnly: true,
      applicationServerKey: keyBytes(await api.publicKey()),
    }));
  try {
    await api.subscribe(inputOf(subscription));
  } catch (error) {
    await subscription.unsubscribe().catch(() => false);
    throw error;
  }
  return "on";
}

/**
 * Removes this browser's subscription from the api and from its push service. The browser is off afterwards even if
 * the api couldn't be told: its push service has forgotten it, so the api's next push to it is refused and the api
 * deletes it then (ADR 0014).
 */
export async function turnPushOff(api: PushApi): Promise<PushState> {
  if (!hasPush()) return "unsupported";
  const registration = await navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistration();
  const subscription = (await registration?.pushManager.getSubscription()) ?? null;
  if (subscription !== null) {
    await Promise.allSettled([api.unsubscribe(subscription.endpoint), subscription.unsubscribe()]);
  }
  return pushState();
}
```

```ts
// The message the service worker sends the app's open pages when a push arrives, so the bell asks again at once. The
// worker (src/service-worker/sw.ts) and the app share it; the app checks a message rather than trusting it, as
// another version of the worker may send others.
export const PUSH_ARRIVED = { type: "notification-arrived" } as const;

export function isPushArrived(data: unknown): boolean {
  return data !== null && typeof data === "object" && (data as { type?: unknown }).type === PUSH_ARRIVED.type;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// Push on this device (spec 9.4), on the notification choices' page: whether this browser gets push notifications,
// turning them on or off, and where it can't, why, in plain words: no push in this browser, no service worker yet, or
// notifications blocked. Support impersonating the person can't turn it on: the api refuses, since the person's
// pushes would reach support's device.
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useId } from "react";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/status-badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner";
import { useMe } from "@/session/me-context";
import { usePushOnThisDevice } from "./use-push-on-this-device";

const cannot = { unsupported: "unsupported", "no-worker": "noWorker", blocked: "blocked" } as const;

export function PushOnThisDevice() {
  const t = useTranslations("notifications.push");
  const headingId = useId();
  const me = useMe();
  const push = usePushOnThisDevice();
  const impersonated = me.impersonatedBy !== null;
  const { state, busy } = push;

  let content;
  if (state === "checking") {
    content = (
      <Delayed>
        <Skeleton role="status" aria-label={t("checking")} className="h-11 w-full" />
      </Delayed>
    );
  } else if (state === "on" || state === "off") {
    const on = state === "on";
    let hint = on ? t("onHint") : t("offHint");
    if (impersonated) hint = t("impersonating", { name: me.user.name });
    content = (
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between sm:gap-6">
        <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
            <span className="font-medium">{t("label")}</span>
            <StatusBadge tone={on ? "good" : "neutral"}>{on ? t("on") : t("off")}</StatusBadge>
          </div>
          <p className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{hint}</p>
        </div>
        <Button
          variant={on ? "outline" : "default"}
          className="shrink-0"
          disabled={busy || impersonated}
          onClick={() => void (on ? push.turnOff() : push.turnOn())}
        >
          {busy && <Spinner />}
          {busy ? t(on ? "turningOff" : "turningOn") : t(on ? "turnOff" : "turnOn")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    );
  } else {
    content = <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t(cannot[state])}</p>;
  }

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby={headingId} className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <h2 id={headingId} className="text-section font-semibold">
        {t("heading")}
      </h2>
      <div className="rounded-lg border px-4 py-3">{content}</div>
    </section>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/notifications/push/use-push-on-this-device.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// Push on this device, for the notification choices' page: its state, asked of the browser when the page opens, and
// again once the service worker is ready (on a first visit it registers while the page opens), and turning push on
// or off. A failure shows its sentence: the api's refusal, or the browser's own failure to subscribe.
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useTRPCClient } from "@/data/trpc";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { pushApi, type PushApi } from "./push-api";
import { pushState, turnPushOff, turnPushOn, type PushState } from "./push-device";

export function usePushOnThisDevice() {
  const t = useTranslations("notifications.push");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const client = useTRPCClient();
  const [state, setState] = useState<PushState | "checking">("checking");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    let mounted = true;
    const check = async () => {
      const found = await pushState().catch((): PushState => "unsupported");
      if (mounted) setState(found);
      return found;
    };
    void check().then((found) => {
      if (found === "no-worker" && "serviceWorker" in navigator) void navigator.serviceWorker.ready.then(check);
    });
    return () => {
      mounted = false;
    };
  }, []);

  async function change(turn: (api: PushApi) => Promise<PushState>): Promise<void> {
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      setState(await turn(pushApi(client)));
    } catch (error) {
      // The browser's own failures (no push service, a refused key) are DOMExceptions; the rest are the api's.
      toast.error(error instanceof DOMException ? t("failed") : apiError(error), { duration: Infinity });
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  return {
    state,
    busy,
    turnOn: () => change(turnPushOn),
    turnOff: () => change(turnPushOff),
  };
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/service-worker/push.ts`:**

```ts
// What the service worker does with a push (spec 9.4), decided from facts alone so it can be tested without a worker:
// the notification it shows, from the payload the api's delivery sends ({ title, body, url }, the domain's
// push-payload.ts), with the app's own words for one it can't read, since a browser must show something for every
// push; and where a tap leads: the push's path in the app, else home, so a push never opens another site.
import notificationWords from "../i18n/messages/en-IN/notifications.json";
import { isAppPath, routes } from "../lib/routes";

/** The app's icon, shown beside the notification's text. */
const ICON = "/icons/icon-192.png";

export interface PushNotification {
  title: string;
  options: { body: string; icon: string; data: { path: string } };
}

function fieldsOf(payload: string | null): Record<string, unknown> {
  if (payload === null) return {};
  try {
    const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(payload);
    return parsed !== null && typeof parsed === "object" ? (parsed as Record<string, unknown>) : {};
  } catch {
    return {};
  }
}

const textOf = (value: unknown): string | null => (typeof value === "string" && value.trim() !== "" ? value : null);

/** The notification for a push, from its payload's text (null for a push without one). */
export function notificationFor(payload: string | null): PushNotification {
  const fields = fieldsOf(payload);
  const title = textOf(fields.title);
  if (title === null) {
    const { fallbackTitle, fallbackBody } = notificationWords.push;
    return { title: fallbackTitle, options: { body: fallbackBody, icon: ICON, data: { path: routes.home } } };
  }
  const url = textOf(fields.url);
  const path = url !== null && isAppPath(url) ? url : routes.home;
  return { title, options: { body: textOf(fields.body) ?? "", icon: ICON, data: { path } } };
}

/** The address a tap on a notification opens: its path on the app's own origin, or home. */
export function tapTarget(data: unknown, origin: string): string {
  const path = data !== null && typeof data === "object" ? (data as { path?: unknown }).path : undefined;
  return new URL(typeof path === "string" && isAppPath(path) ? path : routes.home, origin).href;
}

interface AppWindow {
  url: string;
  focus(): Promise<unknown>;
  navigate(url: string): Promise<{ focus(): Promise<unknown> } | null>;
}

/** The worker's clients, as far as opening a notification's page needs them. */
export interface AppWindows {
  matchAll(options: { type: "window"; includeUncontrolled: boolean }): Promise<readonly AppWindow[]>;
  openWindow(url: string): Promise<unknown>;
}

/** A window of the app already on the page comes forward; else one of the app's windows goes there; else one opens. */
export async function openFromNotification(clients: AppWindows, url: string): Promise<void> {
  const windows = await clients.matchAll({ type: "window", includeUncontrolled: true });
  const there = windows.find((client) => client.url === url);
  if (there) {
    await there.focus();
    return;
  }
  const [other] = windows;
  // Only a window the worker controls can be moved; any other stays as it is, and a new one opens.
  const moved = other ? await other.navigate(url).catch(() => null) : null;
  if (moved) await moved.focus();
  else await clients.openWindow(url);
}
```

```ts
  // "network-only": not answered here, so the browser fetches as if there were no worker.
});

// A push from the api's worker (spec 9.4): show it, and tell the app's open pages, so their bell asks again at once.
self.addEventListener("push", (event) => {
  const shown = notificationFor(event.data?.text() ?? null);
  event.waitUntil(
    Promise.all([
      self.registration.showNotification(shown.title, shown.options),
      self.clients.matchAll({ type: "window", includeUncontrolled: true }).then((windows) => {
        for (const client of windows) client.postMessage(PUSH_ARRIVED);
      }),
    ]),
  );
});

// A tap opens the push's page in the app, never another site, or brings forward a window already on it.
self.addEventListener("notificationclick", (event) => {
  event.notification.close();
  event.waitUntil(openFromNotification(self.clients, tapTarget(event.notification.data, self.location.origin)));
});
```

### Task A1: Read the audit log: who changed what, when, from where, and its before and after

Owners, Admins and any role given `audit:view` can now read the organization's audit log at `/settings/audit`, from a
navigation item of its own (the settings screen leads there too, but it needs `settings:manage`). `audit.list` reads
`listAuditEntries` newest first, a page at a time or one record's history, and names each change's actor on the
server through identity's `memberContacts`, never the sign-in tables: a member by name, support as the member it
signed in as ("Support, as Asha Sharma"), the platform team and the system by what they are ("Platform team",
"Automatic"), and anyone who is not an active member of this organization as a former member; the user ids stay on the
server. Each entry reads as a sentence (a message per action, and the action's own words for one recorded before its
sentence was written), with who, when in the organization's zone, where from, a link to that record's whole history,
and its before and after on request, field by field under the recorded names, each value as stored. A test reads
every `recordAudit` call in the sources and fails on an action without its sentence, as G2's reasons test does.

```ts
// audit.list over HTTP (spec 9.5): the audit log viewer's one call. Newest first, a page at a time or one record's
// history, with each change's actor named by the api from the organization's own members: support as the member it
// signed in as, the platform team and the system by what they are, and nobody the organization can't see by name.
import type { AuditLogPage } from "@travel-crm/contracts/audit";
import { recordAudit, type AuditChange } from "@travel-crm/domain/audit";
import { platformActor, systemActor, type Actor } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { addStaff, createPlatformAdmin, signedInOwner, signedInStaff } from "./support/people.js";
import { createTestAgency, createTestServer, type TestAgency, type TestServer } from "./support/test-server.js";
import { dataOf, mutate, query, refusalOf } from "./support/trpc.js";

describe("audit.list", () => {
  let server: TestServer;

  beforeAll(() => {
    server = createTestServer();
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await server.close();
  });

  /** Records a change as the actor, the way a module does, in the actor's organization. */
  async function record(actor: Actor, change: AuditChange): Promise<void> {
    await server.db.forOrg(actor.organizationId, (tx) => recordAudit(tx, actor, change));
  }

  /** A member acting in the app. */
  const inApp = (agency: TestAgency, userId: string): Actor => ({
    organizationId: agency.organizationId,
    userId,
    source: "web",
    impersonatedBy: null,
  });

  /** One record's history, newest first, as the Owner reads it. */
  async function historyOf(agency: TestAgency, entityType: string, entityId: string) {
    const jar = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    return dataOf<AuditLogPage>(await query(server, "audit.list", jar, { entityType, entityId }));
  }

  it("shows an Owner's change in the app with their name and the change's before and after, newest first", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const jar = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    await dataOf(await mutate(server, "roles.update", { key: "sales", name: "Sales team" }, jar));
    await dataOf(await mutate(server, "roles.update", { key: "sales", name: "Field sales" }, jar));

    const { entries } = await dataOf<AuditLogPage>(await query(server, "audit.list", jar, {}));
    expect(entries.filter((entry) => entry.action === "role.updated")).toEqual([
      expect.objectContaining({
        before: expect.objectContaining({ name: "Sales team" }) as unknown,
        after: expect.objectContaining({ name: "Field sales" }) as unknown,
      }),
      expect.objectContaining({
        source: "web",
        entityType: "role",
        actor: { kind: "member", name: "Asha Owner" },
        before: expect.objectContaining({ name: "Sales" }) as unknown,
        after: expect.objectContaining({ name: "Sales team" }) as unknown,
      }),
    ]);
    // Who acted is a name, never a user id: the viewer has no use for one, and a platform admin's is the platform's.
    expect(entries[0]).not.toHaveProperty("actorUserId");
    expect(entries[0]).not.toHaveProperty("impersonatedBy");
    const times = entries.map((entry) => entry.occurredAt);
    expect(times).toEqual([...times].sort().reverse());
  });

  it("names support as the member it signed in as, and the platform team and the system by what they are", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const admin = await createPlatformAdmin(server);
    const owner = agency.owner;
    const roleId = crypto.randomUUID();
    const change = (action: string): AuditChange => ({ action, entityType: "role", entityId: roleId });
    await record(
      {
        organizationId: agency.organizationId,
        userId: owner.userId,
        source: "impersonation",
        impersonatedBy: admin.userId,
      },
      change("role.updated"),
    );
    // Starting and stopping, the admin acts in their own name: both the actor and the impersonator.
    await record(
      {
        organizationId: agency.organizationId,
        userId: admin.userId,
        source: "impersonation",
        impersonatedBy: admin.userId,
      },
      change("support.impersonation-started"),
    );
    await record(platformActor(agency.organizationId, admin.userId), change("subscription.plan-changed"));
    await record(systemActor(agency.organizationId), change("subscription.status-changed"));

    expect((await historyOf(agency, "role", roleId)).entries.map(({ action, actor }) => ({ action, actor }))).toEqual([
      { action: "subscription.status-changed", actor: { kind: "system" } },
      { action: "subscription.plan-changed", actor: { kind: "platform" } },
      { action: "support.impersonation-started", actor: { kind: "support" } },
      { action: "role.updated", actor: { kind: "support-as-member", name: "Asha Owner" } },
    ]);
  });

  it("names nobody who has left the organization, or who was never one of its members", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const other = await createTestAgency(server);
    const leaver = await addStaff(server, agency, { username: "leaver", roleKey: "org-admin" });
    const roleId = crypto.randomUUID();
    await record(inApp(agency, leaver.userId), { action: "role.updated", entityType: "role", entityId: roleId });
    await record(
      { ...inApp(agency, leaver.userId), source: "impersonation", impersonatedBy: crypto.randomUUID() },
      { action: "role.updated", entityType: "role", entityId: roleId },
    );
    // Recorded by a module that named someone of another organization: their name stays theirs.
    await record(inApp(agency, other.owner.userId), { action: "role.created", entityType: "role", entityId: roleId });
    expect((await historyOf(agency, "role", roleId)).entries.map((entry) => entry.actor)).toEqual([
      { kind: "member", name: null },
      { kind: "support-as-member", name: "leaver" },
      { kind: "member", name: "leaver" },
    ]);

    await dataOf(
      await mutate(server, "staff.remove", { memberId: leaver.memberId }, await signedInOwner(server, agency)),
    );
    expect((await historyOf(agency, "role", roleId)).entries.map((entry) => entry.actor)).toEqual([
      { kind: "member", name: null },
      { kind: "support-as-member", name: null },
      { kind: "member", name: null },
    ]);
  });

  it("gives a page at a time, the next one after the last entry of the page before", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const jar = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    const memberId = crypto.randomUUID();
    for (const action of ["staff.created", "staff.role-changed", "staff.removed"]) {
      await record(inApp(agency, agency.owner.userId), { action, entityType: "member", entityId: memberId });
    }
    const filter = { entityType: "member", entityId: memberId, limit: 2 };

    const first = await dataOf<AuditLogPage>(await query(server, "audit.list", jar, filter));
    expect(first.entries.map((entry) => entry.action)).toEqual(["staff.removed", "staff.role-changed"]);
    expect(first.nextCursor).toBe(first.entries[1]?.id);
    const second = await dataOf<AuditLogPage>(
      await query(server, "audit.list", jar, { ...filter, before: first.nextCursor }),
    );
    expect(second).toEqual({ entries: [expect.objectContaining({ action: "staff.created" })], nextCursor: null });
  });

  it("shows one record's history only, and wants both halves of the record", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const other = await createTestAgency(server);
    const jar = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    const [kept, ignored] = [crypto.randomUUID(), crypto.randomUUID()];
    await record(inApp(agency, agency.owner.userId), { action: "role.created", entityType: "role", entityId: kept });
    await record(inApp(agency, agency.owner.userId), { action: "role.created", entityType: "role", entityId: ignored });
    await record(inApp(other, other.owner.userId), { action: "role.deleted", entityType: "role", entityId: kept });

    // Another organization's entry about the same id stays in that organization (row-level security).
    expect((await historyOf(agency, "role", kept)).entries).toEqual([
      expect.objectContaining({ action: "role.created", entityId: kept }),
    ]);
    expect(await refusalOf(await query(server, "audit.list", jar, { entityType: "role" }))).toEqual({
      status: 400,
      reason: null,
    });
  });

  it("is for roles that may see the audit log: an Admin can, a salesperson can't", async () => {
    const agency = await createTestAgency(server);
    const admin = await addStaff(server, agency, { username: "admin", roleKey: "org-admin" });
    const sales = await addStaff(server, agency, { username: "sales", roleKey: "sales" });
    const adminAnswer = await query(server, "audit.list", await signedInStaff(server, agency, admin), {});
    expect((await dataOf<AuditLogPage>(adminAnswer)).entries.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    expect(await refusalOf(await query(server, "audit.list", await signedInStaff(server, agency, sales), {}))).toEqual({
      status: 403,
      reason: "MISSING_PERMISSION",
    });
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/audit/audit-actions.test.ts`:**

```ts
// @vitest-environment node
// Every action an organization's audit log can hold has its sentence on the audit log screen, and every sentence
// belongs to an action something still records. The actions are read from the sources: the `action` of every
// `recordAudit(...)` call in packages/domain, packages/api and apps/api, written literally, or, where the call passes
// a parameter (`{ action, ... }`), the literals the parameter's type allows (`action: "a" | "b"`).
import { readdirSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";
import path from "node:path";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { isKnownAction } from "@/audit/audit-words";
import audit from "@/i18n/messages/en-IN/audit.json";

const repository = path.resolve(import.meta.dirname, "../../../..");
const SOURCES = ["packages/domain/src", "packages/api/src", "apps/api/src"];

const LITERAL_ACTION = /\baction:\s*"([a-z][a-z0-9.-]*)"/;
const ACTION_TYPE = /\baction:\s*("[a-z][a-z0-9.-]*"(?:\s*\|\s*"[a-z][a-z0-9.-]*")+)/g;

function sourceFiles(): string[] {
  return SOURCES.flatMap((folder) =>
    readdirSync(path.join(repository, folder), { recursive: true, encoding: "utf8" })
      .filter((file) => /\.tsx?$/.test(file))
      .map((file) => readFileSync(path.join(repository, folder, file), "utf8")),
  );
}

/** The text of the call whose opening parenthesis is at `open`, up to its closing one. */
function callAt(text: string, open: number): string {
  let depth = 0;
  let quote: string | null = null;
  for (let index = open; index < text.length; index += 1) {
    const character = text.charAt(index);
    if (quote !== null) {
      if (character === "\\") index += 1;
      else if (character === quote) quote = null;
      continue;
    }
    if (character === '"' || character === "'" || character === "`") quote = character;
    else if ("([{".includes(character)) depth += 1;
    else if (")]}".includes(character)) depth -= 1;
    if (depth === 0) return text.slice(open, index + 1);
  }
  return text.slice(open);
}

function recordedActions(): Set<string> {
  const actions = new Set<string>();
  for (const text of sourceFiles()) {
    // Calls only: not the function's own declaration.
    for (const match of text.matchAll(/(?<![\w.]|function )recordAudit\s*\(/g)) {
      const call = callAt(text, match.index + match[0].length - 1);
      const literal = LITERAL_ACTION.exec(call)?.[1];
      const typed = literal
        ? []
        : [...text.matchAll(ACTION_TYPE)].flatMap(([, union]) => [...(union ?? "").matchAll(/"([^"]+)"/g)]);
      const found = literal ? [literal] : typed.map(([, action]) => action ?? "");
      expect(found.length, `a recordAudit call with an unreadable action: ${call.slice(0, 120)}`).toBeGreaterThan(0);
      for (const action of found) actions.add(action);
    }
  }
  return actions;
}

/** Every sentence in audit.json, as the action it is for ("staff.removed"). */
function sentences(): string[] {
  return Object.entries(audit.actions).flatMap(([entity, happened]) =>
    Object.keys(happened).map((what) => `${entity}.${what}`),
  );
}

describe("audit.json's actions", () => {
  const recorded = recordedActions();

  it("give every action an organization's log can hold a sentence", () => {
    expect([...recorded].filter((action) => !isKnownAction(action)).sort()).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("hold no sentence for an action nothing records", () => {
    expect(sentences().filter((action) => !recorded.has(action))).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("find the actions wherever they are written: literally, or through a parameter's type", () => {
    for (const action of ["staff.removed", "role.updated", "subscription.payment-recorded", "document.issued"]) {
      expect(recorded, action).toContain(action);
    }
    expect(recorded).toContain("support.impersonation-started");
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/audit/audit-navigation.test.ts`:**

```ts
// @vitest-environment node
// The audit log has a navigation item of its own, for every role that may read it (audit:view): the settings screen
// that also leads there needs settings:manage. Under /settings, it is the current item on its own page, not Settings.
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { routes } from "@/lib/routes";
import { isCurrent, navigationItems, visibleNavigationItems } from "@/shell/navigation";
import { member } from "../support/members";

const keys = (items: { key: string }[]) => items.map((item) => item.key);

function item(key: string) {
  const found = navigationItems.find((entry) => entry.key === key);
  if (!found) throw new Error(`no navigation item ${key}`);
  return found;
}

describe("the audit log's navigation item", () => {
  it("leads to the audit log, named as its screen is", () => {
    expect(item("audit")).toMatchObject({ href: routes.audit, requires: "audit:view", module: null });
    expect(messages.shell.navigation.audit).toBe(messages.audit.title);
  });

  it("shows to every role that may read the audit log, after the other destinations", () => {
    expect(keys(visibleNavigationItems(member({ permissions: ["audit:view"] })))).toEqual(["home", "audit"]);
    expect(keys(visibleNavigationItems(member({ isOwner: true }))).at(-1)).toBe("audit");
    expect(keys(visibleNavigationItems(member({ permissions: ["settings:manage"] })))).toEqual(["home", "settings"]);
  });

  it("is the current item on its page, and Settings stays current on the other settings pages", () => {
    expect(isCurrent(item("audit"), "/settings/audit")).toBe(true);
    expect(isCurrent(item("settings"), "/settings/audit")).toBe(false);
    expect(isCurrent(item("settings"), "/settings")).toBe(true);
    expect(isCurrent(item("settings"), "/settings/profile")).toBe(true);
    expect(isCurrent(item("audit"), "/settings")).toBe(false);
  });
});
```

```tsx
// /settings/audit is titled with its heading's message, and shows the audit log only to roles that may read it
// (audit:view); others read why it isn't there, and the api is never asked.
import { screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { createTranslator } from "next-intl";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import AuditPage, { generateMetadata } from "@/app/(app)/settings/audit/page";
import { locale, messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { stubApi } from "../support/api-stub";
import { member } from "../support/members";
import { newQueryClient, renderWithApi } from "../organization/api";

vi.mock("next-intl/server", () => ({
  getTranslations: (namespace: "audit") => Promise.resolve(createTranslator({ locale, messages, namespace })),
}));
vi.mock("next/navigation", () => ({ useSearchParams: () => new URLSearchParams() }));

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("/settings/audit", () => {
  it("is titled with its heading's message", async () => {
    expect(await generateMetadata()).toEqual({ title: messages.audit.title });
  });

  it("shows the audit log to a role that may read it", async () => {
    stubApi({ "audit.list": { data: { entries: [], nextCursor: null } } });
    renderWithApi(<AuditPage />, newQueryClient(), member({ permissions: ["audit:view"] }));
    expect(screen.getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: messages.audit.title })).toBeVisible();
    expect(await screen.findByText(messages.audit.empty)).toBeVisible();

  it("tells other roles it isn't for them, without asking the api", () => {

    renderWithApi(<AuditPage />, newQueryClient(), member({ permissions: ["settings:manage"] }));

    expect(screen.queryByRole("heading", { level: 1 })).toBeNull();
    expect(api.calls).toEqual([]);
  });
});
```

```tsx
// The audit log screen (spec 9.5): every change newest first, a page at a time, each with what happened as a
// sentence, who did it (named by the api), when in the organization's zone, where from, and its before and after as
// stored; one record's history when the address names one; and honest loading, empty and error states.
import type { AuditLogEntry } from "@travel-crm/contracts/audit";
import { screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { AuditScreen } from "@/audit/audit-screen";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { formatDay, formatTime } from "@/lib/format";
import { stubApi } from "../support/api-stub";
import { newQueryClient, renderWithApi } from "../organization/api";

const navigation = vi.hoisted(() => ({ search: "" }));

vi.mock("next/navigation", () => ({ useSearchParams: () => new URLSearchParams(navigation.search) }));

const { audit, common } = messages;
const roleId = "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000b1";

function entry(overrides: Partial<AuditLogEntry> = {}): AuditLogEntry {
  return {
    id: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000a1",
    occurredAt: "2026-10-14T11:00:00.000Z",
    source: "web",
    action: "role.updated",
    entityType: "role",
    entityId: roleId,
    before: { name: "Sales", permissions: [{ permission: "leads:view", scope: "own" }] },
    after: {
      name: "Sales",
      permissions: [
        { permission: "leads:view", scope: "own" },
        { permission: "audit:view", scope: null },
      ],
    },
    actor: { kind: "member", name: "Asha Sharma" },
    ...overrides,
  };
}

const page = (entries: AuditLogEntry[], nextCursor: string | null = null) => ({ data: { entries, nextCursor } });

function renderScreen() {
  return renderWithApi(<AuditScreen />, newQueryClient());
}

/** The entries as listed, each one's text. */
async function listed(): Promise<string[]> {
  const list = await screen.findByRole("list", { name: audit.entries });
  return within(list)
    .getAllByRole("listitem")
    .map((item) => item.textContent);
}

/** The inputs the screen's calls sent, read from the stubbed fetch's URLs. */
function inputsSent(): unknown[] {
  return vi.mocked(globalThis.fetch).mock.calls.map(([input]) => {
    const url = new URL(input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input), "http://localhost");
    return (JSON.parse(url.searchParams.get("input") ?? "{}") as Record<string, unknown>)["0"];
  });
}

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  navigation.search = "";
});

describe("AuditScreen", () => {
  it("lists each change newest first, as the api gives them: what, who, when in the organization's zone, and where from", async () => {
    stubApi({
      "audit.list": page([
        entry(),
        entry({
          id: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000a2",
          occurredAt: "2025-03-01T04:00:00.000Z",
          action: "staff.removed",
          source: "impersonation",
          actor: { kind: "support-as-member", name: "Asha Sharma" },
        }),
      ]),
    });
```

```ts
// @vitest-environment node
// The audit log's words for what happened, and the one record whose history the address asks for: an action with its
// sentence is told apart from one recorded before its sentence was written, which still reads as words, and an
// address the api would refuse names no record.
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { isKnownAction, readableAction } from "@/audit/audit-words";
import { recordFilterOf, recordHistoryHref } from "@/audit/record-filter";

const roleId = "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000b1";

describe("isKnownAction", () => {
  it("knows an action by both halves of its name", () => {
    expect(isKnownAction("staff.removed")).toBe(true);
    expect(isKnownAction("organization-profile.saved")).toBe(true);
    expect(isKnownAction("staff.promoted")).toBe(false);
    expect(isKnownAction("staff")).toBe(false);
    expect(isKnownAction("staff.removed.twice")).toBe(false);
    // Not a prototype's property either.
    expect(isKnownAction("staff.constructor")).toBe(false);
  });
});

describe("readableAction", () => {
  it("reads an action without a sentence as its own words", () => {
    expect(readableAction("share-link.revoked")).toBe("Share link revoked");
    expect(readableAction("organization-logo.uploaded")).toBe("Organization logo uploaded");
    expect(readableAction("subscription.trial-end.moved")).toBe("Subscription trial end moved");
  });
});

describe("recordFilterOf", () => {
  it("reads one record from the address, by its kind and id", () => {
    expect(recordFilterOf(new URLSearchParams({ entityType: "role", entityId: roleId }))).toEqual({
      entityType: "role",
      entityId: roleId,
    });
  });

  it("names no record when the address leaves half out or breaks the api's rules", () => {
    for (const search of [
      "",
      `entityType=role`,
      `entityId=${roleId}`,
      `entityType=Role&entityId=${roleId}`,
      "entityType=role&entityId=not-an-id",
    ]) {
      expect(recordFilterOf(new URLSearchParams(search)), search).toBeNull();
    }
  });

  it("is what one record's history link leads to", () => {
    const record = { entityType: "issued_document", entityId: roleId };
    const href = recordHistoryHref(record);
    expect(href).toBe(`/settings/audit?entityType=issued_document&entityId=${roleId}`);
    expect(recordFilterOf(new URL(href, "https://app.invalid").searchParams)).toEqual(record);
  });
});
```

```ts
import { expectAccessible } from "./support/accessibility";

import { animationsSettled } from "./support/settled";

const navigation = (page: Page) => page.getByRole("navigation", { name: "Main" }).filter({ visible: true });

const changes = (page: Page, sentence: string) =>
  page.getByRole("list", { name: "Changes" }).getByRole("listitem").filter({ hasText: sentence });
```

**Create `packages/contracts/src/audit/audit-log.ts`:**

```ts
// The audit log as its viewer shows it (audit.list): each entry with who acted, named by the api. The ids of the
// person and of an impersonating platform admin stay on the server: the viewer shows a name, or what the actor was.
import { z } from "zod";
import { recordId } from "../identity/index.js";
import { auditEntry } from "./audit.js";

/** A member's name, or null when they are no longer one of the organization's active members. */
const memberName = z.string().nullable();

/** Who made a change. */
export const auditActor = z.discriminatedUnion("kind", [
  /** A member, in the app. */
  z.object({ kind: z.literal("member"), name: memberName }),
  /** Support signed in as a member: the member's name. */
  z.object({ kind: z.literal("support-as-member"), name: memberName }),
  /** Support starting or stopping an impersonation, in its own name. */
  z.object({ kind: z.literal("support") }),
  /** A platform admin in the console: onboarding, corrections, the subscription. */
  z.object({ kind: z.literal("platform") }),
  /** The system: a job no person started. */
  z.object({ kind: z.literal("system") }),
]);
export type AuditActor = z.infer<typeof auditActor>;

export const auditLogEntry = auditEntry.omit({ actorUserId: true, impersonatedBy: true }).extend({ actor: auditActor });
export type AuditLogEntry = z.infer<typeof auditLogEntry>;

/** One page of the log, newest first. */
export const auditLogPage = z.object({
  entries: z.array(auditLogEntry),
  /** Pass as `before` for the next page; null on the last page. */
  nextCursor: recordId.nullable(),
});
export type AuditLogPage = z.infer<typeof auditLogPage>;
```
