**`packages/api/src/routers/audit.ts`**, the whole file:

```ts
// audit.*: the organization's audit log (spec 9.5), for the audit log viewer: who did what, when, and as whom. Names
// come from the identity module (memberContacts), never from the sign-in tables, and only for the organization's own
// active members: anyone else is shown by what they were, never by a name the organization can't see.
import { auditLogPage, listAuditEntriesInput, type AuditActor, type AuditEntry } from "@travel-crm/contracts/audit";
import { listAuditEntries } from "@travel-crm/domain/audit";
import { orgProcedure } from "../procedures.js";
import { router } from "../trpc.js";

/** The member an entry names as acting, if any: support starting or stopping an impersonation acts as no member. */
function memberActing(entry: AuditEntry): string | null {
  if (entry.actorUserId === null || entry.source === "platform") return null;
  return entry.actorUserId === entry.impersonatedBy ? null : entry.actorUserId;
}

/** Who acted, as the viewer shows them: `names` holds the organization's active members among those acting. */
function actorOf(entry: AuditEntry, names: ReadonlyMap<string, string>): AuditActor {
  if (entry.actorUserId === null) return { kind: "system" };
  if (entry.source === "platform") return { kind: "platform" };
  const member = memberActing(entry);
  if (member === null) return { kind: "support" };
  const name = names.get(member) ?? null;
  return entry.source === "impersonation" ? { kind: "support-as-member", name } : { kind: "member", name };
}

export const auditRouter = router({
  /** The log newest first, a page at a time, or one record's history, with each change's actor named. */
  list: orgProcedure
    .requires("audit:view")
    .input(listAuditEntriesInput)
    .output(auditLogPage)
    .query(async ({ ctx, input }) => {
      const { organizationId } = ctx.member;
      const page = await ctx.db.forOrg(organizationId, (tx) => listAuditEntries(tx, input));
      const acting = new Set(page.entries.map(memberActing).filter((userId) => userId !== null));
      const members = await ctx.identity.memberContacts(organizationId, [...acting]);
      const names = new Map(members.map((member) => [member.userId, member.name]));
      // The output schema leaves out actorUserId and impersonatedBy: the viewer shows the actor, not their ids.
      return {
        entries: page.entries.map((entry) => ({ ...entry, actor: actorOf(entry, names) })),
        nextCursor: page.nextCursor,
      };
    }),
});
```

```tsx
// /settings/audit: the organization's audit log, for members whose role may read it. It has its own navigation item,
// because /settings itself needs settings:manage.
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
import { Suspense } from "react";
import { AuditScreen } from "@/audit/audit-screen";
import { RequirePermission } from "@/session/require-permission";

export async function generateMetadata(): Promise<Metadata> {
  const t = await getTranslations("audit");
  return { title: t("title") };
}

export default function AuditPage() {
  return (
    <RequirePermission permission="audit:view">
      {/* The screen reads the record whose history to show from the address, which only the browser knows. */}
      <Suspense>
        <AuditScreen />
      </Suspense>
    </RequirePermission>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/audit/audit-change.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// A change's before and after (spec 9.5), field by field under the names they were recorded with, each side's value as
// stored. A side with no state (the record didn't exist yet, or no longer does) shows None for every field.
import type { AuditLogEntry } from "@travel-crm/contracts/audit";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { StoredValue } from "./stored-value";

type Snapshot = AuditLogEntry["before"];

/** The fields either side recorded, in the order they were recorded: the before's first. */
function fieldsOf(before: Snapshot, after: Snapshot): string[] {
  return [...new Set([...Object.keys(before ?? {}), ...Object.keys(after ?? {})])];
}

function Side({ label, value }: { label: string; value: unknown }) {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
      <span className="text-caption text-muted-foreground">{label}</span>
      <StoredValue value={value} />
    </div>
  );
}

export function AuditChange({ id, before, after }: { id: string; before: Snapshot; after: Snapshot }) {
  const t = useTranslations("audit.change");
  return (
    <dl id={id} className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-lg bg-surface p-3">
      {fieldsOf(before, after).map((field) => (
        <div key={field} className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <dt className="text-label font-medium break-words">{field}</dt>
          <dd className="grid gap-2 sm:grid-cols-2">
            <Side label={t("before")} value={before?.[field]} />
            <Side label={t("after")} value={after?.[field]} />
          </dd>
        </div>
      ))}
    </dl>
  );
}

/** Whether there is anything to show: an entry may record no state at all (a password reset, an invite). */
export function hasChange(before: Snapshot, after: Snapshot): boolean {
  return fieldsOf(before, after).length > 0;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The audit log's entries (DESIGN.md section 6): a divided list at every width, since each entry opens its before and
// after below it. Each says what happened, who did it, when in the organization's zone and from where, and leads to
// the record's whole history.
import type { AuditLogEntry } from "@travel-crm/contracts/audit";
import { ChevronDownIcon } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { formatDay, formatTime } from "@/lib/format";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useMe } from "@/session/me-context";
import { AuditChange, hasChange } from "./audit-change";
import { useAuditWords } from "./audit-words";
import { recordHistoryHref } from "./record-filter";

/** A text-sized action with a 44px target, aligned with the entry's words. */
const entryAction = "flex min-h-11 w-fit items-center gap-1.5 font-medium text-primary hover:underline";

function AuditEntry({ entry, recordLink }: { entry: AuditLogEntry; recordLink: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations("audit");
  const words = useAuditWords();
  const { timeZone } = useMe().organization;
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const changeId = useId();
  const instant = new Date(entry.occurredAt);
  const changed = hasChange(entry.before, entry.after);
  return (
    <li className="flex flex-col gap-1 px-4 py-3">
      <p className="font-medium">{words.action(entry.action)}</p>
      <p className="text-label text-muted-foreground">
        <span className="break-words script-leading">{words.actor(entry.actor)}</span> ·{" "}
        <time dateTime={entry.occurredAt} className="numbers">
          {t("when", { day: formatDay(instant, { timeZone }), time: formatTime(instant, { timeZone }) })}
        </time>{" "}
        · {words.source(entry.source)}
      </p>
      {(changed || recordLink) && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-6">
          {changed && (
            <button
              type="button"
              aria-expanded={open}
              aria-controls={open ? changeId : undefined}
              onClick={() => {
                setOpen(!open);
              }}
              className={entryAction}
            >
              {t("change.show")}
              <ChevronDownIcon
                aria-hidden="true"
                className={cn("size-4 motion-safe:transition-transform motion-safe:ease-out", open && "rotate-180")}
              />
            </button>
          )}
          {recordLink && (
            <Link href={recordHistoryHref(entry)} className={entryAction}>
              {t("recordHistory", { kind: entry.entityType })}
            </Link>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
      {changed && open && <AuditChange id={changeId} before={entry.before} after={entry.after} />}
    </li>
  );
}

/** The entries, newest first. `recordLinks` leads each to its record's history; a record's own history needs none. */
export function AuditEntries({ entries, recordLinks }: { entries: AuditLogEntry[]; recordLinks: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations("audit");
  return (
    <ul aria-label={t("entries")} className="divide-y rounded-lg border">
      {entries.map((entry) => (
        <AuditEntry key={entry.id} entry={entry} recordLink={recordLinks} />
      ))}
    </ul>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The audit log screen (spec 9.5): every change made in the organization, newest first, a page at a time, or one
// record's history when the address names one. Loading shows rows of skeleton; nothing recorded says so; a failure
// says what failed, with a Retry.
import { HistoryIcon } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useSearchParams } from "next/navigation";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/empty-state";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { PageTitle } from "@/components/page-title";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner";
import { routes } from "@/lib/routes";
import { AuditEntries } from "./audit-entries";
import { recordFilterOf } from "./record-filter";
import { useAuditLog } from "./use-audit-log";

export function AuditScreen() {
  const t = useTranslations("audit");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const record = recordFilterOf(useSearchParams());
  const log = useAuditLog(record);
  const { entries } = log;

  let content;
  if (entries === undefined) {
    content = log.isError ? (
      <ErrorState message={t("loadFailed")} retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")} onRetry={() => void log.refetch()} />
    ) : (
      <Delayed>
        <div role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={tCommon("loading")} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((row) => (
            <Skeleton key={row} className="h-20 w-full" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </Delayed>
    );
  } else if (entries.length === 0) {
    content = <EmptyState icon={HistoryIcon} message={record ? t("emptyRecord") : t("empty")} />;
  } else {
    content = (
      <>
        <AuditEntries entries={entries} recordLinks={record === null} />
        {log.isFetchNextPageError && (
          <p role="alert" className="text-center">
            {t("moreFailed")}
          </p>
        )}
        {log.hasNextPage && (
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            className="self-center"
            disabled={log.isFetchingNextPage}
            onClick={() => void log.fetchNextPage()}
          >
            {log.isFetchingNextPage && <Spinner />}
            {log.isFetchingNextPage ? t("loadingMore") : t("showMore")}
          </Button>
        )}
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="flex max-w-[65ch] flex-col gap-2">
        <PageTitle>{t("title")}</PageTitle>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("intro")}</p>
      </div>
      {record && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-6">
          <p className="font-medium">{t("oneRecord", { kind: record.entityType })}</p>
          <Link href={routes.audit} className="flex min-h-11 w-fit items-center text-primary hover:underline">
            {t("showEverything")}
          </Link>
        </div>
      )}
      {content}
    </div>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/audit/audit-words.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// The audit log's words: each action's sentence (audit.json's actions), a readable one made from the action itself for
// an action recorded before its sentence was written, who acted, and where from.
import type { AuditActor, AuditSource } from "@travel-crm/contracts/audit";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useCallback } from "react";
import audit from "@/i18n/messages/en-IN/audit.json";

type Actions = typeof audit.actions;

/** "staff.removed", and every other action with a sentence. */
type KnownAction = { [Entity in keyof Actions]: `${Entity}.${keyof Actions[Entity] & string}` }[keyof Actions];

const isEntity = (value: string): value is keyof Actions => Object.hasOwn(audit.actions, value);

/** Whether the action ("<entity>.<what happened>") has its sentence. */
export function isKnownAction(action: string): action is KnownAction {
  const [entity = "", happened, ...rest] = action.split(".");
  return (
    isEntity(entity) && happened !== undefined && rest.length === 0 && Object.hasOwn(audit.actions[entity], happened)
  );
}

/** "share-link.revoked" reads "Share link revoked": an action recorded before its sentence was written. */
export function readableAction(action: string): string {
  const words = action
    .split(/[.-]+/)
    .filter((word) => word !== "")
    .join(" ");
  return words.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + words.slice(1);
}

export function useAuditWords() {
  const t = useTranslations("audit");

  const action = useCallback((key: string) => (isKnownAction(key) ? t(`actions.${key}`) : readableAction(key)), [t]);

  const actor = useCallback(
    (who: AuditActor): string => {
      switch (who.kind) {
        case "member":
          return who.name ?? t("actors.formerMember");
        case "support-as-member":
          return who.name === null ? t("actors.supportAsFormerMember") : t("actors.supportAs", { name: who.name });
        case "support":
          return t("actors.support");
        case "platform":
          return t("actors.platform");
        case "system":
          return t("actors.system");
      }
    },
    [t],
  );

  const source = useCallback((from: AuditSource) => t(`sources.${from}`), [t]);

  return { action, actor, source };
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/audit/record-filter.ts`:**

```ts
// One record's history, the audit log's one filter, kept in the address (?entityType=role&entityId=…) so a link can
// open it. Read with the api's own rules: an address the api would refuse shows the whole log instead.
import { auditEntityType } from "@travel-crm/contracts/audit";
import { recordId } from "@travel-crm/contracts/identity";
import { routes } from "@/lib/routes";

/** The record whose history to show: its kind ("role") and id. */
export interface RecordFilter {
  entityType: string;
  entityId: string;
}

/** The record the address names, or null for the whole log. */
export function recordFilterOf(search: Pick<URLSearchParams, "get">): RecordFilter | null {
  const entityType = auditEntityType.safeParse(search.get("entityType"));
  const entityId = recordId.safeParse(search.get("entityId"));
  return entityType.success && entityId.success ? { entityType: entityType.data, entityId: entityId.data } : null;
}

/** The address of one record's history. */
export function recordHistoryHref({ entityType, entityId }: RecordFilter): string {
  return `${routes.audit}?${new URLSearchParams({ entityType, entityId }).toString()}`;
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/audit/stored-value.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// One value of a change's before or after, shown as it was recorded: text and numbers as they are, true and false as
// Yes and No, a list one item a line, an object field by field. Nothing is looked up, decoded or fetched.
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";

export function StoredValue({ value }: { value: unknown }) {
  const t = useTranslations("audit.change");
  const none = <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t("none")}</span>;
  if (value === null || value === undefined || value === "") return none;
  if (typeof value === "boolean") return <span>{value ? t("yes") : t("no")}</span>;
  if (typeof value === "number") return <span className="numbers">{String(value)}</span>;
  if (typeof value === "string") return <span className="break-words script-leading">{value}</span>;
  if (Array.isArray(value)) {
    if (value.length === 0) return none;
    return (
      <ul className="flex flex-col gap-1">
        {value.map((item: unknown, index) => (
          // A recorded list has no ids, and an entry never changes, so its positions are stable keys.
          <li key={index}>
            <StoredValue value={item} />
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    );
  }
  if (typeof value !== "object") return none;
  return (
    <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-3">
      {Object.entries(value).map(([field, inner]: [string, unknown]) => (
        <span key={field} className="break-words">
          <span className="text-muted-foreground">{field}</span> <StoredValue value={inner} />
        </span>
      ))}
    </span>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/audit/use-audit-log.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// The audit log a page at a time (audit.list), newest first, or one record's history: each page asks for the entries
// before the last one of the page before. Called through the client, as the console's dashboard is: tRPC's infinite
// queries add a `direction` to the input, which the api's strict input refuses.
import { useInfiniteQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTRPC, useTRPCClient } from "@/data/trpc";
import type { RecordFilter } from "./record-filter";

export const AUDIT_ENTRIES_PER_PAGE = 25;

export function useAuditLog(record: RecordFilter | null) {
  const trpc = useTRPC();
  const client = useTRPCClient();
  const input = { ...record, limit: AUDIT_ENTRIES_PER_PAGE };
  const query = useInfiniteQuery({
    queryKey: [...trpc.audit.list.pathKey(), input],
    queryFn: ({ pageParam }) =>
      client.audit.list.query({ ...input, ...(pageParam === null ? {} : { before: pageParam }) }),
    initialPageParam: null as string | null,
    getNextPageParam: (page) => page.nextCursor,
  });
  return { ...query, entries: query.data?.pages.flatMap((page) => page.entries) };
}
```

```ts
export function isCurrent(item: NavigationItem, pathname: string): boolean {
```

## Track C: The console's organizations (onboarding, an organization's page, impersonation, its subscription)

Spec 7.1 (onboarding and the Owner's invite), 6.1 (support's impersonation, recorded and at most an hour), 7.2-7.4
(the subscription's plan, overrides, dates, payments, suspension and cancelling) and 12.1's impersonation journey, on
plan 4's `organizations.*`, `plans.list` and `subscriptions.*`. Support onboards an agency at
`/console/organizations/new`; the organization's page at `/console/organizations/<id>` shows its row (with
corrections), its subscription (with every change support may make, and a super admin's lift of a suspension), its
business profile and its members, from whom support resends an invite or signs in as one. The api gains one query,
`organizations.members`, read by the identity module; Better Auth's `/admin/impersonate-user` now refuses platform
staff without two-factor, as the console does. Built in its own worktree from the groundwork's last commit (Task G2).

(`packages/domain/test/identity/{impersonation-two-factor,impersonation-targets,audit-trail,auth-hardening,platform-staff-levels,platform-staff-powers}.test.ts`),
`apps/api/test/console-organization-members.test.ts`. And, needed by the members query (only identity reaches the
sign-in tables): `packages/domain/src/identity/organization-members.ts`, one export line in

**Rulings made in this track:**

- The members' read is identity's (`organizationMembers(tx, organizationId)`, inside the organization), wrapped by the
  platform's `listOrganizationMembers`; the contract adds `hasPassword`, so the page offers a new invite only to
  someone who hasn't chosen a password (the api's `PASSWORD_ALREADY_SET`).
- Better Auth's side door refuses `SET_UP_TWO_FACTOR` after `CHANGE_PASSWORD` on every `/admin/*` call, as
  `staffProcedure` does; stopping an impersonation stays open.
- The organization's page says "the invite went to the Owner" from `?onboarded=1`, which the onboarding form adds; the
  server page reads only that flag and the id.
- Impersonation starts from the members list after a confirmation; Better Auth's refusals are said in the console's
  words (a target no longer active) or by `errors.reasons` (a step still to take); Stop returns to `/console`.
- The time zone is picked from a short list, India first; a zone set otherwise is still offered as itself.
- Every form checks itself with the api's own schema before sending, and names each problem on its field; rupees are
  read by the contracts' `paiseFromRupeesText` and grouped the Indian way on leaving the box.
- The subscription shows the state due today, and the recorded one only when they differ; the price (due) in ink,
  payments (received) in forest; calendar days never shifted by a zone.
- Suspending and cancelling are confirmed by their reason dialog, red on its last button; actions the api would refuse
  in the current state are not offered.

### Task C1: Support onboards an agency from the console, and its Owner's invite goes out

Platform staff of either level now onboard an agency at `/console/organizations/new` (the console's Onboard
destination), in one form over `organizations.onboard`: the agency's own row (name, sign-in code, time zone from a
short list with India's first, contact email), its business profile (legal name, GST state, an optional GSTIN, a
contact person and phone), its Owner (name and email) and its subscription (a plan on sale from `plans.list` with its
prices, a billing cycle the plan is priced for, and the usual trial, a trial to a chosen day, or active and paid
through a day). The form checks itself with the api's own schema before anything is sent, so a GSTIN of another
state, a malformed code or a placeholder address is named on its field; a refusal (a code another agency has) shows
its sentence and keeps what was typed; with no plan on sale the screen says so and leads to Plans. Onboarded, the
console opens the organization's page, which says the Owner's invite is on its way; the dashboard is refreshed. The
organization's page starts here with the organization's name, code and status today, and says plainly when there is
no such organization; Tasks C2 and C3 fill it.

**Create `apps/web/test/console/organizations/onboard-screen.test.tsx`:**

```tsx
// Onboarding an agency (spec 7.1): the agency, its business profile, its Owner and a plan on sale, checked by the api's
// own schema before anything is sent (a GSTIN of another state among the refusals); success opens the organization's
// page, saying the invite went to the Owner; a refusal shows its sentence; with no plan on sale, the screen says where
// plans are made.
import type { PlanSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { OnboardScreen } from "@/console/organizations/onboarding/onboard-screen";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { stubApi, type Answer } from "../../support/api-stub";
import { inputsSentTo, renderConsoleScreen } from "./render";

const navigation = vi.hoisted(() => ({ push: vi.fn() }));
vi.mock("next/navigation", () => ({ useRouter: () => ({ push: navigation.push, replace: vi.fn() }) }));

const { onboard } = messages.consoleOrganizations;

function plan(overrides: Partial<PlanSummary> = {}): PlanSummary {
  return {
    id: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000c1",
    key: "growth",
    name: "Growth",
    monthlyPricePaise: 250_000,
    yearlyPricePaise: 2_500_000,
    extraSeatMonthlyPricePaise: null,
    extraSeatYearlyPricePaise: null,
    seatLimit: 10,
    whatsappNumberLimit: 1,
    storageLimitBytes: 10_000_000_000,
    modules: ["crm"],
    forSale: true,
    archived: false,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

const organizationId = "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-000000000002";

function renderOnboarding(answers: Record<string, Answer> = {}) {
  const api = stubApi({
    "platform.plans.list": {
      data: [plan(), plan({ id: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000de", name: "Demo", forSale: false })],
    },
    "platform.plans.policy": { data: { trialDays: 7, pastDueDays: 7, readOnlyDays: 14 } },
    "platform.organizations.onboard": {
      data: { organizationId, code: "KERALA", ownerMemberId: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000aa" },
    },
    ...answers,
  });
  renderConsoleScreen(<OnboardScreen />);
  return api;
}

async function choose(label: string, option: RegExp | string): Promise<void> {
  await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("combobox", { name: label }));
  await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("option", { name: option }));
}

/** Everything the form asks for, the usual trial left as it is. */
async function fillIn(): Promise<void> {
  await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(onboard.agency.name), "Kerala Trails");
  await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(onboard.agency.code), "kerala");
  await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(onboard.agency.contactEmail), "hello@keralatrails.example");
  await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(onboard.profile.legalName), "Kerala Trails LLP");
  await choose(onboard.profile.gstState, /Kerala/);
  await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(onboard.owner.name), "Lakshmi Nair");
  await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(onboard.owner.email), "lakshmi@keralatrails.example");
  await choose(onboard.subscription.plan, /Growth/);
}

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  navigation.push.mockReset();
});

describe("OnboardScreen", () => {
  it("offers the plans on sale with their prices, and their cycles once one is chosen", async () => {
    renderOnboarding();
    expect(await screen.findByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: onboard.title })).toBeVisible();
    await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("combobox", { name: onboard.subscription.plan }));
    const options = await screen.findAllByRole("option");
    expect(options.map((option) => option.textContent)).toEqual(["Growth · ₹2,500 a month · ₹25,000 a year"]);
    await userEvent.click(options[0] ?? document.body);
    const cycle = screen.getByRole("radiogroup", { name: onboard.subscription.cycle });
    expect(within(cycle).getByRole("radio", { name: "Monthly, ₹2,500 before GST" })).toBeChecked();
    expect(within(cycle).getByRole("radio", { name: "Yearly, ₹25,000 before GST" })).not.toBeChecked();
    expect(screen.getByText("7 days, today the first")).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("onboards the agency and opens its page, saying the Owner's invite is on its way", async () => {
    renderOnboarding();
    await screen.findByRole("combobox", { name: onboard.subscription.plan });
    await fillIn();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: onboard.submit }));
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(navigation.push).toHaveBeenCalledWith(`/console/organizations/${organizationId}?onboarded=1`);
    });
    expect(inputsSentTo("organizations.onboard")).toEqual([
      {
        name: "Kerala Trails",
        code: "KERALA",
        timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata",
        contactEmail: "hello@keralatrails.example",
        profile: {
          legalName: "Kerala Trails LLP",
          gstin: null,
          gstStateCode: "32",
          contactName: null,
          contactPhone: null,
        },
        owner: { name: "Lakshmi Nair", email: "lakshmi@keralatrails.example" },
        subscription: { planId: plan().id, billingCycle: "monthly", paidThrough: null },
      },
    ]);
  });

  it("starts the subscription paid through a day when asked", async () => {
    renderOnboarding();
    await screen.findByRole("combobox", { name: onboard.subscription.plan });
    await fillIn();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("radio", { name: "Yearly, ₹25,000 before GST" }));
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("radio", { name: onboard.subscription.starts.paid }));
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(onboard.subscription.paidThrough), "2027-03-31");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: onboard.submit }));
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(navigation.push).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
    expect(inputsSentTo("organizations.onboard")).toMatchObject([
      { subscription: { billingCycle: "yearly", trialEndsOn: null, paidThrough: "2027-03-31" } },
    ]);
  });

  it("refuses a GSTIN of another state before sending anything", async () => {
    const api = renderOnboarding();
    await screen.findByRole("combobox", { name: onboard.subscription.plan });
    await fillIn();
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(onboard.profile.gstin), "27AAPFU0939F1ZV");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: onboard.submit }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(onboard.problems.gstinOtherState)).toBeVisible();
    expect(api.calls).not.toContain("platform.organizations.onboard");
  });

  it("shows the api's refusal as a sentence, keeping what was typed", async () => {
    renderOnboarding({ "platform.organizations.onboard": { status: 409, reason: "ORGANIZATION_CODE_TAKEN" } });
    await screen.findByRole("combobox", { name: onboard.subscription.plan });
    await fillIn();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: onboard.submit }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(messages.errors.reasons.ORGANIZATION_CODE_TAKEN)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(onboard.agency.code)).toHaveValue("kerala");
    expect(navigation.push).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("says when no plan is on sale, and where plans are made", async () => {
    renderOnboarding({ "platform.plans.list": { data: [plan({ forSale: false })] } });
    expect(await screen.findByText(onboard.subscription.noPlans)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: onboard.subscription.plansLink })).toHaveAttribute(
      "href",
      "/console/plans",
    );
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: onboard.submit })).toBeDisabled();
  });

  it("says when the plans didn't load, and loads them on Try again", async () => {
    const api = renderOnboarding({ "platform.plans.list": { status: 403 } });
    expect(await screen.findByText(onboard.subscription.plansLoadFailed)).toBeVisible();
    api.answer("platform.plans.list", { data: [plan()] });
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: messages.common.tryAgain }));
    expect(await screen.findByRole("combobox", { name: onboard.subscription.plan })).toBeVisible();
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/console/organizations/onboard-values.test.ts`:**

```ts
// The onboarding form's values become organizations.onboard's input by the api's own schema: blank optional boxes are
// no value, the subscription starts as the person chose (the usual trial, a trial to a day, or paid through a day),
// and every problem is named on the field it belongs to, a GSTIN of another state among them, before anything is sent.
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  emptyOnboardValues,
  toOnboardInput,
  type OnboardValues,
} from "@/console/organizations/onboarding/onboard-values";

const planId = "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000c1";

function filled(overrides: Partial<OnboardValues> = {}): OnboardValues {
  return {
    ...emptyOnboardValues(),
    name: "Kerala Trails",
    code: "kerala",
    contactEmail: "Hello@KeralaTrails.example",
    legalName: "Kerala Trails LLP",
    gstStateCode: "32",
    ownerName: "Lakshmi Nair",
    ownerEmail: "lakshmi@keralatrails.example",
    planId,
    billingCycle: "monthly",
    ...overrides,
  };
}

describe("toOnboardInput", () => {
  it("starts empty, in India's time zone, on the usual trial", () => {
    expect(emptyOnboardValues()).toMatchObject({ timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata", start: "trial", gstin: "", planId: "" });
  });

  it("reads the form as the api's input, blank optional boxes as no value, the usual trial left to the policy", () => {
    expect(toOnboardInput(filled())).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      input: {
        name: "Kerala Trails",
        code: "KERALA",
        timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata",
        contactEmail: "hello@keralatrails.example",
        profile: {
          legalName: "Kerala Trails LLP",
          gstin: null,
          gstStateCode: "32",
          contactName: null,
          contactPhone: null,
        },
        owner: { name: "Lakshmi Nair", email: "lakshmi@keralatrails.example" },
        subscription: { planId, billingCycle: "monthly", paidThrough: null },
      },
    });
  });

  it("keeps a GSTIN of the state chosen, and the contact's name and phone in E.164", () => {
    const result = toOnboardInput(
      filled({ gstin: "32aapfu0939f1z4", contactName: "Lakshmi Nair", contactPhone: "98765 43210" }),
    );
    expect(result).toMatchObject({
      ok: true,
      input: { profile: { gstin: "32AAPFU0939F1Z4", contactName: "Lakshmi Nair", contactPhone: "+919876543210" } },
    });
  });

  it("starts a trial to the day chosen, or active and paid through one", () => {
    expect(toOnboardInput(filled({ start: "trial-until", trialEndsOn: "2026-11-30" }))).toMatchObject({
      ok: true,
      input: { subscription: { trialEndsOn: "2026-11-30", paidThrough: null } },
    });
    expect(
      toOnboardInput(filled({ start: "paid", paidThrough: "2027-03-31", trialEndsOn: "2026-11-30" })),
    ).toMatchObject({ ok: true, input: { subscription: { trialEndsOn: null, paidThrough: "2027-03-31" } } });
  });

  it("refuses a GSTIN of another state before anything is sent", () => {
    expect(toOnboardInput(filled({ gstin: "27AAPFU0939F1ZV" }))).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problems: { gstin: "gstinOtherState" },
    });
    expect(toOnboardInput(filled({ gstin: "32AAPFU0939F1Z5" }))).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problems: { gstin: "gstinInvalid" },
    });
  });

  it("asks for the day a trial ends or a payment runs to, when the start needs one", () => {
    expect(toOnboardInput(filled({ start: "trial-until" }))).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problems: { trialEndsOn: "dateRequired" },
    });
    expect(toOnboardInput(filled({ start: "paid" }))).toEqual({ ok: false, problems: { paidThrough: "dateRequired" } });
  });

  it("names every problem on its own field", () => {
    expect(toOnboardInput(emptyOnboardValues())).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problems: {
        name: "required",
        code: "required",
        contactEmail: "required",
        legalName: "required",
        gstStateCode: "required",
        ownerName: "required",
        ownerEmail: "required",
        planId: "required",
        billingCycle: "required",
      },
    });
    expect(
      toOnboardInput(
        filled({
          code: "K-1",
          contactEmail: "nobody",
          ownerEmail: "owner@placeholder.invalid",
          contactPhone: "12",
          contactName: "\u202Eevil",
        }),
      ),
    ).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problems: {
        code: "codeInvalid",
        contactEmail: "emailInvalid",
        ownerEmail: "emailInvalid",
        contactPhone: "phoneInvalid",
        contactName: "nameInvalid",
      },
    });
  });
});
```

```tsx
// An organization's page in the console: its name, code and status today; after onboarding, that the Owner's invite
// is on its way; an organization that doesn't exist, or a page that didn't load, said plainly.
import { screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { OrganizationScreen } from "@/console/organizations/organization/organization-screen";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { stubApi } from "../../support/api-stub";
import { organizationDetails, organizationId } from "./organization-details";
import { renderConsoleScreen } from "./render";

const { organization } = messages.consoleOrganizations;

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("OrganizationScreen", () => {
  it("shows the organization's name, code and status today", async () => {
    stubApi({ "platform.organizations.get": { data: organizationDetails() } });
    renderConsoleScreen(<OrganizationScreen organizationId={organizationId} onboarded={false} />);
    expect(await screen.findByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: "Kerala Trails" })).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByText("KERALA")).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByText(messages.console.status.active)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.queryByText(organization.onboarded)).toBeNull();
  });

  it("says, just after onboarding, that the Owner's invite is on its way", async () => {
    stubApi({ "platform.organizations.get": { data: organizationDetails() } });
    renderConsoleScreen(<OrganizationScreen organizationId={organizationId} onboarded />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(organization.onboarded)).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("says when there is no such organization, and leads back to the dashboard", async () => {
    stubApi({ "platform.organizations.get": { status: 404, reason: "ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND" } });
    renderConsoleScreen(<OrganizationScreen organizationId={organizationId} onboarded={false} />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(organization.notFound)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: organization.backToDashboard })).toHaveAttribute("href", "/console");
  });

  it("says when the organization didn't load, and loads it on Try again", async () => {
    const api = stubApi({ "platform.organizations.get": { status: 403 } });
    renderConsoleScreen(<OrganizationScreen organizationId={organizationId} onboarded={false} />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(organization.loadFailed)).toBeVisible();
    api.answer("platform.organizations.get", { data: organizationDetails() });
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: messages.common.tryAgain }));
    expect(await screen.findByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: "Kerala Trails" })).toBeVisible();
  });
});
```

```ts
// The organizations' console pages are titled by their screen, under the console's pattern ("<screen> · Console ·
// <product>"), and an organization's page takes its organization and whether it was just onboarded from the address.
import { createTranslator } from "next-intl";
import { isValidElement } from "react";
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { locale, messages } from "@/i18n/messages";

vi.mock("next-intl/server", () => ({
  getTranslations: (namespace: "consoleOrganizations") =>
    Promise.resolve(createTranslator({ locale, messages, namespace })),
}));

const { consoleOrganizations } = messages;

describe("the organizations' console pages", () => {
  it("title onboarding as its heading does", async () => {
    const { generateMetadata } = await import("@/app/console/organizations/new/page");
    expect(await generateMetadata()).toEqual({ title: consoleOrganizations.onboard.title });
  });

  it("title an organization's page, and hand it the organization and the onboarded flag", async () => {
    const page = await import("@/app/console/organizations/[organizationId]/page");
    expect(await page.generateMetadata()).toEqual({ title: consoleOrganizations.organization.title });
    const element = await page.default({
      params: Promise.resolve({ organizationId: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-000000000002" }),
      searchParams: Promise.resolve({ onboarded: "1" }),
    });
    expect(isValidElement(element) && element.props).toEqual({
      organizationId: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
      onboarded: true,
    });
```

```tsx
// Renders a console screen as platform staff see it: the app's messages, the console's own data layer (answered by
// the stubbed api, support/api-stub.ts) and who is signed in; reads back what the screen sent to a procedure; and
// gives jsdom the few browser methods Radix's selects and dialogs call.
import { render } from "@testing-library/react";
import { NextIntlClientProvider } from "next-intl";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { vi } from "vitest";
import { ConsoleProviders } from "@/console/data/console-providers";
import { StaffProvider, type ConsoleStaff } from "@/console/session/staff-context";
import { locale, messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { platformStaff } from "../../support/platform-staff";

export function renderConsoleScreen(ui: ReactNode, staff: ConsoleStaff = platformStaff()) {
  // Stubbed per render because tests unstub their globals after each test; nothing here depends on layout.
  vi.stubGlobal(
    "ResizeObserver",
    class {
      observe = () => undefined;
      unobserve = () => undefined;
      disconnect = () => undefined;
    },
  );
  Element.prototype.hasPointerCapture = () => false;
  Element.prototype.releasePointerCapture = () => undefined;
  Element.prototype.scrollIntoView = () => undefined;
  return render(
    <NextIntlClientProvider locale={locale} messages={messages} timeZone="Asia/Kolkata">
      <ConsoleProviders>
        <StaffProvider staff={staff}>{ui}</StaffProvider>
      </ConsoleProviders>
    </NextIntlClientProvider>,
  );
}

const CONSOLE_TRPC = "/api/platform/trpc/";

/**
 * The inputs sent to one console procedure ("organizations.onboard"), in call order, from the stubbed fetch: a query's
 * from its address, a mutation's from its body.
 */
export function inputsSentTo(procedure: string): unknown[] {
  const sent: unknown[] = [];
  for (const [input, init] of vi.mocked(globalThis.fetch).mock.calls) {
    const url = new URL(input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input), "http://localhost");
    if (!url.pathname.startsWith(CONSOLE_TRPC)) continue;
    const paths = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname.slice(CONSOLE_TRPC.length)).split(",");
    const body = typeof init?.body === "string" ? init.body : (url.searchParams.get("input") ?? "{}");
    const batch = JSON.parse(body) as Record<string, unknown>;
    paths.forEach((path, index) => {
      if (path === procedure) sent.push(batch[String(index)]);
    });
  }
  return sent;
}
```

```ts
// What the console's organization journeys share: a plan on sale of each journey's own (journeys run side by side on
// one database, and the console offers every plan on sale), the Owner's invite link as Mailpit received it, and
// choosing from the console's selects.
import { expect, type Page } from "@playwright/test";
import { test as consoleTest } from "./console";

export interface PlanOnSale {
  id: string;
  name: string;
}

export const test = consoleTest.extend<{ planOnSale: PlanOnSale }>({
  planOnSale: async ({ database }, use) => {
    const suffix = crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8);
    const plan = await database.platform.plan.create({
      data: {
        key: `journey-${suffix}`,
        name: `Journey ${suffix}`,
        monthlyPricePaise: 250_000,
        yearlyPricePaise: 2_500_000,
        seatLimit: 5,
        whatsappNumberLimit: 1,
        storageLimitBytes: 5_000_000_000n,
        modules: ["crm"],
      },
      select: { id: true, name: true },
    });
    await use(plan);
  },
});

export { expect };

/** A code no other journey's organization has: 3-12 capitals and digits. */
export function organizationCode(prefix: string): string {
  return `${prefix}${crypto.randomUUID().replaceAll("-", "").slice(0, 8)}`.toUpperCase();
}

async function readMailpit<T>(path: string): Promise<T> {
  const base = process.env.E2E_MAILPIT_URL;
  if (!base) throw new Error("E2E_MAILPIT_URL is not set: run the journeys with `pnpm --filter @travel-crm/web e2e`");
  const response = await fetch(`${base}/api/v1${path}`);
  if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`Mailpit ${path} answered ${String(response.status)}`);
  return (await response.json()) as T;
}

/**
 * The link in the invite the worker emailed to address, a page of the web app with the token: waits up to 30 seconds,
 * since the worker's relay picks the event up and its listener sends.
 */
export async function inviteLinkSentTo(address: string): Promise<string> {
  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 300; attempt += 1) {
    const { messages } = await readMailpit<{ messages: { ID: string; To: { Address: string }[] }[] }>("/messages");
    const sent = messages.find((message) => message.To.some((to) => to.Address === address));
    if (sent) {
      const { Text } = await readMailpit<{ Text: string }>(`/message/${sent.ID}`);
      const link = /https?:\/\/\S+\/reset-password\?token=[A-Za-z0-9_-]+/.exec(Text)?.[0];
      if (!link) throw new Error("the invite holds no link to choose a password");
      return link;
    }
    await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 100));
  }
  throw new Error(`no invite reached ${address}`);
}

/** Picks an option from one of the console's selects by its label. */
export async function choose(page: Page, label: string, option: string | RegExp): Promise<void> {
  await page.getByRole("combobox", { name: label }).click();
  await page.getByRole("option", { name: option }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("listbox")).toHaveCount(0);
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// A choice of a few options bound to a form field: radio buttons under a legend, each labelled and optionally
// explained (DESIGN.md: 20px radios with a 44px hit area, labels always visible).
import { useId } from "react";
import { Controller, type Control, type FieldPath, type FieldValues } from "react-hook-form";
import {
  Field,
  FieldContent,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldLabel,
  FieldLegend,
  FieldSet,
} from "@/components/ui/field";
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/components/ui/radio-group";

export interface ChoiceOption {
  value: string;
  label: string;
  description?: string | undefined;
}

export function ChoiceField<Values extends FieldValues>({
  control,
  name,
  legend,
  options,
}: {
  control: Control<Values>;
  name: FieldPath<Values>;
  legend: string;
  options: ChoiceOption[];
}) {
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <Controller
      control={control}
      name={name}
      render={({ field, fieldState }) => (
        <FieldSet data-invalid={fieldState.invalid}>
          <FieldLegend id={`${id}-legend`} variant="label">
            {legend}
          </FieldLegend>
          <RadioGroup
            aria-labelledby={`${id}-legend`}
            name={field.name}
            value={typeof field.value === "string" ? field.value : ""}
            onValueChange={field.onChange}
          >
            {options.map((option) => (
              <Field key={option.value} orientation="horizontal">
                <RadioGroupItem id={`${id}-${option.value}`} value={option.value} />
                <FieldContent>
                  <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-${option.value}`} className="font-normal">
                    {option.label}
                  </FieldLabel>
                  {option.description && <FieldDescription>{option.description}</FieldDescription>}
                </FieldContent>
              </Field>
            ))}
          </RadioGroup>
          {fieldState.error && <FieldError>{fieldState.error.message}</FieldError>}
        </FieldSet>
      )}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// One labelled select bound to a form field, as TextField is for inputs (DESIGN.md: a visible label above, the error
// below with an icon, linked by aria-describedby; 44px options). Options' words wrap rather than being cut off.
import { CircleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useId, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { Controller, type Control, type FieldPath, type FieldValues } from "react-hook-form";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select";

export interface SelectOption {
  value: string;
  label: ReactNode;
}

export function SelectField<Values extends FieldValues>({
  control,
  name,
  label,
  hint,
  placeholder,
  options,
  onChosen,
}: {
  control: Control<Values>;
  name: FieldPath<Values>;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  placeholder?: string;
  options: SelectOption[];
  /** Runs after the field takes a new value, for fields that follow it. */
  onChosen?: (value: string) => void;
}) {
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <Controller
      control={control}
      name={name}
      render={({ field, fieldState }) => {
        const describedBy = [hint ? `${id}-hint` : null, fieldState.error ? `${id}-error` : null].filter(
          (part) => part !== null,
        );
        return (
          <Field data-invalid={fieldState.invalid}>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={id}>{label}</FieldLabel>
            <Select
              name={field.name}
              value={typeof field.value === "string" ? field.value : ""}
              onValueChange={(value) => {
                field.onChange(value);
                onChosen?.(value);
              }}
            >
              <SelectTrigger
                id={id}
                ref={field.ref}
                className="h-auto w-full"
                aria-invalid={fieldState.invalid}
                aria-describedby={describedBy.length > 0 ? describedBy.join(" ") : undefined}
                onBlur={field.onBlur}
              >
                <SelectValue placeholder={placeholder} />
              </SelectTrigger>
              <SelectContent position="popper">
                {options.map((option) => (
                  <SelectItem key={option.value} value={option.value} className="whitespace-normal">
                    {option.label}
                  </SelectItem>
                ))}
              </SelectContent>
            </Select>
            {hint && <FieldDescription id={`${id}-hint`}>{hint}</FieldDescription>}
            {fieldState.error && (
              <FieldError id={`${id}-error`} className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                <CircleAlertIcon aria-hidden="true" className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" />
                {fieldState.error.message}
              </FieldError>
            )}
          </Field>
        );
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

```ts
// The time zones an organization can be put in, as canonical IANA names (the contract keeps a zone as entered, and
// relies on this list for spelling). India's first: the product sells in India in Phase 1, and these are the zones of
// its neighbours and of the places Indian agencies most often keep an office.
export const timeZones = [
  "Asia/Kolkata",
  "Asia/Kathmandu",
  "Asia/Colombo",
  "Asia/Dhaka",
  "Asia/Thimphu",
  "Indian/Maldives",
  "Asia/Dubai",
  "Asia/Singapore",
  "Europe/London",
  "UTC",
] as const;

export type ListedTimeZone = (typeof timeZones)[number];

export function isListedTimeZone(zone: string): zone is ListedTimeZone {
  return (timeZones as readonly string[]).includes(zone);
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The two picks the organization forms share: its time zone from the console's list (a zone set some other way is
// still offered, as itself, so a correction never changes it unasked), and its GST state from the kernel's list, each
// with its two-digit code in mono.
import { gstStates } from "@travel-crm/contracts/kernel";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import type { Control, FieldPath, FieldValues } from "react-hook-form";
import { SelectField, type SelectOption } from "./select-field";
import { isListedTimeZone, timeZones } from "./time-zones";

export function TimeZoneField<Values extends FieldValues>({
  control,
  name,
  label,
  current,
}: {
  control: Control<Values>;
  name: FieldPath<Values>;
  label: string;
  /** The organization's zone today, offered even when the list doesn't hold it. */
  current?: string;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.timeZones");
  const options: SelectOption[] = timeZones.map((zone) => ({ value: zone, label: t(zone) }));
  if (current !== undefined && !isListedTimeZone(current)) options.push({ value: current, label: current });
  return <SelectField control={control} name={name} label={label} options={options} />;
}

export function GstStateField<Values extends FieldValues>({
  control,
  name,
  label,
}: {
  control: Control<Values>;
  name: FieldPath<Values>;
  label: string;
}) {
  const options = gstStates.map((state) => ({
    value: state.code,
    label: (
      <span className="flex gap-2">
        <span className="numbers">{state.code}</span>
        <span className="script-leading">{state.name}</span>
      </span>
    ),
  }));
  return <SelectField control={control} name={name} label={label} options={options} />;
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/organizations/onboarding/onboard-form.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// The onboarding form: the agency, its business profile, its Owner and its subscription, checked by the api's own
// schema before it is sent (problems under their fields); a refusal shows above the button, keeping what was typed.
// Onboarded, it opens the organization's page, which says the Owner's invite is on its way.
import type { PlanSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { CircleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { useForm, type FieldErrors, type Resolver } from "react-hook-form";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { FieldLegend, FieldSet } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../../data/console-trpc";
import { consoleRoutes } from "../../routes";
import { AgencyFields, OwnerFields, ProfileFields } from "./agency-fields";
import { emptyOnboardValues, toOnboardInput, type OnboardField, type OnboardValues } from "./onboard-values";
import { SubscriptionFields } from "./subscription-fields";

/** The plans on sale, or what stands in for them while they load, failed or are none. */
export type PlansOnSale = { plans: PlanSummary[]; trialDays: number | null } | { placeholder: ReactNode };

export function OnboardForm({ plansOnSale }: { plansOnSale: PlansOnSale }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.onboard");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const router = useRouter();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const onboard = useMutation(
    trpc.organizations.onboard.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: async ({ organizationId }) => {
        await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.dashboard.organizations.pathKey() });
        router.push(`${consoleRoutes.organization(organizationId)}?onboarded=1`);
      },
    }),
  );
  const resolver: Resolver<OnboardValues> = (values) => {
    const result = toOnboardInput(values);
    if (result.ok) return { values, errors: {} };
    const errors: FieldErrors<OnboardValues> = {};
    for (const [field, problem] of Object.entries(result.problems)) {
      errors[field as OnboardField] = { type: "validate", message: t(`problems.${problem}`) };
    }
    return { values: {}, errors };
  };
  const form = useForm<OnboardValues>({ resolver, defaultValues: emptyOnboardValues() });
  const submit = form.handleSubmit((values) => {
    const result = toOnboardInput(values);
    if (result.ok) onboard.mutate(result.input);
  });
  const ready = "plans" in plansOnSale;

  return (
    <form noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)} className="flex max-w-xl flex-col gap-8">
      <AgencyFields control={form.control} />
      <ProfileFields control={form.control} />
      <OwnerFields control={form.control} />
      <FieldSet>
        <FieldLegend className="text-section font-semibold">{t("subscription.heading")}</FieldLegend>
        {ready ? (
          <SubscriptionFields form={form} plans={plansOnSale.plans} trialDays={plansOnSale.trialDays} />
        ) : (
          plansOnSale.placeholder
        )}
      </FieldSet>
      {onboard.isError && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <CircleAlertIcon aria-hidden="true" />
          <AlertDescription>{apiError(onboard.error)}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}
      <Button type="submit" disabled={!ready || onboard.isPending} className="self-start">
        {onboard.isPending && <Spinner />}
        {onboard.isPending ? t("submitting") : t("submit")}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/organizations/onboarding/onboard-screen.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// /console/organizations/new: onboarding an agency (spec 7.1). The plans on sale (plans.list, the demo's own and
// archived ones left out) and the policy's trial length load first; until they have, or if they fail or none is on
// sale, the subscription's part says so and the form can't be sent.
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { PageTitle } from "@/components/page-title";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../../data/console-trpc";
import { consoleRoutes } from "../../routes";
import { OnboardForm, type PlansOnSale } from "./onboard-form";

export function OnboardScreen() {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.onboard");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const plans = useQuery(trpc.plans.list.queryOptions({ includeArchived: false }));
  const policy = useQuery(trpc.plans.policy.queryOptions());
  const onSale = plans.data?.filter((plan) => plan.forSale && !plan.archived);

  let plansOnSale: PlansOnSale;
  if (onSale && onSale.length > 0) {
    plansOnSale = { plans: onSale, trialDays: policy.data?.trialDays ?? null };
  } else if (onSale) {
    plansOnSale = {
      placeholder: (
        <div className="flex flex-col items-start gap-3">
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("subscription.noPlans")}</p>
          <Button asChild variant="outline">
            <Link href={consoleRoutes.plans}>{t("subscription.plansLink")}</Link>
          </Button>
        </div>
      ),
    };
  } else if (plans.isError) {
    plansOnSale = {
      placeholder: (
        <ErrorState
          message={t("subscription.plansLoadFailed")}
          retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")}
          onRetry={() => void plans.refetch()}
        />
      ),
    };
  } else {
    plansOnSale = {
      placeholder: (
        <Delayed>
          <div role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={t("subscription.loading")} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
            <Skeleton className="h-11 w-full" />
            <Skeleton className="h-24 w-full" />
          </div>
        </Delayed>
      ),
    };
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <PageTitle>{t("title")}</PageTitle>
        <p className="max-w-[65ch] text-pretty text-muted-foreground">{t("intro")}</p>
      </div>
      <OnboardForm plansOnSale={plansOnSale} />
    </div>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/organizations/onboarding/onboard-values.ts`:**

```ts
// The onboarding form's values, as text, turned into organizations.onboard's input. The api's own schema
// (onboardOrganizationInput) decides what is valid, a GSTIN of another state included; each problem is named on the
// field it belongs to, so the form shows it there before anything is sent.
import { isValidGstin } from "@travel-crm/contracts/kernel";
import { onboardOrganizationInput, type OnboardOrganizationInput } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";

/** How the subscription starts: the policy's usual trial, a trial to a chosen day, or paid through a day already. */
export type SubscriptionStart = "trial" | "trial-until" | "paid";

export interface OnboardValues {
  name: string;
  code: string;
  timeZone: string;
  contactEmail: string;
  legalName: string;
  gstStateCode: string;
  gstin: string;
  contactName: string;
  contactPhone: string;
  ownerName: string;
  ownerEmail: string;
  planId: string;
  billingCycle: string;
  start: SubscriptionStart;
  trialEndsOn: string;
  paidThrough: string;
}

export type OnboardField = keyof OnboardValues;

/** Message keys in "consoleOrganizations.onboard.problems". */
export type OnboardProblem =
  | "required"
  | "codeInvalid"
  | "emailInvalid"
  | "nameInvalid"
  | "gstinInvalid"
  | "gstinOtherState"
  | "phoneInvalid"
  | "timeZoneInvalid"
  | "dateRequired"
  | "dateInvalid";

export function emptyOnboardValues(): OnboardValues {
  return {
    name: "",
    code: "",
    timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata",
    contactEmail: "",
    legalName: "",
    gstStateCode: "",
    gstin: "",
    contactName: "",
    contactPhone: "",
    ownerName: "",
    ownerEmail: "",
    planId: "",
    billingCycle: "",
    start: "trial",
    trialEndsOn: "",
    paidThrough: "",
  };
}

/** The form field each place in the api's input comes from. */
const fieldAt: Record<string, OnboardField> = {
  name: "name",
  code: "code",
  timeZone: "timeZone",
  contactEmail: "contactEmail",
  "profile.legalName": "legalName",
  "profile.gstin": "gstin",
  "profile.gstStateCode": "gstStateCode",
  "profile.contactName": "contactName",
  "profile.contactPhone": "contactPhone",
  "owner.name": "ownerName",
  "owner.email": "ownerEmail",
  "subscription.planId": "planId",
  "subscription.billingCycle": "billingCycle",
  "subscription.trialEndsOn": "trialEndsOn",
  "subscription.paidThrough": "paidThrough",
};

/** What is wrong with a field the schema refused, other than being left blank. */
const problemOf: Record<OnboardField, OnboardProblem> = {
  name: "nameInvalid",
  code: "codeInvalid",
  timeZone: "timeZoneInvalid",
  contactEmail: "emailInvalid",
  legalName: "nameInvalid",
  gstStateCode: "required",
  gstin: "gstinInvalid",
  contactName: "nameInvalid",
  contactPhone: "phoneInvalid",
  ownerName: "nameInvalid",
  ownerEmail: "emailInvalid",
  planId: "required",
  billingCycle: "required",
  start: "required",
  trialEndsOn: "dateInvalid",
  paidThrough: "dateInvalid",
};

/** A blank optional box is no value (ADR 0024's one rule for optional text). */
const optional = (text: string) => (text.trim() === "" ? null : text);

function subscriptionOf(values: OnboardValues) {
  const base = { planId: values.planId, billingCycle: values.billingCycle };
  if (values.start === "trial") return { ...base, paidThrough: null };
  if (values.start === "trial-until") return { ...base, trialEndsOn: values.trialEndsOn, paidThrough: null };
  return { ...base, trialEndsOn: null, paidThrough: values.paidThrough };
}

export function toOnboardInput(
  values: OnboardValues,
):
  | { ok: true; input: OnboardOrganizationInput }
  | { ok: false; problems: Partial<Record<OnboardField, OnboardProblem>> } {
  const problems: Partial<Record<OnboardField, OnboardProblem>> = {};
  // The day a start needs, asked for in words rather than left to the schema's "Use a date like…".
  if (values.start === "trial-until" && values.trialEndsOn === "") problems.trialEndsOn = "dateRequired";
  if (values.start === "paid" && values.paidThrough === "") problems.paidThrough = "dateRequired";
  const parsed = onboardOrganizationInput.safeParse({
    name: values.name,
    code: values.code,
    timeZone: values.timeZone,
    contactEmail: values.contactEmail,
    profile: {
      legalName: values.legalName,
      gstin: optional(values.gstin),
      gstStateCode: values.gstStateCode,
      contactName: optional(values.contactName),
      contactPhone: optional(values.contactPhone),
    },
    owner: { name: values.ownerName, email: values.ownerEmail },
    subscription: subscriptionOf(values),
  });
  if (parsed.success && Object.keys(problems).length === 0) return { ok: true, input: parsed.data };
  for (const issue of parsed.error?.issues ?? []) {
    const field = fieldAt[issue.path.join(".")];
    if (field === undefined || problems[field] !== undefined) continue;
    if (values[field].trim() === "") {
      problems[field] = "required";
    } else if (field === "gstin" && isValidGstin(values.gstin.trim().toUpperCase())) {
      // A well-formed GSTIN refused all the same: the schema's rule that it be of the state chosen.
      problems[field] = "gstinOtherState";
    } else {
      problems[field] = problemOf[field];
    }
  }
  return { ok: false, problems };
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/organizations/onboarding/subscription-fields.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// Onboarding's subscription: a plan on sale with its prices, a billing cycle the plan is sold on (the first one it is
// priced for, until changed), and how it starts: the policy's usual trial, a trial to a chosen day, or active and
// paid through a day. Prices are before GST, in Indian formats.
import type { BillingCycle, PlanSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { money } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useWatch, type UseFormReturn } from "react-hook-form";
import { TextField } from "@/account/text-field";
import { formatRupees } from "@/lib/format";
import { ChoiceField } from "../fields/choice-field";
import { SelectField } from "../fields/select-field";
import type { OnboardValues } from "./onboard-values";

const cycles: readonly BillingCycle[] = ["monthly", "yearly"];

function priceOf(plan: PlanSummary, cycle: BillingCycle): number | null {
  return cycle === "monthly" ? plan.monthlyPricePaise : plan.yearlyPricePaise;
}

const rupees = (paise: number) => formatRupees(money(paise));

export function SubscriptionFields({
  form,
  plans,
  trialDays,
}: {
  form: UseFormReturn<OnboardValues>;
  /** The plans on sale. */
  plans: PlanSummary[];
  /** The policy's trial length, once it has loaded. */
  trialDays: number | null;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.onboard.subscription");
  const [planId, start] = useWatch({ control: form.control, name: ["planId", "start"] });
  const chosen = plans.find((plan) => plan.id === planId);

  const planLabel = (plan: PlanSummary) =>
    [
      plan.name,
      ...cycles.flatMap((cycle) => {
        const price = priceOf(plan, cycle);
        return price === null ? [] : [t(`planPrices.${cycle}`, { price: rupees(price) })];
      }),
    ].join(" · ");

  return (
    <>
      <SelectField
        control={form.control}
        name="planId"
        label={t("plan")}
        options={plans.map((plan) => ({ value: plan.id, label: planLabel(plan) }))}
        onChosen={(value) => {
          const plan = plans.find((candidate) => candidate.id === value);
          const current = form.getValues("billingCycle");
          if (!plan || cycles.some((cycle) => cycle === current && priceOf(plan, cycle) !== null)) return;
          form.setValue("billingCycle", cycles.find((cycle) => priceOf(plan, cycle) !== null) ?? "");
        }}
      />
      {chosen && (
        <ChoiceField
          control={form.control}
          name="billingCycle"
          legend={t("cycle")}
          options={cycles.flatMap((cycle) => {
            const price = priceOf(chosen, cycle);
            return price === null ? [] : [{ value: cycle, label: t(`cycles.${cycle}`, { price: rupees(price) }) }];
          })}
        />
      )}
      <ChoiceField
        control={form.control}
        name="start"
        legend={t("start")}
        options={[
          {
            value: "trial",
            label: t("starts.trial"),
            description: trialDays === null ? undefined : t("trialLength", { count: trialDays }),
          },
          { value: "trial-until", label: t("starts.trial-until") },
          { value: "paid", label: t("starts.paid") },
        ]}
      />
      {start === "trial-until" && (
        <TextField control={form.control} name="trialEndsOn" label={t("trialEndsOn")} type="date" />
      )}
      {start === "paid" && <TextField control={form.control} name="paidThrough" label={t("paidThrough")} type="date" />}
    </>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/organizations/organization/organization-screen.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// /console/organizations/<id>: one organization as the console shows it (organizations.get): its name, sign-in code
// and status today; just after onboarding, that the Owner's invite is on its way. An organization that doesn't exist
// (purged, or a mistyped address) is said so, with the way back to the dashboard.
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { CircleCheckIcon, SearchXIcon } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/empty-state";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { PageTitle } from "@/components/page-title";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { refusalOf } from "@/data/api-error";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../../data/console-trpc";
import { consoleRoutes } from "../../routes";
import { SubscriptionStatusBadge } from "../../subscription-status";

export function OrganizationScreen({ organizationId, onboarded }: { organizationId: string; onboarded: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.organization");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const details = useQuery(trpc.organizations.get.queryOptions({ organizationId }));

  if (!details.data) {
    const status = refusalOf(details.error)?.status;
    // A malformed id is refused as invalid input: to the person, both are no such organization.
    if (status === 404 || status === 400) {
      return (
        <EmptyState
          icon={SearchXIcon}
          message={t("notFound")}
          action={
            <Button asChild variant="outline">
              <Link href={consoleRoutes.home}>{t("backToDashboard")}</Link>
            </Button>
          }
        />
      );
    }
    return details.isError ? (
      <ErrorState message={t("loadFailed")} retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")} onRetry={() => void details.refetch()} />
    ) : (
      <Delayed>
        <div role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={t("loading")} className="flex flex-col gap-4">
          <Skeleton className="h-9 w-64" />
          <Skeleton className="h-40 w-full" />
        </div>
      </Delayed>
    );
  }

  const { organization, subscription } = details.data;
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <PageTitle className="text-balance break-words script-leading">{organization.name}</PageTitle>
        <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <span className="numbers">{organization.code}</span>
          <SubscriptionStatusBadge status={subscription?.subscription.status ?? null} />
        </p>
      </div>
      {onboarded && (
        <Alert>
          <CircleCheckIcon aria-hidden="true" />
          <AlertDescription>{t("onboarded")}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Task C2: Support opens an organization's page, corrects it, sees its members and signs in as one of them

The organization's page now shows, under its name, code and status, the organization's own row (name, code, time
zone, contact email, the day it was onboarded) with a correction dialog over `organizations.update` (the code never
changes); its business profile, read-only, with the bank account as the api masks it; and its members, from a new
`organizations.members` query (each active member's role, whether they are an Owner, their real email or none,
whether they have a password yet, and their last activity), where support resends the invite to an Owner who hasn't
chosen a password and signs in as any member after a confirmation that says it is recorded in the organization's
audit log and lasts an hour at most: Better Auth's `impersonate-user`, then a full load of `/`, where the agency's
banner offers Stop. Super admins also get the way to the organization's data protection. Better Auth's
`/admin/impersonate-user`, the side door the console uses, now refuses platform staff without two-factor
(`SET_UP_TWO_FACTOR`, after `CHANGE_PASSWORD`), as `staffProcedure` does, closing the gap Task G2 left; the identity
and api tests that impersonate turn two-factor on first. The members are read by the identity module, the only one
that reaches the sign-in tables, inside the organization.

**Create `apps/api/test/console-organization-members.test.ts`:**

```ts
// An organization's members in the console (organizations.members): each active member with their role, whether they
// are an Owner, their real email or none, whether they have a password yet (an invited Owner hasn't) and when they
// last used the app; removed and banned people are left out. Platform staff only.
import type { OrganizationMember } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  consoleQuery,
  createTestConsole,
  signedInPlatformStaff,
  type TestConsole,
  type TestPlatformStaff,
} from "./support/console.js";
import { addStaff, ownerAccess, signedInOwner, signedInStaff } from "./support/people.js";
import { createTestAgency, createTestServer, type TestAgency, type TestServer } from "./support/test-server.js";
import { dataOf, query, refusalOf } from "./support/trpc.js";

describe("an organization's members in the console", () => {
  let server: TestServer;
  let testConsole: TestConsole;
  let support: TestPlatformStaff;
  let agency: TestAgency;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    server = createTestServer();
    testConsole = createTestConsole(server);
    support = await signedInPlatformStaff(server, "support");
    agency = await createTestAgency(server);
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await testConsole.close();
    await server.close();
  });

  const membersOf = async (organizationId: string) =>
    dataOf<OrganizationMember[]>(
      await consoleQuery(testConsole, "organizations.members", support.jar, { organizationId }),
    );

  it("lists each active member, oldest first, with their role, email, password and last activity", async () => {
    const ravi = await addStaff(server, agency, { username: "ravi", roleKey: "sales" });
    await query(server, "settings.get", await signedInStaff(server, agency, ravi));
    const meera = await server.identity.staff.create(await ownerAccess(server, agency), {
      name: "Meera Iyer",
      email: `meera-${agency.code.toLowerCase()}@example.test`,
      roleKey: "operations",
      temporaryPassword: "meera-password-1",
    });
    const members = await membersOf(agency.organizationId);
    expect(members).toEqual([
      {
        memberId: agency.owner.memberId,
        userId: agency.owner.userId,
        name: "Asha Owner",
        roleName: "Owner",
        isOwner: true,
        email: agency.owner.email,
        hasPassword: true,
        lastActiveAt: null,
      },
      expect.objectContaining({
        memberId: ravi.memberId,
        name: "ravi",
        roleName: "Sales",
        isOwner: false,
        email: null,
      }),
      expect.objectContaining({ memberId: meera.memberId, roleName: "Operations", email: meera.email }),
    ]);
    // Ravi used the app just now; nobody else has yet.
    expect(Date.parse(members[1]?.lastActiveAt ?? "")).toBeGreaterThan(Date.now() - 60_000);
    expect(members[2]?.lastActiveAt).toBeNull();
  });

  it("says an invited person has no password yet, and leaves removed and banned people out", async () => {
    const other = await createTestAgency(server);
    await server.platform.account.updateMany({ where: { userId: other.owner.userId }, data: { password: null } });
    const leaver = await addStaff(server, other, { username: "leaver", roleKey: "sales" });
    await server.platform.member.update({
      where: { id: leaver.memberId },
      data: { deletedAt: new Date(), deletedBy: other.owner.userId },
    });
    const banned = await addStaff(server, other, { username: "banned", roleKey: "sales" });
    await server.platform.user.update({ where: { id: banned.userId }, data: { banned: true } });
    expect(await membersOf(other.organizationId)).toEqual([
      expect.objectContaining({ memberId: other.owner.memberId, isOwner: true, hasPassword: false }),
    ]);
  });

  it("refuses an organization that doesn't exist, and anyone but platform staff", async () => {
    const missing = await consoleQuery(testConsole, "organizations.members", support.jar, {
      organizationId: crypto.randomUUID(),
    });
    expect(await refusalOf(missing)).toEqual({ status: 404, reason: "ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND" });
    const owner = await signedInOwner(server, agency);
    const refused = await consoleQuery(testConsole, "organizations.members", owner, {
      organizationId: agency.organizationId,
    });
    expect(await refusalOf(refused)).toEqual({ status: 403, reason: "PLATFORM_ONLY" });
  });
});
```
