**Create `apps/web/test/console/organizations/members-section.test.tsx`:**

```tsx
// The organization's members on its console page: each with role, email or none and last activity; support signs in
// as one after confirming (Better Auth's impersonate-user, then the agency's app with a full load), a refusal said in
// the dialog; and an Owner still to choose a password gets a new invite.
import type { OrganizationMember } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { MembersSection } from "@/console/organizations/organization/members-section";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { stubApi, type Answer } from "../../support/api-stub";
import { screenIs } from "../../organization/render";
import { organizationDetails, organizationId } from "./organization-details";
import { inputsSentTo, renderConsoleScreen } from "./render";

const navigation = vi.hoisted(() => ({ loadPage: vi.fn() }));
vi.mock("@/lib/navigate", () => ({ loadPage: navigation.loadPage, replacePage: vi.fn() }));
const toast = vi.hoisted(() => ({ success: vi.fn(), error: vi.fn() }));
vi.mock("sonner", () => ({ toast }));

const { members, impersonate } = messages.consoleOrganizations;
const { organization } = organizationDetails();

function member(overrides: Partial<OrganizationMember> = {}): OrganizationMember {
  return {
    memberId: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000a1",
    userId: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000b1",
    name: "Lakshmi Nair",
    roleName: "Owner",
    isOwner: true,
    email: "lakshmi@keralatrails.example",
    hasPassword: true,
    lastActiveAt: "2026-10-14T06:30:00.000Z",
    ...overrides,
  };
}

const ravi = member({
  memberId: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000a2",
  userId: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000b2",
  name: "Ravi",
  roleName: "Sales",
  isOwner: false,
  email: null,
  lastActiveAt: null,
});

const urlOf = (input: RequestInfo | URL) =>
  typeof input === "string" ? input : input instanceof URL ? input.href : input.url;

function renderMembers(answers: Record<string, Answer>) {
  const api = stubApi(answers);
  renderConsoleScreen(<MembersSection organization={organization} />);
  return api;
}

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  navigation.loadPage.mockReset();
  toast.success.mockReset();
  toast.error.mockReset();
});

describe("MembersSection", () => {
  it("lists each member with their role, email or none, and last activity", async () => {
    screenIs("wide");
    renderMembers({ "platform.organizations.members": { data: [member(), ravi] } });
    const owner = within((await screen.findByText("Lakshmi Nair")).closest("tr") ?? document.body);
    expect(owner.getByText("Owner")).toBeVisible();
    expect(owner.getByText("lakshmi@keralatrails.example")).toBeVisible();
    expect(owner.getByText("14 Oct")).toBeVisible();
    const sales = within(screen.getByText("Ravi").closest("tr") ?? document.body);
    expect(sales.getByText(members.noEmail)).toBeVisible();
    expect(sales.getByText(members.neverActive)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: members.resendInvite })).toBeNull();
  });

  it("signs support in as a member once confirmed, then opens the agency's app", async () => {
    screenIs("phone");
    renderMembers({
      "platform.organizations.members": { data: [member()] },
      "auth/admin/impersonate-user": { data: {} },
    });
    await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Sign in as Lakshmi Nair" }));
    const dialog = await screen.findByRole("alertdialog", { name: "Sign in as Lakshmi Nair?" });
    expect(dialog).toHaveTextContent("recorded in the organization's audit log and ends after an hour at most");
    await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Sign in as Lakshmi Nair" }));
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(navigation.loadPage).toHaveBeenCalledWith("/");
    });
    const sent = vi
      .mocked(globalThis.fetch)
      .mock.calls.find(([input]) => urlOf(input).endsWith("/api/auth/admin/impersonate-user"));
    expect(sent?.[1]?.body).toBe(JSON.stringify({ userId: member().userId }));
  });

  it("says why an impersonation was refused, and stays", async () => {
    screenIs("wide");
    renderMembers({
      "platform.organizations.members": { data: [member()] },
      "auth/admin/impersonate-user": { status: 403, reason: "IMPERSONATION_TARGET_NOT_A_MEMBER" },
    });
    await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: "Sign in as Lakshmi Nair" }));
    const dialog = await screen.findByRole("alertdialog");
    await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: "Sign in as Lakshmi Nair" }));
    expect(await within(dialog).findByText(impersonate.notAMember.replace("{name}", "Lakshmi Nair"))).toBeVisible();
    expect(navigation.loadPage).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it("sends a new invite to an Owner who hasn't chosen a password", async () => {
    screenIs("wide");
    renderMembers({
      "platform.organizations.members": { data: [member({ hasPassword: false, lastActiveAt: null })] },
      "platform.organizations.resendInvite": { data: null },
    });
    expect(await screen.findByText(members.invitePending)).toBeVisible();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: members.resendInvite }));
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(toast.success).toHaveBeenCalledWith("A new invite is on its way to lakshmi@keralatrails.example.");
    });
    expect(inputsSentTo("organizations.resendInvite")).toEqual([{ organizationId, memberId: member().memberId }]);
  });

  it("says a refused invite's reason", async () => {
    screenIs("wide");
    renderMembers({
      "platform.organizations.members": { data: [member({ hasPassword: false })] },
      "platform.organizations.resendInvite": { status: 409, reason: "PASSWORD_ALREADY_SET" },
    });
    await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: members.resendInvite }));
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(toast.error).toHaveBeenCalledWith(messages.errors.reasons.PASSWORD_ALREADY_SET);
    });
  });

  it("says when the members didn't load, and loads them on Try again", async () => {
    screenIs("wide");
    const api = renderMembers({ "platform.organizations.members": { status: 403 } });
    expect(await screen.findByText(members.loadFailed)).toBeVisible();
    api.answer("platform.organizations.members", { data: [] });
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: messages.common.tryAgain }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(members.empty)).toBeVisible();
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/console/organizations/record-section.test.tsx`:**

```tsx
// The organization's row and business profile on its console page: the row's values (the code, which never changes,
// and the onboarding day in mono), corrected through organizations.update with a refusal's sentence kept in the
// dialog; and the profile read-only, the account number as the api masks it, a missing value said.
import { screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { ProfileSection, RecordSection } from "@/console/organizations/organization/record-and-profile";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { stubApi } from "../../support/api-stub";
import { screenIs } from "../../organization/render";
import { organizationDetails, organizationId } from "./organization-details";
import { inputsSentTo, renderConsoleScreen } from "./render";

const toast = vi.hoisted(() => ({ success: vi.fn(), error: vi.fn() }));
vi.mock("sonner", () => ({ toast }));

const { record, profile } = messages.consoleOrganizations;
const details = organizationDetails();

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  toast.success.mockReset();
});

function valueOf(label: string): HTMLElement {
  const term = screen.getByText(label, { selector: "dt" });
  const value = term.nextElementSibling;
  if (!(value instanceof HTMLElement)) throw new Error(`no value for ${label}`);
  return value;
}

describe("RecordSection", () => {
  it("shows the organization's row, its zone in words and its onboarding day", () => {
    screenIs("wide");
    stubApi({});
    renderConsoleScreen(<RecordSection organization={details.organization} />);
    expect(valueOf(record.name)).toHaveTextContent("Kerala Trails");
    expect(within(valueOf(record.code)).getByText("KERALA")).toHaveClass("numbers");
    expect(valueOf(record.timeZone)).toHaveTextContent("India (Asia/Kolkata)");
    expect(valueOf(record.contactEmail)).toHaveTextContent("hello@keralatrails.example");
    expect(valueOf(record.onboardedOn)).toHaveTextContent("1 Oct");
  });

  it("corrects the name and clears the contact email, then says it is saved", async () => {
    screenIs("wide");
    stubApi({ "platform.organizations.update": { data: details.organization } });
    renderConsoleScreen(<RecordSection organization={details.organization} />);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: record.correct }));
    const dialog = await screen.findByRole("dialog", { name: record.dialogTitle });
    await userEvent.clear(within(dialog).getByLabelText(record.name));
    await userEvent.type(within(dialog).getByLabelText(record.name), "Kerala Trails and Treks");
    await userEvent.clear(within(dialog).getByLabelText(record.contactEmail));
    await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: record.save }));
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(toast.success).toHaveBeenCalledWith(record.saved);
    });
    expect(inputsSentTo("organizations.update")).toEqual([
      { organizationId, name: "Kerala Trails and Treks", timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata", contactEmail: null },
    ]);
    expect(screen.queryByRole("dialog")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("names a blank name before sending, and keeps a refusal's sentence in the dialog", async () => {
    screenIs("wide");
    const api = stubApi({ "platform.organizations.update": { status: 404, reason: "ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND" } });
    renderConsoleScreen(<RecordSection organization={details.organization} />);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: record.correct }));
    const dialog = await screen.findByRole("dialog", { name: record.dialogTitle });
    await userEvent.clear(within(dialog).getByLabelText(record.name));
    await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: record.save }));
    expect(await within(dialog).findByText(record.problems.required)).toBeVisible();
    expect(api.calls).not.toContain("platform.organizations.update");
    await userEvent.type(within(dialog).getByLabelText(record.name), "Kerala Trails");
    await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: record.save }));
    expect(await within(dialog).findByText(messages.errors.reasons.ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND)).toBeVisible();
  });
});

describe("ProfileSection", () => {
  it("shows the business profile read-only, the account number masked and a missing value said", () => {
    stubApi({});
    renderConsoleScreen(<ProfileSection profile={details.profile} />);
    expect(within(valueOf(profile.gstin)).getByText("32AAPFU0939F1Z4")).toHaveClass("numbers");
    expect(valueOf(profile.gstState)).toHaveTextContent("32Kerala");
    expect(valueOf(profile.contactPhone)).toHaveTextContent("+91 98765 43210");
    expect(valueOf(profile.bankAccountNumber)).toHaveTextContent("XXXX7890");
    expect(valueOf(profile.address)).toHaveTextContent(profile.notGiven);
```

**Create `packages/domain/test/identity/impersonation-two-factor.test.ts`:**

```ts
// Support's impersonation needs two-factor sign-in, as the console does (ADR 0019): Better Auth's
// /admin/impersonate-user, the side door the console starts it through, refuses platform staff without it, after a
// temporary password still to replace, so nobody reaches an agency's data past the console's own check.
import { createPlatformClient, type PlatformClient } from "@travel-crm/db/platform";
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, inject, it } from "vitest";
import {
  createPlatformAdmin,
  createTestAgency,
  createTestIdentity,
  signInByEmail,
  type TestAgency,
  type TestIdentity,
} from "./test-identity.js";

describe("impersonation and two-factor", () => {
  let test: TestIdentity;
  let platform: PlatformClient;
  let agency: TestAgency;

  beforeAll(async () => {
    test = createTestIdentity();
    platform = createPlatformClient(inject("dbUrls").platform);
    agency = await createTestAgency(test.identity, platform);
  });

  afterAll(async () => {
    await test.close();
    await platform.$disconnect();
  });

  function impersonate(headers: Headers, userId: string): Promise<Response> {
    return test.identity.auth.handler(
      new Request("http://localhost/api/auth/admin/impersonate-user", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: {
          cookie: headers.get("cookie") ?? "",
          origin: "http://localhost",
          "content-type": "application/json",
        },
        body: JSON.stringify({ userId }),
      }),
    );
  }

  it("refuses support without two-factor, and starts nothing, until two-factor is on", async () => {
    const support = await createPlatformAdmin(test, "support-password-1");
    const headers = await signInByEmail(test.identity, support.email, "support-password-1");
    const refused = await impersonate(headers, agency.ownerUserId);
    expect(refused.status).toBe(403);
    expect(await refused.json()).toMatchObject({ code: "SET_UP_TWO_FACTOR" });
    expect(await test.database.client.session.count({ where: { impersonatedBy: support.userId } })).toBe(0);

    // As finishing the setup screen leaves it; the side door reads the column on every call.
    await test.database.client.user.update({ where: { id: support.userId }, data: { twoFactorEnabled: true } });
    expect((await impersonate(headers, agency.ownerUserId)).status).toBe(200);
    expect(await test.database.client.session.count({ where: { impersonatedBy: support.userId } })).toBe(1);
  });

  it("asks for a new password first, as the console does", async () => {
    const support = await createPlatformAdmin(test, "support-password-1");
    const headers = await signInByEmail(test.identity, support.email, "support-password-1");
    await test.database.client.user.update({ where: { id: support.userId }, data: { mustChangePassword: true } });
    const refused = await impersonate(headers, agency.ownerUserId);
    expect(refused.status).toBe(403);
    expect(await refused.json()).toMatchObject({ code: "CHANGE_PASSWORD" });
  });
});
```

**Create `packages/domain/src/identity/organization-members.ts`:**

```ts
// An organization's active staff as the platform console lists them (spec 6.1: support impersonates one of them, and
// resends an invite to an Owner who hasn't chosen a password): who they are, their role, whether they have a password
// yet, and when they last used the app. Read inside the organization (asOrganization), oldest member first.
import type { IdentityTx } from "@travel-crm/db/identity";
import { shownEmail } from "./sign-in-names.js";

export interface OrganizationMemberRecord {
  memberId: string;
  userId: string;
  name: string;
  /** Null for staff without email: their placeholder address is never shown. */
  email: string | null;
  roleName: string;
  isOwner: boolean;
  /** False until an invited person chooses a password from their invite. */
  hasPassword: boolean;
  /** When they last made a request, support's impersonation aside, to the day; null before their first. */
  lastActiveAt: Date | null;
}

/** The organization's members, removed and banned ones left out, as support may impersonate only active staff. */
export async function organizationMembers(tx: IdentityTx, organizationId: string): Promise<OrganizationMemberRecord[]> {
  // The member table has no row-level security, so the organization is filtered here; soft delete hides removals.
  const members = await tx.member.findMany({
    where: {
      organizationId,
      // Banned as resolveAccess sees it: banned, and the ban has no end or hasn't ended yet.
      NOT: { user: { banned: true, OR: [{ banExpires: null }, { banExpires: { gt: new Date() } }] } },
    },
    select: {
      id: true,
      userId: true,
      role: true,
      lastActiveAt: true,
      user: { select: { name: true, email: true } },
    },
    orderBy: [{ createdAt: "asc" }, { id: "asc" }],
  });
  const roles = new Map((await tx.role.findMany({ where: { organizationId } })).map((role) => [role.key, role]));
  const withPassword = new Set(
    (
      await tx.account.findMany({
        where: {
          userId: { in: members.map((member) => member.userId) },
          providerId: "credential",
          password: { not: null },
        },
        select: { userId: true },
      })
    ).map((account) => account.userId),
  );
  return members.map((member) => {
    const role = roles.get(member.role);
    return {
      memberId: member.id,
      userId: member.userId,
      name: member.user.name,
      email: shownEmail(member.user.email),
      roleName: role?.name ?? member.role,
      isOwner: role?.isOwner ?? false,
      hasPassword: withPassword.has(member.userId),
      lastActiveAt: member.lastActiveAt,
    };
  });
}
```

**Create `packages/domain/src/platform/members.ts`:**

```ts
// An organization's members as the console lists them (spec 6.1): whom support may impersonate, and an Owner still to
// choose a password from their invite. Identity reads its own tables, inside the organization.
import type { OrganizationMember } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { asOrganization } from "@travel-crm/db/platform";
import { findOrganizationRecord, organizationMembers } from "../identity/index.js";
import type { PlatformServices } from "./services.js";

/** The organization's active members, oldest first; ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND for one that doesn't exist. */
export async function listOrganizationMembers(
  services: PlatformServices,
  organizationId: string,
): Promise<OrganizationMember[]> {
  return services.platformDb.transaction(async (tx) => {
    await findOrganizationRecord(tx, organizationId);
    const members = await asOrganization(tx, organizationId, (orgTx) => organizationMembers(orgTx, organizationId));
    return members.map((member) => ({ ...member, lastActiveAt: member.lastActiveAt?.toISOString() ?? null }));
  });
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/organizations/organization/correct-record-dialog.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// Correcting an organization's row (organizations.update): its name, time zone and contact email, checked by the api's
// own schema first. Saved, the organization's page and the dashboard load it again; a refusal shows its sentence in
// the dialog, keeping what was typed.
import type { OrganizationRecord } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { CircleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { useForm, type FieldErrors, type Resolver } from "react-hook-form";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { TextField } from "@/account/text-field";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { FieldGroup } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { ResponsiveDialog } from "@/organization/responsive-dialog";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../../data/console-trpc";
import { TimeZoneField } from "../fields/zone-and-state-fields";
import { toUpdateInput, type RecordField, type RecordValues } from "./record-values";

export function CorrectRecordDialog({ organization }: { organization: OrganizationRecord }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.record");
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <>
      <Button
        variant="outline"
        onClick={() => {
          setOpen(true);
        }}
      >
        {t("correct")}
      </Button>
      <ResponsiveDialog
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={setOpen}
        title={t("dialogTitle")}
        description={t("dialogDescription")}
      >
        {/* Mounted while open only, so it starts from the organization as it is now. */}
        {open && (
          <CorrectRecordForm
            organization={organization}
            onSaved={() => {
              setOpen(false);
            }}
          />
        )}
      </ResponsiveDialog>
    </>
  );
}

function CorrectRecordForm({ organization, onSaved }: { organization: OrganizationRecord; onSaved: () => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.record");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const update = useMutation(
    trpc.organizations.update.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: async () => {
        await Promise.all([
          queryClient.invalidateQueries({
            queryKey: trpc.organizations.get.queryKey({ organizationId: organization.id }),
          }),
          queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.dashboard.organizations.pathKey() }),
        ]);
        toast.success(t("saved"));
        onSaved();
      },
    }),
  );
  const resolver: Resolver<RecordValues> = (values) => {
    const result = toUpdateInput(organization.id, values);
    if (result.ok) return { values, errors: {} };
    const errors: FieldErrors<RecordValues> = {};
    for (const [field, problem] of Object.entries(result.problems)) {
      errors[field as RecordField] = { type: "validate", message: t(`problems.${problem}`) };
    }
    return { values: {}, errors };
  };
  const form = useForm<RecordValues>({
    resolver,
    defaultValues: {
      name: organization.name,
      timeZone: organization.timeZone,
      contactEmail: organization.contactEmail ?? "",
    },
  });
  const submit = form.handleSubmit((values) => {
    const result = toUpdateInput(organization.id, values);
    if (result.ok) update.mutate(result.input);
  });

  return (
    <form noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)} className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <FieldGroup>
        <TextField control={form.control} name="name" label={t("name")} autoComplete="off" />
        <TimeZoneField control={form.control} name="timeZone" label={t("timeZone")} current={organization.timeZone} />
        <TextField
          control={form.control}
          name="contactEmail"
          label={t("contactEmail")}
          hint={t("contactEmailHint")}
          type="email"
          inputMode="email"
          autoComplete="off"
        />
      </FieldGroup>
      {update.isError && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <CircleAlertIcon aria-hidden="true" />
          <AlertDescription>{apiError(update.error)}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}
      <Button type="submit" disabled={update.isPending} className="self-end">
        {update.isPending && <Spinner />}
        {update.isPending ? t("saving") : t("save")}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/organizations/organization/impersonate-dialog.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// Support signing in as a member (spec 6.1, ADR 0019), asked once more: it is recorded in the organization's audit
// log and lasts an hour at most. Better Auth swaps the session cookie, then the agency's app opens with a full page
// load, so nothing of the console stays in memory; its banner offers Stop. A refusal says why and changes nothing.
import type { OrganizationMember } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
  AlertDialogTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner";
import { authClient, type AuthResult } from "@/data/auth-client";
import errors from "@/i18n/messages/en-IN/errors.json";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { loadPage } from "@/lib/navigate";
import { routes } from "@/lib/routes";

type Failure = Extract<AuthResult<unknown>, { ok: false }>;

const isReason = (code: string): code is keyof typeof errors.reasons => Object.hasOwn(errors.reasons, code);

export function ImpersonateDialog({
  member,
  organizationName,
}: {
  member: OrganizationMember;
  organizationName: string;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.impersonate");
  const tMembers = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.members");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const tErrors = useTranslations("errors");
  const { authError } = useErrorMessage();
  const [starting, setStarting] = useState(false);
  const [failure, setFailure] = useState<Failure | null>(null);

  /** The side door's own refusals (a target no longer active, a step still to take) in the console's words. */
  const refusal = (refused: Failure) => {
    if (refused.code === "IMPERSONATION_TARGET_NOT_A_MEMBER") return t("notAMember", { name: member.name });
    return isReason(refused.code) ? tErrors(`reasons.${refused.code}`) : authError(refused);
  };

  const start = async () => {
    setStarting(true);
    setFailure(null);
    const result = await authClient.impersonate({ userId: member.userId });
    if (result.ok) {
      loadPage(routes.home);
      return;
    }
    setFailure(result);
    setStarting(false);
  };

  return (
    <AlertDialog
      onOpenChange={(open) => {
        if (!open) setFailure(null);
      }}
    >
      <AlertDialogTrigger asChild>
        <Button variant="outline">{tMembers("impersonate", { name: member.name })}</Button>
      </AlertDialogTrigger>
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogTitle>{t("title", { name: member.name })}</AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>
            {t("description", { name: member.name, organization: organizationName })}
          </AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        {failure && (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertDescription>{refusal(failure)}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel>{tCommon("cancel")}</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction
            disabled={starting}
            onClick={(event) => {
              // Stay open until Better Auth answers, so a refusal is shown here.
              event.preventDefault();
              void start();
            }}
          >
            {starting && <Spinner />}
            {starting ? t("starting") : t("confirm", { name: member.name })}
          </AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The organization's active members (organizations.members): name, role (Owners marked), email or none, last activity
// in the organization's zone, and what support may do for each: sign in as them, and resend the invite to one still
// to choose a password. A table from tablets up, a divided list on phones; names wrap rather than being cut off.
import type { OrganizationMember, OrganizationRecord } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/status-badge";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { formatDay } from "@/lib/format";
import { shownEmail } from "@/lib/shown-email";
import { useWideScreen } from "@/lib/use-wide-screen";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../../data/console-trpc";
import { DetailSection } from "./detail-list";
import { ImpersonateDialog } from "./impersonate-dialog";
import { ResendInviteButton } from "./resend-invite-button";

export function MembersSection({ organization }: { organization: OrganizationRecord }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.members");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const wide = useWideScreen();
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const members = useQuery(trpc.organizations.members.queryOptions({ organizationId: organization.id }));

  const lastActive = (lastActiveAt: string) => formatDay(new Date(lastActiveAt), { timeZone: organization.timeZone });
  const invitePending = (member: OrganizationMember) =>
    !member.hasPassword && member.email !== null && <StatusBadge tone="attention">{t("invitePending")}</StatusBadge>;
  const email = (member: OrganizationMember) =>
    shownEmail(member.email) ?? <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t("noEmail")}</span>;
  const actions = (member: OrganizationMember) => (
    <span className="flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2">
      {invitePending(member) && <ResendInviteButton organizationId={organization.id} member={member} />}
      <ImpersonateDialog member={member} organizationName={organization.name} />
    </span>
  );

  let content;
  if (!members.data) {
    content = members.isError ? (
      <ErrorState message={t("loadFailed")} retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")} onRetry={() => void members.refetch()} />
    ) : (
      <Delayed>
        <div role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={t("loading")} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          <Skeleton className="h-14 w-full" />
          <Skeleton className="h-14 w-full" />
        </div>
      </Delayed>
    );
  } else if (members.data.length === 0) {
    content = <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("empty")}</p>;
  } else if (!wide) {
    content = (
      <ul className="divide-y rounded-lg border">
        {members.data.map((member) => (
          <li key={member.memberId} className="flex flex-col gap-1 px-4 py-3">
            <span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className="font-medium break-words script-leading">{member.name}</span>
              {invitePending(member)}
            </span>
            <span className="text-label break-all text-muted-foreground script-leading">
              {member.roleName} · {email(member)}
            </span>
            <span className="text-label text-muted-foreground">
              {member.lastActiveAt === null
                ? t("neverUsed")
                : t("lastActive", { date: lastActive(member.lastActiveAt) })}
            </span>
            <span className="mt-2 flex justify-start">{actions(member)}</span>
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    );
  } else {
    content = (
      <Table>
        <TableHeader>
          <TableRow>
            <TableHead scope="col">{t("columns.name")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead scope="col">{t("columns.role")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead scope="col">{t("columns.email")}</TableHead>
            <TableHead scope="col" className="text-right">
              {t("columns.lastActive")}
            </TableHead>
            <TableHead scope="col">
              <span className="sr-only">{t("columns.actions")}</span>
            </TableHead>
          </TableRow>
        </TableHeader>
        <TableBody>
          {members.data.map((member) => (
            <TableRow key={member.memberId}>
              <TableCell className="font-medium whitespace-normal script-leading">{member.name}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="whitespace-normal">
                <span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                  <span className="script-leading">{member.roleName}</span>
                  {invitePending(member)}
                </span>
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell className="whitespace-normal break-all">{email(member)}</TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-right">
                {member.lastActiveAt === null ? (
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t("neverActive")}</span>
                ) : (
                  <span className="numbers">{lastActive(member.lastActiveAt)}</span>
                )}
              </TableCell>
              <TableCell className="text-right">{actions(member)}</TableCell>
            </TableRow>
          ))}
        </TableBody>
      </Table>
    );
  }

  return (
    <DetailSection id="members-heading" heading={t("heading")} wide>
      {content}
    </DetailSection>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/organizations/organization/phone-number.ts`:**

```ts
// A stored phone number (E.164) as Indian screens write it (DESIGN.md section 9): "+91 98765 43210". Numbers of other
// countries are shown as stored, which is already unambiguous.
const INDIAN_NUMBER = /^\+91(\d{5})(\d{5})$/;

export function formatPhoneNumber(e164: string): string {
  const match = INDIAN_NUMBER.exec(e164);
  return match ? `+91 ${match[1] ?? ""} ${match[2] ?? ""}` : e164;
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The organization's row (name, code, time zone, contact email, when it was onboarded), with its corrections, and its
// business profile, read-only here: the Owner keeps it up to date, and the account number comes masked by the api.
// GSTIN, IFSC, codes and numbers are mono; dates are the organization's own.
import type { OrganizationRecord } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import type { OrganizationProfileDetails } from "@travel-crm/contracts/profile";
import { gstStates } from "@travel-crm/contracts/kernel";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { formatDay } from "@/lib/format";
import { isListedTimeZone } from "../fields/time-zones";
import { CorrectRecordDialog } from "./correct-record-dialog";
import { DetailList, DetailSection } from "./detail-list";
import { formatPhoneNumber } from "./phone-number";

export function RecordSection({ organization }: { organization: OrganizationRecord }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.record");
  const tZones = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.timeZones");
  const zone = isListedTimeZone(organization.timeZone) ? tZones(organization.timeZone) : organization.timeZone;
  return (
    <DetailSection
      id="record-heading"
      heading={t("heading")}
      action={<CorrectRecordDialog organization={organization} />}
    >
      <DetailList
        details={[
          { label: t("name"), value: organization.name },
          { label: t("code"), value: <span className="numbers">{organization.code}</span> },
          { label: t("timeZone"), value: zone },
          {
            label: t("contactEmail"),
            value: organization.contactEmail ?? <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t("noContactEmail")}</span>,
          },
          {
            label: t("onboardedOn"),
            value: (
              <span className="numbers">
                {formatDay(new Date(organization.createdAt), { timeZone: organization.timeZone })}
              </span>
            ),
          },
        ]}
      />
    </DetailSection>
  );
}

export function ProfileSection({ profile }: { profile: OrganizationProfileDetails | null }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.profile");
  if (!profile) {
    return (
      <DetailSection id="profile-heading" heading={t("heading")}>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("none")}</p>
      </DetailSection>
    );
  }
  const notGiven = <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t("notGiven")}</span>;
  const text = (value: string | null) => value ?? notGiven;
  const mono = (value: string | null) => (value === null ? notGiven : <span className="numbers">{value}</span>);
  const state = gstStates.find((candidate) => candidate.code === profile.gstStateCode);
  return (
    <DetailSection id="profile-heading" heading={t("heading")}>
      <DetailList
        details={[
          { label: t("legalName"), value: profile.legalName },
          { label: t("gstin"), value: mono(profile.gstin) },
          {
            label: t("gstState"),
            value: (
              <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                <span className="numbers">{profile.gstStateCode}</span>
                {state && <span>{state.name}</span>}
              </span>
            ),
          },
          { label: t("address"), value: <span className="whitespace-pre-line">{text(profile.address)}</span> },
          { label: t("contactName"), value: text(profile.contactName) },
          { label: t("contactPhone"), value: mono(profile.contactPhone && formatPhoneNumber(profile.contactPhone)) },
          { label: t("bankAccountName"), value: text(profile.bankAccountName) },
          { label: t("bankAccountNumber"), value: mono(profile.bankAccountNumber) },
          { label: t("bankIfsc"), value: mono(profile.bankIfsc) },
          { label: t("bankName"), value: text(profile.bankName) },
          { label: t("invoicePrefix"), value: mono(profile.invoicePrefix) },
        ]}
      />
      <p className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{t("hint")}</p>
    </DetailSection>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/organizations/organization/record-values.ts`:**

```ts
// The correction form's values, as text, turned into organizations.update's input by the api's own schema
// (updateOrganizationInput); a blank contact email is none. Each problem is named on its field.
import { updateOrganizationInput, type UpdateOrganizationInput } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";

export interface RecordValues {
  name: string;
  timeZone: string;
  contactEmail: string;
}

export type RecordField = keyof RecordValues;

/** Message keys in "consoleOrganizations.record.problems". */
export type RecordProblem = "required" | "nameInvalid" | "emailInvalid" | "timeZoneInvalid";

const problemOf: Record<RecordField, RecordProblem> = {
  name: "nameInvalid",
  timeZone: "timeZoneInvalid",
  contactEmail: "emailInvalid",
};

const isField = (value: unknown): value is RecordField => typeof value === "string" && Object.hasOwn(problemOf, value);

export function toUpdateInput(
  organizationId: string,
  values: RecordValues,
): { ok: true; input: UpdateOrganizationInput } | { ok: false; problems: Partial<Record<RecordField, RecordProblem>> } {
  const parsed = updateOrganizationInput.safeParse({
    organizationId,
    name: values.name,
    timeZone: values.timeZone,
    contactEmail: values.contactEmail.trim() === "" ? null : values.contactEmail,
  });
  if (parsed.success) return { ok: true, input: parsed.data };
  const problems: Partial<Record<RecordField, RecordProblem>> = {};
  for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) {
    const field = issue.path[0];
    if (!isField(field) || problems[field] !== undefined) continue;
    problems[field] = field !== "contactEmail" && values[field].trim() === "" ? "required" : problemOf[field];
  }
  return { ok: false, problems };
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// A new invite for a member who hasn't chosen a password yet (organizations.resendInvite: the first Owner, until they
// do). The worker emails it; earlier links keep working until they lapse. A refusal (they have chosen one meanwhile,
// the hour's cap) says why.
import type { OrganizationMember } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../../data/console-trpc";

export function ResendInviteButton({ organizationId, member }: { organizationId: string; member: OrganizationMember }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.members");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const resend = useMutation(
    trpc.organizations.resendInvite.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: () => {
        toast.success(t("inviteSent", { email: member.email ?? "" }));
      },
      onError: async (error) => {
        toast.error(apiError(error));
        // A password chosen since the list loaded: the list says so once it loads again.
        await queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.organizations.members.queryKey({ organizationId }) });
      },
    }),
  );
  return (
    <Button
      variant="outline"
      disabled={resend.isPending}
      onClick={() => {
        resend.mutate({ organizationId, memberId: member.memberId });
      }}
    >
      {resend.isPending && <Spinner />}
      {resend.isPending ? t("resending") : t("resendInvite")}
    </Button>
  );
}
```

### Task C3: Support keeps an organization's subscription: payments, plan, overrides, dates, suspension, cancelling

The organization's page gains its subscription (`organizations.get`'s, which plan 4 already returns): the state due
today as a dot and a word since its first day, and the state the nightly job last recorded when the two differ; the
day it moves on if nothing is paid; a suspension made by hand with its day and reason; the plan and billing cycle;
the trial's last day and the paid-through day; the extra seats, an agreed price and the modules switched on early;
the price per cycle with CGST and SGST at 9 % each, mono and right-aligned; and the payments, money received in
forest, a voided one with its reason. Support records a payment (rupees typed as people write them, grouped the Indian
way on leaving the box, the day paid in the organization's zone, the day it pays through, a reference), voids one,
changes the plan to another on sale, sets the overrides, moves a trial's end, changes the paid-through day with a
reason, suspends with a reason and cancels with one; a super admin lifts a suspension made by hand. Every change goes
through `subscriptions.*`, checked by the api's own schemas first, and a refusal shows its sentence in its dialog;
saved, the page and the dashboard load again. The onboarding form's plan choice moves to a shared field the change of
plan uses too.

  `apps/web/src/console/organizations/subscription/{change-inputs,calendar-day}.ts`,

```ts
// The subscription forms' values become subscriptions.*'s inputs by the api's own schemas: rupees as people type them
// read into paise exactly, a blank optional box as none, and every problem named on its field before anything is
// sent.
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  toChangePlanInput,
  toEndAccessInput,
  toOverridesInput,
  toPaidThroughInput,
  toRecordPaymentInput,
  toTrialEndInput,
  toVoidPaymentInput,
} from "@/console/organizations/subscription/change-inputs";
import { groupedRupees } from "@/console/organizations/fields/money-field";

const organizationId = "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-000000000002";
const paymentId = "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000f1";

describe("the subscription forms' inputs", () => {
  it("read a payment's rupees into paise, and a blank reference as none", () => {
    expect(
      toRecordPaymentInput(organizationId, {
        amount: "₹2,950.50",
        paidOn: "2026-10-16",
        paidThrough: "2026-11-30",
        reference: " ",
      }),
    ).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      input: { organizationId, amountPaise: 295_050, paidOn: "2026-10-16", paidThrough: "2026-11-30", reference: null },
    });
  });

  it("name a payment's problems on their fields", () => {
    expect(toRecordPaymentInput(organizationId, { amount: "", paidOn: "", paidThrough: "", reference: "" })).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problems: { amount: "required", paidOn: "required", paidThrough: "required" },
    });
    expect(
      toRecordPaymentInput(organizationId, {
        amount: "two thousand",
        paidOn: "2026-02-30",
        paidThrough: "2026-11-30",
        reference: "x".repeat(101),
      }),
    ).toEqual({ ok: false, problems: { amount: "amountInvalid", paidOn: "dateInvalid", reference: "tooLong" } });
    expect(
      toRecordPaymentInput(organizationId, {
        amount: "0",
        paidOn: "2026-10-16",
        paidThrough: "2026-11-30",
        reference: "",
      }),
    ).toEqual({ ok: false, problems: { amount: "amountInvalid" } });
  });

  it("read the overrides: seats as a whole number, a blank agreed price as the plan's, modules as chosen", () => {
    expect(toOverridesInput(organizationId, { extraSeats: "2", customPrice: "", extraModules: ["crm"] })).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      input: { organizationId, extraSeats: 2, customPricePaise: null, extraModules: ["crm"] },
    });
    expect(toOverridesInput(organizationId, { extraSeats: "0", customPrice: "1,999", extraModules: [] })).toMatchObject(
      {
        ok: true,
        input: { customPricePaise: 199_900 },
      },
    );
    expect(toOverridesInput(organizationId, { extraSeats: "1.5", customPrice: "lots", extraModules: [] })).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problems: { extraSeats: "seatsInvalid", customPrice: "amountInvalid" },
    });
  });

  it("read a plan, a trial's end and a paid-through day with its reason", () => {
    expect(toChangePlanInput(organizationId, { planId: "", billingCycle: "monthly" })).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problems: { planId: "required" },
    });
    expect(toTrialEndInput(organizationId, { trialEndsOn: "2026-11-30" })).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      input: { organizationId, trialEndsOn: "2026-11-30" },
    });
    expect(toPaidThroughInput(organizationId, { paidThrough: "2026-12-31", reason: "" })).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problems: { reason: "required" },
    });
  });

  it("ask a reason of every suspension, cancellation and void, at most 200 characters", () => {
    expect(toEndAccessInput(organizationId, { reason: " Chargeback " })).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      input: { organizationId, reason: "Chargeback" },
    });
    expect(toEndAccessInput(organizationId, { reason: "x".repeat(201) })).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problems: { reason: "tooLong" },
    });
    expect(toVoidPaymentInput(organizationId, paymentId, { reason: "Entered twice" })).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      input: { organizationId, paymentId, reason: "Entered twice" },
    });
  });

  it("group a typed amount the Indian way once the person moves on", () => {
    expect(groupedRupees("250000")).toBe("2,50,000");
    expect(groupedRupees("1250.5")).toBe("1,250.50");
    expect(groupedRupees("lots")).toBe("lots");
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/console/organizations/subscription-section.test.tsx`:**

```tsx
// The organization's subscription in the console: its state today beside the recorded one, the plan, dates and
// overrides, the price with CGST and SGST in mono, and the payments; and every change through subscriptions.*,
// each with what it sends and a refusal's sentence kept in its dialog. Lifting a suspension is a super admin's.
import type { SubscriptionPayment, SubscriptionWithPayments } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { afterEach, beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { SubscriptionSection } from "@/console/organizations/subscription/subscription-section";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { stubApi, type Answer } from "../../support/api-stub";
import { platformStaff } from "../../support/platform-staff";
import { screenIs } from "../../organization/render";
import { organizationDetails, organizationId, subscriptionDetails } from "./organization-details";
import { inputsSentTo, renderConsoleScreen } from "./render";

const toast = vi.hoisted(() => ({ success: vi.fn(), error: vi.fn() }));
vi.mock("sonner", () => ({ toast }));

const { subscription: words } = messages.consoleOrganizations;
const { organization } = organizationDetails();

function payment(overrides: Partial<SubscriptionPayment> = {}): SubscriptionPayment {
  return {
    id: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000f1",
    amountPaise: 295_000,
    paidOn: "2026-10-01",
    paidThrough: "2026-10-31",
    reference: "NEFT UTR 412345678901",
    provider: "manual",
    recordedBy: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000ad",
    recordedAt: "2026-10-01T05:00:00.000Z",
    voided: null,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function renderSection(
  found: SubscriptionWithPayments = { subscription: subscriptionDetails(), payments: [payment()] },
  answers: Record<string, Answer> = {},
  staff = platformStaff(),
) {
  const api = stubApi(answers);
  renderConsoleScreen(<SubscriptionSection organization={organization} subscription={found} />, staff);
  return api;
}

function valueOf(label: string): HTMLElement {
  const value = screen.getByText(label, { selector: "dt" }).nextElementSibling;
  if (!(value instanceof HTMLElement)) throw new Error(`no value for ${label}`);
  return value;
}

async function openDialog(button: string, title: string | RegExp): Promise<HTMLElement> {
  await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: button }));
  return screen.findByRole("dialog", { name: title });
}

async function fill(dialog: HTMLElement, label: string, text: string): Promise<void> {
  await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByLabelText(label));
  await userEvent.paste(text);
}

beforeEach(() => {
  screenIs("wide");
});

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  toast.success.mockReset();
});

describe("SubscriptionSection", { timeout: 20_000 }, () => {
  it("shows today's state beside the recorded one, the plan, dates, overrides and the price with GST", () => {
    renderSection({
      subscription: subscriptionDetails({
        status: "past_due",
        since: "2026-11-01",
        nextChangeOn: "2026-11-08",
        recorded: { status: "active", since: "2026-10-01" },
        extraModules: ["quotes"],
      }),
      payments: [payment()],
    });
    expect(valueOf(words.status)).toHaveTextContent(`${messages.console.status.past_due}since 1 Nov`);
    expect(valueOf(words.status)).toHaveTextContent("The nightly job last recorded Active since 1 Oct");
    expect(valueOf(words.nextChange)).toHaveTextContent("8 Nov, if nothing is paid");
    expect(valueOf(words.plan)).toHaveTextContent("Growth, billed monthly");
    expect(valueOf(words.paidThroughOn)).toHaveTextContent("31 Oct");
    expect(valueOf(words.trialEndsOn)).toHaveTextContent(words.notSet);
    expect(valueOf(words.extraModules)).toHaveTextContent("Quotes");
    const price = screen.getByRole("table", { name: words.price.caption.monthly });
    expect(within(price).getByRole("row", { name: "The plan's price ₹2,500.00" })).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(price).getByRole("row", { name: "CGST at 9% ₹225.00" })).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(price).getByRole("row", { name: "SGST at 9% ₹225.00" })).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(price).getByRole("row", { name: "Total a month ₹2,950.00" })).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(price).getByText("₹2,950.00")).toHaveClass("numbers", "text-right");
  });

  it("lists the payments, money received in forest, a voided one with its reason", () => {
    const voided = payment({
      id: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000f2",
      voided: { at: "2026-10-02T05:00:00.000Z", by: null, reason: "Entered twice" },
    });
    renderSection({ subscription: subscriptionDetails(), payments: [payment(), voided] });
    const [first, second] = screen.getAllByRole("row").filter((row) => row.textContent.includes("NEFT"));
    expect(within(first ?? document.body).getByText("₹2,950")).toHaveClass("text-money");
    expect(within(second ?? document.body).getByText(words.payments.voided)).toBeVisible();
    expect(within(second ?? document.body).getByText("Entered twice")).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("records a payment, reading the rupees typed", async () => {
    renderSection(undefined, { "platform.subscriptions.recordPayment": { data: payment() } });
    const dialog = await openDialog(words.recordPayment.action, words.recordPayment.title);
    await fill(dialog, words.recordPayment.amount, "2950");
    await userEvent.clear(within(dialog).getByLabelText(words.recordPayment.paidOn));
    await userEvent.type(within(dialog).getByLabelText(words.recordPayment.paidOn), "2026-11-01");
    await userEvent.type(within(dialog).getByLabelText(words.recordPayment.paidThrough), "2026-11-30");
    await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: words.recordPayment.submit }));
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(toast.success).toHaveBeenCalledWith(words.recordPayment.done);
    });
    expect(inputsSentTo("subscriptions.recordPayment")).toEqual([
      { organizationId, amountPaise: 295_000, paidOn: "2026-11-01", paidThrough: "2026-11-30", reference: null },
    ]);
  });

  it("voids a payment, with the reason", async () => {
    renderSection(undefined, { "platform.subscriptions.voidPayment": { data: payment() } });
    const dialog = await openDialog(
      "Void the payment of ₹2,950 paid on 1 Oct",
      "Void the payment of ₹2,950 paid on 1 Oct?",
    );
    await fill(dialog, words.reason.label, "Entered twice");
    await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: words.voidPayment.submit }));
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(inputsSentTo("subscriptions.voidPayment")).toEqual([
        { organizationId, paymentId: payment().id, reason: "Entered twice" },
      ]);
    });
  });

  it("suspends with a reason, and only a super admin lifts a suspension made by hand", async () => {
    renderSection(undefined, { "platform.subscriptions.suspend": { data: subscriptionDetails() } });
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: words.liftSuspension.action })).toBeNull();
    const dialog = await openDialog(words.suspend.action, words.suspend.title);
    await fill(dialog, words.reason.label, "Chargeback");
    await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: words.suspend.submit }));
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(inputsSentTo("subscriptions.suspend")).toEqual([{ organizationId, reason: "Chargeback" }]);
    });
  });

  const suspendedByHand = {
    subscription: subscriptionDetails({
      status: "suspended",
      access: "export_only",
      manualSuspension: { at: "2026-10-16T05:00:00.000Z", by: null, reason: "Chargeback" },
    }),
    payments: [],
  };

  it("shows a suspension made by hand, which support can't lift", () => {
    renderSection(suspendedByHand);
    expect(valueOf(words.suspendedByHand)).toHaveTextContent("On 16 Oct: Chargeback");
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: words.suspend.action })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: words.liftSuspension.action })).toBeNull();
  });

  it("lets a super admin lift a suspension made by hand, with a reason", async () => {
    renderSection(
      suspendedByHand,
      { "platform.subscriptions.liftSuspension": { data: subscriptionDetails() } },
      platformStaff("super-admin"),
    );
    const dialog = await openDialog(words.liftSuspension.action, words.liftSuspension.title);
    await fill(dialog, words.reason.label, "Paid in full");
    await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: words.liftSuspension.submit }));
    await vi.waitFor(() => {
      expect(inputsSentTo("subscriptions.liftSuspension")).toEqual([{ organizationId, reason: "Paid in full" }]);
    });
  });

  it("cancels after a reason, and offers no cancel once cancelled", async () => {
    renderSection(undefined, { "platform.subscriptions.cancel": { data: subscriptionDetails() } });
    const dialog = await openDialog(words.cancel.action, words.cancel.title);
    await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: words.cancel.submit }));
    expect(await within(dialog).findByText(words.problems.required)).toBeVisible();
    await fill(dialog, words.reason.label, "Closed the business");
```

```ts
// An organization's subscription in the console (spec 7.3, 7.4): a past-due agency is active again once support
// records its payment; and a suspension made by hand shows in the console while the agency's own calls are refused.
import { addDays, calendarDateIn } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { expect, signInToConsole, test } from "./support/console";
import { signInByEmail } from "./support/fixtures";

const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

test("a past-due agency becomes active when support records a payment", async ({ page, support, agency, database }) => {
  // Paid through three days ago: past due today, by the lifecycle's own reckoning.
  await database.platform.subscription.update({
    where: { organizationId: agency.organizationId },
    data: { paidThrough: new Date(Date.now() - 3 * DAY_MS) },
  });
  await signInToConsole(page, support);
  await page.goto(`/console/organizations/${agency.organizationId}`);
  const subscription = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Subscription" });
  await expect(subscription.getByText("Payment due")).toBeVisible();

  await subscription.getByRole("button", { name: "Record a payment" }).click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Record a payment" });
  await dialog.getByLabel("Amount received").fill("2950");
  await dialog.getByLabel("Pays through").fill(addDays(calendarDateIn(new Date(), "Asia/Kolkata"), 30));
  await dialog.getByLabel("Reference").fill("NEFT UTR 412345678901");
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Record the payment" }).click();

  await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(subscription.getByText("Active", { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(subscription.getByText("₹2,950", { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(subscription.getByText("NEFT UTR 412345678901")).toBeVisible();
});

test("a suspension shows in the console, and the agency's calls are refused", async ({ page, support, agency }) => {
  await signInToConsole(page, support);
  await page.goto(`/console/organizations/${agency.organizationId}`);
  const subscription = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Subscription" });
  await subscription.getByRole("button", { name: "Suspend", exact: true }).click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Suspend this organization?" });
  await dialog.getByLabel("Reason").fill("Chargeback on the last payment");
  await dialog.getByRole("button", { name: "Suspend" }).click();

  await expect(dialog).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(subscription.getByText("Suspended", { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(subscription.getByText(/Chargeback on the last payment/)).toBeVisible();

  // The Owner, in a browser of their own: the agency's api refuses what a suspended organization can't do.
  await page.context().clearCookies();
  await signInByEmail(page, agency.owner);
  const refused = await page.request.get("/api/trpc/roles.list");
  expect(refused.status()).toBe(403);
  expect(await refused.json()).toMatchObject({ error: { data: { reason: "ORGANIZATION_SUSPENDED" } } });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/organizations/fields/money-field.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// A rupee amount bound to a form field (DESIGN.md: a ₹ prefix, mono, right-aligned, Indian grouping once the person
// moves on): the text as typed, read into paise by the contracts' own parser when the form is checked.
import { paiseFromRupeesText } from "@travel-crm/contracts/kernel";
import { formatMoney, money } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { CircleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useId } from "react";
import { Controller, type Control, type FieldPath, type FieldValues } from "react-hook-form";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";

/** An amount as the field shows it: "2,950", "1,250.50", without the symbol the field puts beside it. */
export function rupeesFieldText(paise: number): string {
  return formatMoney(money(paise), { symbol: false }).replace(/\.00$/, "");
}

/** "2950" becomes "2,950", "1250.5" becomes "1,250.50"; text that isn't an amount is left for the check to name. */
export function groupedRupees(text: string): string {
  const paise = paiseFromRupeesText(text);
  return paise === null ? text : rupeesFieldText(paise);
}

export function MoneyField<Values extends FieldValues>({
  control,
  name,
  label,
  hint,
}: {
  control: Control<Values>;
  name: FieldPath<Values>;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
}) {
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <Controller
      control={control}
      name={name}
      render={({ field, fieldState }) => {
        const text = typeof field.value === "string" ? field.value : "";
        const describedBy = [hint ? `${id}-hint` : null, fieldState.error ? `${id}-error` : null].filter(
          (part) => part !== null,
        );
        return (
          <Field data-invalid={fieldState.invalid}>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={id}>{label}</FieldLabel>
            <div className="relative">
              <span aria-hidden="true" className="pointer-events-none absolute top-1/2 left-3 -translate-y-1/2">
                ₹
              </span>
              <Input
                id={id}
                name={field.name}
                ref={field.ref}
                value={text}
                inputMode="decimal"
                autoComplete="off"
                className="numbers pl-7 text-right"
                aria-invalid={fieldState.invalid}
                aria-describedby={describedBy.length > 0 ? describedBy.join(" ") : undefined}
                onChange={field.onChange}
                onBlur={() => {
                  field.onChange(groupedRupees(text));
                  field.onBlur();
                }}
              />
            </div>
            {hint && <FieldDescription id={`${id}-hint`}>{hint}</FieldDescription>}
            {fieldState.error && (
              <FieldError id={`${id}-error`} className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                <CircleAlertIcon aria-hidden="true" className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" />
                {fieldState.error.message}
              </FieldError>
            )}
          </Field>
        );
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/organizations/fields/plan-fields.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// Choosing a plan on sale and a billing cycle it is sold on, for onboarding and for a change of plan: each plan with
// its prices, then the cycles of the plan chosen, each with its price before GST.
import type { BillingCycle, PlanSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import type { Control, FieldPath, FieldValues } from "react-hook-form";
import { ChoiceField } from "./choice-field";
import { cyclesOf, priceOf, rupees } from "./plan-prices";
import { SelectField } from "./select-field";

/** The cycle to keep when the plan changes: the one chosen if the new plan is sold that way, else its first. */
export function cycleFor(plan: PlanSummary, current: string): BillingCycle | "" {
  const cycles = cyclesOf(plan);
  return cycles.find((cycle) => cycle === current) ?? cycles[0] ?? "";
}

export function PlanFields<Values extends FieldValues>({
  control,
  planField,
  cycleField,
  plans,
  chosenPlanId,
  onPlanChosen,
}: {
  control: Control<Values>;
  planField: FieldPath<Values>;
  cycleField: FieldPath<Values>;
  /** The plans on sale. */
  plans: PlanSummary[];
  chosenPlanId: string;
  onPlanChosen: (plan: PlanSummary) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.onboard.subscription");
  const chosen = plans.find((plan) => plan.id === chosenPlanId);
  const planLabel = (plan: PlanSummary) =>
    [
      plan.name,
      ...cyclesOf(plan).map((cycle) => t(`planPrices.${cycle}`, { price: rupees(priceOf(plan, cycle) ?? 0) })),
    ].join(" · ");
  return (
    <>
      <SelectField
        control={control}
        name={planField}
        label={t("plan")}
        placeholder={t("planPlaceholder")}
        options={plans.map((plan) => ({ value: plan.id, label: planLabel(plan) }))}
        onChosen={(value) => {
          const plan = plans.find((candidate) => candidate.id === value);
          if (plan) onPlanChosen(plan);
        }}
      />
      {chosen && (
        <ChoiceField
          control={control}
          name={cycleField}
          legend={t("cycle")}
          options={cyclesOf(chosen).map((cycle) => ({
            value: cycle,
            label: t(`cycles.${cycle}`, { price: rupees(priceOf(chosen, cycle) ?? 0) }),
          }))}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/organizations/fields/plan-prices.ts`:**

```ts
// A plan's prices as the console offers it: the billing cycles it is sold on (those it has a price for) and its
// prices in words, in Indian formats, before GST.
import type { BillingCycle, PlanSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { money } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { formatRupees } from "@/lib/format";

export const billingCycles: readonly BillingCycle[] = ["monthly", "yearly"];

/** The plan's flat price for a cycle, in paise, or null when it isn't sold that way. */
export function priceOf(plan: Pick<PlanSummary, "monthlyPricePaise" | "yearlyPricePaise">, cycle: BillingCycle) {
  return cycle === "monthly" ? plan.monthlyPricePaise : plan.yearlyPricePaise;
}

/** The cycles the plan is sold on, monthly first. */
export function cyclesOf(plan: Pick<PlanSummary, "monthlyPricePaise" | "yearlyPricePaise">): BillingCycle[] {
  return billingCycles.filter((cycle) => priceOf(plan, cycle) !== null);
}

/** "₹2,500", "₹1,250.50". */
export function rupees(paise: number): string {
  return formatRupees(money(paise));
}
```

```ts
// A calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD: a day in the organization's zone, never an instant) as Indian screens write it: "16 Oct"
// in the current year, "16 Oct 2027" in another (DESIGN.md section 9).
import { formatDay } from "@/lib/format";

export function formatCalendarDay(date: string, now: Date = new Date()): string {
  // The day as UTC midnight, shown in UTC, so no zone can move it to the day before or after.
  return formatDay(new Date(`${date}T00:00:00Z`), { timeZone: "UTC", now });
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/organizations/subscription/change-form.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// What every subscription change shares: a button that opens its form in a dialog (a sheet on phones), mounted while
// open so it starts from the subscription as it is; the form checked before sending, problems on their fields; the
// api's refusal as a sentence above the button, keeping what was typed; and, once saved, the organization's page and
// the dashboard loaded again and a toast that says what changed.
import { useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { CircleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useCallback, useState, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { useForm, type DefaultValues, type FieldErrors, type FieldValues, type Resolver } from "react-hook-form";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { ResponsiveDialog } from "@/organization/responsive-dialog";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../../data/console-trpc";
import type { Checked, SubscriptionProblem } from "./change-inputs";

export function ChangeDialog({
  label,
  accessibleLabel,
  title,
  description,
  primary = false,
  children,
}: {
  label: string;
  /** A fuller name for the button where its words alone are ambiguous (one in each row of a list). */
  accessibleLabel?: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  /** The section's one primary action (DESIGN.md: one primary per region). */
  primary?: boolean;
  children: (close: () => void) => ReactNode;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const close = useCallback(() => {
    setOpen(false);
  }, []);
  return (
    <>
      <Button
        variant={primary ? "default" : "outline"}
        aria-label={accessibleLabel}
        onClick={() => {
          setOpen(true);
        }}
      >
        {label}
      </Button>
      <ResponsiveDialog open={open} onOpenChange={setOpen} title={title} description={description}>
        {open && children(close)}
      </ResponsiveDialog>
    </>
  );
}

/** A form checked by `check` before it is sent: each problem's words on its field. */
export function useCheckedForm<Values extends FieldValues, Input>(
  defaultValues: DefaultValues<Values>,
  check: (values: Values) => Checked<Values, Input>,
) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.subscription.problems");
  const resolver: Resolver<Values> = (values) => {
    const result = check(values);
    if (result.ok) return { values, errors: {} };
    const errors: Record<string, { type: string; message: string }> = {};
    for (const [field, problem] of Object.entries<SubscriptionProblem | undefined>(result.problems)) {
      if (problem !== undefined) errors[field] = { type: "validate", message: t(problem) };
    }
    return { values: {}, errors: errors as FieldErrors<Values> };
  };
  return useForm<Values>({ resolver, defaultValues });
}

/** After a change: the organization's page and the dashboard load again, and a toast says it is done. */
export function useAfterChange(organizationId: string): (said: string) => Promise<void> {
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  return useCallback(
    async (said: string) => {
      await Promise.all([
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.organizations.get.queryKey({ organizationId }) }),
        queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.dashboard.organizations.pathKey() }),
      ]);
      toast.success(said);
    },
    [queryClient, trpc, organizationId],
  );
}

/** The refusal, if any, and the button that sends the form; red only as a destructive change's last step. */
export function FormFooter({
  pending,
  error,
  label,
  pendingLabel,
  destructive = false,
}: {
  pending: boolean;
  error: unknown;
  label: string;
  pendingLabel: string;
  destructive?: boolean;
}) {
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  return (
    <>
      {error !== null && error !== undefined && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <CircleAlertIcon aria-hidden="true" />
          <AlertDescription>{apiError(error)}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}
      <Button
        type="submit"
        disabled={pending}
        className={cn("self-end", destructive && "bg-status-bad-ink text-on-action hover:bg-status-bad-ink/90")}
      >
        {pending && <Spinner />}
        {pending ? pendingLabel : label}
      </Button>
    </>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/organizations/subscription/change-inputs.ts`:**

```ts
// The subscription forms' values, as text, turned into subscriptions.*'s inputs by the api's own schemas: rupees typed
// as people write them read into paise, a blank optional box as none. Each problem is named on the field it belongs
// to (message keys in "consoleOrganizations.subscription.problems").
import { paiseFromRupeesText } from "@travel-crm/contracts/kernel";
import {
  changePlanInput,
  endAccessInput,
  recordPaymentInput,
  setOverridesInput,
  setPaidThroughInput,
  setTrialEndInput,
  voidPaymentInput,
  type ChangePlanInput,
  type EndAccessInput,
  type PlanModule,
  type RecordPaymentInput,
  type SetOverridesInput,
  type SetPaidThroughInput,
  type SetTrialEndInput,
  type VoidPaymentInput,
} from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import type { z } from "zod";

export type SubscriptionProblem = "required" | "amountInvalid" | "dateInvalid" | "seatsInvalid" | "tooLong";

export type Checked<Values, Input> =
  { ok: true; input: Input } | { ok: false; problems: Partial<Record<keyof Values & string, SubscriptionProblem>> };

/**
 * Parses raw with the schema; each refused input key is put on its form field (`fields`, input key to field), as
 * "required" when the field was left blank and as the field's own problem otherwise.
 */
function check<Values extends Record<string, unknown>, Input>(
  schema: z.ZodType<Input>,
  raw: unknown,
  values: Values,
  fields: Partial<Record<string, keyof Values & string>>,
  problemOf: Partial<Record<keyof Values & string, SubscriptionProblem>>,
): Checked<Values, Input> {
  const parsed = schema.safeParse(raw);
  if (parsed.success) return { ok: true, input: parsed.data };
  const problems: Partial<Record<keyof Values & string, SubscriptionProblem>> = {};
  for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) {
    const field = fields[String(issue.path[0])];
    if (field === undefined || problems[field] !== undefined) continue;
    const value = values[field];
    problems[field] = typeof value === "string" && value.trim() === "" ? "required" : (problemOf[field] ?? "required");
  }
  return { ok: false, problems };
}

/** Paise for rupees typed, or -1 (refused by every amount's schema) for text that isn't an amount. */
const paiseOrInvalid = (text: string) => paiseFromRupeesText(text) ?? -1;

export interface PlanValues extends Record<string, unknown> {
  planId: string;
  billingCycle: string;
}

export function toChangePlanInput(organizationId: string, values: PlanValues): Checked<PlanValues, ChangePlanInput> {
  return check(
    changePlanInput,
    { organizationId, ...values },
    values,
    { planId: "planId", billingCycle: "billingCycle" },
    {},
  );
}

export interface OverridesValues extends Record<string, unknown> {
  extraSeats: string;
  customPrice: string;
  extraModules: PlanModule[];
}

export function toOverridesInput(
  organizationId: string,
  values: OverridesValues,
): Checked<OverridesValues, SetOverridesInput> {
  const raw = {
    organizationId,
    extraSeats: /^\d+$/.test(values.extraSeats.trim()) ? Number(values.extraSeats.trim()) : -1,
    customPricePaise: values.customPrice.trim() === "" ? null : paiseOrInvalid(values.customPrice),
    extraModules: values.extraModules,
  };
  return check(
    setOverridesInput,
    raw,
    values,
    { extraSeats: "extraSeats", customPricePaise: "customPrice", extraModules: "extraModules" },
    { extraSeats: "seatsInvalid", customPrice: "amountInvalid" },
  );
}

export interface TrialEndValues extends Record<string, unknown> {
  trialEndsOn: string;
}

export function toTrialEndInput(
  organizationId: string,
  values: TrialEndValues,
): Checked<TrialEndValues, SetTrialEndInput> {
  return check(
    setTrialEndInput,
    { organizationId, ...values },
    values,
    { trialEndsOn: "trialEndsOn" },
    {
      trialEndsOn: "dateInvalid",
    },
  );
}

export interface PaidThroughValues extends Record<string, unknown> {
  paidThrough: string;
  reason: string;
}

export function toPaidThroughInput(
  organizationId: string,
  values: PaidThroughValues,
): Checked<PaidThroughValues, SetPaidThroughInput> {
  return check(
    setPaidThroughInput,
    { organizationId, ...values },
    values,
    { paidThrough: "paidThrough", reason: "reason" },
    { paidThrough: "dateInvalid", reason: "tooLong" },
  );
}

export interface PaymentValues extends Record<string, unknown> {
  amount: string;
  paidOn: string;
  paidThrough: string;
  reference: string;
}

export function toRecordPaymentInput(
  organizationId: string,
  values: PaymentValues,
): Checked<PaymentValues, RecordPaymentInput> {
  const raw = {
    organizationId,
    amountPaise: values.amount.trim() === "" ? undefined : paiseOrInvalid(values.amount),
    paidOn: values.paidOn,
    paidThrough: values.paidThrough,
    reference: values.reference.trim() === "" ? null : values.reference,
  };
  return check(
    recordPaymentInput,
    raw,
    values,
    { amountPaise: "amount", paidOn: "paidOn", paidThrough: "paidThrough", reference: "reference" },
    { amount: "amountInvalid", paidOn: "dateInvalid", paidThrough: "dateInvalid", reference: "tooLong" },
  );
}

export interface ReasonValues extends Record<string, unknown> {
  reason: string;
}

/** Suspending, lifting a suspension and cancelling: the organization and why. */
export function toEndAccessInput(organizationId: string, values: ReasonValues): Checked<ReasonValues, EndAccessInput> {
  return check(endAccessInput, { organizationId, ...values }, values, { reason: "reason" }, { reason: "tooLong" });
}

export function toVoidPaymentInput(
  organizationId: string,
  paymentId: string,
  values: ReasonValues,
): Checked<ReasonValues, VoidPaymentInput> {
  return check(
    voidPaymentInput,
    { organizationId, paymentId, ...values },
    values,
    { reason: "reason" },
    {
      reason: "tooLong",
    },
  );
}
```
