```tsx
"use client";

// Moving an organization to another plan or billing cycle (subscriptions.changePlan): a plan on sale and a cycle it is
// sold on, starting from the current ones. The plans load when the dialog opens; failing, it says so with Try again.
import type { SubscriptionDetails } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { useMutation, useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useWatch } from "react-hook-form";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { FieldGroup } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../../data/console-trpc";
import { cycleFor, PlanFields } from "../fields/plan-fields";
import { toChangePlanInput, type PlanValues } from "./change-inputs";
import { ChangeDialog, FormFooter, useAfterChange, useCheckedForm } from "./change-form";

export function ChangePlanDialog({ subscription }: { subscription: SubscriptionDetails }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.subscription.changePlan");
  return (
    <ChangeDialog label={t("action")} title={t("title")} description={t("description")}>
      {(close) => <ChangePlanForm subscription={subscription} onDone={close} />}
    </ChangeDialog>
  );
}

function ChangePlanForm({ subscription, onDone }: { subscription: SubscriptionDetails; onDone: () => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.subscription.changePlan");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const plans = useQuery(trpc.plans.list.queryOptions({ includeArchived: false }));
  const onSale = plans.data?.filter((plan) => plan.forSale && !plan.archived);
  const afterChange = useAfterChange(subscription.organizationId);
  const change = useMutation(
    trpc.subscriptions.changePlan.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: async () => {
        await afterChange(t("done"));
        onDone();
      },
    }),
  );
  const check = (values: PlanValues) => toChangePlanInput(subscription.organizationId, values);
  const form = useCheckedForm({ planId: subscription.plan.id, billingCycle: subscription.billingCycle }, check);
  const planId = useWatch({ control: form.control, name: "planId" });
  const submit = form.handleSubmit((values) => {
    const result = check(values);
    if (result.ok) change.mutate(result.input);
  });

  if (!onSale) {
    return plans.isError ? (
      <ErrorState
        message={t("plansLoadFailed")}
        retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")}
        onRetry={() => void plans.refetch()}
      />
    ) : (
      <div role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={t("loading")}>
        <Skeleton className="h-24 w-full" />
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <form noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)} className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <FieldGroup>
        <PlanFields
          control={form.control}
          planField="planId"
          cycleField="billingCycle"
          plans={onSale}
          chosenPlanId={planId}
          onPlanChosen={(plan) => {
            form.setValue("billingCycle", cycleFor(plan, form.getValues("billingCycle")));
          }}
        />
      </FieldGroup>
      <FormFooter pending={change.isPending} error={change.error} label={t("submit")} pendingLabel={t("submitting")} />
    </form>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// The subscription's overrides (spec 7.2, subscriptions.setOverrides): seats bought above the plan's, an agreed price
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The payments recorded against the subscription, newest first: the rupees received (forest: money in), the day paid,
// the day they pay through, the reference, and a way to void one recorded by mistake; a voided one says so and why.
// A table from tablets up, a divided list on phones.
import type { SubscriptionPayment } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { money } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/status-badge";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { formatRupees } from "@/lib/format";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { useWideScreen } from "@/lib/use-wide-screen";
import { formatCalendarDay } from "./calendar-day";
import { VoidPaymentDialog } from "./reason-dialogs";

export function PaymentsList({
  organizationId,
  payments,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  payments: SubscriptionPayment[];
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.subscription.payments");
  const wide = useWideScreen();
  const amount = (payment: SubscriptionPayment) => (
    <span className={cn("numbers", payment.voided === null ? "text-money" : "text-muted-foreground line-through")}>
      {formatRupees(money(payment.amountPaise))}
    </span>
  );
  const state = (payment: SubscriptionPayment) =>
    payment.voided === null ? (
      <VoidPaymentDialog
        organizationId={organizationId}
        payment={payment}
        describedAs={t("describedAs", {
          amount: formatRupees(money(payment.amountPaise)),
          date: formatCalendarDay(payment.paidOn),
        })}
      />
    ) : (
      <span className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1">
        <StatusBadge tone="neutral">{t("voided")}</StatusBadge>
        <span className="text-caption text-muted-foreground break-words">{payment.voided.reason}</span>
      </span>
    );

  if (payments.length === 0) return <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("empty")}</p>;
  if (!wide) {
    return (
      <ul className="divide-y rounded-lg border">
        {payments.map((payment) => (
          <li key={payment.id} className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3 px-4 py-3">
            <span className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-1">
              {amount(payment)}
              <span className="text-label text-muted-foreground">
                {t("paidOnThrough", {
                  paidOn: formatCalendarDay(payment.paidOn),
                  paidThrough: formatCalendarDay(payment.paidThrough),
                })}
              </span>
              {payment.reference !== null && <span className="text-label break-words">{payment.reference}</span>}
            </span>
            {state(payment)}
          </li>
        ))}
      </ul>
    );
  }
  return (
    <Table>
      <TableHeader>
        <TableRow>
          <TableHead scope="col">{t("columns.paidOn")}</TableHead>
          <TableHead scope="col">{t("columns.paidThrough")}</TableHead>
          <TableHead scope="col">{t("columns.reference")}</TableHead>
          <TableHead scope="col" className="text-right">
            {t("columns.amount")}
          </TableHead>
          <TableHead scope="col">
            <span className="sr-only">{t("columns.state")}</span>
          </TableHead>
        </TableRow>
      </TableHeader>
      <TableBody>
        {payments.map((payment) => (
          <TableRow key={payment.id}>
            <TableCell className="numbers">{formatCalendarDay(payment.paidOn)}</TableCell>
            <TableCell className="numbers">{formatCalendarDay(payment.paidThrough)}</TableCell>
            <TableCell className="whitespace-normal break-words">{payment.reference ?? ""}</TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-right">{amount(payment)}</TableCell>
            <TableCell className="text-right">{state(payment)}</TableCell>
          </TableRow>
        ))}
      </TableBody>
    </Table>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/organizations/subscription/price-breakdown.tsx`:**

```tsx
// What the subscription costs per billing cycle, as the api computes it (spec 7.2): the plan's price or the agreed
// one, the extra seats, the amount before GST, CGST and SGST at 9 % each, and the total. Amounts are mono and
// right-aligned with ₹ and Indian grouping, paise shown (an invoice's figures), in ink: they are due, not received.
import type { SubscriptionPrice } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { money } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { formatRupees } from "@/lib/format";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function PriceBreakdown({ price, agreed }: { price: SubscriptionPrice; agreed: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.subscription.price");
  const amount = (paise: number) => formatRupees(money(paise), { paise: "always" });
  const lines = [
    { label: agreed ? t("agreed") : t("plan"), paise: price.basePaise },
    ...(price.extraSeats > 0
      ? [{ label: t("extraSeats", { count: price.extraSeats }), paise: price.extraSeatsPaise }]
      : []),
    { label: t("subtotal"), paise: price.subtotalPaise },
    { label: t("cgst"), paise: price.cgstPaise },
    { label: t("sgst"), paise: price.sgstPaise },
    { label: t(`total.${price.cycle}`), paise: price.totalPaise, total: true },
  ];
  return (
    <table className="w-full max-w-[720px] border-collapse rounded-lg text-body">
      <caption className="mb-2 text-left text-label text-muted-foreground">{t(`caption.${price.cycle}`)}</caption>
      <tbody>
        {lines.map((line) => (
          <tr key={line.label} className="border-b last:border-b-0">
            <th scope="row" className={cn("py-2 pr-4 text-left font-normal", line.total === true && "font-semibold")}>
              {line.label}
            </th>
            <td className={cn("numbers py-2 text-right", line.total === true && "font-medium")}>
              {amount(line.paise)}
            </td>
          </tr>
        ))}
      </tbody>
    </table>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/organizations/subscription/reason-dialogs.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// The changes that take only a reason, kept in the organization's audit log: suspending by hand (whatever is paid; no
// payment lifts it), lifting that suspension (super admins), cancelling (the data kept, locked), and voiding a
// payment recorded by mistake. Suspending and cancelling end the agency's access: their button is red, the dialog
// itself the confirmation.
import type { SubscriptionDetails, SubscriptionPayment } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { TextField } from "@/account/text-field";
import { FieldGroup } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../../data/console-trpc";
import { toEndAccessInput, toVoidPaymentInput, type Checked, type ReasonValues } from "./change-inputs";
import { ChangeDialog, FormFooter, useAfterChange, useCheckedForm } from "./change-form";

function ReasonForm<Input>({
  check,
  send,
  pending,
  error,
  submit: submitLabel,
  submitting,
  destructive = false,
}: {
  check: (values: ReasonValues) => Checked<ReasonValues, Input>;
  send: (input: Input) => void;
  pending: boolean;
  error: unknown;
  submit: string;
  submitting: string;
  destructive?: boolean;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.subscription.reason");
  const form = useCheckedForm({ reason: "" }, check);
  const submit = form.handleSubmit((values) => {
    const result = check(values);
    if (result.ok) send(result.input);
  });
  return (
    <form noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)} className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <FieldGroup>
        <TextField control={form.control} name="reason" label={t("label")} hint={t("hint")} autoComplete="off" />
      </FieldGroup>
      <FormFooter
        pending={pending}
        error={error}
        label={submitLabel}
        pendingLabel={submitting}
        destructive={destructive}
      />
    </form>
  );
}

type EndAccess = "suspend" | "liftSuspension" | "cancel";

/** Suspending, lifting a suspension or cancelling: one dialog each, the same reason form. */
export function EndAccessDialog({ subscription, change }: { subscription: SubscriptionDetails; change: EndAccess }) {
  const t = useTranslations(`consoleOrganizations.subscription.${change}`);
  return (
    <ChangeDialog label={t("action")} title={t("title")} description={t("description")}>
      {(close) => <EndAccessForm organizationId={subscription.organizationId} change={change} onDone={close} />}
    </ChangeDialog>
  );
}

function EndAccessForm({
  organizationId,
  change,
  onDone,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  change: EndAccess;
  onDone: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations(`consoleOrganizations.subscription.${change}`);
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const afterChange = useAfterChange(organizationId);
  const options = {
    onSuccess: async () => {
      await afterChange(t("done"));
      onDone();
    },
  };
  const procedures = {
    suspend: trpc.subscriptions.suspend.mutationOptions(options),
    liftSuspension: trpc.subscriptions.liftSuspension.mutationOptions(options),
    cancel: trpc.subscriptions.cancel.mutationOptions(options),
  };
  const mutation = useMutation(procedures[change]);
  return (
    <ReasonForm
      check={(values) => toEndAccessInput(organizationId, values)}
      send={(input) => {
        mutation.mutate(input);
      }}
      pending={mutation.isPending}
      error={mutation.error}
      submit={t("submit")}
      submitting={t("submitting")}
      destructive={change !== "liftSuspension"}
    />
  );
}

export function VoidPaymentDialog({
  organizationId,
  payment,
  describedAs,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  payment: SubscriptionPayment;
  /** The payment in words, e.g. "₹2,950 paid on 16 Oct", which names its button and dialog. */
  describedAs: string;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.subscription.voidPayment");
  return (
    <ChangeDialog
      label={t("action")}
      accessibleLabel={t("actionFor", { payment: describedAs })}
      title={t("title", { payment: describedAs })}
      description={t("description")}
    >
      {(close) => <VoidPaymentForm organizationId={organizationId} payment={payment} onDone={close} />}
    </ChangeDialog>
  );
}

function VoidPaymentForm({
  organizationId,
  payment,
  onDone,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  payment: SubscriptionPayment;
  onDone: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.subscription.voidPayment");
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const afterChange = useAfterChange(organizationId);
  const voidPayment = useMutation(
    trpc.subscriptions.voidPayment.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: async () => {
        await afterChange(t("done"));
        onDone();
      },
    }),
  );
  return (
    <ReasonForm
      check={(values) => toVoidPaymentInput(organizationId, payment.id, values)}
      send={(input) => {
        voidPayment.mutate(input);
      }}
      pending={voidPayment.isPending}
      error={voidPayment.error}
      submit={t("submit")}
      submitting={t("submitting")}
      destructive
    />
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/organizations/subscription/record-payment-dialog.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// Recording a payment received outside the product (spec 7.4, subscriptions.recordPayment): the rupees received, the
// day they were paid (today in the organization's zone, until changed), the day they pay through, and a reference.
// From today on, it makes the organization active again (a suspension by hand stays), as the api decides.
import { calendarDateIn } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { TextField } from "@/account/text-field";
import { FieldGroup } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../../data/console-trpc";
import { MoneyField } from "../fields/money-field";
import { toRecordPaymentInput, type PaymentValues } from "./change-inputs";
import { ChangeDialog, FormFooter, useAfterChange, useCheckedForm } from "./change-form";

export function RecordPaymentDialog({ organizationId, timeZone }: { organizationId: string; timeZone: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.subscription.recordPayment");
  return (
    <ChangeDialog label={t("action")} title={t("title")} description={t("description")} primary>
      {(close) => <RecordPaymentForm organizationId={organizationId} timeZone={timeZone} onDone={close} />}
    </ChangeDialog>
  );
}

function RecordPaymentForm({
  organizationId,
  timeZone,
  onDone,
}: {
  organizationId: string;
  timeZone: string;
  onDone: () => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.subscription.recordPayment");
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const afterChange = useAfterChange(organizationId);
  const record = useMutation(
    trpc.subscriptions.recordPayment.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: async () => {
        await afterChange(t("done"));
        onDone();
      },
    }),
  );
  const check = (values: PaymentValues) => toRecordPaymentInput(organizationId, values);
  const form = useCheckedForm(
    { amount: "", paidOn: calendarDateIn(new Date(), timeZone), paidThrough: "", reference: "" },
    check,
  );
  const submit = form.handleSubmit((values) => {
    const result = check(values);
    if (result.ok) record.mutate(result.input);
  });
  return (
    <form noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)} className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <FieldGroup>
        <MoneyField control={form.control} name="amount" label={t("amount")} hint={t("amountHint")} />
        <TextField control={form.control} name="paidOn" label={t("paidOn")} type="date" />
        <TextField control={form.control} name="paidThrough" label={t("paidThrough")} type="date" />
        <TextField
          control={form.control}
          name="reference"
          label={t("reference")}
          hint={t("referenceHint")}
          autoComplete="off"
        />
      </FieldGroup>
      <FormFooter pending={record.isPending} error={record.error} label={t("submit")} pendingLabel={t("submitting")} />
    </form>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/organizations/subscription/subscription-section.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// The organization's subscription on its page (spec 7.2-7.4): its state today, beside the one the nightly job last
// recorded when they differ; the next change; a suspension made by hand; the plan, the dates and the overrides; the
// price with GST; what support may change; and the payments. Every change goes through subscriptions.*; lifting a
// suspension is a super admin's, the others either level's.
import type { OrganizationRecord } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import type { SubscriptionWithPayments } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { formatDay } from "@/lib/format";
import { isSuperAdmin, useStaff } from "../../session/staff-context";
import { SubscriptionStatusBadge } from "../../subscription-status";
import { rupees } from "../fields/plan-prices";
import { DetailList, DetailSection, type Detail } from "../organization/detail-list";
import { formatCalendarDay } from "./calendar-day";
import { ChangePlanDialog } from "./change-plan-dialog";
import { PaidThroughDialog, TrialEndDialog } from "./dates-dialogs";
import { OverridesDialog } from "./overrides-dialog";
import { PaymentsList } from "./payments-list";
import { PriceBreakdown } from "./price-breakdown";
import { RecordPaymentDialog } from "./record-payment-dialog";
import { EndAccessDialog } from "./reason-dialogs";

export function SubscriptionSection({
  organization,
  subscription: found,
}: {
  organization: OrganizationRecord;
  subscription: SubscriptionWithPayments | null;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consoleOrganizations.subscription");
  const tStatus = useTranslations("console.status");
  const staff = useStaff();
  if (!found) {
    return (
      <DetailSection id="subscription-heading" heading={t("heading")}>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("none")}</p>
      </DetailSection>
    );
  }
  const { subscription, payments } = found;
  const muted = (text: string) => <span className="text-muted-foreground">{text}</span>;
  const day = (date: string | null) =>
    date === null ? muted(t("notSet")) : <span className="numbers">{formatCalendarDay(date)}</span>;
  const recordedDiffers =
    subscription.recorded.status !== subscription.status || subscription.recorded.since !== subscription.since;
  const details: Detail[] = [
    {
      label: t("status"),
      value: (
        <span className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <span className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
            <SubscriptionStatusBadge status={subscription.status} />
            <span className="text-label">{t("since", { date: formatCalendarDay(subscription.since) })}</span>
          </span>
          {recordedDiffers && (
            <span className="text-label text-muted-foreground">
              {t("recorded", {
                status: tStatus(subscription.recorded.status),
                date: formatCalendarDay(subscription.recorded.since),
              })}
            </span>
          )}
        </span>
      ),
    },
    {
      label: t("nextChange"),
      value:
        subscription.nextChangeOn === null
          ? muted(t("noChangeDue"))
          : t("nextChangeOn", { date: formatCalendarDay(subscription.nextChangeOn) }),
    },
    ...(subscription.manualSuspension
      ? [
          {
            label: t("suspendedByHand"),
            value: t("suspendedOn", {
              date: formatDay(new Date(subscription.manualSuspension.at), { timeZone: organization.timeZone }),
              reason: subscription.manualSuspension.reason,
            }),
          },
        ]
      : []),
    {
      label: t("plan"),
      value: t("planAndCycle", { plan: subscription.plan.name, cycle: t(`cycles.${subscription.billingCycle}`) }),
    },
    { label: t("trialEndsOn"), value: day(subscription.trialEndsOn) },
    { label: t("paidThroughOn"), value: day(subscription.paidThrough) },
    { label: t("extraSeats"), value: <span className="numbers">{subscription.extraSeats}</span> },
    {
      label: t("customPrice"),
      value:
        subscription.customPricePaise === null ? (
          muted(t("customPriceNone"))
        ) : (
          <span className="numbers">{rupees(subscription.customPricePaise)}</span>
        ),
    },
    {
      label: t("extraModules"),
      value:
        subscription.extraModules.length === 0
          ? muted(t("noModules"))
          : subscription.extraModules.map((module) => t(`modules.${module}`)).join(", "),
    },
  ];

  return (
    <DetailSection
      id="subscription-heading"
      heading={t("heading")}
      action={<RecordPaymentDialog organizationId={organization.id} timeZone={organization.timeZone} />}
    >
      <DetailList details={details} />
      <PriceBreakdown price={subscription.price} agreed={subscription.customPricePaise !== null} />
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <ChangePlanDialog subscription={subscription} />
        <OverridesDialog subscription={subscription} />
        {subscription.status === "trial" && <TrialEndDialog subscription={subscription} />}
        <PaidThroughDialog subscription={subscription} />
        {subscription.manualSuspension === null && subscription.status !== "cancelled" && (
          <EndAccessDialog subscription={subscription} change="suspend" />
        )}
        {subscription.manualSuspension !== null && isSuperAdmin(staff) && (
          <EndAccessDialog subscription={subscription} change="liftSuspension" />
        )}
        {subscription.status !== "cancelled" && <EndAccessDialog subscription={subscription} change="cancel" />}
      </div>
      <h3 className="text-section font-semibold">{t("payments.heading")}</h3>
      <PaymentsList organizationId={organization.id} payments={payments} />
    </DetailSection>
  );
}
```

## Track P: The console's platform screens (plans, jobs, the log, staff, data protection)

Spec 5 (permanent deletion, the platform log), 6.1 (platform staff), 7.2-7.4 (plans, the policy) and 9.1 (failed
jobs), on plan 4's console routers (`plans`, `jobs`, `log`, `platformStaff`, `dataProtection`) and Task G1's
console frame. Super admins set the plans and the subscription policy, which support sees read-only; platform staff
see the failed jobs and run one again, and super admins remove a schedule a job left behind; everyone reads the
platform log, each entry by who, what, which organization and when; super admins manage the platform staff, and a
newcomer comes in through the one sign-in page, a new password and two-factor; and super admins export an
organization, delete it for good, or erase one person or record. No api or domain change: every screen is in the
web app's console section.

**Worktree.** Track P starts from the last groundwork commit (Task G2) in its own worktree and branch:

```bash
cd /Users/ak/personal/travel-crm && git worktree add ../travel-crm-05b-console-platform -b foundation/05b-console-platform foundation/05b-screens

```

**Rulings for this track:**

- Every screen asks only plan 4's console api; what the platform log leaves out on purpose (names) the screens look
  up: platform staff by name for super admins (`platformStaff.list`; support sees "Platform staff"), plans by name,
  each organization on a page by `organizations.get`, five at a time.
- What a super admin alone may do, support sees without the actions and one sentence saying so (plans, the policy,
  schedules); the staff and data protection screens show support the api's `SUPER_ADMIN_ONLY` sentence and ask
  nothing of the api.
- The platform's own queues the api treats apart (purges, erasures and exports never retried; the console's own
  schedules never removed) are named in the web app, and a test holds them to the domain's queue constants.
- The temporary passwords are the api's, shown once in their dialog: their calls fail at once offline, and leave the
  mutation cache when the dialog lets go of them, as 5A's staff screen does.
- A purge or an erasure's result comes from the platform log (the newest result above the newest request); the
  purge is offered only once the organization is cancelled and has an export from the last day, each condition
  shown, and both take the organization's code typed.
- The journeys share the platform's plans, policy, jobs, schedules and log with every journey running at once: each
  makes its own (a plan archived again, a queue of its own written as pg-boss 12 writes it, a log entry found by its
  own names), saves the policy unchanged, and purges only its own agency.
- The console's screens show times by India's clocks (G1's `PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE`), "16 Oct, 4:30 pm".

### Task P1: Super admins set the plans and the subscription policy; support sees them read-only

`/console/plans` shows every plan an organization can be put on (spec 7.2): its name and key, whether it is on sale
(the demo's own plan is "Not for sale"), its monthly and yearly prices before GST in Indian grouping ("Not sold" for a
cycle it has no price for) with an extra seat's price under each, the seats, WhatsApp numbers and storage it
includes, and its modules by name; archived plans follow in a section of their own. A super admin creates a plan
(key, name, prices typed as rupees and read into paise digit by digit, limits, modules), changes one (everything but
its key; storage typed in GB keeps the plan's exact bytes when left as shown) and archives one once confirmed; the
api's own schemas check the form before anything is sent, each problem under its field, and a refusal from the api
(`PLAN_CYCLE_IN_USE`, `DEMO_PLAN_LOCKED`) shows its sentence. Below, the subscription policy (spec 7.3, Q3): the
trial's days and the days past due and read-only, shown to everyone, changed by super admins. Support sees it all
without actions, and a line saying only a super admin changes plans and the policy; the console's api refuses
support's changes anyway.

- Create: `apps/web/src/app/console/plans/page.tsx`,
  `apps/web/src/console/plans/{plans-screen,plans-table,plans-list,plan-figures,plan-actions,plan-dialog,plan-form,plan-text-field,modules-field,archive-plan-dialog,policy-section,policy-dialog}.tsx`,
  `apps/web/src/console/plans/{plan-values,policy-values,use-plans,use-policy}.ts`
- Modify: `apps/web/src/i18n/messages/en-IN/console-platform.json` (from `{}`: `modules`, `plans`, `planForm`,
  `policy`)
- Test: `apps/web/test/console/plans/{plan-values,page-title}.test.ts`,
  `apps/web/test/console/plans/{plans-screen,policy}.test.tsx`, `apps/web/test/console/plans/render-console.tsx`,
  `apps/web/test/e2e/console-plans.spec.ts`, `apps/web/test/e2e/support/console-platform.ts`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Task G1's `consoleRoutes.plans`, `useConsoleTRPC()`, `ConsoleProviders`, `useStaff()`,
  `isSuperAdmin(staff)`, `StaffProvider`, the console layout's title pattern, and the journeys' `test` (with
  `superAdmin`, `support`, `agency`), `signInToConsole(page, staff)`; Task G2's `formatFileSize(bytes)`; plan 4's
  `plans.{list,create,update,archive,policy,setPolicy}` with `createPlanInput`, `updatePlanInput`, `planSummary`,

```ts
// The plan form keeps plain text: rupees as people type them ("4,999", "1,250.50") and storage in GB, read into paise
// and bytes without a float. The api's own schema decides what's valid, and each problem is shown on its field.
import type { PlanSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import {
  gigabytesTextOf,
  planValues,
  rupeesTextOf,
  toCreatePlanInput,
  toUpdatePlanInput,
  type PlanValues,
} from "@/console/plans/plan-values";

const GIGABYTE = 1024 ** 3;

const values: PlanValues = {
  key: "growth",
  name: "Growth",
  monthlyPrice: "4,999",
  yearlyPrice: "",
  extraSeatMonthlyPrice: "299.50",
  extraSeatYearlyPrice: "",
  seats: "10",
  whatsappNumbers: "2",
  storageGigabytes: "25",
  modules: ["crm", "quotes"],
};

const growth: PlanSummary = {
  id: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000a1",
  key: "growth",
  name: "Growth",
  monthlyPricePaise: 499_900,
  yearlyPricePaise: 4_999_000,
  extraSeatMonthlyPricePaise: null,
  extraSeatYearlyPricePaise: 299_000,
  seatLimit: 10,
  whatsappNumberLimit: 2,
  // Not a whole number of GB: 1,000,000,000,000 bytes is 931.32 GB.
  storageLimitBytes: 1_000_000_000_000,
  modules: ["crm"],
  forSale: true,
  archived: false,
};

describe("toCreatePlanInput", () => {
  it("reads rupees into paise and GB into bytes, a blank price as not sold that way", () => {
    expect(toCreatePlanInput(values)).toEqual({
      ok: true,
      input: {
        key: "growth",
        name: "Growth",
        monthlyPricePaise: 499_900,
        yearlyPricePaise: null,
        extraSeatMonthlyPricePaise: 29_950,
        extraSeatYearlyPricePaise: null,
        seatLimit: 10,
        whatsappNumberLimit: 2,
        storageLimitBytes: 25 * GIGABYTE,
        modules: ["crm", "quotes"],
      },
    });
  });

  it("takes ₹ and spaces as typed, and a fraction of a GB", () => {
    const result = toCreatePlanInput({ ...values, monthlyPrice: " ₹12,50,000.5 ", storageGigabytes: "2.5" });
    expect(result).toMatchObject({
      ok: true,
      input: { monthlyPricePaise: 125_000_050, storageLimitBytes: 2.5 * GIGABYTE },
    });
  });

  it("asks for a monthly or a yearly price when both are blank", () => {
    expect(toCreatePlanInput({ ...values, monthlyPrice: "", yearlyPrice: " " })).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problems: { monthlyPrice: "priceRequired" },
    });
  });

  it("puts each problem on its field", () => {
    expect(
      toCreatePlanInput({
        key: "Growth plan",
        name: " ",
        monthlyPrice: "4.999.00",
        yearlyPrice: "-10",
        extraSeatMonthlyPrice: "abc",
        extraSeatYearlyPrice: "3,00,00,000",
        seats: "0",
        whatsappNumbers: "2.5",
        storageGigabytes: "0",
        modules: [],
      }),
    ).toEqual({
      ok: false,
      problems: {
        key: "keyInvalid",
        name: "nameRequired",
        monthlyPrice: "priceInvalid",
        yearlyPrice: "priceInvalid",
        extraSeatMonthlyPrice: "priceInvalid",
        extraSeatYearlyPrice: "priceInvalid",
        seats: "seatsInvalid",
        whatsappNumbers: "whatsappInvalid",
        storageGigabytes: "storageInvalid",
      },
    });
  });
});

describe("toUpdatePlanInput", () => {
  it("sends everything but the key, which never changes", () => {
    const result = toUpdatePlanInput(growth, { ...values, key: "renamed" });
    expect(result).toMatchObject({ ok: true, input: { planId: growth.id, name: "Growth" } });
    expect(result.ok && "key" in result.input).toBe(false);
  });

  it("keeps the plan's exact storage when its GB weren't changed", () => {
    const shown = planValues(growth);
    expect(shown.storageGigabytes).toBe("931.32");
    expect(toUpdatePlanInput(growth, shown)).toMatchObject({
      ok: true,
      input: { storageLimitBytes: 1_000_000_000_000 },
    });
    expect(toUpdatePlanInput(growth, { ...shown, storageGigabytes: "931" })).toMatchObject({
      ok: true,
      input: { storageLimitBytes: 931 * GIGABYTE },
    });
  });
});

describe("planValues", () => {
  it("shows a plan as the form edits it", () => {
    expect(planValues(growth)).toEqual({
      key: "growth",
      name: "Growth",
      monthlyPrice: "4,999",
      yearlyPrice: "49,990",
      extraSeatMonthlyPrice: "",
      extraSeatYearlyPrice: "2,990",
      seats: "10",
      whatsappNumbers: "2",
      storageGigabytes: "931.32",

  it("starts a new plan blank", () => {

      key: "",
      name: "",
      monthlyPrice: "",
      yearlyPrice: "",
      extraSeatMonthlyPrice: "",
      extraSeatYearlyPrice: "",
      seats: "",
      whatsappNumbers: "",
      storageGigabytes: "",
      modules: [],
    });
  });
});

describe("the text of amounts and sizes", () => {
  it("shows rupees with Indian grouping, paise only when there are some", () => {
    expect(rupeesTextOf(null)).toBe("");
    expect(rupeesTextOf(125_000_000)).toBe("12,50,000");
    expect(rupeesTextOf(125_050)).toBe("1,250.50");
  });

  it("shows GB to two decimals at most", () => {
    expect(gigabytesTextOf(25 * GIGABYTE)).toBe("25");
    expect(gigabytesTextOf(2.5 * GIGABYTE)).toBe("2.5");
    expect(gigabytesTextOf(1_000_000_000_000)).toBe("931.32");
  });
});
```

```tsx
// The subscription policy (spec 7.3, Q3): how long a trial lasts and how long an unpaid organization stays past due,
// then read-only. Every platform staff member sees it; a super admin changes it, checked before it is sent.
import { screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { PolicySection } from "@/console/plans/policy-section";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { stubApi } from "../../support/api-stub";
import { platformStaff } from "../../support/platform-staff";
import { screenIs } from "../../organization/render";
import { inputsTo, renderConsole } from "./render-console";

const { policy: words } = messages.consolePlatform;
const policy = { trialDays: 7, pastDueDays: 7, readOnlyDays: 14 };

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("PolicySection", () => {
  it("shows support the policy, without a way to change it", async () => {
    screenIs("wide");
    stubApi({ "platform.plans.policy": { data: policy } });
    renderConsole(<PolicySection />, platformStaff("support"));
    const trial = (await screen.findByText(words.trialDays)).closest("div");
    expect(within(trial ?? document.body).getByText("7 days")).toBeVisible();
    const readOnly = screen.getByText(words.readOnlyDays).closest("div");
    expect(within(readOnly ?? document.body).getByText("14 days")).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: words.change })).toBeNull();
  });

  it("lets a super admin change it, and shows the new days", async () => {
    screenIs("wide");
    const api = stubApi({ "platform.plans.policy": { data: policy } });
    renderConsole(<PolicySection />);
    await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: words.change }));
    const dialog = screen.getByRole("dialog", { name: words.changeTitle });
    const pastDue = within(dialog).getByLabelText(words.pastDueDays);
    await userEvent.clear(pastDue);
    await userEvent.type(pastDue, "10");
    api.answer("platform.plans.setPolicy", { data: { ...policy, pastDueDays: 10 } });
    api.answer("platform.plans.policy", { data: { ...policy, pastDueDays: 10 } });
    await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: messages.common.save }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.saved)).toBeVisible();
    expect(inputsTo("plans.setPolicy")).toEqual([{ trialDays: 7, pastDueDays: 10, readOnlyDays: 14 }]);
    expect(await screen.findByText("10 days")).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("says what to fix before anything is sent", async () => {
    screenIs("wide");
    stubApi({ "platform.plans.policy": { data: policy } });
    renderConsole(<PolicySection />);
    await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: words.change }));
    const dialog = screen.getByRole("dialog", { name: words.changeTitle });
    const readOnly = within(dialog).getByLabelText(words.readOnlyDays);
    await userEvent.clear(readOnly);
    await userEvent.type(readOnly, "0");
    await userEvent.click(within(dialog).getByRole("button", { name: messages.common.save }));
    expect(await within(dialog).findByText(words.problems.readOnlyDays)).toBeVisible();
    expect(inputsTo("plans.setPolicy")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("says when the policy didn't load, and loads it on Try again", async () => {
    screenIs("wide");
    const api = stubApi({ "platform.plans.policy": { status: 403 } });
    renderConsole(<PolicySection />);
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.loadFailed)).toBeVisible();
    api.answer("platform.plans.policy", { data: policy });
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: messages.common.tryAgain }));
    expect(await screen.findAllByText("7 days")).toHaveLength(2);
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/console/plans/render-console.tsx`:**

```tsx
// Renders a console screen as platform staff see it: the console's own data layer over the stubbed api
// (test/support/api-stub.ts), the app's words and toasts, and who is signed in; and reads back what the screen sent.
import { render } from "@testing-library/react";
import { NextIntlClientProvider } from "next-intl";
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import { vi } from "vitest";
import { Toaster } from "@/components/ui/sonner";
import { ConsoleProviders } from "@/console/data/console-providers";
import { StaffProvider, type ConsoleStaff } from "@/console/session/staff-context";
import { locale, messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { platformStaff } from "../../support/platform-staff";

export function renderConsole(ui: ReactNode, staff: ConsoleStaff = platformStaff("super-admin")) {
  // Radix selects and dialogs ask for ResizeObserver, which jsdom lacks; nothing here depends on layout.
  vi.stubGlobal(
    "ResizeObserver",
    class {
      observe = () => undefined;
      unobserve = () => undefined;
      disconnect = () => undefined;
    },
  );
  return render(
    <NextIntlClientProvider locale={locale} messages={messages} timeZone="Asia/Kolkata">
      <ConsoleProviders>
        <StaffProvider staff={staff}>{ui}</StaffProvider>
      </ConsoleProviders>
      <Toaster />
    </NextIntlClientProvider>,
  );
}

/**
 * The inputs each call to a console procedure carried, in call order: a query's from its URL, a mutation's from its
 * body. `path` is the procedure's ("plans.create").
 */
export function inputsTo(path: string): unknown[] {
  const fetch = vi.mocked(globalThis.fetch);
  return fetch.mock.calls.flatMap(([input, init]) => {
    const url = new URL(input instanceof Request ? input.url : String(input), "http://localhost");
    const prefix = "/api/platform/trpc/";
    if (!url.pathname.startsWith(prefix)) return [];
    const paths = decodeURIComponent(url.pathname.slice(prefix.length)).split(",");
    const body = typeof init?.body === "string" ? init.body : (url.searchParams.get("input") ?? "{}");
    const batch = JSON.parse(body) as Record<string, unknown>;
    return paths.flatMap((called, index) => (called === path ? [batch[String(index)]] : []));
  });
}
```

```ts
// The console's plans and policy (spec 7.2, 7.3): a super admin creates a plan, changes its price and archives it;
// support sees the plans and the policy, told that only a super admin changes them. Plans and the policy belong to the
// whole platform: this journey's plan has a key of its own and ends archived, off sale, and the policy is saved with
// the days it already has, so journeys running at the same time see no change.
import { expect, test } from "./support/console";
import { openConsoleScreen, recordWith, uniqueSuffix } from "./support/console-platform";

test("a super admin creates a plan, changes its yearly price and archives it", async ({
  page,
  superAdmin,
}, testInfo) => {
  const suffix = uniqueSuffix();
  const name = `Journey ${suffix}`;
  await openConsoleScreen(page, superAdmin, "/console/plans", "Plans");

  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "New plan" }).click();
  const form = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "New plan" });
  await form.getByLabel("Key").fill(`journey-${suffix}`);
  await form.getByLabel("Name").fill(name);
  await form.getByLabel("Monthly price").fill("4,999");
  await form.getByLabel("Seats included").fill("10");
  await form.getByLabel("WhatsApp numbers").fill("2");
  await form.getByLabel("Storage (GB)").fill("25");
  await form.getByRole("checkbox", { name: "CRM" }).check();
  await form.getByRole("button", { name: "Create plan" }).click();

  const shown = recordWith(page, testInfo, name);
  await expect(shown).toContainText("₹4,999");
  await expect(shown).toContainText("25 GB");
  await shown.getByRole("button", { name: `Actions for ${name}` }).click();
  await page.getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Edit" }).click();
  const edit = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: `Edit ${name}` });
  await edit.getByLabel("Yearly price").fill("49,990");
  await edit.getByRole("button", { name: "Save" }).click();
  await expect(edit).toBeHidden();
  await expect(shown).toContainText("₹49,990");

  await shown.getByRole("button", { name: `Actions for ${name}` }).click();
  await page.getByRole("menuitem", { name: "Archive" }).click();
  await page.getByRole("alertdialog").getByRole("button", { name: "Archive" }).click();
  await expect(recordWith(page.getByRole("region", { name: "Archived" }), testInfo, name)).toBeVisible();
});

test("support sees the plans and the policy, and that only a super admin changes them", async ({
  page,
  support,
  agency,
}) => {
  // The agency's subscription puts the journeys' own plan on sale, so there is one to see.
  expect(agency.code).not.toBe("");
  await openConsoleScreen(page, support, "/console/plans", "Plans");
  await expect(page.getByText("Only a super admin can change plans and the policy.")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText("Everything (tests)").first()).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "New plan" })).toHaveCount(0);
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: /^Actions for / })).toHaveCount(0);
  const policy = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Subscription policy" });
  await expect(policy.getByText("Trial days", { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(policy.getByRole("button", { name: "Change the policy" })).toHaveCount(0);
});

test("a super admin saves the subscription policy", async ({ page, superAdmin }) => {
  await openConsoleScreen(page, superAdmin, "/console/plans", "Plans");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Change the policy" }).click();
  const dialog = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Change the policy" });
```

**Create `apps/web/test/e2e/support/console-platform.ts`:**

```ts
// Steps the journeys of the console's platform screens share: opening a screen as platform staff, finding one record
// on it as a phone or a desktop shows it, and names of a journey's own, since plans, jobs and the platform log are the
// whole platform's, seen by every journey running at once.
import { expect, type Locator, type Page, type TestInfo } from "@playwright/test";
import { signInToConsole, type PlatformStaff } from "./console";

/** Signs platform staff in, opens a console screen and waits for its heading. */
export async function openConsoleScreen(page: Page, staff: PlatformStaff, path: string, heading: string) {
  await signInToConsole(page, staff);
  await page.goto(path);
  await expect(page.getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: heading })).toBeVisible();
}

/**
 * The table row on a desktop, or the list item on a phone, that holds the text, within the page's main region (a
 * toast is a list item too) or a part of it.
 */
export function recordWith(scope: Page | Locator, testInfo: TestInfo, text: string): Locator {
  const within = "goto" in scope ? scope.getByRole("main") : scope;
  return within.getByRole(testInfo.project.name === "phone" ? "listitem" : "row").filter({ hasText: text });
}

/** Eight characters of this journey's own, for names no other journey running at once has. */
export function uniqueSuffix(): string {
  return crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8);
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// Archiving a plan, asked once more: nothing un-archives a plan, and no organization can be put on it afterwards.
import type { PlanSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { useArchivePlan } from "./use-plans";

export function ArchivePlanDialog({
  plan,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
}: {
  plan: PlanSummary;
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.plans");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const archive = useArchivePlan();
  return (
    <AlertDialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogTitle>{t("archiveTitle", { name: plan.name })}</AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>{t("archiveDescription")}</AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        {archive.isError && (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertDescription>{apiError(archive.error)}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel>{tCommon("cancel")}</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction
            // The final step of a destructive action is the one place red fills a button (DESIGN.md section 6).
            className="bg-status-bad-ink text-on-action hover:bg-status-bad-ink/90"
            disabled={archive.isPending}
            onClick={(event) => {
              // Stay open until the api answers, so a refusal is shown here and the button can't be pressed twice.
              event.preventDefault();
              archive.mutate(
                { planId: plan.id },
                {
                  onSuccess: () => {
                    onOpenChange(false);
                  },
                },
              );
            }}
          >
            {t("archiveConfirm")}
          </AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The business modules a plan includes, one checkbox each in spec 1's build order. The Foundation's own features
// (staff, roles, settings, the audit log, documents) come with every plan, so they are not offered.
import { planModules, type PlanModule } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useId } from "react";
import { Controller, type Control } from "react-hook-form";
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldLabel, FieldLegend, FieldSet } from "@/components/ui/field";
import type { PlanValues } from "./plan-values";

/** The modules ticked, in the catalog's order whatever order they were ticked in. */
function withModule(modules: PlanModule[], module: PlanModule, included: boolean): PlanModule[] {
  return planModules.filter((entry) => (entry === module ? included : modules.includes(entry)));
}

export function ModulesField({ control }: { control: Control<PlanValues> }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform");
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <Controller
      control={control}
      name="modules"
      render={({ field }) => (
        <FieldSet>
          <FieldLegend variant="label">{t("planForm.modules")}</FieldLegend>
          <FieldDescription>{t("planForm.modulesHint")}</FieldDescription>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-x-4 sm:grid-cols-2">
            {planModules.map((module) => (
              <Field key={module} orientation="horizontal" className="min-h-11">
                <Checkbox
                  id={`${id}-${module}`}
                  checked={field.value.includes(module)}
                  onCheckedChange={(checked) => {
                    field.onChange(withModule(field.value, module, checked === true));
                  }}
                />
                <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-${module}`} className="font-normal">
                  {t(`modules.${module}`)}
                </FieldLabel>
              </Field>
            ))}
          </div>
        </FieldSet>
      )}
    />
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// A super admin's actions on one plan: change it, or archive it. The demo's own plan is never archived (the api
// refuses: DEMO_PLAN_LOCKED), so it offers only a change.
import type { PlanSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { EllipsisVerticalIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
import { ArchivePlanDialog } from "./archive-plan-dialog";
import { PlanDialog } from "./plan-dialog";

type OpenDialog = "edit" | "archive" | null;

export function PlanActions({ plan }: { plan: PlanSummary }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.plans");
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<OpenDialog>(null);
  const closeWhen = (dialog: Exclude<OpenDialog, null>) => (next: boolean) => {
    setOpen(next ? dialog : null);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <DropdownMenu>
        <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label={t("actionsFor", { name: plan.name })}>
            <EllipsisVerticalIcon aria-hidden="true" />
          </Button>
        </DropdownMenuTrigger>
        <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
          <DropdownMenuItem
            onSelect={() => {
              setOpen("edit");
            }}
          >
            {t("edit")}
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          {plan.forSale && (
            <DropdownMenuItem
              className="text-destructive"
              onSelect={() => {
                setOpen("archive");
              }}
            >
              {t("archive")}
            </DropdownMenuItem>
          )}
        </DropdownMenuContent>
      </DropdownMenu>
      {open === "edit" && <PlanDialog plan={plan} open onOpenChange={closeWhen("edit")} />}
      {open === "archive" && <ArchivePlanDialog plan={plan} open onOpenChange={closeWhen("archive")} />}
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// One plan as the console shows it: each price before GST in Indian grouping ("Not sold" for a cycle it has no price
// for), its seats, WhatsApp numbers and storage, its modules by name, and its state as a dot and a word.
import type { PlanSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { money } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useCallback } from "react";
import { StatusBadge } from "@/components/status-badge";
import { formatFileSize } from "@/files/file-size";
import { formatCount, formatRupees } from "@/lib/format";

export interface PlanFigures {
  monthly: string;
  yearly: string;
  /** Null when the plan sells no extra seats on that cycle. */
  extraSeatMonthly: string | null;
  extraSeatYearly: string | null;
  seats: string;
  whatsappNumbers: string;
  storage: string;
  modules: string;
}

const priceOf = (paise: number | null) => (paise === null ? null : formatRupees(money(paise)));

export function usePlanFigures(): (plan: PlanSummary) => PlanFigures {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform");
  return useCallback(
    (plan: PlanSummary) => ({
      monthly: priceOf(plan.monthlyPricePaise) ?? t("plans.notSold"),
      yearly: priceOf(plan.yearlyPricePaise) ?? t("plans.notSold"),
      extraSeatMonthly: priceOf(plan.extraSeatMonthlyPricePaise),
      extraSeatYearly: priceOf(plan.extraSeatYearlyPricePaise),
      seats: formatCount(plan.seatLimit),
      whatsappNumbers: formatCount(plan.whatsappNumberLimit),
      storage: formatFileSize(plan.storageLimitBytes),
      modules:
        plan.modules.length === 0
          ? t("plans.coreOnly")
          : plan.modules.map((module) => t(`modules.${module}`)).join(", "),
    }),
    [t],
  );
}

/** On sale, archived, or not for sale (the demo's own plan): DESIGN.md's neutral for the last two. */
export function PlanStatusBadge({ plan }: { plan: Pick<PlanSummary, "archived" | "forSale"> }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.plans");
  if (plan.archived) return <StatusBadge tone="neutral">{t("archived")}</StatusBadge>;
  if (!plan.forSale) return <StatusBadge tone="neutral">{t("notForSale")}</StatusBadge>;
  return <StatusBadge tone="good">{t("onSale")}</StatusBadge>;
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/plans/plan-form.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// The plan form, for a new plan or a change to one: its key (new plans only: it never changes), name, prices before
// GST for each cycle and for an extra seat, the seats, WhatsApp numbers and storage it includes, and its modules.
// Checked by the api's own schema before it is sent; a refusal from the api shows above the button.
import type { PlanSummary } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useForm, type FieldErrors, type Resolver } from "react-hook-form";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { FieldDescription, FieldGroup, FieldLegend, FieldSet } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { ModulesField } from "./modules-field";
import { PlanTextField } from "./plan-text-field";
import { planValues, toCreatePlanInput, toUpdatePlanInput, type PlanValues } from "./plan-values";
import { useCreatePlan, useUpdatePlan } from "./use-plans";

export function PlanForm({ plan, onSaved }: { plan?: PlanSummary | undefined; onSaved: () => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.planForm");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const create = useCreatePlan();
  const update = useUpdatePlan();
  const saving = plan ? update : create;
  const toInput = (values: PlanValues) => (plan ? toUpdatePlanInput(plan, values) : toCreatePlanInput(values));
  const resolver: Resolver<PlanValues> = (values) => {
    const result = toInput(values);
    if (result.ok) return { values, errors: {} };
    const errors: FieldErrors<PlanValues> = {};
    for (const [field, problem] of Object.entries(result.problems)) {
      errors[field as keyof PlanValues] = { type: "validate", message: t(`problems.${problem}`) };
    }
    return { values: {}, errors };
  };
  const form = useForm<PlanValues>({ resolver, defaultValues: planValues(plan) });
  const { control } = form;

  const submit = form.handleSubmit((values) => {
    const done = { onSuccess: onSaved };
    if (plan) {
      const result = toUpdatePlanInput(plan, values);
      if (result.ok) update.mutate(result.input, done);
    } else {
      const result = toCreatePlanInput(values);
      if (result.ok) create.mutate(result.input, done);
    }
  });

  return (
    <form noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)} className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      {/* The fields scroll inside the dialog, its button always in view: the form is taller than many screens. The
          sheet on phones scrolls as a whole. The padding keeps the focus ring inside the scrolling box. */}
      <div className="-m-1 p-1 md:max-h-[55dvh] md:overflow-x-hidden md:overflow-y-auto">
        <FieldGroup>
          {!plan && <PlanTextField control={control} name="key" label={t("key")} hint={t("keyHint")} kind="code" />}
          <PlanTextField control={control} name="name" label={t("name")} />
          <FieldSet>
            <FieldLegend variant="label">{t("pricesLegend")}</FieldLegend>
            <FieldDescription>{t("pricesHint")}</FieldDescription>
            <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <PlanTextField control={control} name="monthlyPrice" label={t("monthlyPrice")} kind="rupees" />
              <PlanTextField control={control} name="yearlyPrice" label={t("yearlyPrice")} kind="rupees" />
            </div>
          </FieldSet>
          <FieldSet>
            <FieldLegend variant="label">{t("extraSeatLegend")}</FieldLegend>
            <FieldDescription>{t("extraSeatHint")}</FieldDescription>
            <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
              <PlanTextField
                control={control}
                name="extraSeatMonthlyPrice"
                label={t("extraSeatMonthlyPrice")}
                kind="rupees"
              />
              <PlanTextField
                control={control}
                name="extraSeatYearlyPrice"
                label={t("extraSeatYearlyPrice")}
                kind="rupees"
              />
            </div>
          </FieldSet>
          <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-3">
            <PlanTextField control={control} name="seats" label={t("seats")} kind="number" />
            <PlanTextField control={control} name="whatsappNumbers" label={t("whatsappNumbers")} kind="number" />
            <PlanTextField control={control} name="storageGigabytes" label={t("storageGigabytes")} kind="number" />
          </div>
          <ModulesField control={control} />
        </FieldGroup>
      </div>
      {saving.isError && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertDescription>{apiError(saving.error)}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}
      <Button type="submit" disabled={saving.isPending} className="self-end">
        {t(saving.isPending ? (plan ? "saving" : "creating") : plan ? "save" : "create")}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/plans/plan-text-field.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// One labelled field of the plan form (DESIGN.md section 6: a label above, the problem below with an icon, linked by
// aria-describedby). Numbers are mono; a rupee amount has ₹ before it, sits right-aligned, and takes Indian grouping
// once the field is left, as text: plan-values.ts reads it into paise.
import { paiseFromRupeesText } from "@travel-crm/contracts/kernel";
import { CircleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useId } from "react";
import { Controller, type Control } from "react-hook-form";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { rupeesTextOf, type PlanField, type PlanValues } from "./plan-values";

export function PlanTextField({
  control,
  name,
  label,
  hint,
  kind = "text",
}: {
  control: Control<PlanValues>;
  name: PlanField;
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  kind?: "text" | "code" | "number" | "rupees";
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.planForm");
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <Controller
      control={control}
      name={name}
      render={({ field, fieldState }) => {
        const describedBy = [hint ? `${id}-hint` : null, fieldState.error ? `${id}-error` : null].filter(
          (part) => part !== null,
        );
        return (
          <Field data-invalid={fieldState.invalid}>
            <FieldLabel htmlFor={id}>{label}</FieldLabel>
            <div className="relative">
              {kind === "rupees" && (
                <span
                  aria-hidden="true"
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-y-0 left-3 flex items-center text-muted-foreground"
                >
                  {t("rupeeSymbol")}
                </span>
              )}
              <Input
                id={id}
                {...field}
                autoComplete="off"
                spellCheck={false}
                autoCapitalize={kind === "code" ? "none" : undefined}
                inputMode={kind === "number" || kind === "rupees" ? "decimal" : undefined}
                className={cn(kind !== "text" && "numbers", kind === "rupees" && "pl-7 text-right")}
                aria-invalid={fieldState.invalid}
                // No attribute at all rather than an empty one, which points at nothing.
                aria-describedby={describedBy.length > 0 ? describedBy.join(" ") : undefined}
                onBlur={() => {
                  const paise = kind === "rupees" ? paiseFromRupeesText(field.value) : null;
                  if (paise !== null && paise >= 0) field.onChange(rupeesTextOf(paise));
                  field.onBlur();
                }}
              />
            </div>
            {hint && <FieldDescription id={`${id}-hint`}>{hint}</FieldDescription>}
            {fieldState.error && (
              <FieldError id={`${id}-error`} className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
                <CircleAlertIcon aria-hidden="true" className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" />
                {fieldState.error.message}
              </FieldError>
            )}
          </Field>
        );
      }}
    />
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/plans/plan-values.ts`:**

```ts
// The plan form's values, as text, turned into the api's input: rupees as people type them read into paise and storage
// in GB into bytes, digit by digit, never through a float. The api's own schemas decide what is valid; each problem
// is named so the form shows its message on the field it belongs to.
import { paiseFromRupeesText } from "@travel-crm/contracts/kernel";
import {
  createPlanInput,
  updatePlanInput,
  type CreatePlanInput,
  type PlanModule,
  type PlanSummary,
  type UpdatePlanInput,
} from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { money } from "@travel-crm/domain/kernel";
import { formatRupees } from "@/lib/format";

export interface PlanValues {
  key: string;
  name: string;
  monthlyPrice: string;
  yearlyPrice: string;
  extraSeatMonthlyPrice: string;
  extraSeatYearlyPrice: string;
  seats: string;
  whatsappNumbers: string;
  storageGigabytes: string;
  modules: PlanModule[];
}

export type PlanField = Exclude<keyof PlanValues, "modules">;

/** Message keys in the "consolePlatform.planForm.problems" namespace. */
export type PlanProblem =
  | "keyInvalid"
  | "nameRequired"
  | "priceInvalid"
  | "priceRequired"
  | "seatsInvalid"
  | "whatsappInvalid"
  | "storageInvalid";

export type PlanProblems = Partial<Record<PlanField, PlanProblem>>;

type Result<Input> = { ok: true; input: Input } | { ok: false; problems: PlanProblems };

/** Storage is entered in GB of 1,024 MB, as formatFileSize shows it. */
const GIGABYTE = 1024 ** 3;

/** Each field of the api's input, with the form field it comes from and that field's problem. */
const fieldOf = {
  key: ["key", "keyInvalid"],
  name: ["name", "nameRequired"],
  monthlyPricePaise: ["monthlyPrice", "priceInvalid"],
  yearlyPricePaise: ["yearlyPrice", "priceInvalid"],
  extraSeatMonthlyPricePaise: ["extraSeatMonthlyPrice", "priceInvalid"],
  extraSeatYearlyPricePaise: ["extraSeatYearlyPrice", "priceInvalid"],
  seatLimit: ["seats", "seatsInvalid"],
  whatsappNumberLimit: ["whatsappNumbers", "whatsappInvalid"],
  storageLimitBytes: ["storageGigabytes", "storageInvalid"],
} as const satisfies Record<string, readonly [PlanField, PlanProblem]>;

const isInputField = (value: unknown): value is keyof typeof fieldOf =>
  typeof value === "string" && Object.hasOwn(fieldOf, value);

/** "12,50,000", "1,250.50" or "" for no price: an amount as the form shows it. */
export function rupeesTextOf(paise: number | null): string {
  return paise === null ? "" : formatRupees(money(paise)).replace("₹", "");
}

/** "25", "2.5", "931.32": GB to two decimals at most. */
export function gigabytesTextOf(bytes: number): string {
  const hundredths = Math.round((bytes * 100) / GIGABYTE);
  const fraction = String(hundredths % 100)
    .padStart(2, "0")
    .replace(/0$/, "");
  return hundredths % 100 === 0
    ? String(Math.floor(hundredths / 100))
    : `${String(Math.floor(hundredths / 100))}.${fraction}`;
}

/** The form's values for a plan, or blank ones for a new plan. */
export function planValues(plan?: PlanSummary): PlanValues {
  if (!plan) {
    return {
      key: "",
      name: "",
      monthlyPrice: "",
      yearlyPrice: "",
      extraSeatMonthlyPrice: "",
      extraSeatYearlyPrice: "",
      seats: "",
      whatsappNumbers: "",
      storageGigabytes: "",
      modules: [],
    };
  }
  return {
    key: plan.key,
    name: plan.name,
    monthlyPrice: rupeesTextOf(plan.monthlyPricePaise),
    yearlyPrice: rupeesTextOf(plan.yearlyPricePaise),
    extraSeatMonthlyPrice: rupeesTextOf(plan.extraSeatMonthlyPricePaise),
    extraSeatYearlyPrice: rupeesTextOf(plan.extraSeatYearlyPricePaise),
    seats: String(plan.seatLimit),
    whatsappNumbers: String(plan.whatsappNumberLimit),
    storageGigabytes: gigabytesTextOf(plan.storageLimitBytes),
    modules: plan.modules,
  };
}

/** A typed price in paise, null for a blank one, NaN for text that isn't an amount (the schema then refuses it). */
function paiseOf(text: string): number | null {
  return text.trim() === "" ? null : (paiseFromRupeesText(text) ?? Number.NaN);
}

function wholeNumberOf(text: string): number {
  const digits = text.trim().replaceAll(",", "");
  return /^\d{1,9}$/.test(digits) ? Number(digits) : Number.NaN;
}

/** GB to two decimals in bytes; the plan's own bytes when its GB as shown weren't changed (they may not be whole). */
function bytesOf(text: string, original: PlanSummary | undefined): number {
  const trimmed = text.trim().replaceAll(",", "");
  if (original && trimmed === gigabytesTextOf(original.storageLimitBytes)) return original.storageLimitBytes;
  const match = /^(\d{1,6})(?:\.(\d{1,2}))?$/.exec(trimmed);
  if (!match) return Number.NaN;
  const [, whole = "", fraction = ""] = match;
  return Math.round((Number(whole + fraction.padEnd(2, "0")) * GIGABYTE) / 100);
}

function fieldsOf(values: PlanValues, original?: PlanSummary) {
  return {
    name: values.name,
    monthlyPricePaise: paiseOf(values.monthlyPrice),
    yearlyPricePaise: paiseOf(values.yearlyPrice),
    extraSeatMonthlyPricePaise: paiseOf(values.extraSeatMonthlyPrice),
    extraSeatYearlyPricePaise: paiseOf(values.extraSeatYearlyPrice),
    seatLimit: wholeNumberOf(values.seats),
    whatsappNumberLimit: wholeNumberOf(values.whatsappNumbers),
    storageLimitBytes: bytesOf(values.storageGigabytes, original),
    modules: values.modules,
  };
}

/**
 * The schema's verdict, each problem on its field. A plan priced neither monthly nor yearly is said so whatever else is
 * wrong: the schema checks that only once every field is valid.
 */
function resultOf<Input>(
  parsed: { success: true; data: Input } | { success: false; error: { issues: { path: PropertyKey[] }[] } },
  fields: ReturnType<typeof fieldsOf>,
): Result<Input> {
  const unpriced = fields.monthlyPricePaise === null && fields.yearlyPricePaise === null;
  if (parsed.success && !unpriced) return { ok: true, input: parsed.data };
  const problems: PlanProblems = unpriced ? { monthlyPrice: "priceRequired" } : {};
  for (const issue of parsed.success ? [] : parsed.error.issues) {
    const field = issue.path[0];
    if (!isInputField(field)) continue;
    const [formField, problem] = fieldOf[field];
    problems[formField] ??= problem;
  }
  return { ok: false, problems };
}

export function toCreatePlanInput(values: PlanValues): Result<CreatePlanInput> {
  const fields = fieldsOf(values);
  return resultOf(createPlanInput.safeParse({ key: values.key.trim(), ...fields }), fields);
}

/** Everything but the key, which never changes. */
export function toUpdatePlanInput(plan: PlanSummary, values: PlanValues): Result<UpdatePlanInput> {
  const fields = fieldsOf(values, plan);
  return resultOf(updatePlanInput.safeParse({ planId: plan.id, ...fields }), fields);
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The console's plans (spec 7.2): those an organization can be put on, then the archived ones apart, and the
// subscription policy below. Super admins create, change and archive plans; support sees them all read-only and is
// told why (the console's api refuses support's changes anyway).
import { LayersIcon, LockIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/empty-state";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { PageTitle } from "@/components/page-title";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { useWideScreen } from "@/lib/use-wide-screen";
import { isSuperAdmin, useStaff } from "../session/staff-context";
import { NewPlanButton } from "./plan-dialog";
import { PlansList } from "./plans-list";
import { PlansTable } from "./plans-table";
import { PolicySection } from "./policy-section";
import { usePlans } from "./use-plans";

export function PlansScreen() {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.plans");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const editable = isSuperAdmin(useStaff());
  const wide = useWideScreen();
  const plans = usePlans();
  const Plans = wide ? PlansTable : PlansList;

  const body = () => {
    if (plans.data) {
      const current = plans.data.filter((plan) => !plan.archived);
      const archived = plans.data.filter((plan) => plan.archived);
      if (plans.data.length === 0) {
        return <EmptyState icon={LayersIcon} message={editable ? t("empty") : t("emptyReadOnly")} />;
      }
      return (
        <>
          {current.length > 0 && <Plans plans={current} editable={editable} />}
          {archived.length > 0 && (
            <section aria-labelledby="archived-plans" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
              <h2 id="archived-plans" className="text-section font-semibold">
                {t("archivedTitle")}
              </h2>
              <Plans plans={archived} editable={false} />
            </section>
          )}
        </>
      );
    }
    if (plans.isError) {
      return (
        <ErrorState message={t("loadFailed")} retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")} onRetry={() => void plans.refetch()} />
      );
    }
    return (
      <Delayed>
        <div role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={t("loading")} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {[0, 1, 2].map((row) => (
            <Skeleton key={row} className="h-14 w-full" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </Delayed>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-8">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="flex max-w-[65ch] flex-col gap-2">
          <PageTitle>{t("title")}</PageTitle>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("intro")}</p>
          {!editable && (
            <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-label">
              <LockIcon aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" />
              {t("readOnly")}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        {editable && <NewPlanButton />}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">{body()}</div>
      <PolicySection />
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// A super admin changes the policy: the trial's days, then the days past due and read-only, checked by the api's own
// schema before they are sent. It closes once the api has saved them; a refusal shows above the button.
import type { SubscriptionPolicy } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useForm, type FieldErrors, type Resolver } from "react-hook-form";
import { TextField } from "@/account/text-field";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { FieldGroup } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { ResponsiveDialog } from "@/organization/responsive-dialog";
import { policyValues, toPolicyInput, type PolicyField, type PolicyValues } from "./policy-values";
import { useSetPolicy } from "./use-policy";

const FIELDS: readonly PolicyField[] = ["trialDays", "pastDueDays", "readOnlyDays"];

function PolicyForm({ policy, onSaved }: { policy: SubscriptionPolicy; onSaved: () => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.policy");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const save = useSetPolicy();
  const resolver: Resolver<PolicyValues> = (values) => {
    const result = toPolicyInput(values);
    if (result.ok) return { values, errors: {} };
    const errors: FieldErrors<PolicyValues> = {};
    for (const field of result.problems) errors[field] = { type: "validate", message: t(`problems.${field}`) };
    return { values: {}, errors };
  };
  const form = useForm<PolicyValues>({ resolver, defaultValues: policyValues(policy) });
  const submit = form.handleSubmit((values) => {
    const result = toPolicyInput(values);
    if (result.ok) save.mutate(result.input, { onSuccess: onSaved });
  });
  return (
    <form noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)} className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <FieldGroup>
        {FIELDS.map((field) => (
          <TextField
            key={field}
            control={form.control}
            name={field}
            label={t(field)}
            inputMode="numeric"
            autoComplete="off"
            className="[&_input]:numbers"
          />
        ))}
      </FieldGroup>
      {save.isError && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertDescription>{apiError(save.error)}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}
      <Button type="submit" disabled={save.isPending} className="self-end">
        {save.isPending ? tCommon("saving") : tCommon("save")}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}

export function PolicyDialog({
  policy,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
}: {
  policy: SubscriptionPolicy;
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.policy");
  return (
    <ResponsiveDialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={onOpenChange}
      title={t("changeTitle")}
      description={t("changeDescription")}
    >
      {open && (
        <PolicyForm
          policy={policy}
          onSaved={() => {
            onOpenChange(false);
          }}
        />
      )}
    </ResponsiveDialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The subscription policy (spec 7.3, Q3), shown to all platform staff: how long a trial lasts when onboarding gives
// it no end, and how many days an unpaid organization stays past due, then read-only, before it is suspended. Super
// admins change it.
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { isSuperAdmin, useStaff } from "../session/staff-context";
import { PolicyDialog } from "./policy-dialog";
import type { PolicyField } from "./policy-values";
import { usePolicy } from "./use-policy";

const FIELDS: readonly PolicyField[] = ["trialDays", "pastDueDays", "readOnlyDays"];

export function PolicySection() {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.policy");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const editable = isSuperAdmin(useStaff());
  const policy = usePolicy();
  const [changing, setChanging] = useState(false);

  const body = () => {
    if (policy.data) {
      const days = policy.data;
      return (
        <dl className="grid divide-y rounded-lg border sm:grid-cols-3 sm:divide-x sm:divide-y-0">
          {FIELDS.map((field) => (
            <div key={field} className="flex flex-col gap-1 px-4 py-3">
              <dt className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{t(field)}</dt>
              <dd className="numbers">{t("days", { count: days[field] })}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      );
    }
    if (policy.isError) {
      return (
        <ErrorState message={t("loadFailed")} retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")} onRetry={() => void policy.refetch()} />
      );
    }
    return <Skeleton role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={t("loading")} className="h-16 w-full" />;
  };

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="subscription-policy" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="flex max-w-[65ch] flex-col gap-1">
          <h2 id="subscription-policy" className="text-section font-semibold">
            {t("title")}
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("intro")}</p>
        </div>
        {editable && policy.data && (
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            onClick={() => {
              setChanging(true);
            }}
          >
            {t("change")}
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
      {body()}
      {policy.data && <PolicyDialog policy={policy.data} open={changing} onOpenChange={setChanging} />}
    </section>
  );
}
```
