**Create `apps/web/src/console/plans/policy-values.ts`:**

```ts
// The policy form's values, as text, turned into the api's input: three whole numbers of days, checked by the api's
// own schema (setSubscriptionPolicyInput), each problem on its field.
import { setSubscriptionPolicyInput, type SubscriptionPolicy } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";

export type PolicyField = keyof SubscriptionPolicy;
export type PolicyValues = Record<PolicyField, string>;

const isField = (value: unknown): value is PolicyField =>
  value === "trialDays" || value === "pastDueDays" || value === "readOnlyDays";

export function policyValues(policy: SubscriptionPolicy): PolicyValues {
  return {
    trialDays: String(policy.trialDays),
    pastDueDays: String(policy.pastDueDays),
    readOnlyDays: String(policy.readOnlyDays),
  };
}

const daysOf = (text: string) => (/^\d{1,4}$/.test(text.trim()) ? Number(text.trim()) : Number.NaN);

/** The input, or the fields whose days aren't allowed (each field's message names its range). */
export function toPolicyInput(
  values: PolicyValues,
): { ok: true; input: SubscriptionPolicy } | { ok: false; problems: PolicyField[] } {
  const parsed = setSubscriptionPolicyInput.safeParse({
    trialDays: daysOf(values.trialDays),
    pastDueDays: daysOf(values.pastDueDays),
    readOnlyDays: daysOf(values.readOnlyDays),
  });
  if (parsed.success) return { ok: true, input: parsed.data };
  const problems = parsed.error.issues.map((issue) => issue.path[0]).filter(isField);
  return { ok: false, problems: [...new Set(problems)] };
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/plans/use-plans.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// The plans screen's calls. Each change refreshes every list of plans the console holds (this screen's, with the
// archived ones, and onboarding's, on sale only), and says so in a toast from the hook itself, so it doesn't depend on
// the dialog that asked still being open.
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../data/console-trpc";

export function usePlans() {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  return useQuery(trpc.plans.list.queryOptions({ includeArchived: true }));
}

function useRefreshPlans() {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.plans.list.pathKey() });
}

export function useCreatePlan() {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const refresh = useRefreshPlans();
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.plans");
  return useMutation(
    trpc.plans.create.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: (plan) => {
        toast.success(t("created", { name: plan.name }));
      },
      onSettled: refresh,
    }),
  );
}

export function useUpdatePlan() {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const refresh = useRefreshPlans();
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.plans");
  return useMutation(
    trpc.plans.update.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: (plan) => {
        toast.success(t("saved", { name: plan.name }));
      },
      onSettled: refresh,
    }),
  );
}

export function useArchivePlan() {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const refresh = useRefreshPlans();
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.plans");
  return useMutation(
    trpc.plans.archive.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: (plan) => {
        toast.success(t("archivedToast", { name: plan.name }));
      },
      onSettled: refresh,
    }),
  );
}
```

```ts
"use client";

// The subscription policy's calls: every platform staff member reads it, a super admin saves it. A save refreshes it
// and says so in a toast.
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../data/console-trpc";

export function usePolicy() {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  return useQuery(trpc.plans.policy.queryOptions());
}

export function useSetPolicy() {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.policy");
  return useMutation(
    trpc.plans.setPolicy.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: () => {
        toast.success(t("saved"));
      },
      onSettled: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.plans.policy.queryKey() }),
    }),
  );
}
```

### Task P2: Platform staff see the failed jobs, run one again, tidy the schedules, and read the platform log

`/console/jobs` lists the jobs that failed after their last retry (spec 9.1), newest first and 25 at a time, every
queue's or one queue's (its name checked by the api's own `queueName` before it is asked for): each job's queue,
when it failed (India's clocks) and after how many attempts, its data and its error exactly as the api gives them
(ids and codes only). Platform staff run one again (a toast says so and the list refreshes; a refusal shows its
sentence), but never the platform's purge, erasure or export, whose button is disabled with the reason: they are asked
for again so that every check is made again. Below, the schedules that start jobs, each by its queue, cron and zone:
a super admin removes one a job left behind, once confirmed, while the console's own say why they stay (it registers
them at every start); support sees them read-only, told why. `/console/log` is the platform log (spec 5, 7), newest
first and 50 at a time, each entry readable: what was done (a sentence for every action the platform module records,
the action's own words for one the console doesn't know yet), who did it ("You", other staff by name for super admins,
who may list them, "Platform staff" for support, which may not, "Automatic" for the platform's jobs), the
organization it concerns by its name, linked to its page (by the code the entry kept once it is deleted), the plan,
person, job or record acted on, when, and, on request, what changed field by field.

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing tests**

The screens may not import the domain (`web-reaches-the-api-over-http`), so they name the platform's own queues
themselves; a test holds those names to the domain's constants. The journeys reach pg-boss as the runtime role, the
role the worker and the console run it as, writing the rows pg-boss 12 writes (its `create_queue`, then a job failed
after its one attempt, or a schedule): the web app's tests can't import the jobs adapter. Each journey's job and
schedule are on a queue of its own, which nothing works, so a retried job waits, out of the failed list.

**Create `apps/web/test/console/jobs/failed-jobs.test.tsx`:**

```tsx
// The failed-jobs list (spec 9.1): newest first, a page at a time, optionally one queue's, each job with its queue,
// when it failed, its attempts, its data and its error as the api gives them (ids and codes only). Platform staff
// run one again, but not the platform's purge, erasure or export, which are asked for again instead: the screen says
// why. Loading, empty and failed states are honest.
import type { FailedJobOutput } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { FailedJobsSection } from "@/console/jobs/failed-jobs-section";
import { PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE } from "@/console/platform-time-zone";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { formatDay, formatTime } from "@/lib/format";
import { stubApi, type Answer } from "../../support/api-stub";
import { platformStaff } from "../../support/platform-staff";
import { inputsTo, renderConsole } from "../plans/render-console";

const { jobs: words } = messages.consolePlatform;

function job(overrides: Partial<FailedJobOutput> = {}): FailedJobOutput {
  return {
    id: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000b1",
    queue: "documents.render-pdf",
    data: {
      organizationId: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-000000000002",
      documentId: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000d1",
    },
    attempts: 6,
    failedAt: "2026-10-14T10:00:00.000Z",
    error: "StorageError: NoSuchBucket",
    ...overrides,
  };
}

function open(failed: Answer) {
  const api = stubApi({ "platform.jobs.failed": failed });
  renderConsole(<FailedJobsSection />, platformStaff("support"));
  return api;
}

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("FailedJobsSection", () => {
  it("shows each failed job's queue, when it failed, its attempts, data and error", async () => {
    open({ data: { jobs: [job()], nextCursor: null } });
    const item = (await screen.findByText("documents.render-pdf")).closest("li");
    const shown = within(item ?? document.body);
    const failedAt = new Date(job().failedAt ?? "");
    const day = formatDay(failedAt, { timeZone: PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE });
    expect(shown.getByText(`Failed ${day}, ${formatTime(failedAt, { timeZone: PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE })}`)).toBeVisible();
    expect(shown.getByText("6 attempts")).toBeVisible();
    expect(shown.getByText("documentId")).toBeVisible();
    expect(shown.getByText("0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000d1")).toBeVisible();
    expect(shown.getByText("StorageError: NoSuchBucket")).toBeVisible();
    expect(inputsTo("jobs.failed")).toEqual([{ limit: 25 }]);
  });

  it("says when a job's failure has no time", async () => {
    open({ data: { jobs: [job({ failedAt: null, data: {} })], nextCursor: null } });
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.noTime)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByText(words.noData)).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("runs a failed job again and refreshes the list", async () => {
    const api = open({ data: { jobs: [job()], nextCursor: null } });
    await screen.findByText("documents.render-pdf");
    api.answer("platform.jobs.retry", { data: null });
    api.answer("platform.jobs.failed", { data: { jobs: [], nextCursor: null } });
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.retry }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.retried)).toBeVisible();
    expect(inputsTo("jobs.retry")).toEqual([{ queue: "documents.render-pdf", jobId: job().id }]);
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.empty)).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("says why the platform's purge, erasure and export aren't run again", async () => {
    open({
      data: {
        jobs: [
          job({ id: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000b2", queue: "platform.purge-organization" }),
          job({ id: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000b3", queue: "platform.erase-subject" }),
          job({ id: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000b4", queue: "platform.export-organization" }),
        ],
        nextCursor: null,
      },
    });
    await screen.findByText("platform.purge-organization");
    for (const button of screen.getAllByRole("button", { name: words.retry })) expect(button).toBeDisabled();
    expect(screen.getAllByText(messages.errors.reasons.NOT_RETRYABLE)).toHaveLength(3);
  });

  it("shows the api's sentence when a retry is refused", async () => {
    const api = open({ data: { jobs: [job()], nextCursor: null } });
    await screen.findByText("documents.render-pdf");
    api.answer("platform.jobs.retry", { status: 404, reason: "FAILED_JOB_NOT_FOUND" });
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.retry }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(messages.errors.reasons.FAILED_JOB_NOT_FOUND)).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("shows one queue's failed jobs, and every queue again", async () => {
    const api = open({ data: { jobs: [job()], nextCursor: null } });
    await screen.findByText("documents.render-pdf");
    api.answer("platform.jobs.failed", { data: { jobs: [], nextCursor: null } });
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText(words.queue));
    await userEvent.paste("identity.send-invite");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.filter }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.emptyQueue.replace("{queue}", "identity.send-invite"))).toBeVisible();
    expect(inputsTo("jobs.failed")).toContainEqual({ limit: 25, queue: "identity.send-invite" });

    api.answer("platform.jobs.failed", { data: { jobs: [job()], nextCursor: null } });
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.allQueues }));
    expect(await screen.findByText("documents.render-pdf")).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("says what a queue's name looks like before anything is sent", async () => {
    open({ data: { jobs: [job()], nextCursor: null } });
    await screen.findByText("documents.render-pdf");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByLabelText(words.queue));
    await userEvent.paste("Render PDF");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.filter }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.queueInvalid)).toBeVisible();
    expect(inputsTo("jobs.failed")).toEqual([{ limit: 25 }]);
  });

  it("shows the next page below the first, asked for after the page's last job", async () => {
    const first = job();
    const cursor = { failedAt: first.failedAt, id: first.id };
    const api = open({ data: { jobs: [first], nextCursor: cursor } });
    await screen.findByText("documents.render-pdf");
    api.answer("platform.jobs.failed", {
      data: {
        jobs: [job({ id: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000b9", queue: "identity.send-invite" })],
        nextCursor: null,
      },
    });
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.showMore }));
    expect(await screen.findByText("identity.send-invite")).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByText("documents.render-pdf")).toBeVisible();
    expect(inputsTo("jobs.failed")).toEqual([{ limit: 25 }, { limit: 25, after: cursor }]);
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: words.showMore })).toBeNull();
  });

  it("says when the failed jobs didn't load, and loads them on Try again", async () => {
    const api = open({ status: 403 });
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.loadFailed)).toBeVisible();
    api.answer("platform.jobs.failed", { data: { jobs: [job()], nextCursor: null } });
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: messages.common.tryAgain }));
    expect(await screen.findByText("documents.render-pdf")).toBeVisible();
  });
});
```

```tsx
// The schedules that start jobs (ADR 0010): each with its queue, its cron and its zone. A super admin removes one a job

import { screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";

import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { SchedulesSection } from "@/console/jobs/schedules-section";

import { stubApi } from "../../support/api-stub";
import { platformStaff } from "../../support/platform-staff";
import { inputsTo, renderConsole } from "../plans/render-console";

const { schedules: words } = messages.consolePlatform;

const schedules = [
  { queue: "subscriptions.advance-lifecycle", cron: "15 0 * * *", timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata" },
  { queue: "reports.weekly-digest", cron: "0 8 * * 1", timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata" },

const itemOf = async (queue: string) => within((await screen.findByText(queue)).closest("li") ?? document.body);

afterEach(() => {

    expect(screen.getByText(words.readOnly)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: /Remove/ })).toBeNull();
  });

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: messages.common.tryAgain }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.empty)).toBeVisible();
  });
});
```

```ts
// What a platform log entry changed, field by field, as stored: the fields that differ between its before and after
```

```ts
// The console's jobs (spec 9.1, ADR 0010): support finds a failed job by its queue and runs it again, and it leaves the
// failed list; a super admin removes a schedule a job left behind, once confirmed, while the console's own schedules
// say why they stay. Failed jobs and schedules are the whole platform's, so each journey makes its own, on a queue
// of its own.
import { expect, test } from "./support/console";
import { addFailedJob, addLeftoverSchedule, openConsoleScreen, uniqueSuffix } from "./support/console-platform";

test("support runs a failed job again, and it leaves the failed list", async ({ page, support }) => {
  const queue = `probe.journey-${uniqueSuffix()}`;
  await addFailedJob(queue);
  await openConsoleScreen(page, support, "/console/jobs", "Jobs");
  await page.getByLabel("Queue").fill(queue);
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Show this queue" }).click();

  const failed = page.getByRole("main").getByRole("listitem").filter({ hasText: queue });
  await expect(failed).toContainText("1 attempt");
  await expect(failed).toContainText("ProbeError: failed on purpose");
  await failed.getByRole("button", { name: "Run again" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText("Sent to run again")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(`No failed jobs on ${queue}.`)).toBeVisible();
});

test("a super admin removes a schedule a job left behind, and the console's own stay", async ({ page, superAdmin }) => {
  const queue = `probe.journey-${uniqueSuffix()}`;
  await addLeftoverSchedule(queue);
  await openConsoleScreen(page, superAdmin, "/console/jobs", "Jobs");

  const schedules = page.getByRole("region", { name: "Schedules" });
  await expect(schedules.getByRole("listitem").filter({ hasText: "subscriptions.advance-lifecycle" })).toContainText(
    "The console schedules this job every time it starts",
  );
  await schedules.getByRole("button", { name: `Remove the schedule for ${queue}` }).click();
  await page.getByRole("alertdialog").getByRole("button", { name: "Remove schedule" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText(`The schedule for ${queue} was removed`)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(schedules.getByText(queue)).toHaveCount(0);
});
```

```ts
// platform's, seen by every journey running at once.
```

```ts

/** Calls one of the console's procedures as its screens do, signed in as the page is; returns what it answered. */
export async function consoleCall(page: Page, path: string, input: unknown): Promise<unknown> {
  const response = await page.request.post(`/api/platform/trpc/${path}`, {
    data: input,
    // The console accepts calls only from the web app's own origin, which a browser would send.
    headers: { origin: process.env.E2E_BASE_URL ?? "" },
  });
  expect(response.ok()).toBe(true);
  return ((await response.json()) as { result: { data: unknown } }).result.data;
}

/**
 * Runs SQL on pg-boss's tables as the runtime role, the role the worker and the console run pg-boss as. The journeys
 * reach pg-boss no other way: the web app's tests can't import the jobs adapter.
 */
async function onPgBoss(work: (tx: OrgTx) => Promise<void>): Promise<void> {
  const database = createDatabase(process.env.E2E_DATABASE_URL ?? "");
  try {
    await database.withoutOrg(work);
  } finally {
    await database.disconnect();
  }
}

/**
 * A failed job on a queue of the journey's own, as pg-boss 12 leaves one after its one attempt: the queue
 * (pgboss.create_queue, as its createQueue does), then the job, failed, with ids only in its data and our own words
 * as its error. Nobody works the queue, so a retry leaves the job waiting, out of the failed list.
 */
export async function addFailedJob(queue: string): Promise<void> {
  await onPgBoss(async (tx) => {
    await tx.$executeRaw`SELECT pgboss.create_queue(${queue}, ${JSON.stringify({ policy: "standard", retryLimit: 0 })}::jsonb)`;
    await tx.$executeRaw`
      INSERT INTO pgboss.job (name, data, state, retry_limit, started_on, completed_on, output)
      VALUES (${queue}, ${JSON.stringify({ recordId: crypto.randomUUID() })}::jsonb, 'failed', 0, now(), now(),
              ${JSON.stringify({ message: "ProbeError: failed on purpose" })}::jsonb)`;
  });
}

/** A schedule a job left behind when it went from the code: pg-boss's row for a queue nothing registers. */
export async function addLeftoverSchedule(queue: string): Promise<void> {
  await onPgBoss(async (tx) => {
    await tx.$executeRaw`SELECT pgboss.create_queue(${queue}, ${JSON.stringify({ policy: "standard" })}::jsonb)`;
    await tx.$executeRaw`
      INSERT INTO pgboss.schedule (name, cron, timezone, data, options)
      VALUES (${queue}, '0 8 * * 1', 'Asia/Kolkata', '{}'::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb)`;
  });
}
```

```tsx
// /console/jobs: the jobs that failed after their last retry, and the schedules that start jobs (spec 9.1).
import type { Metadata } from "next";
import { getTranslations } from "next-intl/server";
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/jobs/failed-job-item.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// One failed job as the api gives it (ADR 0010: ids and codes only): its queue, when it failed and after how many
// attempts, its data and its error; and a way to run it again, except for the platform's purge, erasure and export,
// which a super admin asks for again so that every check is made again. The screen says so beside the button.
import type { FailedJobOutput } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useId } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useInstantText } from "../log/instant";
import { ASKED_FOR_AGAIN_QUEUES } from "./platform-queues";
import { useRetryJob } from "./use-failed-jobs";

export function FailedJobItem({ job }: { job: FailedJobOutput }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.jobs");
  const tErrors = useTranslations("errors");
  const instantText = useInstantText();
  const retry = useRetryJob();
  const reasonId = useId();
  const retryable = !ASKED_FOR_AGAIN_QUEUES.has(job.queue);
  const data = Object.entries(job.data);
  return (
    <li className="flex flex-col gap-2 px-4 py-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-1">
        <span className="numbers font-medium break-all">{job.queue}</span>
        <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 text-caption text-muted-foreground">
          <span className="numbers">
            {job.failedAt === null ? t("noTime") : t("failedAt", { when: instantText(job.failedAt) })}
          </span>
          <span className="numbers">{t("attempts", { count: job.attempts })}</span>
        </span>
      </div>
      {data.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-caption text-muted-foreground">{t("noData")}</p>
      ) : (
        <dl aria-label={t("data")} className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 text-caption">
          {data.map(([key, value]) => (
            <div key={key} className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-2">
              <dt className="numbers text-muted-foreground">{key}</dt>
              <dd className="numbers break-all">{String(value)}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>
      )}
      <p className="flex flex-col gap-0.5">
        <span className="text-caption text-muted-foreground">{t("error")}</span>
        <span className="numbers text-label break-all whitespace-pre-wrap">{job.error}</span>
      </p>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-4 gap-y-2">
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          disabled={!retryable || retry.isPending}
          aria-describedby={retryable ? undefined : reasonId}
          onClick={() => {
            retry.mutate({ queue: job.queue, jobId: job.id });
          }}
        >
          {t("retry")}
        </Button>
        {!retryable && (
          <span id={reasonId} className="max-w-[65ch] text-caption text-muted-foreground">
            {tErrors("reasons.NOT_RETRYABLE")}
          </span>
        )}
      </div>
    </li>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The failed jobs (spec 9.1: "after the last retry, a job lands in a failed-jobs list in the platform console"),
// newest first and a page at a time, every queue's or one queue's. Loading shows rows of skeleton; an empty list
// says so, for the queue when one is chosen; a failure says so with a Retry.
import { CircleCheckIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/empty-state";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner";
import { FailedJobItem } from "./failed-job-item";
import { QueueFilter } from "./queue-filter";
import { useFailedJobs } from "./use-failed-jobs";

export function FailedJobsSection() {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.jobs");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const [queue, setQueue] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const failed = useFailedJobs(queue);
  const { jobs } = failed;

  let content;
  if (jobs === undefined) {
    content = failed.isError ? (
      <ErrorState message={t("loadFailed")} retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")} onRetry={() => void failed.refetch()} />
    ) : (
      <Delayed>
        <div role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={t("loading")} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {[0, 1, 2].map((row) => (
            <Skeleton key={row} className="h-24 w-full" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </Delayed>
    );
  } else if (jobs.length === 0) {
    content = <EmptyState icon={CircleCheckIcon} message={queue === null ? t("empty") : t("emptyQueue", { queue })} />;
  } else {
    content = (
      <>
        <ul className="divide-y rounded-lg border">
          {jobs.map((job) => (
            <FailedJobItem key={`${job.queue}:${job.id}`} job={job} />
          ))}
        </ul>
        {failed.hasNextPage && (
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            className="self-center"
            disabled={failed.isFetchingNextPage}
            onClick={() => void failed.fetchNextPage()}
          >
            {failed.isFetchingNextPage && <Spinner />}
            {failed.isFetchingNextPage ? t("loadingMore") : t("showMore")}
          </Button>
        )}
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="failed-jobs" className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <h2 id="failed-jobs" className="text-section font-semibold">
        {t("failedTitle")}
      </h2>
      <QueueFilter queue={queue} onChange={setQueue} />
      {content}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// Narrows the failed jobs to one queue, by its name ("documents.render-pdf", checked by the api's own schema before
// it is asked for), and back to every queue.
import { queueName } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { CircleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";

export function QueueFilter({ queue, onChange }: { queue: string | null; onChange: (queue: string | null) => void }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.jobs");
  const id = useId();
  const [text, setText] = useState(queue ?? "");
  const [invalid, setInvalid] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
      <form
        noValidate
        className="flex flex-wrap items-start gap-3"
        onSubmit={(event) => {
          event.preventDefault();
          const parsed = queueName.safeParse(text.trim());
          setInvalid(!parsed.success);
          if (parsed.success) onChange(parsed.data);
        }}
      >
        <Field data-invalid={invalid} className="max-w-sm flex-1">
          <FieldLabel htmlFor={id}>{t("queue")}</FieldLabel>
          <Input
            id={id}
            value={text}
            className="numbers"
            autoCapitalize="none"
            autoComplete="off"
            spellCheck={false}
            aria-invalid={invalid}
            aria-describedby={invalid ? `${id}-error` : `${id}-hint`}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setText(event.target.value);
            }}
          />
          {invalid ? (
            <FieldError id={`${id}-error`} className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
              <CircleAlertIcon aria-hidden="true" className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" />
              {t("queueInvalid")}
            </FieldError>
          ) : (
            <FieldDescription id={`${id}-hint`}>{t("queueHint")}</FieldDescription>
          )}
        </Field>
        <Button type="submit" variant="outline" className="sm:mt-7">
          {t("filter")}
        </Button>
      </form>
      {queue !== null && (
        <p className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-2">
          <span>{t("showingQueue", { queue })}</span>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            onClick={() => {
              setText("");
              onChange(null);
            }}
          >
            {t("allQueues")}
          </Button>
        </p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/jobs/remove-schedule-dialog.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// Removing a schedule, asked once more: it is for a job the code no longer has, and one the worker or the console
// still registers would only be back at its next start. The api refuses the console's own (SCHEDULE_IS_THE_CONSOLES).
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { useRemoveSchedule } from "./use-schedules";

export function RemoveScheduleDialog({
  queue,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
}: {
  queue: string;
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.schedules");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const remove = useRemoveSchedule();
  return (
    <AlertDialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogTitle>{t("removeTitle", { queue })}</AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>{t("removeDescription")}</AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        {remove.isError && (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertDescription>{apiError(remove.error)}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel>{tCommon("cancel")}</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction
            // The final step of a destructive action is the one place red fills a button (DESIGN.md section 6).
            className="bg-status-bad-ink text-on-action hover:bg-status-bad-ink/90"
            disabled={remove.isPending}
            onClick={(event) => {
              // Stay open until the api answers, so a refusal is shown here and the button can't be pressed twice.
              event.preventDefault();
              remove.mutate(
                { queue },
                {
                  onSuccess: () => {
                    onOpenChange(false);
                  },
                },
              );
            }}
          >
            {t("removeConfirm")}
          </AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/jobs/schedules-section.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// The schedules that start jobs (ADR 0010), each by its queue, its cron and its zone. A super admin removes one a job
// left behind when it went from the code; the console's own are registered at every start, so they say why they stay.
// Support sees them all, and that only a super admin removes one.
import { CalendarClockIcon, LockIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/empty-state";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { isSuperAdmin, useStaff } from "../session/staff-context";
import { CONSOLE_SCHEDULES } from "./platform-queues";
import { RemoveScheduleDialog } from "./remove-schedule-dialog";
import { useSchedules } from "./use-schedules";

export function SchedulesSection() {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.schedules");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const tErrors = useTranslations("errors");
  const removable = isSuperAdmin(useStaff());
  const schedules = useSchedules();
  const [removing, setRemoving] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const body = () => {
    if (schedules.data) {
      if (schedules.data.length === 0) return <EmptyState icon={CalendarClockIcon} message={t("empty")} />;
      return (
        <ul className="divide-y rounded-lg border">
          {schedules.data.map((schedule) => {
            const theConsoles = CONSOLE_SCHEDULES.has(schedule.queue);
            return (
              <li
                key={schedule.queue}
                className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-2 px-4 py-3"
              >
                <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-col gap-0.5">
                  <span className="numbers font-medium break-all">{schedule.queue}</span>
                  <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 text-caption">
                    <span>
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t("cron")}</span>{" "}
                      <span className="numbers">{schedule.cron}</span>
                    </span>
                    <span>
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground">{t("timeZone")}</span> <span>{schedule.timeZone}</span>
                    </span>
                  </span>
                  {removable && theConsoles && (
                    <span className="max-w-[65ch] text-caption text-muted-foreground">
                      {tErrors("reasons.SCHEDULE_IS_THE_CONSOLES")}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                {removable && !theConsoles && (
                  <Button
                    variant="destructive"
                    aria-label={t("removeFor", { queue: schedule.queue })}
                    onClick={() => {
                      setRemoving(schedule.queue);
                    }}
                  >
                    {t("remove")}
                  </Button>
                )}
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      );
    }
    if (schedules.isError) {
      return (
        <ErrorState
          message={t("loadFailed")}
          retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")}
          onRetry={() => void schedules.refetch()}
        />
      );
    }
    return <Skeleton role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={t("loading")} className="h-32 w-full" />;
  };

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="job-schedules" className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="flex max-w-[65ch] flex-col gap-1">
        <h2 id="job-schedules" className="text-section font-semibold">
          {t("title")}
        </h2>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("intro")}</p>
        {!removable && (
          <p className="flex items-center gap-2 text-label">
            <LockIcon aria-hidden="true" className="size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground" />
            {t("readOnly")}
          </p>
        )}
      </div>
      {body()}
      {removing !== null && (
        <RemoveScheduleDialog
          queue={removing}
          open
          onOpenChange={(open) => {
            if (!open) setRemoving(null);
          }}
        />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/jobs/use-failed-jobs.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// The failed-jobs list a page at a time (jobs.failed), newest first, optionally one queue's: each page asks for the
// jobs after the last job of the page before. Running one again refreshes the list and says so in a toast, from the
// hook itself, so it doesn't depend on the job's row still being there.
import { useInfiniteQuery, useMutation, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import type { FailedJobsCursor } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { useConsoleTRPC, useConsoleTRPCClient } from "../data/console-trpc";

export const FAILED_JOBS_PER_PAGE = 25;

export function useFailedJobs(queue: string | null) {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const client = useConsoleTRPCClient();
  const query = useInfiniteQuery({
    queryKey: [...trpc.jobs.failed.pathKey(), { limit: FAILED_JOBS_PER_PAGE, queue }],
    queryFn: ({ pageParam }) =>
      client.jobs.failed.query({
        limit: FAILED_JOBS_PER_PAGE,
        ...(queue === null ? {} : { queue }),
        ...(pageParam === null ? {} : { after: pageParam }),
      }),
    initialPageParam: null as FailedJobsCursor | null,
    getNextPageParam: (page) => page.nextCursor,
  });
  return { ...query, jobs: query.data?.pages.flatMap((page) => page.jobs) };
}

export function useRetryJob() {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.jobs");
  return useMutation(
    trpc.jobs.retry.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: () => {
        toast.success(t("retried"));
      },
      onError: (error) => {
        toast.error(apiError(error), { duration: Infinity });
      },
      onSettled: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.jobs.failed.pathKey() }),
    }),
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/jobs/use-schedules.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// The schedules pg-boss holds (jobs.schedules), and a super admin's removal of one a job left behind, which refreshes
// them and says so in a toast.
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../data/console-trpc";

export function useSchedules() {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  return useQuery(trpc.jobs.schedules.queryOptions());
}

export function useRemoveSchedule() {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.schedules");
  return useMutation(
    trpc.jobs.unschedule.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: (_answer, { queue }) => {
        toast.success(t("removed", { queue }));
      },
      onSettled: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.jobs.schedules.queryKey() }),
    }),
  );
}
```

```ts
"use client";

// An instant as the console shows it: "16 Oct, 4:30 pm" by India's clocks (PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE), with the year when it
// isn't this one (DESIGN.md section 9).
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useCallback } from "react";
import { formatDay, formatTime } from "@/lib/format";
import { PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE } from "../platform-time-zone";

export function useInstantText(): (iso: string) => string {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.time");
  return useCallback(
    (iso: string) => {
      const at = new Date(iso);
      return t("dayAndTime", {
        day: formatDay(at, { timeZone: PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE }),
        time: formatTime(at, { timeZone: PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE }),
      });
    },
    [t],
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/log/log-actions.ts`:**

```ts
// The platform log's actions the console has a sentence for (consolePlatform.log.actions): everything the platform
// module records (packages/domain/src/platform). Another reads as recorded, in its own words, until it has one.
const KNOWN_ACTIONS = [
  "organization.onboarded",
  "organization.updated",
  "organization.export-requested",
  "organization.exported",
  "organization.export-downloaded",
  "organization.export-expired",
  "organization.purge-requested",
  "organization.purge-skipped",
  "organization.purged",
  "subject.exported",
  "subject.erasure-requested",
  "subject.erasure-skipped",
  "subject.erased",
  "plan.created",
  "plan.updated",
  "plan.archived",
  "subscription-policy.changed",
  "subscription.plan-changed",
  "subscription.paid-through-changed",
  "subscription.payment-voided",
  "subscription.cancelled",
  "platform-staff.added",
  "platform-staff.level-changed",
  "platform-staff.password-reset",
  "platform-staff.removed",
  "job.retried",
  "job.retry-failed",
  "schedule.removed",
  "schedule.removal-failed",
  "demo.reset",
] as const;

export type KnownAction = (typeof KNOWN_ACTIONS)[number];

export function isKnownAction(action: string): action is KnownAction {
  return (KNOWN_ACTIONS as readonly string[]).includes(action);
}

/** The kinds of target the log names by a word (consolePlatform.log.targets); others show their own name. */
const NAMED_TARGETS = ["plan", "platform_staff", "job", "member", "traveller"] as const;

export type NamedTarget = (typeof NAMED_TARGETS)[number];

export function isNamedTarget(targetType: string): targetType is NamedTarget {
  return (NAMED_TARGETS as readonly string[]).includes(targetType);
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/log/log-changes.ts`:**

```ts
// What a platform log entry changed, field by field, as stored: the fields that differ between its before and after
// snapshots (a plan's change keeps the whole plan on both sides), and every field of a side the other lacks. Values
// show as stored: text as it is, anything else as JSON.
type Snapshot = Record<string, unknown> | null;

export interface Change {
  field: string;
  /** Null when the entry has no such field on that side. */
  before: string | null;
  after: string | null;
}

const textOf = (value: unknown): string => (typeof value === "string" ? value : JSON.stringify(value));

export function changesOf(before: Snapshot, after: Snapshot): Change[] {
  const fields = [...new Set([...Object.keys(before ?? {}), ...Object.keys(after ?? {})])];
  return fields.flatMap((field) => {
    const was = before !== null && Object.hasOwn(before, field) ? textOf(before[field]) : null;
    const is = after !== null && Object.hasOwn(after, field) ? textOf(after[field]) : null;
    return was === is ? [] : [{ field, before: was, after: is }];
  });
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// One platform log entry, readable: what was done (a sentence, or the action's own words for one the console doesn't
// know yet), who did it, the organization it concerns and what it was about, when, and, on request, what changed.
import type { PlatformLogEntry } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { ArrowRightIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useStaff } from "../session/staff-context";
import { useInstantText } from "./instant";
import { isKnownAction } from "./log-actions";
import { changesOf } from "./log-changes";
import { LogOrganization, LogTarget } from "./log-target";
import type { LogNames } from "./use-log-names";

export function LogEntry({ entry, names }: { entry: PlatformLogEntry; names: LogNames }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.log");
  const viewer = useStaff();
  const instantText = useInstantText();
  const changesId = useId();
  const [showChanges, setShowChanges] = useState(false);
  const changes = changesOf(entry.before, entry.after);
  const what = isKnownAction(entry.action)
    ? t(`actions.${entry.action}`)
    : t("unknownAction", { action: entry.action });
  let who: string;
  if (entry.actorUserId === null) who = t("automatic");
  else if (entry.actorUserId === viewer.userId) who = t("you");
  else who = names.personName(entry.actorUserId) ?? t("platformStaff");

  return (
    <li className="flex flex-col gap-1 px-4 py-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-1">
        <span className="font-medium">{what}</span>
        <span className="numbers text-caption text-muted-foreground">{instantText(entry.occurredAt)}</span>
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-4 gap-y-1 text-label">
        <span className="script-leading">{who}</span>
        <LogOrganization entry={entry} names={names} />
        <LogTarget entry={entry} names={names} />
      </div>
      {changes.length > 0 && (
        <>
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            className="-ml-4 self-start"
            aria-expanded={showChanges}
            aria-controls={changesId}
            onClick={() => {
              setShowChanges(!showChanges);
            }}
          >
            {showChanges ? t("hideChanges") : t("changes")}
          </Button>
          {showChanges && (
            <dl id={changesId} className="flex flex-col gap-1 rounded-lg bg-muted px-3 py-2 text-caption">
              {changes.map((change) => (
                <div key={change.field} className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2">
                  <dt className="numbers text-muted-foreground">{change.field}</dt>
                  <dd className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-2">
                    {change.before !== null && <span className="numbers break-all">{change.before}</span>}
                    {change.before !== null && change.after !== null && (
                      <ArrowRightIcon role="img" aria-label={t("changedTo")} className="size-3.5 shrink-0" />
                    )}
                    {change.after !== null && <span className="numbers break-all">{change.after}</span>}
                  </dd>
                </div>
              ))}
            </dl>
          )}
        </>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/log/log-screen.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// The platform log (spec 5, 7): what platform staff and the platform's own jobs did, newest first, a page at a time.
// Loading shows rows of skeleton; an empty log says so; a failure says so with a Retry.
import { ScrollTextIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/empty-state";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { PageTitle } from "@/components/page-title";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { Spinner } from "@/components/ui/spinner";
import { LogEntry } from "./log-entry";
import { useLogNames } from "./use-log-names";
import { usePlatformLog } from "./use-platform-log";

export function LogScreen() {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.log");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const log = usePlatformLog();
  const { entries } = log;
  const names = useLogNames(entries);

  let content;
  if (entries === undefined) {
    content = log.isError ? (
      <ErrorState message={t("loadFailed")} retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")} onRetry={() => void log.refetch()} />
    ) : (
      <Delayed>
        <div role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={t("loading")} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
          {[0, 1, 2, 3].map((row) => (
            <Skeleton key={row} className="h-16 w-full" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </Delayed>
    );
  } else if (entries.length === 0) {
    content = <EmptyState icon={ScrollTextIcon} message={t("empty")} />;
  } else {
    content = (
      <>
        <ul className="divide-y rounded-lg border">
          {entries.map((entry) => (
            <LogEntry key={entry.id} entry={entry} names={names} />
          ))}
        </ul>
        {log.hasNextPage && (
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            className="self-center"
            disabled={log.isFetchingNextPage}
            onClick={() => void log.fetchNextPage()}
          >
            {log.isFetchingNextPage && <Spinner />}
            {log.isFetchingNextPage ? t("loadingMore") : t("showMore")}
          </Button>
        )}
      </>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="flex max-w-[65ch] flex-col gap-2">
        <PageTitle>{t("title")}</PageTitle>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("intro")}</p>
      </div>
      {content}
    </div>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/log/log-target.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// What a platform log entry was about, readably: the organization it concerns, linked to its page by its name (or
// by the code the entry kept, once it is deleted), and the plan, person, job or record acted on.
import type { PlatformLogEntry } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { consoleRoutes } from "../routes";
import { isNamedTarget } from "./log-actions";
import type { LogNames } from "./use-log-names";

/** A text field of either snapshot, e.g. the code an onboarding or a purge kept. */
function storedText(entry: PlatformLogEntry, field: string): string | null {
  const value = entry.after?.[field] ?? entry.before?.[field];
  return typeof value === "string" ? value : null;
}

export function LogOrganization({ entry, names }: { entry: PlatformLogEntry; names: LogNames }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.log");
  const organizationId = entry.targetOrganizationId;
  if (organizationId === null) return null;
  const code = storedText(entry, "code");
  const known = names.organization(organizationId);
  if (known.state === "deleted") {
    return <span>{code === null ? t("deletedOrganizationWithoutCode") : t("deletedOrganization", { code })}</span>;
  }
  return (
    <Link
      href={consoleRoutes.organization(organizationId)}
      className="text-primary underline-offset-4 script-leading hover:underline"
    >
      {known.state === "found" ? known.name : (code ?? t("organization"))}
    </Link>
  );
}

/** The thing acted on, when it isn't the organization itself; nothing for the policy, which is one of a kind. */
export function LogTarget({ entry, names }: { entry: PlatformLogEntry; names: LogNames }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.log");
  const { targetType, targetId } = entry;
  if (["organization", "subscription", "subscription_policy"].includes(targetType)) return null;
  let name: string | null;
  if (targetType === "plan") name = names.planName(targetId) ?? storedText(entry, "name") ?? storedText(entry, "key");
  else if (targetType === "platform_staff") name = names.personName(targetId);
  else if (targetType === "job") name = storedText(entry, "queue") ?? targetId;
  else name = targetId;
  // Support can't list platform staff: the action already says who was acted on.
  if (name === null) return null;
  return (
    <span>
      <span className="text-muted-foreground">
        {isNamedTarget(targetType) ? t(`targets.${targetType}`) : targetType}
      </span>{" "}
      <span
        className={targetType === "plan" || targetType === "platform_staff" ? "script-leading" : "numbers break-all"}
      >
        {name}
      </span>
    </span>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/log/use-log-names.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// The names a platform log entry is read by, which the log itself never keeps (ADR 0019: ids and codes only, so it
// outlives a purge): platform staff by name for super admins, who may list them (support may not); plans by name;
// organizations by name, or as deleted once they are gone.
import { keepPreviousData, useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import type { PlatformLogEntry } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { refusalOf } from "@/data/api-error";
import { useConsoleTRPC, useConsoleTRPCClient, type ConsoleClient } from "../data/console-trpc";
import { isSuperAdmin, useStaff } from "../session/staff-context";

export type OrganizationName = { state: "unknown" } | { state: "found"; name: string } | { state: "deleted" };

export interface LogNames {
  /** Null when the viewer may not list platform staff, or the person isn't on the list. */
  personName(userId: string): string | null;
  planName(planId: string): string | null;
  organization(organizationId: string): OrganizationName;
}

/** How many organizations are asked for at once: each is a transaction of the console's. */
const AT_ONCE = 5;

/** Each organization's name, or null once it is gone; one that didn't load is left out (its name stays unknown). */
async function organizationNames(client: ConsoleClient, ids: string[]): Promise<Record<string, string | null>> {
  const names: Record<string, string | null> = {};
  for (let start = 0; start < ids.length; start += AT_ONCE) {
    await Promise.all(
      ids.slice(start, start + AT_ONCE).map(async (organizationId) => {
        try {
          names[organizationId] = (await client.organizations.get.query({ organizationId })).organization.name;
        } catch (error) {
          if (refusalOf(error)?.reason === "ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND") names[organizationId] = null;
        }
      }),
    );
  }
  return names;
}

export function useLogNames(entries: PlatformLogEntry[] | undefined): LogNames {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const client = useConsoleTRPCClient();
  const superAdmin = isSuperAdmin(useStaff());
  const staff = useQuery(trpc.platformStaff.list.queryOptions(undefined, { enabled: superAdmin }));
  const plans = useQuery(trpc.plans.list.queryOptions({ includeArchived: true }));
  const organizationIds = useMemo(
    () => [...new Set(entries?.flatMap((entry) => entry.targetOrganizationId ?? []))].sort(),
    [entries],
  );
  const organizations = useQuery({
    queryKey: [...trpc.log.list.pathKey(), "organizations", organizationIds],
    queryFn: () => organizationNames(client, organizationIds),
    enabled: organizationIds.length > 0,
    // A longer page asks again for every organization on it; the names already known stay meanwhile.
    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
  });

  return useMemo(() => {
    const people = new Map(staff.data?.map((person) => [person.userId, person.name]));
    const planNames = new Map(plans.data?.map((plan) => [plan.id, plan.name]));
    const found = organizations.data ?? {};
    return {
      personName: (userId) => people.get(userId) ?? null,
      planName: (planId) => planNames.get(planId) ?? null,
      organization: (organizationId) => {
        const name = found[organizationId];
        if (name === undefined) return { state: "unknown" };
        return name === null ? { state: "deleted" } : { state: "found", name };
      },
    };
  }, [staff.data, plans.data, organizations.data]);
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/log/use-platform-log.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// The platform log a page at a time (log.list), newest first: each page asks for the entries before the last entry
// of the page before.
import { useInfiniteQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useConsoleTRPC, useConsoleTRPCClient } from "../data/console-trpc";

export const LOG_ENTRIES_PER_PAGE = 50;

export function usePlatformLog() {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const client = useConsoleTRPCClient();
  const query = useInfiniteQuery({
    queryKey: [...trpc.log.list.pathKey(), { limit: LOG_ENTRIES_PER_PAGE }],
    queryFn: ({ pageParam }) =>
      client.log.list.query({ limit: LOG_ENTRIES_PER_PAGE, ...(pageParam === null ? {} : { before: pageParam }) }),
    initialPageParam: null as string | null,
    getNextPageParam: (page) => page.nextCursor,
  });
  return { ...query, entries: query.data?.pages.flatMap((page) => page.entries) };
}
```

### Task P3: A super admin manages the platform staff, and a newcomer signs in with two-factor

`/console/staff` is a super admin's alone (spec 5, 6.1; ADR 0019): everyone on the platform staff, each with their
address, level and whether they can use the console yet (a temporary password still to replace, two-factor not yet
on, or "Two-factor on", as one status and a line), when they were added, the viewer marked "You" with no actions
(another super admin changes a super admin), and the removed apart. A super admin adds someone (full name, address,
level, checked by the api's own schema), and the temporary password the api makes is shown this once, with copy,
with what the newcomer must do at first sign-in: replace it and set up two-factor; it is gone once the dialog closes,
as nothing keeps it but its hash. A super admin changes someone's level, gives them a new temporary password (shown
once; it signs them out everywhere) and removes them once confirmed; the api keeps the last super admin, and each
refusal shows its sentence. Support never sees Staff in the navigation; opening the address says it is a super
admin's and asks nothing of the api. The journey follows a newcomer from the super admin's dialog through the one
sign-in page, the new password and two-factor setup the console requires, to the dashboard.

```tsx
// Adding platform staff (ADR 0019): a name, an address and a level; the temporary password the api makes is shown
// once, with copy, and what the newcomer must do at first sign-in (replace it, set up two-factor). It is gone once the
// dialog closes. The api's own schema checks the form first; a refusal shows its sentence.
import { screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { StaffScreen } from "@/console/staff/staff-screen";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { stubApi } from "../../support/api-stub";
import { screenIs } from "../../organization/render";
import { inputsTo, renderConsole } from "../plans/render-console";
import { kavita, viewer } from "./people";

const { staff: words } = messages.consolePlatform;

async function openForm() {
  const api = stubApi({ "platform.platformStaff.list": { data: [kavita] } });
  renderConsole(<StaffScreen />, viewer);
  await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: words.add }));
  return { api, dialog: within(screen.getByRole("dialog", { name: words.addForm.title })) };
}

/** Pasted, one event a field: typing key by key is slow on a busy machine. */
async function fill(field: HTMLElement, value: string) {
  await userEvent.click(field);
  await userEvent.paste(value);
}

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("adding platform staff", () => {
  it("shows the temporary password once, with what the newcomer must do, and forgets it after", async () => {
    screenIs("wide");
    const { api, dialog } = await openForm();
    await fill(dialog.getByLabelText(words.addForm.name), "Neha Joshi");
    await fill(dialog.getByLabelText(words.addForm.email), "Neha@Platform.test");
```

**Create `apps/web/test/e2e/console-staff.spec.ts`:**

```ts
// Platform staff (spec 5, 6.1; ADR 0019): a super admin adds support, who signs in on their own device with the
// temporary password, replaces it, sets up two-factor (the console requires it) and lands on the dashboard, while the
// super admin's list follows. Support opening the staff screen is told it is a super admin's.
import { setUpTwoFactor } from "./support/account-steps";
import { expect, test } from "./support/console";
import { openConsoleScreen, recordWith, uniqueSuffix } from "./support/console-platform";

test("a super admin adds support, who replaces the temporary password and sets up two-factor", async ({
  page,
  browser,
  superAdmin,
}, testInfo) => {
  const email = `support-${uniqueSuffix()}@platform.test`;
  await openConsoleScreen(page, superAdmin, "/console/staff", "Platform staff");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Add platform staff" }).click();
  const form = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Add platform staff" });
  await form.getByLabel("Full name").fill("Neha Joshi");
  await form.getByLabel("Email").fill(email);
  await expect(form.getByRole("radio", { name: "Support" })).toBeChecked();
  // The temporary password is the api's, in its one answer: read it there, then see the screen show it.
  const added = page.waitForResponse((response) => response.url().includes("/api/platform/trpc/platformStaff.add"));
  await form.getByRole("button", { name: "Add", exact: true }).click();
  // The console's client batches its calls: the answer is the batch's one item.
  const [answer] = (await (await added).json()) as [{ result: { data: { temporaryPassword: string } } }];
  const { temporaryPassword } = answer.result.data;
  const handover = page.getByRole("dialog", { name: "Neha Joshi was added" });
  await expect(handover.getByText(temporaryPassword, { exact: true })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(handover.getByText("set up two-factor sign-in")).toBeVisible();
  await handover.getByRole("button", { name: "Done" }).click();
  const newcomer = recordWith(page, testInfo, email);
  await expect(newcomer).toContainText("Must replace the temporary password");
  await expect(newcomer).toContainText("No two-factor yet");

  // Neha, on her own device, signs in on the one sign-in page and is taken through both steps to the console.
  const theirs = await browser.newContext({ baseURL: process.env.E2E_BASE_URL ?? "" });
  const device = await theirs.newPage();
  await device.goto("/console");
  await device.getByRole("textbox", { name: "Email" }).fill(email);
  await device.getByLabel("Password").fill(temporaryPassword);
  await device.getByRole("button", { name: "Sign in" }).click();
  await expect(device).toHaveURL(/\/change-password\?next=%2Fconsole$/);
  await device.getByLabel("Temporary password").fill(temporaryPassword);
  await device.getByLabel("New password", { exact: true }).fill("nehas-own-password");
  await device.getByLabel("New password again").fill("nehas-own-password");
  await device.getByRole("button", { name: "Save new password" }).click();
  await expect(device).toHaveURL(/\/two-factor-setup\?next=%2Fconsole$/);
  await setUpTwoFactor(device, "nehas-own-password");
  await expect(device.getByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: "Dashboard" })).toBeVisible();
  await theirs.close();

  await page.reload();
  await expect(recordWith(page, testInfo, email)).toContainText("Two-factor on");
  await expect(recordWith(page, testInfo, email)).not.toContainText("Must replace the temporary password");
});

test("support opening the staff screen is told it is a super admin's", async ({ page, support }) => {
  await openConsoleScreen(page, support, "/console/staff", "Platform staff");
  await expect(page.getByText("Only a super admin can do this.")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Add platform staff" })).toHaveCount(0);
});
```

As 5A's staff screen does, the two calls that carry a temporary password fail at once when offline rather than wait,

```tsx
"use client";

// "Add platform staff": the form, then the details to hand over once the person exists: their address and the
// temporary password the api made, shown this once.
import type { AddedPlatformStaff, AddPlatformStaffInput } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { UserPlusIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { ResponsiveDialog } from "@/organization/responsive-dialog";
import { AddStaffForm } from "./add-staff-form";
import { PasswordHandover } from "./password-handover";
import { useAddPlatformStaff } from "./use-platform-staff";

export function AddStaffDialog() {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.staff");
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const [added, setAdded] = useState<{ input: AddPlatformStaffInput; answer: AddedPlatformStaff } | null>(null);
  const add = useAddPlatformStaff();

  const changeOpen = (next: boolean) => {
    setOpen(next);
    if (!next) {
      // The temporary password is in the call's answer and in this state: let go of both, so it exists only while
      // this dialog shows it.
      setAdded(null);
      add.reset();
    }
  };

  return (
    <>
      <Button
        onClick={() => {
          changeOpen(true);
        }}
      >
        <UserPlusIcon aria-hidden="true" />
        {t("add")}
      </Button>
      <ResponsiveDialog
        open={open}
        onOpenChange={changeOpen}
        title={added ? t("handover.added", { name: added.input.name }) : t("addForm.title")}
        description={added ? t("handover.shownOnce") : t("addForm.description")}
      >
        {added ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
            <PasswordHandover
              email={added.input.email}
              password={added.answer.temporaryPassword}
              intro={t("handover.intro", { name: added.input.name })}
            />
            <Button
              className="self-end"
              onClick={() => {
                changeOpen(false);
              }}
            >
              {t("handover.done")}
            </Button>
          </div>
        ) : (
          open && (
            <AddStaffForm
              add={add}
              onAdded={(input, answer) => {
                setAdded({ input, answer });
              }}
            />
          )
        )}
      </ResponsiveDialog>
    </>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/staff/add-staff-form.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// The add form: the newcomer's full name, their address (they sign in with it) and their level, checked by the api's
// own schema before it is sent. Problems show under their fields; a refusal from the api shows above the button.
import type { AddedPlatformStaff, AddPlatformStaffInput } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Controller, useForm, type FieldErrors, type Resolver } from "react-hook-form";
import { TextField } from "@/account/text-field";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { FieldGroup } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { toAddStaffInput, type AddStaffValues } from "./add-staff-values";
import { LevelField } from "./level-field";
import type { useAddPlatformStaff } from "./use-platform-staff";

export function AddStaffForm({
  add,
  onAdded,
}: {
  /** The add call, owned by the dialog so that it can clear it (and the password in its answer) when it closes. */
  add: ReturnType<typeof useAddPlatformStaff>;
  onAdded: (input: AddPlatformStaffInput, added: AddedPlatformStaff) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.staff.addForm");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const resolver: Resolver<AddStaffValues> = (values) => {
    const result = toAddStaffInput(values);
    if (result.ok) return { values, errors: {} };
    const errors: FieldErrors<AddStaffValues> = {};
    for (const [field, problem] of Object.entries(result.problems)) {
      errors[field as keyof AddStaffValues] = { type: "validate", message: t(`problems.${problem}`) };
    }
    return { values: {}, errors };
  };
  const form = useForm<AddStaffValues>({ resolver, defaultValues: { name: "", email: "", level: "support" } });
  const submit = form.handleSubmit((values) => {
    const result = toAddStaffInput(values);
    if (!result.ok) return;
    add.mutate(result.input, {
      onSuccess: (added) => {
        onAdded(result.input, added);
      },
    });
  });
  return (
    <form noValidate onSubmit={(event) => void submit(event)} className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <FieldGroup>
        <TextField control={form.control} name="name" label={t("name")} autoComplete="off" />
        <TextField
          control={form.control}
          name="email"
          label={t("email")}
          type="email"
          inputMode="email"
          autoComplete="off"
        />
        <Controller
          control={form.control}
          name="level"
          render={({ field }) => <LevelField value={field.value} onChange={field.onChange} />}
        />
      </FieldGroup>
      {add.isError && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertDescription>{apiError(add.error)}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}
      <Button type="submit" disabled={add.isPending} className="self-end">
        {add.isPending ? t("submitting") : t("submit")}
      </Button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/staff/add-staff-values.ts`:**

```ts
// The add form's values, as text, turned into the api's input (addPlatformStaffInput, whose own schema decides what is
// valid: a name, a real address, a level), each problem named for the field it belongs to.
import {
  addPlatformStaffInput,
  type AddPlatformStaffInput,
  type PlatformStaffLevel,
} from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";

export interface AddStaffValues {
  name: string;
  email: string;
  level: PlatformStaffLevel;
}

/** Message keys in the "consolePlatform.staff.addForm.problems" namespace. */
export type AddStaffProblem = "nameRequired" | "emailInvalid";

const problemOf = { name: "nameRequired", email: "emailInvalid" } as const;

const isField = (value: unknown): value is keyof typeof problemOf => value === "name" || value === "email";

export function toAddStaffInput(
  values: AddStaffValues,
):
  | { ok: true; input: AddPlatformStaffInput }
  | { ok: false; problems: Partial<Record<keyof typeof problemOf, AddStaffProblem>> } {
  const parsed = addPlatformStaffInput.safeParse(values);
  if (parsed.success) return { ok: true, input: parsed.data };
  const problems: Partial<Record<keyof typeof problemOf, AddStaffProblem>> = {};
  for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) {
    const field = issue.path[0];
    if (isField(field)) problems[field] = problemOf[field];
  }
  return { ok: false, problems };
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/staff/change-level-dialog.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// Changing someone's level: support works with organizations, a super admin also manages plans, platform staff and
// permanent deletion. The api refuses to demote the last super admin, and the dialog says so.
import type { PlatformStaffEntry, PlatformStaffLevel } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { ResponsiveDialog } from "@/organization/responsive-dialog";
import { LevelField } from "./level-field";
import { useSetPlatformStaffLevel } from "./use-platform-staff";

export function ChangeLevelDialog({
  person,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
}: {
  person: PlatformStaffEntry;
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.staff.changeLevel");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const [level, setLevel] = useState<PlatformStaffLevel>(person.level ?? "support");
  const change = useSetPlatformStaffLevel(person.name);
  return (
    <ResponsiveDialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={onOpenChange}
      title={t("title", { name: person.name })}
      description={t("description")}
    >
      <form
        className="flex flex-col gap-6"
        onSubmit={(event) => {
          event.preventDefault();
          change.mutate(
            { userId: person.userId, level },
            {
              onSuccess: () => {
                onOpenChange(false);
              },
            },
          );
        }}
      >
        <LevelField value={level} onChange={setLevel} />
        {change.isError && (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertDescription>{apiError(change.error)}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}
        <Button type="submit" disabled={change.isPending || level === person.level} className="self-end">
          {change.isPending ? t("submitting") : t("submit")}
        </Button>
      </form>
    </ResponsiveDialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// A platform staff member's level, as two choices each saying what it allows: support works with organizations; a
// super admin also manages plans, platform staff and permanent deletion (ADR 0019).
import { platformStaffLevel, type PlatformStaffLevel } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useId } from "react";
import { Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldLabel, FieldLegend, FieldSet } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/components/ui/radio-group";

export function LevelField({
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  value: PlatformStaffLevel;
  onChange: (level: PlatformStaffLevel) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.staff");
  const tLevels = useTranslations("console.levels");
  const id = useId();
  return (
    <FieldSet>
      <FieldLegend variant="label">{t("addForm.level")}</FieldLegend>
      <RadioGroup

            </FieldContent>
          </Field>
        ))}
      </RadioGroup>
    </FieldSet>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// Removing someone from the platform staff (ADR 0019), asked once more: they are signed out at once, the
// impersonations they started end, and their address stays taken. The api keeps the last super admin.
import type { PlatformStaffEntry } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { useRemovePlatformStaff } from "./use-platform-staff";

export function RemoveStaffDialog({
  person,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
}: {
  person: PlatformStaffEntry;
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.staff.remove");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const remove = useRemovePlatformStaff(person.name);
  return (
    <AlertDialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogTitle>{t("title", { name: person.name })}</AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>{t("description")}</AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        {remove.isError && (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertDescription>{apiError(remove.error)}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel>{tCommon("cancel")}</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction
            // The final step of a destructive action is the one place red fills a button (DESIGN.md section 6).
            className="bg-status-bad-ink text-on-action hover:bg-status-bad-ink/90"
            disabled={remove.isPending}
            onClick={(event) => {
              // Stay open until the api answers, so a refusal is shown here and the button can't be pressed twice.
              event.preventDefault();
              remove.mutate(
                { userId: person.userId },
                {
                  onSuccess: () => {
                    onOpenChange(false);
                  },
                },
              );
            }}
          >
            {t("confirm")}
          </AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/staff/reset-password-dialog.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// A new temporary password for someone of the platform staff: it signs them out everywhere and ends the impersonations
// they started, and they replace it at their next sign-in. The api makes it; it is shown this once.
import type { PlatformStaffEntry } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { ResponsiveDialog } from "@/organization/responsive-dialog";
import { PasswordHandover } from "./password-handover";
import { useResetPlatformStaffPassword } from "./use-platform-staff";

export function ResetPasswordDialog({
  person,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
}: {
  person: PlatformStaffEntry;
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.staff");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const reset = useResetPlatformStaffPassword();
  const changeOpen = (next: boolean) => {
    // The new password is in the call's answer: let go of it when the dialog closes.
    if (!next) reset.reset();
    onOpenChange(next);
  };
  return (
    <ResponsiveDialog
      open={open}
      onOpenChange={changeOpen}
      title={t("resetPassword.title", { name: person.name })}
      description={reset.isSuccess ? t("handover.shownOnce") : t("resetPassword.description")}
    >
      {reset.isSuccess ? (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
          <PasswordHandover
            email={person.email}
            password={reset.data.temporaryPassword}
            intro={t("resetPassword.done", { name: person.name })}
          />
          <Button
            className="self-end"
            onClick={() => {
              changeOpen(false);
            }}
          >
            {t("handover.done")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
          {reset.isError && (
            <Alert variant="destructive">
              <AlertDescription>{apiError(reset.error)}</AlertDescription>
            </Alert>
          )}
          <Button
            className="self-end"
            disabled={reset.isPending}
            onClick={() => {
              reset.mutate({ userId: person.userId });
            }}
          >
            {reset.isPending ? t("resetPassword.submitting") : t("resetPassword.submit")}
          </Button>
        </div>
      )}
    </ResponsiveDialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// Whether a platform staff member can use the console yet (ADR 0019: a temporary password replaced, two-factor on),
// as one status, a dot and a word, for the step still to take; the second step, when both are, as plain text.

export function SignInState({

}: {
```
