**Create `apps/web/src/console/staff/staff-actions.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// A super admin's actions on someone else of the platform staff: change their level, give them a new temporary
// password, remove them. The api keeps the last super admin (LAST_SUPER_ADMIN), and each dialog shows its refusal.
import type { PlatformStaffEntry } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { EllipsisVerticalIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
import { ChangeLevelDialog } from "./change-level-dialog";
import { RemoveStaffDialog } from "./remove-staff-dialog";
import { ResetPasswordDialog } from "./reset-password-dialog";

type OpenDialog = "level" | "password" | "remove" | null;

export function StaffActions({ person }: { person: PlatformStaffEntry }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.staff");
  const [open, setOpen] = useState<OpenDialog>(null);
  const closeWhen = (dialog: Exclude<OpenDialog, null>) => (next: boolean) => {
    setOpen(next ? dialog : null);
  };
  return (
    <>
      <DropdownMenu>
        <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
          <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" aria-label={t("actionsFor", { name: person.name })}>
            <EllipsisVerticalIcon aria-hidden="true" />
          </Button>
        </DropdownMenuTrigger>
        <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
          <DropdownMenuItem
            onSelect={() => {
              setOpen("level");
            }}
          >
            {t("changeLevel.action")}
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuItem
            onSelect={() => {
              setOpen("password");
            }}
          >
            {t("resetPassword.action")}
          </DropdownMenuItem>
          <DropdownMenuSeparator />
          <DropdownMenuItem
            className="text-destructive"
            onSelect={() => {
              setOpen("remove");
            }}
          >
            {t("remove.action")}
          </DropdownMenuItem>
        </DropdownMenuContent>
      </DropdownMenu>
      {open === "level" && <ChangeLevelDialog person={person} open onOpenChange={closeWhen("level")} />}
      {open === "password" && <ResetPasswordDialog person={person} open onOpenChange={closeWhen("password")} />}
      {open === "remove" && <RemoveStaffDialog person={person} open onOpenChange={closeWhen("remove")} />}
    </>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// Platform staff on phones (DESIGN.md section 6): a divided list, each person's name and whether they can use the
// console yet first, then their address, level and when they were added (or removed). The viewer has no actions.
import type { PlatformStaffEntry } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { formatDay } from "@/lib/format";
import { PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE } from "../platform-time-zone";
import { useStaff } from "../session/staff-context";
import { SignInState } from "./sign-in-state";
import { StaffActions } from "./staff-actions";

export function StaffList({ people, removed = false }: { people: PlatformStaffEntry[]; removed?: boolean }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.staff");
  const tLevels = useTranslations("console.levels");
  const viewer = useStaff();
  const dayOf = (iso: string) => formatDay(new Date(iso), { timeZone: PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE });
  return (
    <ul className="divide-y rounded-lg border">
      {people.map((person) => {
        const isViewer = person.userId === viewer.userId;
        return (
          <li key={person.userId} className="flex items-start gap-2 px-4 py-3">
            <div className="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-1">

                {isViewer && <span className="text-caption text-muted-foreground">{t("you")}</span>}
              </span>
              <span className="text-label break-all">{person.email}</span>
              <span className="text-caption text-muted-foreground">
                {person.level !== null && `${tLevels(person.level)} · `}
                {removed
                  ? t("removedOn", { day: dayOf(person.removedAt ?? person.createdAt) })
                  : t("addedOn", { day: dayOf(person.createdAt) })}
              </span>
              {!removed && <SignInState person={person} />}
            </div>
            {!removed && !isViewer && <StaffActions person={person} />}
          </li>
        );
      })}
    </ul>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/staff/staff-screen.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// The console's platform staff (spec 5, 6.1; ADR 0019), a super admin's alone: everyone on the platform staff, with
// their level and whether they can use the console yet, adding someone, and the removed apart. Support never sees it
// in the navigation; opening it says it is a super admin's, and asks nothing of the api, which would refuse.
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { Delayed } from "@/components/delayed";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { PageTitle } from "@/components/page-title";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { useWideScreen } from "@/lib/use-wide-screen";
import { isSuperAdmin, useStaff } from "../session/staff-context";
import { AddStaffDialog } from "./add-staff-dialog";
import { StaffList } from "./staff-list";
import { StaffTable } from "./staff-table";
import { usePlatformStaff } from "./use-platform-staff";

function StaffLists() {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.staff");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const wide = useWideScreen();
  const staff = usePlatformStaff();
  const People = wide ? StaffTable : StaffList;
  if (staff.data) {
    const current = staff.data.filter((person) => person.level !== null);
    const removed = staff.data.filter((person) => person.level === null);
    return (
      <>
        <People people={current} />
        {removed.length > 0 && (
          <section aria-labelledby="removed-staff" className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            <h2 id="removed-staff" className="text-section font-semibold">
              {t("removedTitle")}
            </h2>
            <People people={removed} removed />
          </section>
        )}
      </>
    );
  }
  if (staff.isError) {
    return (
      <ErrorState message={t("loadFailed")} retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")} onRetry={() => void staff.refetch()} />
    );
  }
  return (
    <Delayed>
      <div role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={t("loading")} className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        {[0, 1, 2].map((row) => (
          <Skeleton key={row} className="h-14 w-full" />
        ))}
      </div>
    </Delayed>
  );
}

export function StaffScreen() {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.staff");
  const tErrors = useTranslations("errors");
  const superAdmin = isSuperAdmin(useStaff());
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="flex max-w-[65ch] flex-col gap-2">
          <PageTitle>{t("title")}</PageTitle>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("intro")}</p>
        </div>
        {superAdmin && <AddStaffDialog />}
      </div>
      {superAdmin ? <StaffLists /> : <p>{tErrors("reasons.SUPER_ADMIN_ONLY")}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/staff/use-platform-staff.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// The platform staff screen's calls, a super admin's alone. Adding someone and a new temporary password carry the
// password in their answer: both fail at once when offline rather than wait, and neither stays in the mutation cache
// after its dialog lets go of it, so the password lives only while the dialog shows it. Every change refreshes the
// list; a level change and a removal say so in a toast from the hook itself.
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../data/console-trpc";

const TEMPORARY_PASSWORD_MUTATION = { networkMode: "always", gcTime: 0 } as const;

export function usePlatformStaff() {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  return useQuery(trpc.platformStaff.list.queryOptions());
}

function useRefreshStaff() {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  return () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.platformStaff.list.queryKey() });
}

export function useAddPlatformStaff() {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const refresh = useRefreshStaff();
  return useMutation(trpc.platformStaff.add.mutationOptions({ ...TEMPORARY_PASSWORD_MUTATION, onSettled: refresh }));
}

export function useResetPlatformStaffPassword() {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const refresh = useRefreshStaff();
  return useMutation(
    trpc.platformStaff.resetPassword.mutationOptions({ ...TEMPORARY_PASSWORD_MUTATION, onSettled: refresh }),
  );
}

export function useSetPlatformStaffLevel(name: string) {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const refresh = useRefreshStaff();
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.staff.changeLevel");
  const tLevels = useTranslations("console.levels");
  return useMutation(
    trpc.platformStaff.setLevel.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: (_answer, { level }) => {
        toast.success(t("changed", { name, level: tLevels(level) }));
      },
      onSettled: refresh,
    }),
  );
}

export function useRemovePlatformStaff(name: string) {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const refresh = useRefreshStaff();
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.staff.remove");
  return useMutation(
    trpc.platformStaff.remove.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: () => {
        toast.success(t("removed", { name }));
      },
      onSettled: refresh,
    }),
  );
}
```

### Task P4: A super admin exports an organization, deletes it for good, or erases one person or record

`/console/organizations/[organizationId]/data-protection` is a super admin's alone (spec 5, ADR 0023). Its exports
come first: ask for an export of everything the organization keeps (a job of the console process's, asked about
again every two seconds while it is being prepared), each export's state as a dot and a word, when it was asked for,
finished and is kept until, what it holds once done (parts, rows, people, files), and a done one's download links,
fetched only when asked for (each download is logged) and working for about 15 minutes. Then the deletion for good:
each condition shown met or not with what to do (cancelled by its lifecycle today; an export finished in the last
day), the button offered only once both hold, the organization's code typed to confirm, and the job's result read
from the platform log when it comes (deleted, with its counts, or kept and why). Then one person or record, on a
DPDP request the organization passes on: a removed member by id or a record of a person by type and id (the api's
own schema checks them first), exported at once with their details, audit entries and file links, then erased with
the code typed, the job's result from the log too. Refusals show their sentences, and a deletion's missing export
its own (the api's `EXPORT_FIRST` sentence is worded for an erasure). Once the organization is gone its exports stay
downloadable for their 7 days and nothing else is offered; support is told the screen is a super admin's and nothing
is asked of the api. The journeys run both of the console's jobs for real: an export downloads, and a purge waits
until the agency is cancelled and exported, then is queued with its code typed and its result shows.

**Create `apps/web/test/console/data-protection/agency.tsx`:**

```tsx
// An organization on the data protection screen, as the console's api gives it: its details with today's subscription
// status, its exports, and the platform log's entries a job's result is read from; and the screen rendered for it.
import type { OrganizationExport, PlatformLogEntry } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import type { SubscriptionStatus } from "@travel-crm/contracts/subscriptions";
import { DataProtectionScreen } from "@/console/data-protection/data-protection-screen";
import { stubApi, type Answer } from "../../support/api-stub";
import { platformStaff } from "../../support/platform-staff";
import { renderConsole } from "../plans/render-console";

export const organizationId = "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-000000000002";
const HOUR = 60 * 60 * 1000;

export function details(status: SubscriptionStatus | null = "active"): Answer {
  return {
    data: {
      organization: { id: organizationId, name: "Sharma Travels", code: "SHARMA", timeZone: "Asia/Kolkata" },
      profile: null,
      subscription: status === null ? null : { subscription: { organizationId, status }, payments: [] },
    },
  };
}

export function anExport(overrides: Partial<OrganizationExport> = {}): OrganizationExport {
  const requestedAt = new Date(Date.now() - 2 * HOUR);
  return {
    exportId: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000e1",
    organizationId,
    state: "done",
    requestedBy: platformStaff("super-admin").userId,
    requestedAt: requestedAt.toISOString(),
    completedAt: new Date(Date.now() - HOUR).toISOString(),
    expiresAt: new Date(requestedAt.getTime() + 7 * 24 * HOUR).toISOString(),
    parts: 3,
    rows: 1234,
    people: 4,
    files: 2,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

/** A platform log entry about the organization, newest first as log.list gives them. */
export function logged(action: string, overrides: Partial<PlatformLogEntry> = {}): PlatformLogEntry {
  return {
    id: crypto.randomUUID(),
    occurredAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    actorUserId: platformStaff("super-admin").userId,
    action,
    targetType: "organization",
    targetId: organizationId,
    targetOrganizationId: organizationId,
    before: null,
    after: null,
    ...overrides,
  };
}

export function openScreen(answers: Record<string, Answer>, staff = platformStaff("super-admin")) {
  const api = stubApi({
    "platform.organizations.get": details(),
    "platform.dataProtection.exports": { data: [] },
    "platform.log.list": { data: { entries: [], nextCursor: null } },
    ...answers,
  });
  renderConsole(<DataProtectionScreen organizationId={organizationId} />, staff);
  return api;
}
```

**Create `apps/web/test/console/data-protection/exports.test.tsx`:**

```tsx
// An organization's exports (spec 5, ADR 0023), a super admin's: each with its state, when it was asked for, finished
// and is kept until, and what it holds once done; asking for one; and downloading a done one through links that work
// for about 15 minutes. Support is told the screen is a super admin's; a deleted organization keeps its exports.
import { screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { platformStaff } from "../../support/platform-staff";
import { inputsTo } from "../plans/render-console";
import { anExport, openScreen, organizationId } from "./agency";

const { dataProtection: words } = messages.consolePlatform;

const itemOf = async (state: string) => within((await screen.findByText(state)).closest("li") ?? document.body);

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("the organization's exports", () => {
  it("shows the organization, and each export's state and what it holds", async () => {
    openScreen({
      "platform.dataProtection.exports": {
        data: [anExport(), anExport({ exportId: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000e2", state: "expired" })],
      },
    });
    expect(await screen.findByRole("heading", { level: 1, name: words.title })).toBeVisible();
    expect(await screen.findByText("Sharma Travels")).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByText("SHARMA")).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByRole("link", { name: words.backToOrganization })).toHaveAttribute(
      "href",
      `/console/organizations/${organizationId}`,
    );
    const ready = await itemOf(words.exports.states.done);
    expect(ready.getByText("3 parts")).toBeVisible();
    expect(ready.getByText("1,234 rows")).toBeVisible();
    expect(ready.getByText("4 people")).toBeVisible();
    expect(ready.getByText("2 files")).toBeVisible();
    expect(ready.getByRole("button", { name: words.exports.download })).toBeVisible();
    const expired = await itemOf(words.exports.states.expired);
    expect(expired.queryByRole("button")).toBeNull();
  });

  it("asks for an export of everything the organization keeps", async () => {
    const api = openScreen({});
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.exports.empty)).toBeVisible();
    api.answer("platform.dataProtection.exportOrganization", {
      data: anExport({ state: "requested", completedAt: null, parts: null, rows: null, people: null, files: null }),
    });
    api.answer("platform.dataProtection.exports", {
      data: [anExport({ state: "requested", completedAt: null, parts: null, rows: null, people: null, files: null })],
    });
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.exports.export }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.exports.asked)).toBeVisible();
    expect(inputsTo("dataProtection.exportOrganization")).toEqual([{ organizationId }]);
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.exports.states.requested)).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("downloads a done export through its short-lived links", async () => {
    const api = openScreen({ "platform.dataProtection.exports": { data: [anExport()] } });
    const ready = await itemOf(words.exports.states.done);
    api.answer("platform.dataProtection.downloadExport", {
      data: {
        exportId: anExport().exportId,
        linksExpireAt: new Date(Date.now() + 15 * 60 * 1000).toISOString(),
        parts: [{ part: 1, url: "https://storage.test/part-1" }],
        files: [{ fileId: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000f1", url: "https://storage.test/file-1" }],
      },
    });
    await userEvent.click(ready.getByRole("button", { name: words.exports.download }));
    expect(await ready.findByRole("link", { name: words.exports.part.replace("{number}", "1") })).toHaveAttribute(
      "href",
      "https://storage.test/part-1",
    );
    expect(ready.getByRole("link", { name: /0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000f1/ })).toHaveAttribute(
      "href",
      "https://storage.test/file-1",
    );
    expect(inputsTo("dataProtection.downloadExport")).toEqual([{ exportId: anExport().exportId }]);
  });

  it("tells support the screen is a super admin's, asking nothing of the api", async () => {
    openScreen({}, platformStaff("support"));
    expect(await screen.findByText(messages.errors.reasons.SUPER_ADMIN_ONLY)).toBeVisible();
    expect(inputsTo("dataProtection.exports")).toEqual([]);
    expect(inputsTo("organizations.get")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("keeps a deleted organization's exports downloadable, and offers nothing else", async () => {
    openScreen({
      "platform.organizations.get": { status: 404, reason: "ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND" },
      "platform.dataProtection.exports": { data: [anExport()] },
    });
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.deleted)).toBeVisible();
    expect(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: words.exports.download })).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: words.purge.action })).toBeNull();
    expect(screen.queryByRole("button", { name: words.subject.export })).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```tsx
// Deleting an organization for good (spec 5, ADR 0023): offered only once it is cancelled and has an export finished
// in the last day, each condition shown met or not with what to do; then the organization's code typed to confirm.
// The job's result, read from the platform log, is shown when it comes; a refusal shows its sentence, the purge's own
// for a missing export.
import { screen, within } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import { messages } from "@/i18n/messages";
import { inputsTo } from "../plans/render-console";
import { anExport, details, logged, openScreen, organizationId } from "./agency";

const { dataProtection: words } = messages.consolePlatform;
const HOUR = 60 * 60 * 1000;

async function openConfirm() {
  await userEvent.click(await screen.findByRole("button", { name: words.purge.action }));
  return within(
    screen.getByRole("alertdialog", { name: words.purge.confirmTitle.replace("{name}", "Sharma Travels") }),
  );
}

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
});

describe("deleting the organization for good", () => {
  it("says what stands in the way, and offers it only once nothing does", async () => {
    openScreen({
      "platform.organizations.get": details("active"),
      "platform.dataProtection.exports": {
        data: [anExport({ completedAt: new Date(Date.now() - 30 * HOUR).toISOString() })],
      },
    });
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.purge.notCancelled)).toBeVisible();
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.purge.notExported)).toBeVisible();
    expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.purge.action })).toBeDisabled();
  });

  it("deletes it once the code is typed, and shows the job's result", async () => {
    const api = openScreen({
      "platform.organizations.get": details("cancelled"),
      "platform.dataProtection.exports": { data: [anExport()] },
    });
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.purge.cancelled)).toBeVisible();
    const confirm = await openConfirm();
    const button = confirm.getByRole("button", { name: words.purge.confirm });
    expect(button).toBeDisabled();
    await userEvent.type(confirm.getByLabelText(words.confirmation.label.replace("{code}", "SHARMA")), "SHARMA");
    api.answer("platform.dataProtection.requestPurge", { data: { jobId: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000ab" } });
    api.answer("platform.log.list", {
      data: {
        entries: [
          logged("organization.purged", { before: { code: "SHARMA" }, after: { rows: 120, people: 3, files: 2 } }),
          logged("organization.purge-requested"),
        ],
        nextCursor: null,
      },
    });
    await userEvent.click(button);
    expect(inputsTo("dataProtection.requestPurge")).toEqual([{ organizationId, confirmation: "SHARMA" }]);
    expect(
      await screen.findByText(
        words.purge.purged.replace("{rows}", "120").replace("{people}", "3").replace("{files}", "2"),
      ),
    ).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("says the job kept the organization, and why", async () => {
    const api = openScreen({
      "platform.organizations.get": details("cancelled"),
      "platform.dataProtection.exports": { data: [anExport()] },
    });
    const confirm = await openConfirm();
    await userEvent.type(confirm.getByLabelText(words.confirmation.label.replace("{code}", "SHARMA")), "SHARMA");
    api.answer("platform.dataProtection.requestPurge", { data: { jobId: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000ab" } });
    api.answer("platform.log.list", {
      data: {
        entries: [
          logged("organization.purge-skipped", { after: { reason: "no-recent-export", status: "cancelled" } }),
          logged("organization.purge-requested"),
          logged("organization.purged", { after: { rows: 1, people: 1, files: 1 } }),
        ],
        nextCursor: null,
      },
    });
    await userEvent.click(confirm.getByRole("button", { name: words.purge.confirm }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.purge.skipped["no-recent-export"])).toBeVisible();
  });

  it("shows a refusal's sentence, the purge's own for a missing export", async () => {
    const api = openScreen({
      "platform.organizations.get": details("cancelled"),
      "platform.dataProtection.exports": { data: [anExport()] },
    });
    const confirm = await openConfirm();
    await userEvent.type(confirm.getByLabelText(words.confirmation.label.replace("{code}", "SHARMA")), "SHARMA");
    api.answer("platform.dataProtection.requestPurge", { status: 409, reason: "EXPORT_FIRST" });
    await userEvent.click(confirm.getByRole("button", { name: words.purge.confirm }));
    expect(await confirm.findByText(words.purge.notExported)).toBeVisible();
    expect(confirm.queryByText(messages.errors.reasons.EXPORT_FIRST)).toBeNull();
  });
});
```

```tsx
    await paste(words.subject.recordType, "traveller");
    await paste(words.subject.recordId, memberId);
    api.answer("platform.dataProtection.exportSubject", { data: { ...subjectExport, person: null, files: [] } });
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.subject.export }));
    expect(await screen.findByText("2 audit entries")).toBeVisible();
    expect(inputsTo("dataProtection.exportSubject")).toEqual([
      { organizationId, subject: { kind: "record", recordType: "traveller", recordId: memberId } },
    ]);
  });

  it("says what an id looks like before anything is sent", async () => {
    openScreen({});
    await screen.findByText("Sharma Travels");
    await paste(words.subject.memberId, "ravi");
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.subject.export }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.subject.idInvalid)).toBeVisible();
    expect(inputsTo("dataProtection.exportSubject")).toEqual([]);
  });

  it("erases them once the code is typed, and shows the job's result", async () => {
    const api = openScreen({});
    await screen.findByText("Sharma Travels");
    await paste(words.subject.memberId, memberId);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.subject.erase }));
    const confirm = within(screen.getByRole("alertdialog", { name: words.subject.eraseTitle }));
    await userEvent.type(confirm.getByLabelText(words.confirmation.label.replace("{code}", "SHARMA")), "SHARMA");
    api.answer("platform.dataProtection.requestErasure", { data: { jobId: "0199a000-0000-7000-8000-0000000000ac" } });
    api.answer("platform.log.list", {
      data: {
        entries: [
          logged("subject.erased", { targetType: "member", targetId: memberId }),
          logged("subject.erasure-requested", { targetType: "member", targetId: memberId }),
        ],
        nextCursor: null,
      },
    });
    await userEvent.click(confirm.getByRole("button", { name: words.subject.confirmErase }));
    expect(await screen.findByText(words.subject.erased)).toBeVisible();
    expect(inputsTo("dataProtection.requestErasure")).toEqual([
      { organizationId, subject: { kind: "member", memberId }, confirmation: "SHARMA" },
    ]);
  });

  it("shows the api's sentence when an erasure is refused", async () => {
    const api = openScreen({});
    await screen.findByText("Sharma Travels");
    await paste(words.subject.memberId, memberId);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button", { name: words.subject.erase }));
    const confirm = within(screen.getByRole("alertdialog", { name: words.subject.eraseTitle }));
    await userEvent.type(confirm.getByLabelText(words.confirmation.label.replace("{code}", "SHARMA")), "SHARMA");
    api.answer("platform.dataProtection.requestErasure", { status: 409, reason: "REMOVE_FIRST" });
    await userEvent.click(confirm.getByRole("button", { name: words.subject.confirmErase }));
    expect(await confirm.findByText(messages.errors.reasons.REMOVE_FIRST)).toBeVisible();
  });
});
```

**Create `apps/web/test/e2e/console-data-protection.spec.ts`:**

```ts
// Data protection (spec 5, ADR 0023): a super admin exports an agency, the console process runs the export's job, and
// the export downloads through its short-lived link; a purge waits until the agency is cancelled and has an export
// from the last day, then is queued with the agency's code typed, and the job's result shows. Each journey's agency is
// its own, so the purge deletes nothing another journey uses.
import { expect, test } from "./support/console";
import { consoleCall, openConsoleScreen } from "./support/console-platform";

const pageOf = (organizationId: string) => `/console/organizations/${organizationId}/data-protection`;

test("a super admin exports an agency and downloads the export", async ({ page, superAdmin, agency }) => {
  // The export is a job of the console process's, which takes its turn.
  test.slow();
  await openConsoleScreen(page, superAdmin, pageOf(agency.organizationId), "Data protection");
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Export everything" }).click();
  const ready = page.getByRole("main").getByRole("listitem").filter({ hasText: "Ready" });
  await expect(ready).toBeVisible({ timeout: 60_000 });
  await ready.getByRole("button", { name: "Download" }).click();
  const href = await ready.getByRole("link", { name: "Part 1" }).getAttribute("href");
  const part = await page.request.get(href ?? "");
  expect(part.ok()).toBe(true);
  // JSON lines: each of the organization's rows names its table.
  expect(await part.text()).toContain('"table"');
});

test("a purge waits for the agency to be cancelled and exported, then is queued with its code typed", async ({
  page,
  superAdmin,
  agency,
}) => {
  // Two jobs of the console process's, the export and the purge, each taking its turn.
  test.slow();
  await openConsoleScreen(page, superAdmin, pageOf(agency.organizationId), "Data protection");
  await expect(page.getByText("Cancel the organization's subscription first.")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText(/Export the organization's data first/)).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete for good" })).toBeDisabled();

  // Support cancels an agency from its organization's page; the console's api does the same here.
  await consoleCall(page, "subscriptions.cancel", { organizationId: agency.organizationId, reason: "Closing down" });
  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Export everything" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByRole("main").getByRole("listitem").filter({ hasText: "Ready" })).toBeVisible({
    timeout: 60_000,
  });
  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.getByText("Its subscription is cancelled")).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByText("An export finished in the last day")).toBeVisible();

  await page.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete for good" }).click();
  const confirm = page.getByRole("alertdialog", { name: `Delete ${agency.name} for good?` });
  await confirm.getByLabel(`Type ${agency.code} to confirm`).fill(agency.code);
  await confirm.getByRole("button", { name: "Delete for good" }).click();
  await expect(page.getByText(/^Deleted for good: /)).toBeVisible({ timeout: 60_000 });
});
```

```tsx
"use client";

// One organization's data protection (spec 5, ADR 0023), a super admin's alone: its exports, its deletion for good,
// and one person's or record's export and erasure. Once the organization is deleted, its exports stay downloadable for
// their 7 days, and nothing else is offered. Support is told the screen is a super admin's, and nothing is asked.
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { ArrowLeftIcon } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { ErrorState } from "@/components/error-state";
import { PageTitle } from "@/components/page-title";
import { Skeleton } from "@/components/ui/skeleton";
import { refusalOf } from "@/data/api-error";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../data/console-trpc";
import { consoleRoutes } from "../routes";
import { isSuperAdmin, useStaff } from "../session/staff-context";
import { ExportsSection } from "./exports-section";
import { PurgeSection } from "./purge-section";
import { SubjectSection } from "./subject-section";
import { useExports } from "./use-exports";

function Sections({ organizationId }: { organizationId: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.dataProtection");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const details = useQuery(trpc.organizations.get.queryOptions({ organizationId }));
  const exports = useExports(organizationId);
  const deleted = refusalOf(details.error)?.reason === "ORGANIZATION_NOT_FOUND";

  if (!details.data && !deleted) {
    return details.isError ? (
      <ErrorState message={t("loadFailed")} retryLabel={tCommon("tryAgain")} onRetry={() => void details.refetch()} />
    ) : (
      <Skeleton role="status" aria-busy="true" aria-label={t("loading")} className="h-40 w-full" />
    );
  }
  return (
    <>
      {details.data ? (
        <p className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-x-3">
          <span className="text-section font-semibold script-leading">{details.data.organization.name}</span>
          <span className="numbers text-muted-foreground">{details.data.organization.code}</span>
        </p>
      ) : (
        <p role="status">{t("deleted")}</p>
      )}
      <ExportsSection organizationId={organizationId} canExport={!deleted} />
      {details.data && <PurgeSection details={details.data} exports={exports.data} />}
      {details.data && <SubjectSection organization={details.data.organization} />}
    </>
  );
}

export function DataProtectionScreen({ organizationId }: { organizationId: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.dataProtection");
  const tErrors = useTranslations("errors");
  const superAdmin = isSuperAdmin(useStaff());
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-8">
      <div className="flex max-w-[65ch] flex-col gap-2">
        <Link
          href={consoleRoutes.organization(organizationId)}
          className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center gap-1 self-start text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
        >
          <ArrowLeftIcon aria-hidden="true" className="size-4" />
          {t("backToOrganization")}
        </Link>
        <PageTitle>{t("title")}</PageTitle>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("intro")}</p>
      </div>
      {superAdmin ? <Sections organizationId={organizationId} /> : <p>{tErrors("reasons.SUPER_ADMIN_ONLY")}</p>}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The last step of an erasure: the organization's code typed to confirm, then the request, which the console's job
// carries out once it has checked again. A refusal shows its sentence (remove them first, export them first, a
// record the law keeps or that holds no one's data).
import type { ErasureSubject, QueuedJob } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../data/console-trpc";
import { TypedConfirmation } from "./typed-confirmation";

export function ErasureDialog({
  organization,
  subject,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  onQueued,
}: {
  organization: { id: string; code: string };
  subject: ErasureSubject;
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  onQueued: (job: QueuedJob) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.dataProtection.subject");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const erase = useMutation(trpc.dataProtection.requestErasure.mutationOptions());
  const [typed, setTyped] = useState("");
  return (
    <AlertDialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogTitle>{t("eraseTitle")}</AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>{t("eraseDescription")}</AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        <TypedConfirmation code={organization.code} value={typed} onChange={setTyped} />
        {erase.isError && (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertDescription>{apiError(erase.error)}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel>{tCommon("cancel")}</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction
            // The final step of a destructive action is the one place red fills a button (DESIGN.md section 6).
            className="bg-status-bad-ink text-on-action hover:bg-status-bad-ink/90"
            disabled={typed !== organization.code || erase.isPending}
            onClick={(event) => {
              // Stay open until the api answers, so a refusal is shown here and the button can't be pressed twice.
              event.preventDefault();
              erase.mutate(
                { organizationId: organization.id, subject, confirmation: typed },
                {
                  onSuccess: (job) => {
                    onQueued(job);
                    onOpenChange(false);
                  },
                },
              );
            }}
          >
            {t("confirmErase")}
          </AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// One export of the organization: its state as a dot and a word, when it was asked for, finished and is kept until,
// what it holds once done, and, for a done one, its download links, each working for about 15 minutes (a download is
// logged, so the links are fetched only when asked for).
import type { OrganizationExport } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { StatusBadge, type StatusTone } from "@/components/status-badge";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { useInstantText } from "../log/instant";
import { useDownloadExport } from "./use-exports";

const toneOf: Record<OrganizationExport["state"], StatusTone> = {
  requested: "attention",
  done: "good",
  failed: "bad",
  expired: "neutral",
};

const COUNTS = ["parts", "rows", "people", "files"] as const;

export function ExportItem({ entry }: { entry: OrganizationExport }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.dataProtection.exports");
  const instantText = useInstantText();
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const download = useDownloadExport();
  return (
    <li className="flex flex-col gap-2 px-4 py-3">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-x-4 gap-y-2">
        <StatusBadge tone={toneOf[entry.state]}>{t(`states.${entry.state}`)}</StatusBadge>
        <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-3 text-caption text-muted-foreground">
          <span className="numbers">{t("requestedAt", { when: instantText(entry.requestedAt) })}</span>
          {entry.completedAt !== null && (
            <span className="numbers">{t("completedAt", { when: instantText(entry.completedAt) })}</span>
          )}
          <span className="numbers">{t("expiresAt", { when: instantText(entry.expiresAt) })}</span>
        </span>
      </div>
      {entry.state === "done" && (
        <span className="flex flex-wrap gap-x-4 text-label">
          {COUNTS.map((count) => {
            const value = entry[count];
            return value === null ? null : (
              <span key={count} className="numbers">
                {t(count, { count: value })}
              </span>
            );
          })}
        </span>
      )}
      {entry.state === "done" && !download.data && (
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          className="self-start"
          disabled={download.isPending}
          onClick={() => {
            download.mutate({ exportId: entry.exportId });
          }}
        >
          {download.isPending ? t("downloading") : t("download")}
        </Button>
      )}
      {download.isError && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertDescription>{apiError(download.error)}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}
      {download.data && (
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
          <p className="text-caption text-muted-foreground">
            {t("linksExpire", { when: instantText(download.data.linksExpireAt) })}
          </p>
          <ul className="flex flex-col">
            {download.data.parts.map((part) => (
              <li key={part.part}>
                <a
                  href={part.url}
                  className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline"
                >
                  {t("part", { number: part.part })}
                </a>
              </li>
            ))}
            {download.data.files.map((file) => (
              <li key={file.fileId}>
                <a
                  href={file.url}
                  className="inline-flex min-h-11 items-center text-primary underline-offset-4 break-all hover:underline"
                >
                  <span className="numbers">{t("file", { id: file.fileId })}</span>
                </a>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </div>
      )}
    </li>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// The organization's exports (spec 5, ADR 0023): everything it keeps, for it to take away before a deletion, each a
// job of the console's, kept for 7 days, and outliving a deletion. Newest first.
import { ArchiveIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { EmptyState } from "@/components/empty-state";

export function ExportsSection({ organizationId, canExport }: { organizationId: string; canExport: boolean }) {

  const exports = useExports(organizationId);
  const ask = useExportOrganization();

  const body = () => {
    if (exports.data) {

        )}

}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/data-protection/fresh-export.ts`:**

```ts
// Whether the organization has an export a deletion can rely on, as the api decides (hasFreshExport): one finished in
// the last day and still kept (an erasure withdraws every export, which then shows as expired).
import type { OrganizationExport } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";

const DAY_MS = 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

export function hasFreshExport(exports: OrganizationExport[], now: number = Date.now()): boolean {
  return exports.some(
    (entry) => entry.state === "done" && entry.completedAt !== null && now - Date.parse(entry.completedAt) <= DAY_MS,
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/data-protection/job-outcome.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// What a purge's or an erasure's job did, read from the platform log once it is asked for: the newest result entry
// (deleted, erased, or kept and why) above the newest request, asked again every two seconds until there is one. Only
// answers the log gave after the request count, so an earlier request's result is never taken for this one's.
import { useQuery } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import type { PlatformLogEntry } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../data/console-trpc";

const UNTIL_DONE_MS = 2000;

export interface JobAwaited {
  organizationId: string;
  /** The log's action for the request, e.g. "organization.purge-requested". */
  requested: string;
  /** The log's actions for its results. */
  results: readonly string[];
  /** The record the job is about, for an erasure. */
  targetId?: string;
  /** When the request was made, by this device's clock; null until it is. */
  since: number | null;
}

export function outcomeIn(entries: PlatformLogEntry[], awaited: JobAwaited): PlatformLogEntry | null {
  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (awaited.targetId !== undefined && entry.targetId !== awaited.targetId) continue;
    if (awaited.results.includes(entry.action)) return entry;
    if (entry.action === awaited.requested) return null;
  }
  return null;
}

export function useJobOutcome(awaited: JobAwaited): PlatformLogEntry | null {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const { since } = awaited;
  const log = useQuery({
    ...trpc.log.list.queryOptions({ targetOrganizationId: awaited.organizationId, limit: 20 }),
    enabled: since !== null,
    refetchInterval: (query) => {
      const fresh = since !== null && query.state.dataUpdatedAt > since;
      return fresh && query.state.data && outcomeIn(query.state.data.entries, awaited) ? false : UNTIL_DONE_MS;
    },
  });
  if (since === null || !log.data || log.dataUpdatedAt <= since) return null;
  return outcomeIn(log.data.entries, awaited);
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/data-protection/purge-dialog.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// The last step of a deletion for good: the organization's code typed to confirm, then the request, which the
// console's job carries out once it has checked everything again. A refusal shows its sentence; a missing export
// gets the deletion's own (the api's EXPORT_FIRST is worded for an erasure).
import type { QueuedJob } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import {
  AlertDialog,
  AlertDialogAction,
  AlertDialogCancel,
  AlertDialogContent,
  AlertDialogDescription,
  AlertDialogFooter,
  AlertDialogHeader,
  AlertDialogTitle,
} from "@/components/ui/alert-dialog";
import { refusalOf } from "@/data/api-error";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../data/console-trpc";
import { TypedConfirmation } from "./typed-confirmation";

export function PurgeDialog({
  organization,
  open,
  onOpenChange,
  onQueued,
}: {
  organization: { id: string; name: string; code: string };
  open: boolean;
  onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void;
  onQueued: (job: QueuedJob) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.dataProtection.purge");
  const tCommon = useTranslations("common");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const purge = useMutation(trpc.dataProtection.requestPurge.mutationOptions());
  const [typed, setTyped] = useState("");
  const refusal = purge.isError
    ? refusalOf(purge.error)?.reason === "EXPORT_FIRST"
      ? t("notExported")
      : apiError(purge.error)
    : null;
  return (
    <AlertDialog open={open} onOpenChange={onOpenChange}>
      <AlertDialogContent>
        <AlertDialogHeader>
          <AlertDialogTitle>{t("confirmTitle", { name: organization.name })}</AlertDialogTitle>
          <AlertDialogDescription>{t("confirmDescription")}</AlertDialogDescription>
        </AlertDialogHeader>
        <TypedConfirmation code={organization.code} value={typed} onChange={setTyped} />
        {refusal !== null && (
          <Alert variant="destructive">
            <AlertDescription>{refusal}</AlertDescription>
          </Alert>
        )}
        <AlertDialogFooter>
          <AlertDialogCancel>{tCommon("cancel")}</AlertDialogCancel>
          <AlertDialogAction
            // The final step of a destructive action is the one place red fills a button (DESIGN.md section 6).
            className="bg-status-bad-ink text-on-action hover:bg-status-bad-ink/90"
            disabled={typed !== organization.code || purge.isPending}
            onClick={(event) => {
              // Stay open until the api answers, so a refusal is shown here and the button can't be pressed twice.
              event.preventDefault();
              purge.mutate(
                { organizationId: organization.id, confirmation: typed },
                {
                  onSuccess: (job) => {
                    onQueued(job);
                    onOpenChange(false);
                  },
                },
              );
            }}
          >
            {t("confirm")}
          </AlertDialogAction>
        </AlertDialogFooter>
      </AlertDialogContent>
    </AlertDialog>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/data-protection/purge-section.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// Deleting the organization for good (spec 5, ADR 0023): offered once it is cancelled (by its lifecycle today) and has
// an export finished in the last day, each condition shown met or not with what to do; the console's job checks both
// again before it deletes anything. Its result comes from the platform log.
import type { OrganizationDetails, OrganizationExport } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { CircleCheckIcon, CircleDashedIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { formatCount } from "@/lib/format";
import { hasFreshExport } from "./fresh-export";
import { useJobOutcome } from "./job-outcome";
import { PurgeDialog } from "./purge-dialog";

const SKIP_REASONS = ["not-cancelled", "no-recent-export"] as const;

function Condition({ met, done, toDo }: { met: boolean; done: string; toDo: string }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.dataProtection.purge");
  const Icon = met ? CircleCheckIcon : CircleDashedIcon;
  return (
    <li className="flex items-start gap-2">
      <Icon
        aria-hidden="true"
        className={met ? "mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 text-status-good-ink" : "mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0 text-muted-foreground"}
      />
      <span>
        <span className="sr-only">{met ? t("met") : t("unmet")} </span>
        {met ? done : toDo}
      </span>
    </li>
  );
}

export function PurgeSection({
  details,
  exports,
}: {
  details: OrganizationDetails;
  exports: OrganizationExport[] | undefined;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.dataProtection.purge");
  const { organization } = details;
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const [since, setSince] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const outcome = useJobOutcome({
    organizationId: organization.id,
    requested: "organization.purge-requested",
    results: ["organization.purged", "organization.purge-skipped"],
    since,
  });
  // The state due today, which the api decides by (ADR 0021), not the one last recorded.
  const cancelled = details.subscription?.subscription.status === "cancelled";
  const exported = hasFreshExport(exports ?? []);

  let result: string | null = null;
  if (outcome?.action === "organization.purged") {
    const count = (field: string) => formatCount(Number(outcome.after?.[field] ?? 0));
    result = t("purged", { rows: count("rows"), people: count("people"), files: count("files") });
  } else if (outcome) {
    const reason = SKIP_REASONS.find((known) => known === outcome.after?.reason) ?? "no-recent-export";
    result = t(`skipped.${reason}`);
  }

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="organization-purge" className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="flex max-w-[65ch] flex-col gap-1">
        <h2 id="organization-purge" className="text-section font-semibold">
          {t("title")}
        </h2>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("intro")}</p>
      </div>
      <ul className="flex flex-col gap-2">
        <Condition met={cancelled} done={t("cancelled")} toDo={t("notCancelled")} />
        <Condition met={exported} done={t("exported")} toDo={t("notExported")} />
      </ul>
      <Button
        variant="destructive"
        className="self-start"
        disabled={!cancelled || !exported || since !== null}
        onClick={() => {
          setConfirming(true);
        }}
      >
        {t("action")}
      </Button>
      {since !== null && (
        <p role="status" className="max-w-[65ch]">
          {result ?? t("queued")}
        </p>
      )}
      {confirming && (
        <PurgeDialog
          organization={organization}
          open
          onOpenChange={setConfirming}
          onQueued={() => {
            setSince(Date.now());
          }}
        />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// What the organization keeps about one person or record, as the export gave it, for the person: who they were (for a
// member), how many audit entries name them, and their files, each with a link that works for 15 minutes.
import type { SubjectExport } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { formatFileSize } from "@/files/file-size";
import { formatDay } from "@/lib/format";
import { shownEmail } from "@/lib/shown-email";
import { useInstantText } from "../log/instant";
import { PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE } from "../platform-time-zone";

export function SubjectExportView({ exported }: { exported: SubjectExport }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.dataProtection.subject");
  const instantText = useInstantText();
  const { person } = exported;
  const dayOf = (iso: string) => formatDay(new Date(iso), { timeZone: PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE });
  const facts =
    person === null
      ? []
      : [
          { label: t("personFacts.name"), value: person.name },
          { label: t("personFacts.email"), value: shownEmail(person.email) },
          { label: t("personFacts.username"), value: person.username },
          { label: t("personFacts.role"), value: person.role },
          { label: t("personFacts.joined"), value: dayOf(person.joinedAt) },
          { label: t("personFacts.removed"), value: person.removedAt === null ? null : dayOf(person.removedAt) },
        ];
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-3 rounded-lg border px-4 py-3">
      <p className="text-caption text-muted-foreground">
        {t("exportedAt", { when: instantText(exported.exportedAt) })}
      </p>
      {facts.length > 0 && (
        <dl className="grid gap-x-4 gap-y-1 sm:grid-cols-[max-content_1fr]">
          {facts.map((fact) =>
            fact.value === null ? null : (
              <div key={fact.label} className="contents">
                <dt className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{fact.label}</dt>
                <dd className="break-words script-leading">{fact.value}</dd>
              </div>
            ),
          )}
        </dl>
      )}
      <p className="numbers text-label">{t("auditEntries", { count: exported.auditEntries.length })}</p>
      {exported.files.length === 0 ? (
        <p className="text-label text-muted-foreground">{t("noFiles")}</p>
      ) : (
        <ul className="flex flex-col">
          {exported.files.map((file) => (
            <li key={file.id} className="flex min-h-11 flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3">
              {file.downloadUrl === null ? (
                <span className="break-all">{file.fileName}</span>
              ) : (
                <a href={file.downloadUrl} className="text-primary underline-offset-4 break-all hover:underline">
                  {file.fileName}
                </a>
              )}
              <span className="numbers text-caption text-muted-foreground">{formatFileSize(file.sizeBytes)}</span>
              {file.sensitive && <span className="text-caption text-muted-foreground">{t("sensitive")}</span>}
              {file.deleted && <span className="text-caption text-muted-foreground">{t("deletedFile")}</span>}
              {file.downloadUrl === null && <span className="text-caption text-muted-foreground">{t("noLink")}</span>}
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
"use client";

// Who or what to export and erase: a removed member by id, or a record of a person by its type and id. Checked by the
// api's own schema before anything is sent, each problem under its field.
import type { ErasureSubject } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { CircleAlertIcon } from "lucide-react";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useId, useState } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Field, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldLabel, FieldLegend, FieldSet } from "@/components/ui/field";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { RadioGroup, RadioGroupItem } from "@/components/ui/radio-group";
import { toErasureSubject, type SubjectField, type SubjectProblem, type SubjectValues } from "./subject-values";

function SubjectInput({
  label,
  hint,
  value,
  problem,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string;
  hint?: string;
  value: string;
  problem: SubjectProblem | undefined;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.dataProtection.subject");
  const id = useId();
  const describedBy = [hint ? `${id}-hint` : null, problem ? `${id}-error` : null].filter((part) => part !== null);
  return (
    <Field data-invalid={problem !== undefined}>
      <FieldLabel htmlFor={id}>{label}</FieldLabel>
      <Input
        id={id}
        value={value}
        className="numbers"
        autoCapitalize="none"
        autoComplete="off"
        spellCheck={false}
        aria-invalid={problem !== undefined}
        aria-describedby={describedBy.length > 0 ? describedBy.join(" ") : undefined}
        onChange={(event) => {
          onChange(event.target.value);
        }}
      />
      {hint && <FieldDescription id={`${id}-hint`}>{hint}</FieldDescription>}
      {problem && (
        <FieldError id={`${id}-error`} className="flex items-start gap-1.5">
          <CircleAlertIcon aria-hidden="true" className="mt-0.5 size-4 shrink-0" />
          {t(problem)}
        </FieldError>
      )}
    </Field>
  );
}

export function SubjectForm({
  busy,
  onExport,
  onErase,
}: {
  busy: boolean;
  onExport: (subject: ErasureSubject) => void;
  onErase: (subject: ErasureSubject) => void;
}) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.dataProtection.subject");
  const id = useId();
  const [values, setValues] = useState<SubjectValues>({ kind: "member", memberId: "", recordType: "", recordId: "" });
  const [problems, setProblems] = useState<Partial<Record<SubjectField, SubjectProblem>>>({});
  const set = (field: SubjectField) => (value: string) => {
    setValues({ ...values, [field]: value });
  };
  /** The subject when the fields hold one, else null, with each problem shown. */
  const subject = (): ErasureSubject | null => {
    const result = toErasureSubject(values);
    setProblems(result.ok ? {} : result.problems);
    return result.ok ? result.subject : null;
  };
  return (
    <form
      noValidate
      className="flex flex-col gap-5"
      onSubmit={(event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const chosen = subject();
        if (chosen) onExport(chosen);
      }}
    >
      <FieldSet>
        <FieldLegend variant="label">{t("kind")}</FieldLegend>
        <RadioGroup
          value={values.kind}
          onValueChange={(kind) => {
            setValues({ ...values, kind: kind === "record" ? "record" : "member" });
            setProblems({});
          }}
        >
          {(["member", "record"] as const).map((kind) => (
            <Field key={kind} orientation="horizontal" className="min-h-11">
              <RadioGroupItem id={`${id}-${kind}`} value={kind} />
              <FieldLabel htmlFor={`${id}-${kind}`} className="font-normal">
                {t(kind)}
              </FieldLabel>
            </Field>
          ))}
        </RadioGroup>
      </FieldSet>
      {values.kind === "member" ? (
        <SubjectInput
          label={t("memberId")}
          value={values.memberId}
          problem={problems.memberId}
          onChange={set("memberId")}
        />
      ) : (
        <div className="grid gap-5 sm:grid-cols-2">
          <SubjectInput
            label={t("recordType")}
            hint={t("recordTypeHint")}
            value={values.recordType}
            problem={problems.recordType}
            onChange={set("recordType")}
          />
          <SubjectInput
            label={t("recordId")}
            value={values.recordId}
            problem={problems.recordId}
            onChange={set("recordId")}
          />
        </div>
      )}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-3">
        <Button type="submit" disabled={busy}>
          {t("export")}
        </Button>
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="destructive"
          disabled={busy}
          onClick={() => {
            const chosen = subject();
            if (chosen) onErase(chosen);
          }}
        >
          {t("erase")}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </form>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/data-protection/subject-section.tsx`:**

```tsx
"use client";

// One person's or one record's export and erasure (spec 5, DPDP; ADR 0023), on a request the organization passes on:
// export what it keeps about them (handed over at once, and logged; an erasure needs it from the last day), then
// erase them with the organization's code typed. The erasure's result comes from the platform log.
import type { ErasureSubject } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";
import { useMutation } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { useState } from "react";
import { Alert, AlertDescription } from "@/components/ui/alert";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../data/console-trpc";
import { ErasureDialog } from "./erasure-dialog";
import { useJobOutcome } from "./job-outcome";
import { SubjectExportView } from "./subject-export-view";
import { SubjectForm } from "./subject-form";

const SKIP_REASONS = ["organization-gone", "no-recent-export"] as const;

const recordIdOf = (subject: ErasureSubject) => (subject.kind === "member" ? subject.memberId : subject.recordId);

export function SubjectSection({ organization }: { organization: { id: string; code: string } }) {
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.dataProtection.subject");
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const exportSubject = useMutation(trpc.dataProtection.exportSubject.mutationOptions());
  const [erasing, setErasing] = useState<ErasureSubject | null>(null);
  const [requested, setRequested] = useState<{ subject: ErasureSubject; since: number } | null>(null);
  const outcome = useJobOutcome({
    organizationId: organization.id,
    requested: "subject.erasure-requested",
    results: ["subject.erased", "subject.erasure-skipped"],
    ...(requested === null ? {} : { targetId: recordIdOf(requested.subject) }),
    since: requested?.since ?? null,
  });

  let result: string | null = null;
  if (outcome?.action === "subject.erased") result = t("erased");
  else if (outcome) {
    const reason = SKIP_REASONS.find((known) => known === outcome.after?.reason) ?? "no-recent-export";
    result = t(`skipped.${reason}`);
  }

  return (
    <section aria-labelledby="subject-erasure" className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <div className="flex max-w-[65ch] flex-col gap-1">
        <h2 id="subject-erasure" className="text-section font-semibold">
          {t("title")}
        </h2>
        <p className="text-muted-foreground">{t("intro")}</p>
      </div>
      <SubjectForm
        busy={exportSubject.isPending}
        onExport={(subject) => {
          exportSubject.mutate({ organizationId: organization.id, subject });
        }}
        onErase={setErasing}
      />
      {exportSubject.isError && (
        <Alert variant="destructive">
          <AlertDescription>{apiError(exportSubject.error)}</AlertDescription>
        </Alert>
      )}
      {exportSubject.data && <SubjectExportView exported={exportSubject.data} />}
      {requested !== null && (
        <p role="status" className="max-w-[65ch]">
          {result ?? t("queued")}
        </p>
      )}
      {erasing !== null && (
        <ErasureDialog
          organization={organization}
          subject={erasing}
          open
          onOpenChange={(open) => {
            if (!open) setErasing(null);
          }}
          onQueued={() => {
            setRequested({ subject: erasing, since: Date.now() });
          }}
        />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/data-protection/subject-values.ts`:**

```ts
// Who or what an export and an erasure are about, as typed: a removed member by id, or a record of a person by its type
// and id, turned into the api's subject by its own schema (erasureSubject), each problem named for its field.
import { erasureSubject, type ErasureSubject } from "@travel-crm/contracts/platform";

export interface SubjectValues {
  kind: "member" | "record";
  memberId: string;
  recordType: string;
  recordId: string;
}

export type SubjectField = Exclude<keyof SubjectValues, "kind">;

/** Message keys in the "consolePlatform.dataProtection.subject" namespace. */
export type SubjectProblem = "idInvalid" | "recordTypeInvalid";

const problemOf: Record<SubjectField, SubjectProblem> = {
  memberId: "idInvalid",
  recordType: "recordTypeInvalid",
  recordId: "idInvalid",
};

const isField = (value: unknown): value is SubjectField =>
  value === "memberId" || value === "recordType" || value === "recordId";

export function toErasureSubject(
  values: SubjectValues,
): { ok: true; subject: ErasureSubject } | { ok: false; problems: Partial<Record<SubjectField, SubjectProblem>> } {
  const parsed = erasureSubject.safeParse(
    values.kind === "member"
      ? { kind: "member", memberId: values.memberId.trim() }
      : { kind: "record", recordType: values.recordType.trim(), recordId: values.recordId.trim() },
  );
  if (parsed.success) return { ok: true, subject: parsed.data };
  const problems: Partial<Record<SubjectField, SubjectProblem>> = {};
  for (const issue of parsed.error.issues) {
    const field = issue.path[0];
    if (isField(field)) problems[field] = problemOf[field];
  }
  return { ok: false, problems };
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/console/data-protection/use-exports.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// An organization's exports (dataProtection.exports), asked again every two seconds while one is being prepared by
// the console's job; asking for one, which refreshes them and says so in a toast; and a done one's download links.
import { useMutation, useQuery, useQueryClient } from "@tanstack/react-query";
import { useTranslations } from "next-intl";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useErrorMessage } from "@/lib/error-message";
import { useConsoleTRPC } from "../data/console-trpc";

const WHILE_PREPARED_MS = 2000;

export function useExports(organizationId: string) {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  return useQuery({
    ...trpc.dataProtection.exports.queryOptions({ organizationId }),
    refetchInterval: (query) =>
      query.state.data?.some((entry) => entry.state === "requested") ? WHILE_PREPARED_MS : false,
  });
}

export function useExportOrganization() {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
  const { apiError } = useErrorMessage();
  const t = useTranslations("consolePlatform.dataProtection.exports");
  return useMutation(
    trpc.dataProtection.exportOrganization.mutationOptions({
      onSuccess: () => {
        toast.success(t("asked"));
      },
      onError: (error) => {
        toast.error(apiError(error), { duration: Infinity });
      },
      onSettled: () => queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: trpc.dataProtection.exports.pathKey() }),
    }),
  );
}

/** A mutation, as the api's is: each download is logged. */
export function useDownloadExport() {
  const trpc = useConsoleTRPC();
  return useMutation(trpc.dataProtection.downloadExport.mutationOptions());
}
```

The seven tracks come together on `foundation/05b-screens`. Five merges are textually clean; Track A's meets Track S's
navigation and Track B's home screen, in two small conflicts. Once merged, eight web tests fail where tracks met: Track
S's organization tests start every query cache with a paid subscription, which hides the read-only answers Tracks B and
D stub; Track A's navigation item and audit sentences meet Track S's navigation test and Track D's new audit actions;
and on phones Track A's fifth destination brings the bottom bar's More button under the toasts. Then the changes the
tracks asked for in files they didn't own: the suspended Owner's staff list (`staff.list` is part of revoking), the
navigation by the plan's modules everywhere it is drawn (one hook), two refusal sentences that misled, the
notification emails' unsubscribe link (it named a page that doesn't exist), and the two-factor challenge, which no
longer offers platform staff to trust the device on the way to the console.

**`apps/web/test/e2e/support/accessibility.ts`**, the whole file:

```ts
// An accessibility check for a journey's screen (spec 12.1; DESIGN.md section 8 targets WCAG 2.2 AA), with axe.
import AxeBuilder from "@axe-core/playwright";
import { expect, type Page } from "@playwright/test";

/**
 * Waits for every transition and animation with an end (a toast sliding in, a dialog fading) to finish: axe measures
 * colours as they are drawn, so a toast half faded in reads as low contrast, its own and that of what it covers.
 * Skeletons pulse for ever and are left out.
 */
async function settledAnimations(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await page.waitForFunction(() =>
    document
      .getAnimations()
      .every(
        (animation) => animation.playState !== "running" || animation.effect?.getComputedTiming().endTime === Infinity,
      ),
  );
}

export async function expectAccessible(page: Page): Promise<void> {
  await settledAnimations(page);
  const results = await new AxeBuilder({ page })
    .withTags(["wcag2a", "wcag2aa", "wcag21a", "wcag21aa", "wcag22aa"])
    .analyze();
  expect(
    results.violations.map(({ id, nodes }) => ({ id, targets: nodes.map((node) => node.target.join(" ")) })),
  ).toEqual([]);
}
```

**Create `apps/web/test/shell/use-navigation-items.test.tsx`:**

```tsx
// The shell's navigation asks for the plan's modules (subscription.get) and hides what the plan lacks; until the
// subscription is known it hides nothing, as the api still refuses whatever the plan doesn't allow.
import { screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from "vitest";
import type { visibleNavigationItems } from "@/shell/navigation";
import { useNavigationItems } from "@/shell/use-navigation-items";
import { newQueryClient, paidSubscription, renderWithApi } from "../organization/api";
import { stubApi } from "../support/api-stub";

const visible = vi.hoisted(() => vi.fn<typeof visibleNavigationItems>(() => []));
vi.mock(import("@/shell/navigation"), async (original) => ({ ...(await original()), visibleNavigationItems: visible }));

function Items() {
  useNavigationItems();
  return <p>items</p>;
}

/** The modules the navigation was last asked to keep to. */
const modulesAsked = () => visible.mock.lastCall?.[1];

afterEach(() => {
  vi.unstubAllGlobals();
  visible.mockClear();
});

describe("useNavigationItems", () => {
  it("passes the plan's modules to the navigation", async () => {
    renderWithApi(<Items />, newQueryClient({ ...paidSubscription, modules: ["crm", "quotes"] }));
    await screen.findByText("items");
    expect(modulesAsked()).toEqual(["crm", "quotes"]);
  });

  it("passes no modules while the subscription is unknown, so nothing is hidden for the plan", async () => {
    stubApi({});
    renderWithApi(<Items />, newQueryClient(null));
    await screen.findByText("items");
    expect(visible).toHaveBeenCalled();
    expect(modulesAsked()).toBeUndefined();
  });
});
```

```ts
/** Whether an app path ("/console/plans?x=1") is the platform console's, where platform staff work. */
export function isConsolePath(path: string): boolean {
  const { pathname } = new URL(path, PATH_BASE);
  return pathname === routes.console || pathname.startsWith(`${routes.console}/`);
}
```

**Create `apps/web/src/shell/use-navigation-items.ts`:**

```ts
"use client";

// The destinations the shell shows this member: their role's, on their organization's plan (subscription.get's
// modules). Until the subscription is known nothing is hidden for the plan; the api refuses what it doesn't allow.
import { useMe } from "@/session/me-context";
import { useSubscription } from "@/subscription/use-subscription";
import { visibleNavigationItems, type NavigationItem } from "./navigation";

export function useNavigationItems(): NavigationItem[] {
  const me = useMe();
  const modules = useSubscription().data?.modules;
  return visibleNavigationItems(me, modules);
}
```

### Task I2: The console's and the agency's screens, recorded

Two ADRs record plan 5B's decisions: 0025 the console's screens (a section of the web app, one sign-in page,
two-factor for platform staff, impersonation from the console), 0026 the agency's (the lifecycle shown as check 2
decides, every refusal's sentence, files straight to storage, the logo on documents, the sample quotation and its share
links, the bell and push, the audit log, the profile and the checklist). The passages in ADRs 0011, 0012, 0014, 0015,
0019 and 0024 that left a piece "to plan 5" now say where it is. `CLAUDE.md` gains the web app's new rules and a
section for the console; the web app's, the api's and the integrations' READMEs list what 5B added. Nothing else
changes: plan 5C (the release) adds its own lines to `CLAUDE.md`'s command table and to `README.md`.

**Files:**
- Create: `docs/adr/0025-console-screens.md`, `docs/adr/0026-agency-screens.md`
- Modify: `docs/adr/README.md` (two rows), `docs/adr/{0011-files-and-storage,0012-pdfs-and-issued-documents,
  0014-notifications,0015-audit-log,0019-platform-console,0024-business-profile}.md`, `CLAUDE.md` (four bullets at the
  end of "The web app", and a new last section), `apps/web/README.md`, `packages/api/README.md`,
  `packages/integrations/README.md`, `packages/domain/src/notifications/README.md`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: every task's names, as built (Tasks G1-I1).
- Produces: none (documentation).

**`CLAUDE.md`**:

Replace:

```markdown
  in. Hiding a button is a convenience; the api checks every call.
```

with:

```markdown
  in. Hiding a button is a convenience; the api checks every call.
- A change's button asks `useWriteAccess(kind)` (`src/subscription/write-access.ts`, mirroring check 2) and, refused,
  is disabled with the hint as its description; taking access away is kind `"revoke"`, open while read-only (ADR 0026).
- A new `DomainError` reason needs its sentence in `errors.json`, a new audit action its sentence in `audit.json`
  (`actions.<entity>.<what happened>`), a new notification kind its entry in `src/notifications/preferences/kinds.ts`:
  a test fails otherwise.
- Files go from the browser straight to storage: `uploadFile()` (`src/files/upload.ts`) and the reusable
  `AttachmentsPanel`; the CSP allows `STORAGE_ORIGIN`, fixed at build time like `API_ORIGIN` and `CONSOLE_ORIGIN`.

## The platform console (`/console`, ADR 0025)

- A section of the web app: routes in `src/app/console/**`, code in `src/console/**`, which nothing else imports. It
  has its own query cache (memory only, never IndexedDB) and its own tRPC hooks (`useConsoleTRPC()`), typed by
  `type PlatformRouter` from `@travel-crm/api/platform` alone. `/api/platform/*` is rewritten to `CONSOLE_ORIGIN`
  (`http://localhost:3002` in development; the api's `console` command serves it) before `/api/*`.
- Platform staff sign in on the one sign-in page and land on `/console`; the step screens bring them back with
  `?next=`. They must use two-factor (`staffProcedure` refuses `SET_UP_TWO_FACTOR`), and the challenge never trusts the
  device on the way to the console.
- A console screen names its title as `"<screen>"` (the layout adds "· Console · <product>"), shows times in
  `PLATFORM_TIME_ZONE`, and checks `isSuperAdmin(useStaff())` only for convenience: the api refuses support.
- Journeys: `test/e2e/support/console.ts` gives `superAdmin` and `support` (two-factor on) and
  `signInToConsole(page, staff)`; the harness starts the api, the worker and the console process.
```
